description:

title: Senior Scala Engineer (B2B)
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 155 – 170 PLN / godz. netto

Responsibilities

As a Senior Scala Engineer at Nexi Digital, you will join the Cards team, which builds and runs e-commerce card payment acceptance and processing for Nexi's Payment Service Providers and large merchants. The team has full ownership of its solution – from code, through the AWS infrastructure, to operations in a PCI DSS-certified environment.

This is a role for someone who takes topics end-to-end: you pick up a problem, work it out with the team, ship it to production, and own it afterwards. You will work remotely with colleagues in four countries, so clear, proactive communication is as much part of the job as the code.

  • Developing and maintaining the main payment gateway written in Scala (Play Framework), running on AWS.

  • Building the new standalone Network Tokenization service, managing Visa, Mastercard and other scheme integrations and the token lifecycle.

  • Integrating with acquiring systems over ISO 8583 and with Visa and Mastercard APIs for network tokenization.

  • Building and maintaining the team's AWS infrastructure, together with the rest of the team.

  • Developing supporting components as AWS Lambdas in TypeScript and Python, and Python-based test tooling.

  • Working with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB.

  • Applying security practices required by PCI DSS across development, deployment, and operations.

  • Collaborating with other Relay teams (merchant management, notifications) in an English-speaking team spread across Sweden, Switzerland, Germany, and Finland.

  • Taking ownership of your topics end-to-end and driving them forward proactively, in close contact with the team.

  • Sharing knowledge and supporting less experienced engineers in the team.

Qualifications

  • Successfully completed university degree in computer science or a comparable field of study.

  • 5+ years of hands-on backend development, including production-critical systems.

  • Willingness to write production code in Scala – your language background doesn't matter; Scala experience is a strong plus.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, including building and maintaining it (not only using it).

  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

  • End-to-end responsibility – you own your topics from analysis through production and operations, not just the code you write.

  • Self-driven – you take ownership, find answers on your own, and move topics forward without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • Strong communication – you keep the team informed, ask early, say when something is at risk and feel comfortable working remotely with colleagues across several countries.

  • Fluency in Polish and very good communication in English.

  • Availability to work in a hybrid mode. Remote workers, we invite to the office once every month.


Nice to have

  • Commercial experience with Scala and Play Framework, or with another functional language.

  • Interest in joining the team's on-call rotation after onboarding (optional, not a requirement).

  • Frontend experience – full-stack profile is a great fit for the team.

  • Experience with TypeScript or Python (AWS Lambda).

  • Background in payments / card processing: acquiring, ISO 8583, card schemes, network tokenization.

  • Knowledge of PCI-DSS requirements.

About Nexi Digital

Nexi is Europe's PayTech company operating in high-growth, attractive European markets and technologically advanced countries. Listed on Borsa Italiana's MTA, Nexi has the scale, geographic reach and abilities to drive the transition to a cashless Europe. With its portfolio of innovative products, e-commerce expertise and industry-specific solutions, Nexi provides flexible support for the digital economy and the entire payment ecosystem globally, across a broad range of different payment channels and methods. Nexi’s technological platform and the best-in-class professional skills in the sector lets the company operate at its best in three market segments: Merchant Services & Solutions, Cards & Digital Payments and Digital Banking & Corporate Solutions. Nexi constantly invests in technology and innovation, focusing on two fundamental principles: meeting, together with its partner banks, customer needs and creating new business opportunities for them. Nexi is committed to supporting people and businesses of all sizes, transforming the way people pay and businesses accept payments. It offers companies the most innovative and reliable solutions to better serve their customers and expand. By simplifying payments and enabling people and businesses to build closer relationships and grow together, Nexi promotes progress to benefit everyone.

title: Come Grow With Us — Start a Career in Eye Care as an Ophthalmic Technician in South Austin and San Marcos
description:
Begin Your Career in Medical Eye Care – Training Provided!

Austin Retina Associates is looking for a driven, compassionate individual to join our 2025 & 2024 Austin Top Workplaces Team, supporting both South Austin and San Marcos locations! If you are ready to make a difference in the lives of others AND build a meaningful career this is your opportunity! Mission-Career-Growth-Benefits!

Our Team Members work side-by-side with our physicians to deliver exceptional retina care—helping protect and preserve patients’ sight every single day. Our technicians consistently share how rewarding this work is, knowing they make a real, lasting impact in people’s lives. If you are ready to be part of something bigger, join our #SavingSightSquad and help us have an influence—one patient at a time.


No prior ophthalmic experience? No problem. This is a fantastic entry point into the medical field! Recognized as a Healthcare Industry Top Workplaces 2025, we provide comprehensive training for individuals who are dependable, eager to learn, and are passionate about helping others.

A Day in the Life (aka What You’ll Do)
During triage, you will be the steady, compassionate presence to patients—assisting and guiding them through each step of their visit, listening to their concerns, and helping them feel at ease. As an Ophthalmic Technician, you are at the heart of patient care—gathering medical histories, performing vision testing and imaging, preparing exam rooms, documenting clinical notes, and supporting physicians during treatments and procedures.

Every interaction is a chance to live our core values: Serving with Compassion, Striving for Excellence, and Practicing Humility. You will connect with patients and teammates through clear, caring communication, helping create a smooth, supportive experience from start to finish.

Some days may include travel between clinics, early mornings, or later hours, with shared driving responsibilities—but you will always be supported by an incredible team. Along the way, you will build expertise in ophthalmic care and systems, all while making a meaningful difference in preserving patients’ sight. Our Team members rank Austin Retina at the top for Innovation, Meaningful Work, Strong Values, and Supportive Managers.

Other Important Details

  • Schedule will vary based on assigned location, tasks and/or assigned physician
  • Very occasional weekend days although schedule is generally Monday to Friday
  • Bilingual in Spanish a plus
  • Valid Texas driver’s license with satisfactory driving record
  • Hourly pay, FLSA non-exempt, eligible for overtime

Physical Demands and Requirements

Sitting up to 4 hours a day; standing and walking; talking and hear both in person and by telephone; using hands to finger, handle and feel objects or controls; reach with hands and arms. Regularly required to stoop, kneel, bend, crouch, and lift to 25 pounds on occasion. Specific vision abilities required by this job include viewing multiple computer screens, close vision, distance vision, depth perception, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus. Viewing images and operating computer devices constantly

Benefits and more!

  • Choice of 3 Medical plans, 1 is 100% employer paid after 60 days
  • HSA employer contribution
  • Dental & Vision
  • Company paid long-term disability and life insurance
  • 3% 401 (k) safe harbor contribution
  • Paid Time off plus 8 holidays
  • Short-term disability, voluntary life insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident, and pet insurance
  • Gym Membership
  • Annual reviews
  • Opportunities for growth
  • Fun rewards & recognition program and more!

title: Sr. Engineering Manager (Functional Safety & Product Cybersecurity)
description:
At Polaris Inc., we have fun doing what we love by driving change and innovation. We empower employees to take on challenging assignments and roles with an elevated level of responsibility in our agile working environment. Our people make us who we are, and we create incredible products and experiences that empower us to THINK OUTSIDE.

Position Overview:

Functional Safety and Product Cybersecurity are essential engineering capabilities that help Polaris create innovative products customers can trust. In this leadership role, you will guide a growing, multi-site Safety & Security organization and partner with Chief Engineers, product teams, technical experts, and business leaders to expand capability and product coverage. The position shapes pragmatic, risk-based approaches that meet applicable regulatory obligations while balancing customer value, engineering complexity, cost, and development speed. This is an opportunity to advance Foundational Safety & Quality through strong engineering judgment, clear decision-making, and fit-for-purpose practices tailored to the demands of powersports.


Key Responsibilities:

· Lead, develop, and grow the Functional Safety and Product Cybersecurity organization across sites and engineering disciplines.

· Own hiring, coaching, performance management, resource planning, succession planning, and capability development for the organization.

· Partner with Chief Engineers and technical experts to translate technical strategy into clear priorities, plans, and execution.

· Continue to improve risk-based, fit-for-purpose safety and cybersecurity approaches aligned with Polaris products, customers, markets, production scale, and operating conditions.

· Balance safety and cybersecurity risk, regulatory requirements, customer value, complexity, cost, and speed when guiding engineering and business decisions.

· Improve methods, tools, automation, governance, measures, and product coverage while maintaining an appropriate balance of rigor and efficiency.

· Build alignment across product engineering, business units, systems, electrical, software, validation, quality, compliance, legal, supply chain, and senior leadership.

· Translate complex product safety and cybersecurity risks into clear engineering and business decisions, distinguishing required actions, meaningful risk reduction, and proportionate responses.

· Integrate Functional Safety and Product Cybersecurity throughout the product lifecycle by prioritizing resources, providing early architecture and program input, and driving issue resolution and escalation.

· Ensure appropriate application of ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, and applicable regulatory requirements, and manage plans, budgets, commitments, support, roadmaps, and measures.


Desired Competencies:

· Leadership: You inspire, guide, and empower others to achieve their best by setting clear direction, fostering trust, and creating an environment where people feel supported, motivated, and accountable for delivering results.

· Critical Thinking: You analyze information objectively, evaluate options, and apply sound judgment to solve problems and make informed decisions.

· Collaboration: You work effectively with others across functions and levels, contributing to shared goals while respecting different perspectives.


Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Systems, or Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

· Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in product development, embedded systems, systems, software, electronics, Functional Safety, Product Cybersecurity, or a related engineering discipline, including a minimum of 5 years leading teams or complex cross-functional initiatives.

· Demonstrated success making and influencing risk-based decisions, translating technical risk for business leaders, developing talent, building capability, and leading change.

· Practical experience applying Functional Safety and Product Cybersecurity methods, including hazard and risk analysis, requirements, architecture, standards, and risk treatment throughout the product lifecycle.

· Experience with ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, HARA, TARA, embedded or connected products, or safety-related industries is preferred.

· Familiarity with secure product development, requirements management, ASPICE, AUTOSAR, DevSecOps, or comparable approaches is preferred.

· Experience building or scaling engineering capability is strongly preferred.

· This position is not eligible for sponsorship.


The starting pay range for Minnesota is $155,000 to $195,000 per year. Individual salaries and positioning within the range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography. While individual pay could fall anywhere in the range based on these factors, it is not common to start at the high end or top of the range.

To qualify for this position, former employees must be eligible for rehire, and current employees must be in good standing.

We are an ambitious, resourceful, and driven workforce, which empowers us to THINK OUTSIDE. Apply today!

At Polaris we put our employees first, by offering a holistic approach to their health and financial wellbeing. Polaris is proud to offer competitive compensation, including a market-leading profit-sharing plan that is fundamental to our pay-for-performance culture. At Polaris, employees are owners of the company through company contributions to our Employee Stock Ownership Plan and discounted employee stock purchases plan. Employees receive a generous matching contribution to 401(k), financial wellness education and consultation to plan for their financial future. In addition to competitive pay, Polaris provides a comprehensive suite of benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance, wellness programs, paid time off, gym & personal training reimbursement, life insurance and disability offerings. Through the Polaris Foundation and our Polaris Gives paid volunteer time off, we support employees who actively volunteer their time, efforts, and passions to improve the health and wellbeing of the communities in which they live, play and work. Employees at Polaris drive our success and are rewarded for their commitment.

About Polaris

As the global leader in powersports, Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) pioneers product breakthroughs and enriching experiences and services that have invited people to discover the joy of being outdoors since our founding in 1954. Polaris' high-quality product line-up includes the Polaris RANGER®, RZR® and Polaris GENERAL™ side-by-side off-road vehicles; Sportsman® all-terrain off-road vehicles; military and commercial off-road vehicles; snowmobiles; Slingshot® moto-roadsters; Aixam quadricycles; Goupil electric vehicles; and pontoon and deck boats, including industry-leading Bennington pontoons. Polaris enhances the riding experience with a robust portfolio of parts, garments, and accessories. Proudly headquartered in Minnesota, Polaris serves more than 100 countries across the globe.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 160 – 220 PLN / godz. netto

Senior Data Scientist

Predictive Modelling & Analytics | Machine Learning, Statistics & Probability

The Mission

West Code is looking for experienced Data Scientists interested in developing predictive models and solving complex analytical problems using data, statistics and machine learning.

We are particularly interested in people who combine strong analytical thinking with practical experience building models that support real business decisions.

Depending on the project, you may work on sports analytics, probability estimation, dynamic pricing, financial data analysis or other data-driven products.

What You’ll Work On

  • developing and improving predictive models

  • analysing large and complex datasets

  • feature engineering and data preparation

  • statistical modelling and probability estimation

  • building machine learning models for real-world applications

  • evaluating and improving model accuracy

  • model validation, testing and performance monitoring

  • exploring relationships and patterns in historical and real-time data

  • collaborating with Data Engineers, Software Engineers and business teams

  • supporting the deployment of analytical models into production environments

Technology

We are particularly interested in specialists working with:

  • Python

  • pandas, NumPy and SciPy

  • scikit-learn

  • SQL

  • XGBoost, LightGBM or similar ML frameworks

  • PyTorch or TensorFlow

  • statistical modelling and probability theory

  • cloud platforms and modern data environments

You don't need experience with every technology listed above. Strong foundations in statistics, analytical thinking and practical model development matter most.

Must Have:

  • 4+ years of experience in Data Science, predictive analytics or applied machine learning.

  • Strong Python skills (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn).

  • Solid understanding of statistical modelling, regression, classification and tree-based models.

  • Experience working with complex structured/tabular datasets.

  • Ability to evaluate, validate and improve predictive model performance.

  • Experience developing models intended for production environments.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with sports analytics, betting, gaming or financial modelling.

  • Monte Carlo simulations, probabilistic modelling or time-series forecasting.

  • XGBoost, LightGBM or similar frameworks.

  • Performance optimization in Python.

  • Experience working with historical event data and automated model testing.

Working Model

  • B2B cooperation

  • remote or hybrid work depending on the project

  • international engineering and analytical teams

  • projects involving predictive analytics and data-driven products

  • English used on most projects

B2B Rate

150–220 PLN/h + VAT

Final rate depends on seniority, modelling expertise, domain experience and project scope.

Why West Code

West Code builds technology teams around strong engineering, ownership and practical problem-solving.

We work on projects where data, statistical modelling and modern technology help solve complex business challenges.

Our approach combines experienced specialists, AI-enabled delivery practices and accountability for the quality of what we build.

We value people who can think critically, challenge assumptions and turn data into useful, reliable solutions.

If you enjoy building predictive models and solving interesting analytical problems, apply and let's talk.

title: Culinary Aide
description:
Assists with the preparation and service of food using proper food handling and food safety techniques for residents, as well as employees and special events. The Culinary Aide helps ensure that the food tastes good and is served at the proper temperature and in an attractive manner in accordance with established standards. Maintains a clean and safe working environment in accordance with established standards.


Note: All employees of Cascadia Healthcare are required to submit and be cleared to work in the facility per each

state’s specific background check requirements prior to contact with patients/residents.


Schedule is Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

11:00am-7:30pm


Essential Functions

  • Prepares and/or pre-portions food (such as beverages, salads, desserts, and other items assigned by the supervisor) for regular and therapeutic diets according to the planned menu for meals and snacks, as well as employees and special events, as instructed.
  • Prepares and/or portions food using proper food handling and food safety techniques according to established policies, procedures, guidelines, and regulations.
  • Ensures that food is served in an attractive, appetizing manner.
  • Utilizes standardized recipes to prepare menu items.
  • Ensures that meals and snacks are delivered to designated areas according to established time schedules.
  • Maintains the proper temperature of food during preparation and service. Records temperatures of food according to established procedures.
  • Serves resident meals/snacks accurately in accordance with the planned menu, the resident’s diet order, and food preferences.
  • Uses the correct portion control utensils during the preparation, pre-portioning, and service of food.
  • Labels, dates, and stores food properly according to established policies.
  • Ensures that refrigerator/freezer temperatures are within the appropriate range. Records temperatures on appropriate logs and reports any discrepancies to the supervisor.
  • Washes dishes, and other kitchen items. according to established procedures for manual and/or automatic dishwashing. Records water temperatures and/or sanitizer on designated logs. Reports any problems with proper water temperature or sanitizer to the supervisor in a timely manner.
  • Keeps work area clean and uncluttered during preparation and service of food.
  • Performs cleaning assignments according to established policies and utilizes the proper cleaning chemicals.
  • Performs duties using proper infection control techniques and using protective equipment as needed.
  • Ensures that dishes, and other needed items are readily available for the next meal. Stores dishes, and other kitchen items in the proper location in a way to prevent contamination.
  • Assists in receiving, storing, and verifying invoices for incoming food, supplies, etc. as indicated by the supervisor.
  • Reports inadequate stock levels to the supervisor in a timely manner.
  • Uses food supplies and equipment in an efficient and economic manner to prevent waste.
  • Maintains the security of the kitchen.
  • Performs all duties using proper safety techniques.
  • Operates equipment according to manufacturer and supervisory direction. Maintains equipment in clean and safe operating condition. Reports all equipment problems to supervisor promptly.
  • Completes tasks according to established time schedules.
  • Makes recommendations to the supervisor regarding improvements in recipes, menus, production and service of food, equipment, etc. to enhance the quality of the food service.
  • Works cooperatively as a team member with co-workers in all departments of the Nursing Center.
  • Interacts appropriately and in a positive manner with residents, families, and visitors.
  • Ensures punctuality and regular attendance for assigned shifts.


Other Functions

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Attends in-service education and applies instruction to job.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Knowledge of safe food preparation and handling techniques.
  • Ability to read and write at a level appropriate for the job.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with residents and their family members.
  • Ability to be patient and polite.
  • Ability to be accurate, concise and detail-oriented.
  • Ability to read, speak, understand and communicate effectively in English through verbal and written means.

title: Data Engineer with Airflow
description:

B2B: 1300 – 1550 PLN / dzień netto

Data Engineer — Apache Airflow

Make data workflows reliable. Help teams get more from their data.

Work model: Fully Remote

THE OPPORTUNITY

Reliable data workflows are the foundation of great data products. We’re looking for Data Engineers with strong Apache Airflow and Python expertise to help teams build, operate, and optimize dependable data pipelines.

In this role, you’ll combine hands-on technical knowledge with customer-facing engineering. You’ll advise data engineering teams, help them integrate their existing tools and infrastructure, and guide them through platform adoption — from initial configuration to production readiness.

If you enjoy troubleshooting complex technical challenges, sharing your knowledge, and helping others build better data workflows, this opportunity is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Support customers with Apache Airflow configuration, DAG development, scheduling, and troubleshooting.

  • Advise data engineering teams on designing and operating reliable workflows.

  • Help integrate Airflow with existing data ecosystems, including cloud data warehouses, transformation tools, and infrastructure-as-code solutions.

  • Support customers during platform onboarding, adoption, and production implementation.

  • Investigate complex Airflow-related issues and guide customers toward stable, reliable solutions.

  • Help identify root causes of production issues across distributed systems.

  • Deliver technical guidance and support customers in getting the most out of the platform.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to coordinate project scope, track progress, and align on priorities.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Apache Airflow, including DAG development, scheduling, and operational concepts.

  • Professional experience with Python.

  • Experience supporting or advising data engineering teams in a customer-facing technical role.

  • Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems and production issues.

  • Excellent communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset.

  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, distributed environment.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Practical knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized environments.

  • Experience with managed cloud services.

  • Familiarity with modern data stack technologies such as Snowflake and dbt.

  • Experience delivering technical workshops, training, or enablement sessions.

  • Production experience with Airflow administration.

  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Familiarity with SQL and analytical data workflows.

  • Background in technical support, platform engineering, or reliability engineering.

  • Experience supporting enterprise customers during onboarding and platform adoption.

WHY THIS ROLE?

  • Remote flexibility — collaborate with distributed teams from your preferred location.

  • Technical variety — work across workflow orchestration, Python, cloud services, and modern data stacks.

  • Engineering meets enablement — combine technical problem-solving with direct customer impact.

  • Meaningful challenges — help data engineering teams build more reliable and maintainable workflows.

READY TO MAKE DATA WORK BETTER?

If Apache Airflow, Python, and solving real-world data engineering challenges are your strengths, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help engineering teams build more reliable data workflows.

title: Enterprise Applications Administrator
description:
Apogee Services Inc.

The Senior Application Administrator is responsible for administering and supporting enterprise SaaS applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft products, particularly SharePoint Online and Azure DevOps.


This role serves as a trusted resource for business users and IT teams, independently troubleshooting issues, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring applications have clear ownership, appropriate access, documented support processes, and effective license management.


The administrator also helps optimize the enterprise application portfolio by identifying redundant tools, unused licenses, support gaps, and opportunities for automation. This role partners with business owners, Procurement, Security, Infrastructure, and Enterprise Architecture to ensure applications remain efficient, cost-effective, and aligned with enterprise standards.


Key Responsibilities

Microsoft Application Administration

  • Administer and support Microsoft enterprise applications, primarily SharePoint Online and Azure DevOps.
  • Manage SharePoint sites, permissions, sharing settings, and lifecycle activities.
  • Administer Azure DevOps organizations, projects, access, notifications, and configurations.
  • Coordinate application access through Microsoft Entra ID and enterprise identity processes.
  • Troubleshoot configuration, access, functionality, and integration issues.
  • Evaluate product updates, coordinate implementation, and maintain administrative documentation.

SaaS Onboarding and Lifecycle Management

  • Coordinate SaaS application onboarding, including business ownership, licensing, access, configuration, vendor contacts, and support readiness.
  • Establish support processes, escalation paths, and documentation for ongoing application support.
  • Maintain accurate application inventories, including owners, vendors, renewal dates, and support arrangements.
  • Manage application changes, renewals, transitions, and retirement activities, ensuring appropriate access removal and data retention.

Application Portfolio and Optimization

  • Maintain and evaluate the enterprise application portfolio, ensuring clear business ownership.
  • Assess application usage, business value, cost, functional overlap, and supportability.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate applications, eliminate redundancies, and retire unnecessary tools.
  • Partner with stakeholders to improve application efficiency and reduce overall costs.

Application Support and Service Delivery

  • Serve as an escalation resource for enterprise application questions and issues.
  • Own support tickets from initial assessment through resolution, coordinating with IT teams and vendors as needed.
  • Communicate effectively with users regarding issue status, next steps, and resolution.
  • Identify recurring issues and implement corrective actions to improve service delivery.
  • Develop knowledge articles and self-service resources to improve support consistency.
  • Participate in established support coverage and escalation processes.

Licensing and Vendor Management

  • Manage application licenses and subscriptions in partnership with Procurement and business owners.
  • Monitor license utilization, renewal dates, costs, and anticipated needs.
  • Identify unused licenses and opportunities to optimize subscription costs.
  • Provide usage and support data to inform purchasing decisions and vendor negotiations.
  • Coordinate vendor support cases, escalations, and service commitments.

Performance Metrics and Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and maintain application support KPIs aligned with the IT scorecard.
  • Monitor resolution times, response times, service-level performance, ticket backlogs, recurring incidents, and user satisfaction.
  • Track application inventory accuracy, business ownership, license utilization, and optimization efforts.
  • Analyze operational trends and report performance, risks, and improvement opportunities to IT leadership.
  • Use performance data to prioritize initiatives and improve service delivery.

Simplification and Automation

  • Identify opportunities to streamline administration, reduce manual work, and improve user experience.
  • Automate routine activities such as onboarding, access requests, reporting, notifications, and license reviews.
  • Leverage Power Automate, PowerShell, APIs, and native application capabilities to implement secure, documented solutions.
  • Evaluate existing enterprise tools before recommending new applications.
  • Share process improvements and best practices across IT teams.

Governance and Collaboration

  • Support access reviews, audit requests, and applicable SOX and ITGC requirements.
  • Apply least-privilege access principles in partnership with Security.
  • Build collaborative relationships with business stakeholders, IT teams, Procurement, and vendors.
  • Independently manage priorities, resolve issues, and escalate risks appropriately.
  • Maintain documentation and cross-training to ensure continuity of support.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience administering and supporting enterprise applications, including SaaS platforms.
  • Strong hands-on administration experience with SharePoint Online, Azure DevOps, or both.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and the broader Microsoft ecosystem.
  • Experience managing application configuration, permissions, licensing, vendor support, and lifecycle activities.
  • Proven troubleshooting skills with the ability to own support issues through resolution.
  • Experience maintaining application inventories and establishing business ownership.
  • Understanding of enterprise incident, problem, change, and access management practices.
  • Experience developing operational reports, support metrics, or dashboards.
  • Ability to implement automation and process improvements.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and independent problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Administration experience with both SharePoint Online and Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Power Automate, PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, or similar tools.
  • Experience with SaaS onboarding, single sign-on, and automated user provisioning.
  • Knowledge of application rationalization, software asset management, and license optimization.
  • Experience partnering with Procurement on renewals and vendor management.
  • Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting tools.
  • Experience in a SOX-controlled environment.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications or ITIL training.

Location: Remote, with approximately 5% travel based on business needs.

Compensation: $87,000 to $97,000 annually, plus annual bonus opportunity.

title: Shift Lead
description:
"You are applying for work with PM of Fond du Lac, a franchisee of Papa Murphy's, not Papa Murphy's International, Inc., or any of its affiliates. If hired, the franchisee will be your only employer. Franchisees are independent business owners who set their own wage and benefit programs that can vary among franchisees."


$9 - $12 / hr


Summary Description

The Shift Supervisor is responsible for all facets of the operation for the assigned shift of a Papa Murphy's store while continually promoting a culture that embraces the company's core values of Quality, Service, Integrity, and Team Work.

To successfully perform the Shift Supervisor role an individual must be proficient at all aspects of the Crew Member position, and able to accomplish the following, but not limited to, duties and responsibilities:

Duties and Responsibilities

• Exhibit readiness to take responsibility of a shift by wearing a clean and wrinkle-free, uniform and showing up at the assigned time.

• Ensure all team members are in uniform, clocked in, and at assigned work stations at assigned time.

• Perform a walk-through of the store to ensure that the store is clean, ready, stocked, etc. for business using the "Pre-Rush" Checklist.

• Supervise and work with team members to ensure that the store operates with proper guest service, product quality, food handling, sanitation, safety, and security guidelines.

• Accountable for all cash handling and ensure funds are properly secured.

• Ensure proper labor laws are adhered to including schedules and breaks.

• Complete all opening and closing duties and all appropriate checklists.

• Complete accurate shift and daily paperwork using the POS system.

• Maintain adequate prepped product for the shift and if product is not available, make sure product is available including but not limited to proofed crusts.

• Handle emergencies, guest complaints, equipment problems, product shortage, and team member problems as per the company standards and procedures.

• Communicate any shift problems to immediate supervisor.

• Train and develop team members on assigned shift as directed by immediate supervisor.

• Travel to the bank to make deposits, pick up change, and deposit slips.

• Supervise and operate the store independently if needed in the absence of the Store Manager for prolonged periods of time (e.g. vacations).

Required Qualifications

Education:

High school diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

Experience:

At least six months experience in QSR environment. Previous experience at the crew member position.

Degrees, Licensure, and/or Certification:

Food Handlers Card and/or Serve Safe Certified preferred but not required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Ability to communicate effectively.

Ability to read and apply fundamental math skills.

Build and maintain positive relationships with supervisors, co-workers and guests.

Demonstrate good written and oral communication skills.

Demonstrate excellent customer service skills.

Ability to manage various difficult or emotional customer situations.

Basic computer skills, including MS Word, Excel, Outlook, and POS.

Knowledge of store financials, P & L's, break-even analysis, food cost analysis, labor cost analysis and other financial information relative to store operations.

Other requirements:

• Regularly required to stand and walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms.

• Occasionally required to bend and stoop, kneel or crouch.

• Must be able to perform cleaning duties such as wiping tables and equipment, sweeping and mopping.

• Must be able to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds.

• Maintain punctual and regular attendance at work.

The intent of this job description is to provide a representation of the types of duties and responsibilities that will be required in this position and shall not be construed as a declaration of the total of the specific duties and responsibilities of any particular position. Employees may be directed to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description. title: Shift Manager
description:
About Us
Welcome to Urban - the home of great burgers & fries! Established in 2017 in Yorkshire, we are currently undergoing huge growth and expansion.

As one of our awesome Burger Masters, you will get a supportive workplace community, huge potential for career development & growth, as well as recognition for your hard work.

With on-the-job training and a lively, engaging atmosphere, no two days will feel the same! We are customer-centric, fast-paced, and collaborative and our goal is to serve great, fresh food.

Join us today to start the best chapter of your career!

Job Responsibilities
You will be a part of the Management team, along with your Assistant Manager, Deputy Manager and General Manager.

You will be responsible for assisting your Management team with the daily operations of your restaurant. In their absence, you will be required to oversee and manage both the kitchen and dining area to ensure a positive customer experience.

You will be expected to uphold our high standards and ensure we achieve our three priorities every day; Top Quality Food, Great Customer Service and Exceptional Cleanliness.

Your duties will include but are not limited to:

  • Ensuring guest satisfaction through the meeting of targets and standards

  • Cashing up and maintaining accurate financial records in the absence of your Management team
  • Upholding the highest standards of food hygiene and food preparation at all times through proper training, monitoring and observation
  • Collaborating with your management team to achieve sales, costs and performance targets

Job Requirements

Our ideal Shift Manager is positive, organised, ambitious and takes pride in their work. In order to be successful in this role, you should have:

  • 1-year minimum experience of management experience in a fast-paced restaurant environment

  • Strong people skills

  • Use of Microsoft Office (Word and Excel primarily)

Benefits

Working at URBAN is an opportunity to be a key part of a quick-growing, hands-on company. We offer several other great benefits, including:

  • Flexible work schedules
  • Huge opportunities for career development and progression

Apply today to start your new career journey with Urban Fresh Burgers & Fries!

title: Performance and Reward Expert
description:
Performance & Reward Expert III


Shape Reward Strategies That Help People Thrive

At ING, we believe people do their best work when they feel valued, recognized, and empowered to grow. We're looking for a Performance & Reward Expert III to help design and deliver people solutions that attract, motivate, and retain top talent across the organization. If you're passionate about compensation, benefits, performance management, and turning data into meaningful people decisions, we'd love to hear from you.


Role Summary

As a Performance & Reward Expert III, you will play a key role in developing and enhancing our reward and performance frameworks. You will partner with stakeholders across the business to support compensation programs, annual pay reviews, incentive schemes, job evaluation initiatives, and performance management processes.

You will combine strong analytical skills with a deep understanding of people practices to ensure our reward programs remain competitive, equitable, compliant, and aligned with business objectives.


About the Team

You'll join a collaborative HR expertise team focused on designing people solutions that enable the organization to attract, develop, reward, and retain talent. The team works closely with business leaders, HR partners, and global stakeholders to deliver impactful programs that support both employee experience and business success.



What You'll Be Doing

  • Support the delivery of annual compensation processes such as merit increase and variable remuneration
  • Contribute to the design and enhancement of compensation, benefits, incentive, and recognition programs.
  • Support performance management policies, processes, and implementation activities.
  • Partner with senior business and HR stakeholders, including HR leadership, to provide expert guidance on Performance & Reward matters.
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and governance standards.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of HR frameworks, policies, and tools.
  • Provide Performance & Reward support to Hubs Philippines and key growth markets, including Spain and Türkiye, with market-specific knowledge considered an advantage

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards, Performance Management, or a related HR specialty.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in HR systems are required.
  • Experience supporting pay reviews, incentive programs, job evaluation, or reward program design.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly and effectively to different audiences.
  • Experience using data visualization and reporting tools to support decision-making.
  • Strong attention to detail, planning, and organizational skills.
  • A collaborative mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.

What We Offer

At ING, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact on how we recognize, reward, and empower our people. You'll work alongside talented colleagues in a supportive and inclusive environment where innovation, curiosity, and professional growth are encouraged.

We believe in giving our employees the freedom and trust to deliver meaningful outcomes while continuously developing their careers.


How to Apply

Click the Apply button on our career site and submit your application through Workday. We look forward to learning more about you and how your experience can help shape the future of our people programs.


Diversity & Inclusion

Don't meet 100% of the qualifications? Don't let that hold you back. Research consistently shows that many talented candidates only apply when they meet every requirement. If this role excites you and your experience is relevant, we'd encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we're looking for.


Job Application Safety Reminder ⚠️

We're seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

  • Apply only through official ING platforms and our Workday recruitment system.
  • Verify the sender's email address carefully. Legitimate communications will come from@ing.com and/or@myworkday.com domains.
  • ING will never request payment, banking information, or financial transfers as part of the recruitment process. If someone asks for this information, it is a scam.

About ING

With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today

title: Senior Risk Analyst (f/m/x)
description:
Wynagrodzenie

Introduction to offer:

We are looking for a Senior Risk Analyst to support the development and maintenance of market risk models and methodologies for accurate traded risk measurement and management. In this role, you will work within a dynamic team environment, contributing to the ongoing enhancement of risk models and collaborating with international colleagues. This position offers a hybrid work mode (6 times per month in Cracow office), allowing flexibility in your work location across various cities including Cracow, Warsaw, Katowice, Kielce, Rzeszow, and Lodz.

Your tasks:

  • Developing and enhancing market risk models according to regulatory and internal risk management requirements

  • Contributing to the maintenance of models through monitoring tests, periodic calibration, and performance assessment

  • Implementing model development and monitoring in the in-house Python-based Analytics library

  • Analyzing real-world data to develop and enhance risk models, ensuring understanding of features, assumptions, and limitations

  • Participating in the validation of models, identifying target market data and completing validation within agreed timelines

  • Engaging in ad-hoc projects, providing timely and coherent information as needed

  • Suggesting and documenting improvements to existing frameworks to automate systems and enhance controls

  • Explaining model details clearly to non-technical stakeholders, assisting in the ongoing usage of models in daily risk management

Requirements:

  • Minimum qualification in Maths, Engineering, Science, Finance, or Business Management, or relevant 5 years of experience in risk management

  • Good understanding of statistics and strong analytical skills

  • Proficiency in Python for analysis and prototyping, along with Excel VBA skills

  • Basic knowledge of market risk measures and derivative products

  • Ability to process and analyze large volumes of data under pressure and tight timelines

  • Effective communication skills and the ability to work flexibly in an international team

  • Desire to learn and grow in a challenging environment

  • Advanced level of English

Nice-to-have requirements:

  • Professional qualifications such as FRM, PRM, or CFA Levels are advantageous

  • Knowledge of C++ is a plus

The company is made up of people with a huge client base in the country and abroad, for whom we build projects from scratch (UX, UI, frontend, backend, mobile) or in part. title: Pharmacy Assistant (Full Time)
location: Kennebecasis Drugs, 1 Marr Road, Rothesay, New Brunswick, Canada, Canada
description:
Are We The Right Fit For You?

Are you passionate about helping others?

Do you enjoy making a positive difference in people’s lives?

We certainly do.

We believe that work should be a place where you can have fun while doing something meaningful.

We’re currently looking for like-minded team members to join our movement, which is to provide the very best care and service to our clients.

We don’t claim to be perfect, but we try very hard to be there for our clients when they need us and to guide them through the changes in their lives.

As healthcare becomes more complex, we continually need more like-minded people to join our team and serve our clients.

If this sounds like you, you may be a great fit for our team!

Why Join Us?

There are lots of great employers out there, and we believe that there is a right place for everyone.

We believe in lifelong learning. We’ve been out in front of, and welcomed, the major evolutions in the profession over the past 40 plus years. And we are excited about what’s next.

We understand that your time at work is an important part of your life’s journey, so we believe in providing ongoing training and opportunities for you to grown your skills and advance with us.

Taking care of those that provide care is important to us. As part of our benefits package, we provide annual fitness membership subsidy and access to mental health support and other counselling, should you ever need it.

We want you to be supported during your entire time with us and beyond, so we provide a competitive benefits package including health, dental and life insurance, drug coverage, and a pension plan.

How You’ll Spend Your Time…

Like any role, there are, of course, some precise duties that will need to be performed and we’ll tell you all about them.

But there are a few simple things that will determine your success on our team, and your enjoyment in your role.

Quite simply, treat your fellow team members as you would like to be treated.

Our most successful team members will always aim to do what is right, while keeping things simple and predictable. Our team members continuously look for opportunities to improve the clients’ experience. It’s what we believe in.

What You Will Bring To The Team

Our team is client-focused and believes in a high level of attention to detail, professionalism and discretion. We value diverse backgrounds and what that brings to our team and we want to hear more about what makes you unique.

In addition to what makes you unique, there are a few basics that we require for this role:

  • You enjoy working in a team environment while providing exceptional care to clients
  • A passion for helping people in a healthcare environment

Your Role

While we all collaborate to provide services to clients, we all play different roles to make this happen. You’ll contribute by:

  1. Collaborating with other team members to provide timely high quality healthcare service delivery and exceptional client experience.
  2. Having meticulous attention to detail in your work.
  3. Being highly client service focused

Prescription & Dispensing Support

  • Prepare and package prescriptions under pharmacist and/or pharmacy technician supervision
  • Input accurate patient and prescription data into pharmacy software
  • Process refill requests and third-party billing

Client Service & Experience

  • Greet and assist customers in a friendly and professional manner and refer clinical questions to the pharmacist
  • Collect prescription information accurately
  • Handle cash and card transactions, assist with OTC product inquiries

Inventory Management

  • Receive, stock, and organize medications and health supplies
  • Track expiration dates and manage returns or waste in compliance with regulations
  • Monitor stock levels and help with order preparation

Administrative Duties

  • Maintain patient records and filing systems
  • Assist in managing faxes and coordinating follow-ups

In addition to what makes you unique, there are a few basics that we require for this role:

  • Previous community pharmacy experience is preferred
  • A passion for community pharmacy practice
  • Dedication to client care and making people’s lives better

Sound Interesting? Here’s The Next Step…

If this sounds like you, and you are interested in learning more, we’d love to hear from you!

Please attach a current resume and let us know why you would be a good fit.

In closing, thank you for taking the time to review this opportunity, and for considering us in your career journey. We wish you all the best and appreciate your interest in joining the Kennebecasis Drugs Pharmacy Team.

title: Reception Manager
description:
About THE NICI Collection

THE NICI Collection is a luxury lifestyle hotel group inspired by some of the world's most iconic destinations, bringing exceptional hospitality, outstanding food and drink, and unforgettable guest experiences to some of the UK's most desirable locations.

What began with THE NICI Bournemouth, our original flagship hotel inspired by Miami's South Beach, has grown into an exciting collection of destination-led properties. In June 2026, the collection expanded with the opening of THE NICI Newquay, inspired by Italy's Amalfi Coast, and THE NICI New Forest, inspired by the luxury and charm of the Hamptons.

This is just the beginning of our growth journey, and we're looking for talented individuals who want to build their careers with an ambitious and expanding hospitality brand.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced, inspiring, and guest-focused Reception Manager to lead our Front Office team. As the face of the hotel, you will be responsible for delivering an exceptional guest experience from arrival to departure, ensuring the reception operation runs efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of luxury hospitality.

You will lead, motivate, and develop the reception team, driving service excellence, operational efficiency, and team performance while working collaboratively with all hotel departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day operation of the Front Office, ensuring exceptional guest service at every touchpoint.

  • Recruit, train, coach, and develop the reception team to deliver consistently outstanding performance.

  • Foster a positive, engaging, and high-performing team culture.

  • Ensure smooth and efficient check-in and check-out procedures.

  • Handle guest feedback, enquiries, and complaints with professionalism, resolving issues promptly and effectively.

  • Monitor reception performance, implementing improvements to maximise guest satisfaction and operational efficiency.

  • Prepare departmental rotas, manage staffing levels, and control labour costs.

  • Ensure all reservations, billing, cash handling, and administrative procedures are completed accurately.

  • Work closely with Housekeeping, Reservations, Food & Beverage, Maintenance, and other departments to ensure a seamless guest journey.

  • Maintain full compliance with company policies, health and safety procedures, and brand standards.

  • Drive upselling opportunities and maximise revenue through effective room allocation and guest engagement.

  • Produce departmental reports and contribute to operational meetings and business planning.

About You

  • Previous experience as a Reception Manager or senior Front Office leader within a hotel environment.

  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to inspire, motivate, and develop high-performing teams.

  • Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences in a luxury hospitality environment.

  • Outstanding communication, organisational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong commercial awareness with an understanding of revenue opportunities and operational performance.

  • Calm, professional, and confident in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining the highest service standards.

  • Experience using hotel property management systems is essential.

  • Flexible approach to working shifts, including evenings, weekends, and bank holidays when required.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary plus service charge.

  • Staff discounts across THE NICI Collection.

  • Career development opportunities within a growing luxury hospitality brand.

  • Meals on duty.

  • Ongoing training and leadership development.

  • A supportive and collaborative working environment.

Join THE NICI Collection and be part of an exciting growth story where exceptional hospitality, great people, and memorable experiences are at the heart of everything we do. If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and have the leadership skills to inspire exceptional service, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 100 – 140 PLN / godz. netto

  • B2B Contract, 12 months + possible extensions

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Work model: 2-3 days/week in the office, the rest remotely

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET Developer to take ownership of a business-critical enterprise integration platform responsible for consolidating shipment, status event and customs declaration data from multiple transport management systems. The role combines backend development, batch processing, SQL Server optimisation, enterprise integrations and production support, with an additional opportunity to contribute to the future modernisation of an established .NET Framework solution.

Your responsibilities

  • Maintaining and extending an established C# / .NET Framework 4.x Windows Service.

  • Supporting multi-threaded, timer-driven import and export processing.

  • Investigating and resolving production issues across application and data layers.

  • Developing and optimising SQL Server / T-SQL solutions.

  • Maintaining stored procedures and Dapper-based repositories.

  • Analysing and resolving locking, deadlock and performance issues.

  • Maintaining mappings between enterprise canonical data models.

  • Working with shipment, status event, milestone and customs declaration data.

  • Maintaining WCF / SOAP integrations, service references, bindings and endpoints.

  • Working with XML serialisation, XSD schemas and XSLT mappings.

  • Providing 2nd and 3rd level production support.

  • Reprocessing and correcting data when required.

  • Working closely with business, operations, integration and master data teams.

  • Contributing to unit and integration testing, code reviews and technical documentation.

  • Supporting the modernisation roadmap of the platform.

  • Contributing to potential migration towards modern .NET, standard Dependency Injection and REST-based integrations.

Must-have experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a .NET Developer / Software Engineer.

  • Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET Framework 4.x.

  • Experience developing and maintaining Windows Services.

  • Strong understanding of multithreading and the Task Parallel Library.

  • Very good knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL.

  • Experience with:

    • stored procedures,

    • query tuning,

    • transactions,

    • isolation levels,

    • locking,

    • deadlock analysis.

  • Hands-on experience with WCF and SOAP services.

  • Experience configuring service references, bindings and endpoints.

  • Good knowledge of XML, XSD and XSLT.

  • Experience with object mapping tools such as AutoMapper.

  • Familiarity with lightweight ORMs such as Dapper.

  • Experience with Dependency Injection / IoC frameworks.

  • Experience with unit testing and mocking frameworks.

  • Git experience.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

  • Very good English communication skills.

Nice to have

  • Experience with freight forwarding, transport or logistics systems.

  • Experience working with shipment, milestone or customs-related data.

  • Experience modernising legacy .NET Framework applications

  • Knowledge of Worker Services.

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure Functions or App Services.

  • Docker and Kubernetes experience.

  • Agile / Scrum experience.

title: Software Engineer (Mid-level, Full-stack)
description:
Wynagrodzenie
umowa o pracę: 10000 – 14000 PLN / mies. brutto

We're looking for a Mid-level Software Engineer to join the development team behind our in-house Transport Management System (TMS). The TMS is the operational backbone of Egala: dispatchers plan trucks, trailers and drivers on it, drivers use its mobile app on the road, and finance invoices customers and pays drivers from the data it holds. It is a mature, actively developed product – a Python/Django backend, a React frontend, a Flutter driver app and a long list of integrations with telematics, routing, ferry and accounting providers, shipped to production roughly every week.

This is a full-time, on-site role in our office in Żerniki near Poznań, with the option of occasional remote work when the need arises. We offer an employment contract, a B2B contract is open to negotiation if needed. You will own features end to end: from a ticket, through data model, API and UI, to tests, release notes. If you write solid Python and JavaScript, are comfortable reading a large codebase you did not write, and like the idea that a routing bug shows up as a truck on the wrong side of a border, we'd love to meet you.

Your responsibilities

  • Build features end to end – take a ticket from the backlog (e.g. a new planning screen, an invoicing rule, a driver-app flow) through Django models and migrations, REST endpoints, React/MobX UI, tests and changelog.

  • Integrate external systems – connect and maintain integrations with telematics providers, routing and map services, ferry and tunnel operators, tachograph data (DDD files), Microsoft 365 and accounting software over REST, SFTP and webhooks.

  • Keep production healthy – pick up Sentry errors and user-reported incidents, reproduce them on a staging copy of production data, fix the root cause and prevent regressions.

  • Care about performance – the system runs on a large PostgreSQL database; you will profile slow queries, design indexes, move work to Celery background tasks and keep screens fast.

  • Write and maintain tests – Django unit tests for backend logic and Cypress end-to-end tests for user flows are part of every change, not an afterthought.

  • Review and be reviewed – participate in merge-request reviews on GitLab, follow and improve team conventions and help keep the codebase coherent as it grows.

  • Clarify before you build – ask questions when a ticket is unclear, occasionally directly with the dispatchers or finance staff who will use the feature; propose simpler solutions when the request can be met with less.

  • Modernise responsibly – help with the gradual upgrades of the stack (Python, Django, React, TypeScript adoption) without stopping feature delivery.

  • Communicate and stay Agile – priorities change; give short, regular updates on progress and blockers and re-plan when needed.

Our stack at a glance

  • Backend – Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Celery with RabbitMQ and Redis, a WebSocket service (ASGI) for live updates, Gunicorn/gevent, Sentry and New Relic.

  • Frontend – React, MobX and mobx-spine models, JavaScript, Semantic UI and styled-components, Leaflet maps.

  • Mobile – TARA driver app in Flutter; several small native Android (Kotlin) tools such as the panic button and fleet-device managers.

  • Integrations – many third-party systems: telematics, routing/toll calculation, ferries and Eurotunnel, tachograph downloads, Microsoft Graph, Exact Online, Firebase push, SFTP exchanges, AI-assisted order intake and receipt verification.

  • Tooling – Docker Compose for the whole environment, GitLab CI with per-branch instant staging environments, Cypress (several hundred end-to-end specs).

  • Scale – about 250k lines of backend code, 200k lines of frontend code, 100+ screens, releases roughly every week.

Our requirements

  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience, with Python and Django used in a production system.

  • Solid relational database skills – PostgreSQL preferred: data modelling, writing and reading non-trivial SQL, understanding query plans and indexes, safe schema migrations on live data.

  • Practical frontend experience with React and a state-management library (MobX, Redux or similar), modern JavaScript.

  • Experience integrating third-party APIs – REST and ideally SOAP; authentication flows (OAuth2, bearer tokens, API keys); retries and error handling for systems you do not control.

  • Familiarity with asynchronous and scheduled work – Celery or an equivalent task queue; understanding what should and should not run inside a web request.

  • Comfortable with Docker, Git and a CI pipeline (GitLab CI or similar) as daily tools; able to debug a failing pipeline on your own.

title: Staff/Principal Global Business Partner
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

We are looking for an experienced Staff / Principal Global Business Partner (GBP) to partner with site leadership.

This is a senior HR business partnering role for an individual who can operate at both strategic and operational depth, translating business priorities into organization, workforce and talent strategies while staying closely connected to leaders and teams at the point of operations.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, bringing strong business acumen, independent judgment and people expertise to complex organizational decisions. The role requires someone who can see around corners, connect signals across the organization and external environment, challenge constructively, and translate insights into practical actions that improve organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, talent readiness and employee experience.

The GBP will work closely with the Global Executive Business Partner (GEBP), Country People Leaders (CPLs), site and functional leadership, HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Employee Relations and People Services to ensure global People strategies translate effectively into the local operating environment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic People & Organization Leadership

  • Translate business strategy, operating priorities and future capability requirements into a clear, forward-looking people agenda.
  • Advise leaders on organization design, workforce strategy, capability building, leadership effectiveness and talent priorities, connecting near-term business requirements with longer-term organizational health.
  • Understand the business beyond the People agenda, including operating priorities, organizational dependencies, workforce dynamics and external market factors that may affect talent or execution.
  • Anticipate emerging organizational and workforce risks and opportunities, bringing forward recommendations before issues become critical.
  • Balance global consistency with local effectiveness, adapting implementation approaches while preserving the intent of enterprise frameworks.

Senior Leader Partnership & Coaching

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leaders, bringing an independent point of view grounded in business context, data and organizational insight.
  • Coach leaders through complex organization, talent, leadership and workforce decisions.
  • Constructively challenge assumptions and help leaders understand the people and organizational implications of business decisions.
  • Strengthen leadership effectiveness and accountability, particularly during periods of rapid growth, transformation or uncertainty.
  • Build strong relationships deeper into the organization to maintain a direct understanding of business realities and emerging people issues.

Organization & Talent

  • Shape organization and workforce plans that build the capabilities required for future business needs.
  • Lead succession planning, talent reviews, leadership pipeline development and critical talent interventions.
  • Identify organizational capability gaps and mobilize the appropriate development, hiring, movement or succession strategies.
  • Enable talent movement and development across organizations, sites and geographies rather than solving talent needs within organizational boundaries alone.
  • Partner with leaders to strengthen team effectiveness, leadership capability and organizational health.

Team Member Insights, Culture & Change

  • Maintain a strong pulse on the organization through employee listening, leader engagement, workforce data and close connection to operations.
  • Connect seemingly separate employee, talent, organizational and business signals to identify underlying themes and emerging risks.
  • Help leaders navigate complex change with clarity, empathy and execution discipline, ensuring that decisions are understood and translated effectively through the organization.
  • Strengthen leadership capability to communicate context, listen effectively and close the loop on employee feedback.
  • Partner with leaders to anticipate how AI will reshape work, roles, skills and workforce needs, translating implications into talent and organization strategies.
  • Champion Micron values and foster an inclusive, accountable and high-performing culture.

Data, Insights & Decision Quality

  • Using AI to enhance workforce analytics and organizational insights to move leaders from data to diagnosis to action, rather than simply reporting metrics.
  • Integrate quantitative data with qualitative signals from leaders, team members and the external environment to develop a holistic view of organizational health.
  • Identify trends, challenge assumptions and develop executive-ready insights that support timely leadership decisions.
  • Define measurable outcomes for key people priorities and maintain accountability for impact and follow-through.
  • Partner across People teams to improve data quality and decision effectiveness where gaps exist.

Enterprise Partnership & Execution

  • Connect effectively across GEBP, CPL, site leadership, COEs, Employee Relations, People Services and other partners to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Bring the right expertise together around business problems rather than acting as the sole owner of every HR activity.
  • Influence global and regional People solutions by bringing forward local business insights and implementation learnings.
  • Lead critical People initiatives from diagnosis through execution, ensuring clear ownership, disciplined follow-through and measurable outcomes.
  • Simplify and prioritize work to focus HRBP capacity on activities that create the greatest business and organizational value.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • At least 8 to 10 years HR Business Partner experience supporting complex, matrixed and operationally intensive organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organization, workforce, talent and leadership matters.
  • Strong business acumen with demonstrated ability to understand operating priorities and translate them into people and organization implications.
  • Strong AI fluency, with demonstrated ability to apply AI to improve work, generate insights and support business and people decisions.
  • Demonstrated capability in several of the following areas:
    • organization design and effectiveness
    • strategic workforce planning
    • talent and succession management
    • leadership coaching
    • organizational change
    • employee engagement and organizational health
    • people analytics and insight generation
  • Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to challenge constructively without relying on positional authority.
  • Strong judgment and comfort operating independently in complex or ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to translate complex issues into concise recommendations and executive-level narratives.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting semiconductor, manufacturing, engineering or other complex technology/operations environments.
  • Experience working within a multinational, matrixed organization across multiple countries or sites.
  • Experience partnering across global and local HR teams and translating enterprise programs into locally effective solutions.

title: Scala Engineer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 14000 – 20000 PLN / mies. netto

Synerise is not just another tech company. It is a space where our brilliant team consequently brings technology change to the business world and instead of following known paths, we are creating a new one – a next-generation, fully personalized and AI-driven customer experience.

We successfully deliver an all-in-one tool - Synerise. An ever-evolving behavioral data platform, enhanced by AI to generate outstanding ROI in more than 30 markets for industry leaders in Retail, Banking, eCommerce, Automotive, Insurance, and Telco, processing more than 150 billion transactions annually. However, we don't limit ourselves solely to this solution. We're building BaseModel - a foundation model for behavioral data embedded within a novel platform for enterprise Data Science teams, that is another step on our path to create innovation in AI and demonstrate its potential for the business world.

Having such great solutions, we are looking for a highly motivated Scala Engineer to join our brave and brilliant Synerise Team. See if you fit our diverse and dynamic environment, where we constantly evolve together with the growth of our clients.

Our Backend Team works with Scala, Kafka, ElasticSearch, ScyllaDB, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes. Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger), structured logging, and rich metrics are core to how we build and operate services — not an afterthought. Both Backend and Frontend teams are supported by dedicated QA and Infrastructure teams. We like to experiment, and we have the environment to do it. We use AI coding assistants (Claude, Copilot) as a daily part of our workflow — not to replace engineering judgment, but to move faster on the parts that benefit from it.

The platform handles up to 28k API requests per second at peak with p95 latency under 100ms. You'd be joining the team responsible for event processing and analytics — the part of the platform that ingests, processes, and stores customer behavior events at scale, and powers the analytical capabilities our clients rely on. It's the data backbone the rest of the product is built on.

You'll be working on software that:

  • Ingests and processes high-volume streams of customer behavior events from online and offline commerce — peaks at 30k events per second.

  • Reliably stores and organizes event data for downstream analytics and querying.

  • Powers the analytics module that turns raw events into insights for our clients.

  • Has to stay reliable, ordered, and correct under load.

  • Runs on a microservices architecture on Kubernetes.

What will you do on a daily basis?

  • Design architecture and patterns for processing and storing high-volume datasets.

  • Build software with a strong focus on performance and optimization.

  • Translate complex functional and technical requirements into detailed designs.

  • Analyze large data stores and surface meaningful insights.

What will make us a perfect match?

  • Strong Scala skills, with production experience using an effect system (Cats Effect, ZIO, or Akka/Pekko) — we care more about depth of understanding than years on your CV.

  • Experience designing or significantly contributing to event-driven systems in production — comfortable reasoning about ordering guarantees, idempotency, replay, and failure modes.

  • Strong working knowledge of Apache Kafka — not just as a consumer API, but understanding partitioning, delivery guarantees, consumer groups, rebalance issues, and consumer lag.

  • Hands-on Kubernetes skills sufficient to independently diagnose pod issues, resource limits, HPA behavior, and networking.

  • Experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases, with a clear sense of when each is the right tool.

  • Experience with microservices architecture, including awareness of common pitfalls (distributed transactions, eventual consistency, contract versioning).

  • Ability to design for scale and growth — partitioning, sharding, tenant isolation, backpressure.

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in distributed environments.

What will convince us even more?

  • Solid grasp of JVM internals — GC behavior, profiling, heap and thread dump analysis.

  • Experience with observability: distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger), structured logging, metrics — for us this is core to daily work.

  • Experience working in a cloud environment (Azure / GCP) — our stack runs primarily on AKS.

What can we provide for you?

  • Work on a production-grade, large-scale system used by enterprise customers worldwide.

  • Real technical challenges around performance, data volume, and distributed systems.

  • Opportunities for continuous technical growth and deeper ownership over system design.

  • Support from experienced engineers and a strong engineering culture.

  • Influence on architectural and technical decisions within your team.

  • Proven experience in FinOps, cloud financial management, or cloud cost optimization, ideally in enterprise-scale cloud environments.

  • Hands-on experience with native AWS and GCP cost management and optimization tools, including cost and usage analysis, reporting, and forecasting.

  • Practical knowledge of AWS Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, GCP committed use discounts, and other cloud commitment models, including their impact on cloud expenditure and cost optimization.
