title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantages to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the Verification & Validation team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for experienced engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

We are looking for a Design Verification Engineer to join the team to support our mission and culture. This key role will impact the organization by delivering automation and verification needs to scale next generation Fabric interconnect and/or Memory Controller.

This role is targeting an immediate start date.

#SCHIE #CSME



Responsibilities

  • Contributes to verification of fabric interconnect or memory subsystem.

  • Develop UVM/System Verilog based verification environments at the integration level, apply Formal based methods, and run and debug simulations to drive quality.

  • Innovate to improve verification efficiency through methodologies or tools.

  • Applies industry leading generative AI solutions to verification work.

  • Demonstrates Microsoft core values: Customer Focus, Adaptability, Collaboration, Growth Mindset, Drive for Results, Influence for Impact, Judgement, and Diversity & Inclusion.



Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field OR equivalent experience.
Other Requirements:
  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
    • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
    • Citizenship & Citizenship Verification: This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) or Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U.S. permanent residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Coherent Hub Interface (CHI), Advanced Microcontroller Bus Architecture (AMBA), JEDEC, DFI protocols.
  • Demonstrated understanding of one or more of the following: memory controller, fabric interconnects, coherency, virtualization, security, interrupts, PCIe, CXL, and/or protocol bridges.
  • Demonstrated software development and automation skills, with proficiency in Python and TypeScript.
  • Understanding of product cycles from definition to silicon, including writing IP/block or subsystem level test plans, developing tests, debugging failures and coverage signoff.
  • Academic experience creating test benches, checkers and stimulus using Universal Verification Methodology (UVM), System Verilog Test Bench (SVTB), and optionally Python based post-processing checking.
  • Experience applying generative AI to day-to-day tasks.
  • 3+ years of related technical engineering experience
    • OR Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience or internship experience
    • OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience or internship experience.
    • OR Doctorate degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 0+ year(s) technical engineering experience or internship experience.

title: Group Financial Reporting Manager
description:
Group Financial Reporting Manager

Location: Remote

Department: Finance

Contract type: Permanent / Full-time

    About the role

    We’re looking for an experienced Group Financial Reporting Manager to join our Group Finance department.

    The Group Financial Reporting Manager is responsible for the Group's monthly management accounts and annual statutory accounts, and leads on fraud prevention and financial compliance policies across Activate Group and its subsidiaries. The role works closely with the Director of Finance, the external auditors and the leadership of each business to deliver accurate, timely reporting and a strong control environment.

    Activate Group is a growing UK business with 1,000+ team members nationwide. This is an exciting opportunity to build a long-term career with a company that values its people and offers genuine development and progression opportunities.


    Key responsibilities

    Management Accounts:

    • Prepare the monthly management accounts pack for the Group and review the packs provided for each entity, including the consolidated income statement, balance sheet and cash flow, with clear variance and KPI commentary.
    • Own the month end close process and the management accounts timetable, ensuring deadlines are met across all Group companies.
    • Review balance sheet reconciliations and manage intercompany reconciliations and eliminations on consolidation.
    • Report performance against budget and forecast, prepare the finance content of the monthly board pack and provide financial reports to stakeholders as needed.
    • Champion process improvement and efficiency in the finance function, identifying opportunities to use automation and intelligent tools to simplify reporting, reduce manual work and improve accuracy.

    Statutory Accounts and Audit:

    • Prepare the annual consolidated statutory accounts for the Group and the statutory accounts for each subsidiary under FRS 102, meeting all Companies House filing deadlines.
    • Review and refine the stats preparation process (currently in word).
    • Lead the year end audit as the main contact for the external auditors, managing the audit timetable and leading on key areas of audit focus and complex accounting matters.
    • Investigate and present a conclusion on technical matters, including one off queries, writing papers for the audit process and accounting papers throughout the year.
    • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and regulatory requirements, and keep stakeholders up to date on accounting policies and processes.

    Tax and Regulatory Filings:

    • Prepare and file VAT returns and other regulatory documents.
    • Stay updated with changes in tax laws and regulations.
    • Assist in tax planning and ensure timely compliance with tax obligations.
    • Work with the Groups tax advisors to prepare the group tax computations

    Fraud, Governance and Compliance:

    • Own the Group's anti-fraud, anti-bribery and whistleblowing policies, reviewing them at least annually and maintaining a register of finance and compliance policies.
    • Lead the Group’s fraud risk assessment and maintain reasonable prevention procedures under the failure to prevent fraud offence in the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023.
    • Design, document and test key financial controls across the Group, reporting findings and agreed actions to the Director of Finance.
    • Coordinate fraud awareness training for team members and lead or support investigations into suspected fraud or control failures.
    • Monitor regulatory changes, including the Bribery Act 2010 and the Criminal Finances Act 2017, and update Group policies and processes accordingly.


    Skills and experience

    • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with at least 4 years post-qualified experience
    • Experience of working in an accountancy practice preferred
    • Experience preparing consolidated statutory accounts under FRS 102 and monthly management accounts for a multi-entity group
    • Strong understanding of financial regulations and accounting principles
    • Proficiency in financial software and Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel
    • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
    • Confidence to influence and challenge leaders across the Group
    • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
    • High level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results-orientation

    Desirable (but not essential):

    • Experience of internal controls, risk management or fraud prevention frameworks


    Benefits

    We believe in rewarding our people for the great work they do. When you join Activate Group, you can expect:

    • 33 days holiday, including bank holidays
    • Personal health cash plan – claim back the cost of everyday healthcare such as dental and optical check-ups
    • Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental pay
    • Life assurance at three times your basic salary
    • Free breakfasts and fresh fruit
    • A birthday surprise for everyone


    What you can expect from us

    At Activate Group, we want everyone to have the tools and support they need to do their best work. We’re an innovative business that continuously reviews and improves our systems, processes and ways of working, making sure they support our teams to do their jobs effectively.

    Every role at Activate Group is aligned to our wider business vision and purpose – making someone’s bad day better. You’ll understand how your role contributes to the bigger picture and how your work helps deliver excellent outcomes for customer and partners.

    We believe work should be enjoyable. We make time to celebrate success, recognise achievements and bring people together at team events and company-wide celebrations. We’ll also support your ongoing development through regular feedback and career planning.

    Whether you’re based in one of our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough or Huddersfield, working at an Activate Accident Repair (AAR) site, or working from home, you’ll be part of a supportive culture where people are encouraged to succeed.


    A bit about us

    Activate Group is a fast-growing business approaching 1,000 team members nationwide.

    We work with some of the UK’s largest fleets and insurance companies, supporting drivers that have been involved in road incidents through our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough and Huddersfield.

    We manage every step of the repair journey - repairing vehicles at our own Activate Accident Repair (AAR) body shops, as well as through a UK-wide network of trusted independent repair partners.

    We also work with the UK’s largest vehicle manufacturers, supporting their approved repair programmes, and deliver innovative technology solutions to fleets, vehicle repair centres and dealerships.


    Our purpose & values

    Our purpose underpins everything we do: Make someone’s bad day better

    Our values define how we work with our team members, customers and suppliers:

    • Make it happen – Be accountable. Take the initiative, work fast, and do a great job.
    • Strive for better – Be bold. Challenge the norm - make small improvements often.
    • Win together – Be a team player. Win together, learn together, respect each other.

title: Senior Change Manager
description:
Total Comp: $90,000 - $140,000 Yearly (base + bonus)
Also Known As: Change Management Lead
Location: Overland Park, KS
Workplace: In person (not remote)
Company: DataMap
Client Work:

About DataMap

DataMap.ai is an AI-first technology consulting and solutions company focused on enterprise systems and automation. We build applications, implement ERP platforms, and provide managed services and production support at scale. Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth companies such as Google. They rely on us to modernize operations and automate workflows in ways that produce measurable business value.

DataMap is growing fast. We value innovation and collaboration, we work with urgency, and we reward speed, precision, and accountability. Teams here have the authority to solve complex enterprise problems and deliver results.

Summary

Ready to set the change strategy for enterprise transformations?

Every platform DataMap implements and every product we build changes how people work, and the change pays off only when they adopt it. As a Senior Change Manager, you lead the people side of DataMap's largest programs and transformations and are accountable for their change strategy and adoption results. The programs include rollouts of the partner platforms we implement (Coupa, D365, NetSuite, SAP, and Boomi), adoption of our own products (Positron, RoboApprover, Itemova EDI SaaS), and change inside DataMap itself. You advise executive sponsors, lead the change managers on your programs, and plan the change for every internal group and for the suppliers, customers, and other implementation service providers each program reaches. This role is in person at DataMap's office in Overland Park, Kansas, and is not remote.

Change management is a career path at DataMap, from Change Manager to Senior Change Manager to Director of Change Management. Beyond the Director level, the path continues into executive leadership, such as DataMap's Vice President, Operations & Delivery. We promote from within, and moving up depends on performance and on the needs of the business.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Change strategy and execution

  • Define the change strategy and integrated change plan for each program with program leadership, covering sponsorship, the case for change, the transition, and how the new way is reinforced and sustained.
  • Run program-level impact, readiness, and stakeholder assessments across every internal group and third party the program affects, and weigh the forces for and against the change to plan countermeasures.
  • Set up the AI workflows your programs run on, such as prompt libraries for impact assessments, communications, and training content, sentiment analysis of pulse surveys, and adoption analytics. Measure the gains and bring what works to the Director of Change Management.

Stakeholder engagement

  • Advise executive sponsors and people managers on leading their organizations through the change, and present readiness and adoption risk to steering committees.
  • Set the third-party change strategy with the client leaders responsible for each relationship: segment suppliers and customers, time each onboarding wave to the internal go-live it depends on, and agree with the other implementation service providers who owns which change, training, and communication work.
  • Lead and coach the change managers on your programs, along with the champion networks, trainers, and client and vendor teams that carry the change.
  • Find expansion needs across your programs, such as more training, adoption support, or follow-on phases, and pursue them with program leadership and Sales.

Communication, training, and adoption

  • Set each program's communication and feedback plan: WIIFM ("What's in it for me?") messaging for each group, town halls, Q&A sessions, brown bag lunches, two-way pulse surveys, and a RACI matrix (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed) for change decisions.
  • Own the training strategy for each program, from the needs analysis across every impacted role to the curriculum, delivery mix, train-the-trainer and super-user model, and proficiency measures, for internal users and third parties alike.
  • Track adoption, proficiency, and sustained usage on program dashboards, find the root cause of resistance at program scale, and adjust the plan.

Education and Experience

  • At least 6 years of experience leading organizational change management or technology adoption, including leading other change managers.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A track record of program-level change on enterprise system rollouts, measured in adoption, proficiency, and sustained usage.
  • Experience setting the training strategy for large rollouts and leading change for third parties such as suppliers, customers, or other implementation service providers alongside a client's own teams.
  • Experience advising executive sponsors and presenting to steering committees.
  • Strong stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and resistance management skills.
  • Experience building AI tools into a change team's workflow and measuring the results.
  • Ability to work in person at DataMap's office in Overland Park, Kansas. This role is not remote.
  • Knowledge of established change models, especially Lewin's change model and Kotter's 8 steps, as well as Prosci's ADKAR model, the Bridges Transition Model, the McKinsey 7-S Framework, or force field analysis, is a plus. Prosci or CCMP certification is a strong plus.
  • Consulting or professional services experience, and SaaS or ERP rollouts (such as Coupa, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or Salesforce), are a plus.

Benefits & Perks

  • Total compensation of base salary plus bonus.
  • Unlimited vacation and a flexible work environment.
  • Free catered lunch on Fridays at headquarters.
  • On-site gym at headquarters.
  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Health insurance with generous employer contribution.
  • Dental, life, and disability insurance.
  • Hands-on mentorship and career development opportunities.

If you're experienced and have strong change leadership instincts, apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

title: Junior Solutions Architect, AI Operations
description:
Join the Future of Diagnostic Innovation at MicroGenDX


Are you passionate about transforming healthcare through cutting-edge science? At MicroGenDX Laboratory, we’re redefining infection diagnostics with advanced molecular technologies like Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) and Next Generation DNA Sequencing (NGS) empowering physicians to detect all bacteria and fungi in a sample, not just what grows in a petri dish.


Our mission is simple yet powerful: equip doctors with the tools they need to deliver the best outcomes for their patients. With over 100+ peer-reviewed publications and countless stories from patients whose lives have been improved—or even saved—by our technology, we’re proud to be at the forefront of caring innovation.


Trusted by leading hospitals, health systems, and specialists across the country, MicroGenDX reduces diagnostic uncertainty, supports targeted treatment, and improves patient outcomes. From wound care, urology, orthopedics, ENT, and women’s health, we are redefining the future of infectious disease diagnostics.

We’re looking for driven, curious, and compassionate professionals who share our commitment to excellence in patient care and scientific advancement. If you're ready to make a real impact in healthcare, we invite you to bring your talent to MicroGenDX.

Innovate with purpose. Grow with us. Change lives.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.


Job Summary:

The Junior Solutions Architect, AI Operations is a specialized technical role responsible for designing and implementing the "connective tissue" between MicroGenDX’s core software stack and emerging AI capabilities. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will focus on architecting automated workflows that replace legacy manual processes and offshore dependencies. This is not a standard feature-development role; it is a systems-thinking position dedicated to building the autonomous infrastructure of the future. The role combines software development, cloud integration, and AI orchestration to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable AI solutions across the organization.


Duties/Responsibilities:

AI Architecture & Orchestration

  • System Integration: Design and deploy secure integrations (Python and C#) enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to interact with internal diagnostic and operational databases.
  • Agentic Workflow Design: Architect and implement autonomous AI agents that execute complex, multi step business logic.
  • Technical Auditing & Traceability: Implement and maintain model and prompt versioning, monitoring, and auditing capabilities to ensure AI-driven processes are traceable and accountable.

Governance, Compliance & NIST Alignment

  • Security by Design Frameworks: Translate the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) into actionable technical guardrails for AI systems and agents.
  • Regulatory Safeguards: Architect compliant data flows that maintain 100% HIPAA and CLIA compliance, preventing sensitive data from leaking into public or third party LLM training sets.

Operational Transformation

  • Offshore Knowledge Ingestion: Lead the technical knowledge transfer from legacy offshore codebases into MicroGenDX’s internal, AI augmented development environment.
  • Strategic Prototyping: Rapidly build proof of concept (PoC) solutions to help the CTO demonstrate measurable ROI from AI initiatives to executive leadership.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including bioinformatics, IT, and software engineering, to ensure data and AI tools align with business needs.
  • Maintain technical documentation for AI orchestration workflows, architectural decisions and governance controls.
  • Maintain confidentiality and adhere to company policies, including a signed NDA.
  • Adheres to all company policies and applicable laws and regulations.
  • Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

title: Associate Advisor, Private Client
description:
About the role

BizScout is a dynamic marketplace revolutionizing how businesses connect, grow, and transition ownership. Our Private Client program is a concierge service for serious, qualified buyers: we source businesses to buy, screen and underwrite opportunities, and guide buyers from intake through close.

We are hiring an Associate Advisor, Private Client to add execution capacity to the senior advisory team as the program scales. You will work day to day alongside our senior advisors, owning analytical and operational work that keeps buyer search moving: working with our BD team to match deal flow to each buyer, first-pass underwriting, buyer profiles, and pipeline reporting. You will eventually work directly with clients, serving as a day-to-day point of contact for buyers. This is a hands-on role with a clear path to managing your own client portfolio and, over time, leading transactions through close.

Responsibilities

  • Client relationship management – Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned buyers: answer questions, gather feedback on presented deals, and keep buyers engaged and moving through their search.
  • BD partnership on deal flow – Turn buyer criteria into sourcing direction for BD, review sourced opportunities for buyer fit, and relay feedback to BD to sharpen targeting.
  • First-pass underwriting – Review CIMs, P&Ls, tax returns, and broker packages; normalize financials (SDE/EBITDA add-backs), run valuation and SBA debt-service checks, and write concise deal summaries for buyers and senior advisors.
  • Buyer profiles and intake – Assist in building professional buyer profiles that BD can use with sellers and brokers.
  • Pipeline and CRM management – Keep every buyer's pipeline current in the CRM, track deal stages and next steps, and flag closed-lost opportunities to BD for re-engagement.
  • Client strategy calls – Participate in and increasingly lead bi-weekly client calls.
  • Acquisition support – Support buyers and senior advisors through LOI, diligence, and financing to close, taking on increasing ownership of deal execution: build diligence request lists, track lender and third-party deliverables, and manage closing timelines.

Skills and qualifications

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience – investment banking, private equity, search fund, M&A advisory, business brokerage, transaction services or valuation, or SBA/commercial lending.
  • Financial fluency – able to read small-business financials, calculate SDE/EBITDA with add-backs, apply valuation multiples, and test debt service on SBA-financed deals. Strong Excel modeling.
  • Deal execution exposure – hands-on exposure to business acquisitions, sales, or acquisition financing through LOI, diligence, or close (e.g., as an analyst, underwriter, or broker associate).
  • Organization and follow-through – able to track multiple buyers, deals, and deadlines at once without dropping details; proficient with CRM systems and Google Workspace.
  • Clear writing and client presence – writes crisp deal summaries and emails; professional and credible with buyers, sellers, and brokers.
  • Discretion – handles confidential client and financial information with sound judgment.
  • Coachability and ownership – takes feedback well, asks good questions, and owns outcomes in a fast-changing environment; collaborates well across teams, especially BD.

Strongly preferred: having led or co-led a business acquisition or sale through close.

Nice to have: SBA 7(a) lending knowledge, exposure to lower-middle-market or Main Street deals, experience with deal-sourcing tools or data platforms.

Position details

  • Type: Full-time
  • Reports to: Charlie Jacobson, Head of Private Client
  • Works with: Private Client advisory team
  • Compensation: $90,000–$105,000 base, depending on experience, plus performance bonus eligibility
  • Location: Austin, Texas, 5 days in-office required; travel as needed
  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; finance, accounting, or economics preferred
  • Experience: 2–4 years in M&A, private equity, investment banking, business brokerage, valuation, or lending
  • Growth path: Expected progression to Advisor, managing a dedicated client portfolio and eligible for the advisor commission plan, within roughly 12 months based on performance, with a longer-term path to leading transactions through close as a senior advisor

title: Commercial Insurance Product Manager (Small Commercial Lines)
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Product Manager to lead the development and expansion of our small commercial insurance portfolio. This role is critical to accelerating growth at a well-established carrier that is investing in building a more competitive and scalable commercial insurance platform.

The ideal candidate combines strong small commercial underwriting expertise with a “producer mindset”—someone who understands how to structure, package, and position products to win in the market while maintaining underwriting discipline.

This role will focus on core products including General Liability (GL), Professional Liability (PL), Business Owners Policy (BOP). Familiarity with incorporating coverages into product offerings is important from a distribution perspective.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Design & Development

  • Lead the design, development, and enhancement of small commercial products, including:
    • General Liability (GL)
    • Professional Liability (PL)
    • Businessowners Policy (BOP)
    • Fiduciary Liability
    • Cyber Liability
    • Employment Practices Liability Insurance (EPLI)
    • Directors & Officers (D&O) / Management Liability
    • Commercial Crime
    • Commercial Surety Bonds
    • ERISA Fidelity Bonds
  • Develop bundled and packaged product solutions that combine multiple coverages (including bonds where appropriate) to create differentiated offerings for target segments
  • Identify underserved market segments and create tailored solutions to drive growth

Bundling & Packaging Innovation

  • Build scalable, repeatable coverage
  • Support product launches with clear appetite, positioning, and underwriting guidelines
  • Partner with agents, brokers, and program administrators to drive adoption
  • Bring a producer mindset—balancing risk selection with growth, retention, and distribution success

Portfolio & Performance Management

  • Monitor product performance, including premium growth, loss ratios, and mix of business
  • Identify trends and recommend adjustments to improve profitability and competitiveness
  • Continuously refine product offerings based on market feedback and performance data

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with senior leadership
  • Act as a bridge between technical product development and market-facing teams
  • Engage directly with brokers, partners, and occasionally policyholders to inform product direction as necessary
  • Support and advise our in-house producers in marketing bundled packages to our existing customer base.

Required Qualifications (Must-Haves)

  • 5+ years of small commercial underwriting experience at a carrier or MGA
  • Direct experience in product design and development for small commercial insurance
  • Strong expertise in one or more of the following: PL, GL, BOP, FL, Cyber, EPLI, CC, D&O and familiarity with our other commercial insurance products
  • Deep understanding of insurance forms, endorsements, and coverage construction
  • Proven ability to translate underwriting insight into marketable, scalable products
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments to bring products to market
  • Must have excellent computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace (Suite).

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Experience building or contributing to bundled/package insurance solutions
  • Familiarity with incorporating bonds into product offerings (from a product/distribution perspective)
  • Demonstrated proactive and entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward execution
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work with agents, brokers, and policyholders
  • Experience in a growth-oriented or transforming organization

Key Competencies

  • Producer Mindset – Thinks like a producer: understands how products sell, not just how they underwrite
  • Product Innovation – Ability to design compelling, differentiated bundled offerings
  • Technical Expertise – Strong command of coverage, forms, and underwriting fundamentals
  • Commercial Acumen – Balances growth, profitability, and market competitiveness
  • Collaboration – Works effectively across teams and functions
  • Execution-Oriented – Moves from concept to market quickly and efficiently

Why This Role

This is a unique opportunity to play a foundational role in the next phase of growth for a stable, established carrier evolving its commercial insurance platform. You will have the ability to shape product strategy, build innovative bundled solutions, and directly impact the company’s expansion in the small commercial market.

title: User Experience Designer
description:
Description

We are seeking a User Experience Designer to help design and improve digital experiences for Ford vehicle owners. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Analytics, and Design partners to understand customer needs and turn them into clear, accessible experiences.

You’ll contribute throughout the design process—from exploring customer problems and developing concepts to prototyping, validation, delivery, and post-launch improvement. This role is a chance to take ownership of well-scoped design work, collaborate across disciplines, and continue developing your craft.

You’ll also use AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to support ideation, design exploration, and prototyping. You’ll be responsible for reviewing AI-assisted work for accuracy, accessibility, originality, brand fit, and customer usefulness, and for following guidance on approved tools and confidential information.



Responsibilities

User Experience Design & Delivery

  • Design and refine Ford.com experiences that help Owners find vehicle information, understand features, access services, and stay connected with Ford.
  • Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interface designs.
  • Explore design options, communicate trade-offs, and incorporate feedback from customers and cross-functional partners.
  • Create prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity to test assumptions, gather feedback, and support design decisions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to balance customer value, business goals, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
  • Use Ford’s design system and contribute to consistent, reusable patterns across Ford.com.
  • Support design delivery and collaborate with engineering partners to clarify design intent and implementation details.

Customer Research, Validation & Continuous Improvement

  • Help identify customer needs and experience opportunities using research, customer feedback, analytics, and cross-functional input.
  • Support usability testing and other evaluative activities, applying findings before and after launch.
  • Use customer feedback and performance data to assess how experiences are working and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Iterate on designs as new information, feedback, or requirements emerge.
  • Stay curious about evolving design practices and share useful learnings with the team.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Communicate design rationale through presentations, prototypes, and clear documentation.
  • Participate in design critiques, workshops, and planning with a collaborative, open-to-feedback mindset.
  • Build productive working relationships with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Analytics, and Design partners.
  • Explain design concepts and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

AI-Assisted Design

  • Use approved AI-enabled tools to support design work, such as exploring concepts, organizing early ideas, developing prototype content, or streamlining repetitive tasks.
  • Review AI-assisted outputs for accuracy, accessibility, originality, brand fit, and customer usefulness.
  • Follow applicable guidance for approved tools and the handling of confidential information.


Qualifications

We recognize that no one person will embody every quality or skill listed below. If you’re excited about making Ford ownership more helpful and connected, and enjoy learning through collaboration and iteration, we encourage you to apply.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in UX, interaction design, product design, human-computer interaction, visual design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

  • Approximately 2–4 years of experience in UX, product, interaction, or digital design, including relevant internships or project work.
  • A portfolio demonstrating your design process and contributions to digital experiences, including how you framed problems, explored options, used feedback, and developed solutions.
  • Experience using a design and prototyping tool such as Figma.
  • Working knowledge of interaction design, visual design, information architecture, usability, and accessibility.
  • Ability to communicate design ideas and collaborate effectively across disciplines.
  • An iterative approach to feedback, learning, and changing requirements.

Required Design Experience

  • Ability to translate customer needs and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interface designs.
  • Familiarity with usability and accessibility principles.
  • Ability to explain design decisions and incorporate feedback from customers and partners.
  • Ability to collaborate with Product and Engineering on design feasibility and delivery.
  • A portfolio that clearly describes your role and contributions to design work.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing responsive websites or e-commerce experiences.
  • Experience working with a design system or component library.
  • Familiarity with customer research, usability testing, web analytics, or experimentation.
  • Experience working on an Agile or cross-functional product team.
  • Interest in automotive, vehicle ownership, digital services, or helping customers navigate complex information.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted design tools, with the judgment to validate outputs and recognize when human review is essential.
  • Familiarity with front-end concepts that support collaboration with engineers and understanding implementation trade-offs.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care, parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more

title: Project Manager
description:
Total Comp: $60,000 - $90,000 Yearly (base + bonus)
Location: Overland Park, KS
Company: DataMap
Client Work:

About DataMap

DataMap.ai is an AI-first technology consulting and solutions company focused on enterprise systems and automation. We build applications, implement ERP platforms, and provide managed services and production support at scale. Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth companies such as Google. They rely on us to modernize operations and automate workflows in ways that produce measurable business value.

DataMap is growing fast. We value innovation and collaboration, we work with urgency, and we reward speed, precision, and accountability. Teams here have the authority to solve complex enterprise problems and deliver results.

Why Join DataMap

At DataMap, projects run the way we expect every project to run in five years, with AI copilots drafting plans, surfacing risks, and writing first-draft status reports. That frees more of your time for clients and outcomes.

You manage every type of work on your projects, are the primary point of contact for the client, and go after the next piece of business that grows out of the relationship. Functional consultants bring the domain depth, and DataMap's delivery leadership supports you on escalations, so you can concentrate on leading the team, delivering the project, and growing what comes next.

Role Overview

As a Project Manager, you manage projects of every type end to end, from mobilization through deployment and support. Project management at DataMap owns the management of all of our work, which covers everything: customer work, partner work, partnership growth, internal projects, and operations projects. The work ranges from implementations of partner platforms for enterprise clients and development of the products and customer portals we build and sell (Positron, RoboApprover, Itemova EDI SaaS) to the partnership-growth, internal, and operations projects that make DataMap itself run and grow. You are the primary point of contact for your stakeholders, whether client, partner, or internal, and you are accountable for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and the client relationship on each project. You make day-to-day delivery decisions within the agreed scope, plan, and budget, and you bring scope, commercial, and delivery risk to delivery leadership early.

You also go after business development on the projects you are on and lead your team members. Business development means identifying leads for new software and service sales, drafting the orders, and getting customer signatures, with guidance from Sales and delivery leadership. Leading your team means you proactively engage its members, ask what they're working on, suggest course corrections, and drive business outcomes.

You'll use AI tools every day, and at this level you're expected to build your own AI-assisted workflow for delivery and business development, including first-draft orders.

Your Growth Path

Project management at DataMap has a defined five-level ladder that runs from delivery support to leading the practice: Project Coordinator, Senior Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, and Director of Project Management. We post every level and promote from within, and moving up depends on performance and on the needs of the business. Beyond the Director level, the path continues into executive leadership, such as DataMap's Vice President, Operations & Delivery.

At this level you are accountable for the projects you run and the client relationships that come with them, you go after business development on those projects, and you lead the team members who deliver them. Strong Project Managers can grow into Senior Project Manager, where they run programs with executive sponsors, expand those practices to program and account scale, lead others inside and outside the PMO, and drive change in process, structure, visibility, communications, and change management. Along the way you work on Fortune 500 client engagements and build AI-first delivery skills that carry into every level.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery

  • Manage projects of every type (customer, partner, partnership-growth, internal, and operations work) from mobilization through deployment and support, following DataMap's implementation methodology and tailoring it to each client with the functional consultants who bring the domain depth.
  • Build and maintain the project plan, budget, timeline, milestones, and deliverables with client and partner staff.
  • Be the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, whether client, partner, or internal, run the status cadence, and set and manage their expectations.
  • Facilitate requirements and process sessions that start from the business need before the features.
  • Forecast hours, budget, and staffing, track actuals against plan, and flag variances early.
  • Manage risks and issues in the RAID log, use AI-driven risk detection to catch schedule slips early, drive the mitigation, and escalate early and clearly when on-time delivery is at risk.
  • Manage scope through change control, and prepare change requests when scope moves.
  • Run agile delivery for product and portal development: sprints, backlogs, and releases with DataMap's engineers.
  • Build and refine your AI-assisted delivery workflow: project plans, estimates, RAID logs, and client-ready status reports drafted with AI copilots and finished with your judgment.
  • Create reusable deliverables and accelerators that make the next project faster than the last.

Business development

  • Go after business development on the projects you are on: identify leads for new software and service sales, draft the orders, and get customer signatures. Those sales include DataMap's own products (Positron, RoboApprover, Itemova EDI SaaS), the partner platforms we implement, and follow-on services such as new phases, integrations, and managed services.
  • Draft the orders (order forms, change orders, and SOW amendments) with guidance from Sales and delivery leadership. AI produces the first draft, and you get the scope right.
  • Walk sponsors through each order's scope, its value, and what it means for their project, answer their questions, and get the customer signature.

Team leadership

  • Lead the consultants, developers, and coordinators on your projects: proactively engage team members, ask what they're working on, suggest course corrections, and drive business outcomes.
  • Break the work into tasks, assign it, and make clear what good looks like.
  • Delegate, unblock, and resolve issues within the team, and know which calls to make and which to escalate.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years of experience managing or coordinating software or technology projects, including customer-facing responsibility for scope, schedule, and client expectations.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Regular use of AI assistants (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to plan, estimate, report, and draft. Bring examples.
  • Experience following a structured project management methodology and tailoring it to each project.
  • Comfort with commercial conversations about scope, value, and price on your own projects, and examples of spotting new software or service needs on a project and carrying them through to a signed order or change order.
  • A habit of leading teams proactively: you engage team members, ask what they're working on, course-correct before drift costs the project, and keep everyone pointed at business outcomes.
  • The ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team: you know which decisions to make on your own and which to bring to delivery leadership, and you raise risks before they become surprises.
  • You're detail-oriented, adaptable, curious, and positive, and you do your best work in a fast-moving consulting environment.

Preferred Experience

  • PMP certification or equivalent experience (CAPM or PMI-ACP a plus).
  • SaaS and ERP implementation experience (e.g., Coupa, Ariba, Salesforce, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365).
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum software development delivery: sprints, backlogs, and releases.
  • Proficiency with Jira and Smartsheet, including their AI features; Lucidchart a plus.
  • Exposure to integration and automation platforms such as Boomi.
  • Experience drafting change orders, order forms, or SOW amendments.
  • A track record of identifying follow-on work or expansion opportunities on your own projects.
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows for delivery or business development, such as prompt libraries, workflow templates, or first-draft status reports and orders.

Benefits & Perks

  • Total compensation of base salary plus bonus.
  • Unlimited vacation and a flexible work environment.
  • Free catered lunch on Fridays at headquarters.
  • On-site gym at headquarters.
  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Health insurance with generous employer contribution.
  • Dental, life, and disability insurance.
  • Hands-on mentorship and career development opportunities.

Why Apply?

  • Build your career in enterprise technology consulting.
  • Run projects on AI copilots and major financial and supply chain systems, and deliver AI programs for enterprise clients.
  • Work at a company that values innovation, collaboration, and professional growth.

If you're eager to learn and grow, apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

title: Product Manager - Content
description:
Position Overview

Join our team as Product Manager, Content and own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the educational content that sits at the heart of Ceresti’s dementia management program. This role leads the optimization of existing content, the development of new content, and the decisions around how deliver effective, highly-personalized content to caregivers.

This is a player-coach role. You will manage and grow the content development team while staying hands-on as an individual contributor — owning the roadmap, writing the requirements, and shipping the work yourself. You will partner closely with clinical, operations, coaching, engineering, design, and enrollment teams to ensure content is personalized, accessible, mobile-native, and easy to find at the moment a caregiver needs it. This is a role suited for a product manager who is energized by content strategy, data-informed iteration, and building both a team and a production system that scale.

About Us & What We Do

Ceresti is on a mission to reduce avoidable hospitalizations and improve care for people living with dementia while improving the lives of their families and caregivers. We envision a world in which family caregivers of people living with dementia are supported and have the knowledge, skills, and confidence to provide the best possible care for their loved ones.

Ceresti is a tech-enabled dementia care provider with a differentiated model of care that improves outcomes and delivers guaranteed cost savings by including family caregivers in the care team. We offer health plans and accountable care organizations a turnkey solution for impacting a population that has limited engagement in traditional clinical programs.

Our culture is rooted in agility, innovation, and collaboration. We believe that every idea—no matter how small—can spark a meaningful improvement. Together, we create solutions that make a lasting impact on the healthcare ecosystem, enabling more compassionate and cost-effective care for those who need it most.

Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Roadmap

• Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ceresti’s caregiver-facing content.

• Decide what gets created, refreshed, licensed, or retired based on caregiver needs, engagement data, clinical priorities, and business goals.

• Translate company goals around caregiver outcomes, engagement, and clinical quality into a prioritized, sequenced content roadmap.

• Balance near-term execution against the foundational investments that make content faster, cheaper, and better to produce over time.

Team Leadership

• Manage, coach, and grow the content development team — setting clear goals, priorities, and standards for quality.

• Operate as a player-coach: lead the team while staying hands-on as an individual contributor on the highest-leverage work.

• Build the production process, toolkit, and templates that let the team produce more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

• Define what highly effective content looks like across all formats, and continuously raise the bar.

Optimizing Existing Content

• Audit and continuously improve the existing content library based on engagement, completion, and caregiver feedback.

• Solidify the content foundation: taxonomy, metadata, standards, and a single source of truth for what exists and how it performs.

• Improve content discoverability so caregivers find what they need at the moment they need it.

• Ensure content renders correctly and feels native across iOS, Android, smartphones, tablets, and web applications, and meets accessibility standards.

New Content Development & Licensing

• Lead development of new content programs.

• Identify where licensing third-party content is faster or better than building it, and own sourcing, evaluation, and negotiation through integration.

• Partner with clinical and coaching teams to ensure every piece of content is accurate, evidence-based, and usable in the real world.

• Package content into customizable programs that flex to different caregiver journeys, diagnoses, stages, and preferences.

Measurement, Feedback & Experimentation

• Define, track, and own content engagement, completion, and caregiver outcome metrics.

• Build the feedback loops and discovery process that surface what caregivers actually need from content.

• Run experiments on format, sequencing, delivery, and personalization — and scale what works.

• Partner with data and analytics teams to turn content performance into clear product decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

• Collaborate deeply with clinical, coaching, operations, engineering, design, and enrollment teams so content aligns with real-world caregiver needs.

• Define clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to support efficient delivery by engineering and content teams.

• Use modern AI tools to accelerate content discovery, drafting, prototyping, requirements generation, and iteration while holding a high bar for accuracy and quality.

• Be hands-on and scrappy. Unblock the team, clarify decisions, and drive momentum when things get ambiguous.

• Communicate plans, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

Required Qualifications

Education

• BS/BA degree or higher.

Experience

• 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager or equivalent, ideally owning content-driven, educational products, programs, or experiences.

• Experience managing and developing people; comfortable operating as a player-coach who both leads a team and ships work personally.

• Experience overseeing content production end to end — strategy, development, clinical review, and publication.

• Experience building content-driven products, content management systems, or personalization systems.

• Experience sourcing, evaluating, or licensing third-party content is a strong plus.

• Experience shipping mobile experiences across iOS and Android, including phones and tablets.

• Familiarity with accessibility standards for digital content is a plus.

• Strong track record of working cross-functionally with engineering, design, clinical, and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience translating user needs and business goals into shipped product features and user experiences.

• Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where scrappiness and ownership are required.

• Experience in healthcare or caregiving is a strong plus.

Skills

• Strong product judgment with a user-centered mindset.

• Strong content sensibility. Ability to recognize what makes content engaging, useful, and trustworthy for caregivers.

• Strong people leadership skills; able to set direction, give direct feedback, and raise the bar on a team.

• Strong analytical skills; comfortable using engagement data to decide what to build, fix, or retire.

• Strong judgment around applying AI responsibly in emotionally sensitive user experiences.

• Ability to design intuitive experiences for complex or emotionally sensitive user journeys.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Highly collaborative with strong project management skills; able to build trust across functions and with external partners.

• Organized, pragmatic, and execution-focused.

• Curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning new domains.

• High integrity, transparency, and ownership mindset.

• Must be able to pass a background check.

title: Head of Capital Formation
description:
Location: NYC (onsite only – not remote)

Alliance is the leading accelerator for crypto & fintech founders. Since 2020 we've backed 300+ startups (Rain, Pump, Synthetix, Pendle, and many more), now collectively valued at $17B+.

We're hiring a Head of Capital Formation to own fundraising for Alliance's venture funds end to end: strategy, pipeline, LP relationships, and close. You'll report directly to a General Partner.

What you'll do

  • Own the raise: Lead and execute Alliance's capital formation plan across institutional allocators (fund of funds, family offices, endowments, wealth management platforms, sovereign wealth) and HNWIs. You source, you pitch, you close.
  • Build and run the LP pipeline: Own lead sourcing, qualification, and pipeline management. Bring the right prospects to the General Partners at the right moment, and run the process through to signed commitments.
  • Be the voice of Alliance to investors: Serve as the main point of contact for prospective LPs. Communicate our strategy, track record, and edge clearly. Own the deck, data room, and investor materials.
  • Turn LPs into repeat LPs: Build long-term relationships with existing and prospective allocators. Keep them close between raises and bring them back fund after fund.
  • Shape the strategy: Work with the GPs on fund positioning, sizing, timing, and the long-term investor relations plan.

What we're looking for

  • Capital raising track record: 5+ years raising for venture, private equity, private credit, or hedge funds, with closed commitments from institutional investors and HNWIs you can point to. Venture fund experience strongly preferred.
  • An existing allocator network: Warm relationships with fund of funds, family offices, consultants, and HNWIs. This is a must have.
  • Crypto/AI fluency: 2+ years in crypto, fintech, or tech. You can hold your own with allocators on the thesis, not just the process.
  • Sales and relationship skills: Clear communicator, strong negotiator, high degree of professionalism and discretion.
  • Pipeline discipline: Can run a long sales cycle in a CRM, keep the funnel full, and automate where it makes sense.
  • Entrepreneurial and high agency: Self-driven, spots what's broken, and takes ideas through to completion.
  • Frequent travel: NYC is home base, but you'll be on the road often, including SF and internationally.

Strong qualifications (nice to have)

  • Raised for an emerging manager or an early fund, where you sold on conviction rather than a 20-year track record.
  • Relationships with crypto-native or AI-focused allocators.
  • Prior placement agent or in-house IR experience at a venture firm.

Why NOT join us

  • Not willing to get hands dirty: doesn't matter how important you were in past organizations; at Alliance we're all builders, not managers (even though many of us were managers in past lives). There's no IR team under you.
  • Prioritizing work/life balance: this role demands focus, hunger, and a career-defining level of commitment. You must be locked in.
  • Low agency: if you need someone else to set your priorities or keep you on track, you will fail.
  • You can't relocate to NYC. This is non-negotiable: our founders are here, our brand is strongest here, and so are we. You'll travel to SF often, but you'll live in New York.

Why join us

  • Own the raise, share the upside: salary plus fund carry. Your work decides how much capital the next generation of Alliance founders gets to build with, and who backs them.
  • Sell a real track record: 300+ startups backed since 2020, now collectively valued at $15B+, and a brand that's strongest exactly where the capital is.
  • Work with the most ambitious founders in crypto and AI. Learn firsthand from hundreds of startups succeeding – or failing.
  • Join a small, high-trust, high-performance team with outsized impact. We're ex-Meta, WhatsApp, Coinbase, YC, and have collectively founded multiple venture-backed startups.
  • We're backed by S-tier investors including Initialized Capital, Founders Fund, Multicoin, and Dragonfly, along with angels such as Balaji Srinivasan (ex-Coinbase CTO), Kevin Weil (CPO at OpenAI), Kevin Lin (Twitch co-founder), and Jeremy Allaire (Circle CEO), among many others.
  • Career accelerator: this role sets you up, experience- and network-wise, for any high-impact path in crypto/AI – at venture firms, startups, or raising your own fund.
  • Alliance startups are reinventing industries – from media to payments – and improving the lives of everyday people. You'll have a front-row seat as they change the world.

title: IoT Embedded Developer
description:

Od wielu lat realizuje projekty dla międzynarodowych klientów, rozwijając oprogramowanie dla inteligentnych urządzeń wykorzystywanych m.in. w branży medycznej, przemysłowej i automatyce. Zespół tworzą doświadczeni inżynierowie, którzy łączą wiedzę z zakresu oprogramowania, elektroniki i nowoczesnych technologii.

Opis projektu: Projekt dotyczy rozwoju nowoczesnych rozwiązań z obszaru IoT i robotyki. Aktualnie zespół koncentruje się na rozwoju rozwiązania opartego na platformie nRF, wykorzystywanej w urządzeniach połączonych z Internetem. Projekt łączy oprogramowanie, elektronikę i rzeczywiste urządzenia – celem jest tworzenie nowoczesnych rozwiązań, które mogą zbierać i przetwarzać dane oraz komunikować się z innymi systemami.

Zakres obowiązków:

  • projektowanie i rozwój oprogramowania dla urządzeń Embedded w języku C++,

  • udział w projektowaniu architektury i implementacji nowych funkcjonalności,

  • rozwój rozwiązań opartych o mikrokontrolery,

  • tworzenie i utrzymywanie testów jednostkowych,

  • udział w code review oraz dbanie o wysoką jakość kodu,

  • współpraca z zespołem projektowym oraz klientem przy realizacji rozwiązań

Główne wymagania:

  • minimum 3 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w tworzeniu oprogramowania Embedded,

  • bardzo dobrą znajomość języka C++ lub C

  • doświadczenie komercyjne z przynajmniej jednym z mikrokontrolerów: nRF, STM32 lub ESP32 - warunek konieczny,

  • praktyczną znajomość Git oraz CMake,

  • doświadczenie w tworzeniu testów jednostkowych,

  • znajomość dobrych praktyk programistycznych (m.in. Clean Code, SOLID),

  • umiejętność samodzielnego prowadzenia zadań i proponowania rozwiązań,

  • komunikatywną znajomość języka angielskiego umożliwiającą współpracę z klientem,

  • gotowość do pracy stacjonarnej (codziennie z biura) przez pierwszy miesiąc.

Mile widziane:

  • znajomość Embedded Linux lub FreeRTOS,

  • doświadczenie z Dockerem i CI/CD,

  • praktyczna znajomość C lub Python,

  • doświadczenie z BLE, MQTT lub rozwiązaniami IoT,

  • umiejętność debugowania oprogramowania oraz pracy z narzędziami diagnostycznymi,

  • doświadczenie z chmurami IoT (AWS, Azure lub Google Cloud).

Firma oferuje:

  • udział w ciekawych projektach z obszaru IoT, robotyki oraz nowoczesnych urządzeń embedded,

  • realny wpływ na rozwiązania techniczne i rozwój produktu,

  • współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem inżynierów,

  • stabilną współpracę w oparciu o kontrakt B2B,

  • elastyczne godziny rozpoczęcia pracy,

  • prywatną opiekę medyczną (Lux Med),

  • kartę MultiSport,

  • lekcje języka angielskiego z native speakerem,

  • regularne spotkania integracyjne,

  • przyjazną atmosferę oraz kulturę współpracy opartą na wzajemnym wsparciu.

Jeśli cenisz pracę nad rzeczywistymi urządzeniami, chcesz rozwijać swoje kompetencje w obszarze IoT i Embedded oraz mieć wpływ na rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez klientów z różnych branż – wyślij CV 🙂

title: Psychotherapists Needed
description:
Location: Washington, D.C., Maryland & Virginia
Work Setting: Hybrid
Position Type: Part-time or Full-Time
Employment Type: 1099 Independent Contractor
Compensation: Competitive compensation aligned with insurance reimbursement rates, with opportunities to maximize earning potential based on clinical volume

CapitolHill Consortium for Counseling & Consultation, LLC (CCCC) is a well-established, multidisciplinary healthcare and behavioral health group practice serving clients throughout the Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia region. Join a growing, multidisciplinary healthcare and behavioral health practice where you can focus on what matters most: providing excellent patient care.

We are seeking one or more psychotherapists to join our collaborative clinical team and provide high-quality, culturally responsive, patient-centered care to diverse populations across the lifespan. Psychotherapists who specialize in child, adolescent, adult, and elder care are welcome.

Our practice is committed to building strong community partnerships, and we are actively working in collaboration with substance abuse treatment centers, schools, and community-based organizations to expand access to mental health services, promote continuity of care, and address the divers behavioral health needs of the communities we serve.

Diversity As A Core Value. Our diverse referral base provides opportunities to work with children, adolescents, and adults, depending on your clinical interests, experience, specialty, and availability. CCCC offers a collegial environment designed to support professional growth, clinical collaboration, and long-term development.

  • Community engagement
  • Clinical education and workshops
  • Interdisciplinary consultation
  • Corporate and organizational consultation
  • Wellness initiatives
  • Leadership and management opportunities
  • Training and professional development

Scheduling Flexibility. At CCCC, we provide flexible opportunities for psychotherapists to develop a practice that aligns with their professional goals and lifestyle.

  • Full-time or part-time schedules
  • Remote, hybrid, or in-office service options
  • Evening and/or weekend availability

Dedicated Administrative Support. Our administrative team manages many of the operational demands of practice—including scheduling, billing, credentialing, insurance coordination, and patient support—allowing you to focus on delivering exceptional patient care.

  • Insurance credentialing, contracting, and authorization
  • Insurance billing, claims, and collections
  • Appointment scheduling and Waitlist management
  • Electronic health record support
  • Dedicated intakes, billing, and administrative staff for support
  • Office space, equipment, and routine supplies, as available

Key Clinical Responsibilities

Psychotherapist responsibilities include:

  • Treatment — Provide evidence-based psychotherapy and other appropriate interventions tailored to clients’ needs.
  • Treatment planning — Establish goals with clients, monitor progress, modify treatment when needed, and make referrals when another service is more appropriate.
  • Client safety — Assess and respond appropriately to risks such as suicide, self-harm, abuse, violence, or other urgent concerns, following applicable laws and professional standards.
  • Documentation — Maintain accurate, timely, and secure clinical records, including assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and relevant communications.
  • Other responsibilities as required

Required Qualifications

  • Candidates must be licensed in Virginia or Maryland. Licensure in Washington, D.C. is preferred, with priority given to clinicians licensed across all jurisdictions
  • Priority consideration given to clinicians willing to serve pre-adolescent populations
  • Passion for high-quality, compassionate mental health care
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development
  • Desired experience 1-3 years
  • Must be local

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with range of diverse clientele, with priority given to clinicians who serve families
  • Availability during after-school hours, evenings, or weekends
  • Willingness to work a hybrid schedule (some in-person availability preferred)

How to Apply

We welcome experienced and emerging clinicians who are seeking a supportive, inclusive, and values-aligned professional home. To apply, please submit your CV/Resume and a brief cover letter.

CapitolHill Consortium for Counseling & Consultation LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage applications from BIPOC, LGBTQIA+ clinicians, and those from historically underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 100 – 130 PLN / godz. netto

🔍 Product Designer (UX/UI)

Location: 100% remote (Poland)
Contract type: B2B
Capacity: Part-time / Project-based
Rate: 130 PLN + VAT / h

🚀 About the role

We are looking for an experienced Product Designer (UX/UI) to collaborate with us on various digital product development projects.

At Kyotu Technology, we work with international clients on web applications, SaaS platforms, and custom software solutions. Depending on the project, you may be involved in designing a new product from scratch, improving an existing application, or developing specific features and user journeys.

We are looking for someone who can confidently take ownership of the entire design process — from understanding business requirements and defining user flows to delivering polished, development-ready interfaces.

This role requires more than strong design skills. We value excellent communication, a proactive mindset, and the ability to work directly with clients, challenge assumptions, and explain design decisions.

We also expect a modern, AI-native approach to product design, including the practical use of AI tools to improve design workflows and prepare solutions that can be efficiently implemented by AI-assisted development teams.

💡 Who we are

Kyotu Technology is a boutique software house based in Wrocław and Warsaw, working fully remotely or in hybrid mode across Poland. We focus on long-term, high-quality engineering and building production-grade systems with real business impact.

Our teams have real influence on technical and product decisions and the way solutions are delivered.

🧠 Your responsibilities

  • take ownership of the end-to-end UX/UI design process for digital products and features

  • translate business requirements and user needs into intuitive, effective product experiences

  • design complete user journeys, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes

  • create high-quality, visually polished user interfaces for web and mobile applications

  • work directly with international clients to understand requirements, discuss ideas, and present design solutions

  • proactively propose improvements and challenge requirements when better solutions are possible

  • clearly explain and justify design decisions based on usability, business goals, and technical feasibility

  • create and maintain reusable components and design systems in Figma

  • prepare well-structured, development-ready designs, including clear specifications and component states

  • collaborate closely with developers to ensure smooth design implementation

  • use AI-powered tools to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, documentation, and handoff

  • structure design deliverables to support efficient implementation using AI-assisted development workflows

🧩 Must haves

  • minimum 5 years of commercial experience in Product Design, UX/UI Design, or similar roles

  • strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality UX and UI work across complex digital products

  • proven experience independently managing the complete product design process, from initial requirements to final UI delivery

  • strong understanding of UX principles, information architecture, user flows, and interaction design

  • excellent UI design skills, with strong attention to visual quality, consistency, typography, and usability

  • advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout, and design systems

  • experience designing complex web applications, SaaS platforms, or other digital products

  • ability to create clear, structured, and implementation-ready design documentation

  • hands-on experience using AI tools in everyday product design workflows

  • understanding of how to prepare designs, components, and specifications for efficient implementation by AI-assisted development teams

  • strong sense of ownership and ability to independently drive design activities

  • excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

  • confidence in working directly with clients, discussing requirements, proposing solutions, and defending design decisions

  • proactive, solution-oriented mindset and strong problem-solving skills

  • English at C1 level or higher, including confidence in client meetings and design presentations

✨ Nice to have

  • experience designing products from scratch, including early-stage product discovery

  • experience working with AI-assisted prototyping and design-to-code workflows

  • familiarity with tools such as Figma Make, Lovable, v0, Cursor, or Claude Code

  • understanding of frontend development principles and technologies such as HTML, CSS, and React

  • experience collaborating with AI-native engineering teams

  • experience conducting usability testing or user research

  • knowledge of accessibility standards and best practices, including WCAG

  • experience working with international startups or enterprise clients

📦 What we offer

  • B2B contract

  • rate: 100 - 130 PLN + VAT / h

  • 100% remote work

  • flexible, part-time / project-based cooperation

  • opportunities to work on international digital product development projects

  • direct collaboration with clients and engineering teams

  • ownership of the design process and real influence on product decisions

  • opportunity to work with modern AI-powered design and development workflows

  • collaboration with experienced software engineers and product specialists

Please note: We are looking for a designer available for occasional project engagements. The scope, workload, and duration of each assignment will be discussed individually based on project requirements.

  • Design, establish, and optimize data flows feeding central (UniCredit group-level) reporting engines and calculation platforms.

Skills you should have

  • Proven experience in credit risk modelling and data analysis, specifically with PD, LGD, and CCF parameters.

  • Advanced degree (B.S. or Master’s) in Finance, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Econometrics.

  • In-depth knowledge of IFRS9 standard and EBA regulatory requirements.

  • Experience with enterprise data architecture, data warehousing, or central data integration pipelines is a strong plus.

  • Excellent communication skills with full professional fluency in English and Polish.

  • Nice to have

    • Knowledge of Python.

    • Google Cloud understanding.

    • Experience in visualisation tools like Looker, Reporting Services.

    • Git.

What we offer

You will get an opportunity to work in an innovative, digital bank applying state of the art approaches and technologies.
Unless limited by banking regulations we offer a flexible form of contract.
You will be provided an Individual Development Budget, dedicated to enhancing your professional skills.
If your role permits, we also offer flexible work location: home/office — according to your preference.
You and your closest family will be covered with VIP-level private medical care which includes dental treatment and a hospitalisation package.
We care for our colleagues’ well being, therefore we cover psychological consultations if you ever feel you need such support.
We co-sponsor your Multisport card and cover 50% of its cost.
You will work on computer equipment that delivers the best user experience — Apple MacBook.
Our office in Warsaw offers healthy snacks throughout the day.

Our process

We keep our recruiting process simple.
Step 1: Talk with one of our Recruiters about your to date experiences and ambitions
Step 2: Meet with your future Team Manager to deep dive on the role specifics and our work environment

Our note to you

We are an equal opportunity employer. We stand together in nurturing a workplace that welcomes diverse thinking and inclusive behaviors. By embracing diversity of thought and making all voices heard regardless of background, we drive innovation, sustainable growth, and new business opportunities. This inclusive approach enhances our work climate, directly boosting our people's productivity, well-being, and engagement.
Our Values - Integrity, Ownership, Caring - are more than just words. They are actions. Mandates. Pledges. When we all commit to these shared Values, we will deliver for our clients. And delivering for our clients - in any way, large or small - is how we fulfil our Purpose.
If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply - even if you're not 100% sure. We are interested in getting to know you and learning about what you bring to the table.We appreciate your time and application. Please note that we reserve the right to contact selected candidates.

Good luck!

title: Senior Service Manager - Technical Customer Relationship
description:
Overview

MCAPS-Core accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions.
