The Asia Technical Services organization will land Customer Support priorities including being the local incident commander for large-scale events and high-impact outages, drive in region quality requirements, deliver incident management, service management and assess regional support needs. In addition, they will deliver on Global Customer Success priorities including landing customer success plays in region, orchestrating the MACC end-to-end experiences, driving usage end-to-end experience and performance, scaling best practices through regional partners, and accelerating Get Well Plans in partnership with CSS.

Our Service Manager will be positioned and aligned with our customers as Chief Operating Officers within the account, strategically placed to ensure that we have the appropriate level of engagement to support and drive the customer’s reactive support landscape and improve operational health. As such you will work with some of the world’s largest companies, public sector depts and not for profit organisations pursuing strategic activities, utilising Microsoft technologies to modernise their business.

We create an environment where you can do your best work and build a career both in the Service Manager role as well as the wider Microsoft. As your interests and goals evolve we will enable you to connect you with a diverse, thriving community that can help you grow.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

As a Senior Support Escalation Manager, you will be the primary contact managing escalated customer and partner issues. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, hone your problem-solving, collaboration and orchestration skills, and deepen your relationship management expertise.

Customer Resolution:
• Acts as an internal expert to resolve longer running, sensitive, or escalated issues or acts as a primary contact for escalated issues on behalf of less experienced IC levels. Identifies and builds relationships with various internal and external teams
and senior leaders to resolve customer issues. Leads strategic projects. Informally provides coaching, mentorship, or support to less experienced Support Escalation Managers to resolve customer issues.
• Leads inter-regions, cross-regions, cross-group, or account team unit (ATU) initiatives by creating plans and managing relationships with other business units to improve the customer support experience for a group of customers or a specific region/area. Acts as a subject matter expert on best practices to support the customer experience.
• Reviews status updates to customers and provides informal guidance to others on communicating with internal stakeholders through various channels of communication for highly sensitive or difficult issues.
• Leads strategic projects designed to improve resolution times, customer satisfaction, and support experience.
• Proactively coordinates resources and establishes relationships to drive opportunities within the team and across stakeholder groups in postmortem discussions to remediate future issues.

Collaboration:
• Leverages relationships across teams to remove roadblocks. Establishes and oversees the development of written protocols to ensure customer issues are resolved. Identifies reoccurring roadblocks across the team and escalates as needed.
• Owns escalated issues and manages account-aligned customer incidents to identify and remove barriers. Ensures existing processes are not a blocker to customer issue resolution and influences the direction of process improvement efforts with a global perspective. Acts as an expert and provides informal guidance to Support Escalation team members on how to handle moderate to highly complex cases.

Communication:
• Manages customer and field expectations around issue response and represents the company independently. Ensures customer and MSFT internal stakeholders stay informed on the response and resolution status of customer issues. Communicates and influences internally to drive faster issue resolution.
• Identifies and builds strategic relationships with internal teams, partners, and communications with senior leadership to resolve issues that are complex in scope.

Process Improvement:
• Surfaces feedback from the team and drives collaboration across functions to identify systematic issues and leads process breakdowns to ensure resolution/progress. Creates strategy for process improvements and leads project or workgroup to improve internal processes.
• Reviews postmortem executive summaries and identifies patterns across customer issues. Creates strategies to resolve reoccurring or highly sensitive issues in partnership with leadership.

Vendor Relationships:
• Owns and leads relationships with outsource vendor to resolve issues and foster positive cultural and behavioural4 changes.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:
Master's Degree in technology, business, or related field AND 4+ years technology industry, customer service, or related experience
OR Bachelor's Degree in technology, business, or related field AND 6+ years technology industry, customer service, or related experience
OR 9+ years technology industry, customer service, or related experience
OR equivalent experience

Additional Required Qualifications:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and / or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire / transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:
• Project management experience.
• Experience working with Microsoft products and services.
• Cloud Technology Certification (Azure Fundamentals. M365 Fundamentals)


This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.



Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. description:
Job Description:

Job Title: IT Product Owner

Corporate Title: Vice President

Location: Pune, India

Role Description

  • Guide team members in adopting Scrum principles and practices and help them improve their skills and collaboration.
  • Foster a positive and productive team environment, encouraging open communication, conflict resolution, and collaboration.
  • Empower team members to take ownership of their work, make decisions, and solve problems.

  • Help team members provide and receive constructive feedback and facilitate continuous improvement efforts.
  • Help resolve conflicts and impediments that may arise within the team and facilitate open discussions to find solutions.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration between the team and stakeholders, ensuring that expectations are aligned and managed.
  • The role may not have a direct Line Management initially; however, the people skills are critical to be successful in this role.

What we’ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

  • Best in class leave policy.
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • Develop, Create, and communicate Product Vision and Roadmap with the Business Owners, Delivery Teams & Solution/System Architects
  • Serves as the strategic Product Owner for driving the transition toward Strategic Data warehousing solutions on Google Cloud (GCP)
  • Translate business objectives, regulatory expectations, and investigative needs into a prioritized product roadmap that enables compliance, efficiency, and risk reduction
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align feature development with business priorities and migration milestones
  • Ensure development work is tightly aligned to user value and strategic goals
  • Own the product vision for the migration working closely with several teams to define integration points, decommissioning timelines and MVP delivery plans
  • Monitor and track the progress of the platform transition, proactively resolving blockers, refining scope, and communicating impact to leadership and delivery teams
  • Champion continuous improvement across Agile ways of working, contributing to velocity gains, improved stakeholder visibility and enhanced delivery predictability
  • Act as a change leader, supporting business readiness, user adoption, and training efforts to ensure successful platform onboarding and operational continuity
  • Define and Communicate Product Vision and roadmap in partnership with stakeholders and engineering
  • Develop as an SME and primary point of contact liaison with all relevant stakeholders in Business and Engineering, giving them timely, transparent, and metric driven updates.
  • Ensure adherence to both the Bank’s and domain’s testing standards with focus on achieving further efficiencies and benefits through automated testing.
  • Provide management, leadership, and technical/domain guidance to teams across multiple locations and senior escalation point for all stakeholders.
  • Participate in the end-to-end development cycle working closely with squad teams following the domain’s development model.

Your skills and experience

Technical / Domain Skills

  • 10+ years’ experience as Product Owner and Product management in an agile environment
  • 8+ years’ experience working in data warehousing projects executed On Google cloud environment.
  • Avaloq Core banking experience preferred
  • Technical skills include - Data warehousing concepts, Google cloud platform – BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud composer, GKE, pipelines set up using DataProc, Python
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to communicate at all levels of seniority with proven experience in successfully driving roadmaps and delivery of large-scale Regulatory, Risk, Data or Transformation Programs
  • Proven experience and evidencing prioritization techniques, refinement, grooming and challenges with the Backlog management.
  • Knowledge and experience of Finance domain. Good to have experience in any phase of Transaction Monitoring and Reporting, and / or Private Banking.
  • Experience with Agile Testing & Engineering techniques would be a plus
  • Experience with JIRA and Confluence
  • Experience in using AI Tools to achieve increased productivity

Soft Skills

  • Agile & Product mindset
  • Strong Analytical skills
  • Ability to work in virtual teams and in matrix organizations
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Evidence of Team Player, Mentoring or driving Team objectives

Education/ Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited college or university with a concentration in Computer Science or Software Engineering (or equivalent) – with a minor in Finance, Mathematics or Engineering.
  • Good to have: Product owner/Product Manager/ Business Analyst Certifications from recognized institutes/ courses.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career.
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team.
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

About us and our teams

Please visit our company website for further information:

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Sets a professional and positive example to others
Assists as needed to ensure the success of the store as a whole

MARGINIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Performs other job-related duties as assigned.
NATURE OF WORK CONTACTS:

Consistent and daily interaction with store associates
Consistent and daily interaction with customers
Consistent and daily interaction with vendors

TRAINING & QUALIFICATIONS:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities:
A high school diploma or GED preferred; or any combination of education, experience, and training which provides the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

Excellent organization and planning skills
Must possess solid communication skills, including verbal and listening skills to communicate with customers and fellow associates effectively and efficiently
Must possess the ability to accept constructive review and be accountable for one’s own success as well as the success of your team
Continually strives to be product minded, customer minded, personnel minded, detailed, forward focused, and consistent
Ability to interpret policies and procedures
Basic math skills
Understanding of product rotation
Must enjoy working with and handling dairy products
Should have a passion for customer service
Must possess integrity, a positive attitude, be mission-driven, and be self-directed with a demonstrated passion for Harmons’ mission and commitment to working collaboratively
Ability to work weekends, evenings, and holidays

PHYSICAL/SENSORY DEMANDS:
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an associate encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work is generally performed in a safe and comfortable store environment with the possibility of frequent exposure to cold, slippery, and wet conditions. title: Senior 3D Generalist Artist
description:
Role Overview

We’re looking for a Senior 3D Generalist Artist to work on a Simulation Game. You’ll work closely with a small, multidisciplinary team to build imaginative and replayable simulation games that serve a distinct genre audience and connect with players.

Key Responsibilities

1 - Create Game-Ready Art

You’ll mainly be working on modular environments, props, set dressing and character / creature work

Success looks like:

  • Understanding our art ethos and working autonomously with high level direction
  • Grasping the project art style and adapting quickly
  • Understanding how to construct modular environments and working to a grid
  • Rapid output by focusing on getting the core elements right rather than superficial details

2 - Be a Force Multiplayer, Not Just an Asset Maker

There’s more to it than just creating assets, it’s about being an invaluable team member.

Success looks like:

  • Communicating and collaborating with the team. Nurturing the synergy between disciplines and problem solving the gaps in-between
  • Joining playtests and contributing to the game experience beyond art
  • Identifying risks and constraints early and redirecting effort when needed
  • Being pro-active and moving the project forward, even if you’re waiting for feedback or currently blocked, you know how to identify meaningful work to keep momentum

3 - Implement Assets in Engine

You’re not just handing off art assets, you’re implementing them in-engine.

Success looks like:

  • Importing, setting up and hooking up assets
  • Correctly handling setup for materials, prefabs, folders and naming etc
  • Fixing materials, collision and general art bugs in engine
  • Spotting inefficiencies and offering better solutions
  • Keeping assets and scenes well optimized without sacrificing the game’s vision

Requirements

  • Senior experience level. Comfortable working autonomously with high level direction, championing your area of responsibility.
  • Broad artistic & technical skillset: Environments, props, characters / creatures.
  • Confident in Unreal Engine; asset implementation and fixing art bugs.
  • Happy to prioritize speed & efficiency.
  • Project first mindset: Our games look good but we’re not trying to win art awards or build stunning portfolio pieces. The experience is king.
  • General understanding of supporting optimization and performance for single player and online multiplayer titles (from an art POV).
  • Bonus skills: Rigging, VFX, UI, Tech Art skills, Concept Art

Please Note: This is a full-time, remote-working position, open to anyone within the UK & Europe.

Benefits

Our benefits include a 2-week company summer break and a 2-week winter break to rest and recharge, in addition to your normal holiday allowance.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Overview

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world.

Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture.

​​Within Microsoft Fabric, the Data Integration team enables organizations to connect, move, and shape data across their entire data estate. As data is generated across applications, devices, and systems, our integration capabilities make it easy to ingest, transform, and prepare data for downstream use. Fabric’s unified integration experience simplifies how customers bring data together, ensuring it is trusted, usable, and ready to power analytics, real-time insights, and AI scenarios. ​

​​Within Azure Data, the Azure Data Integration team helps customers connect, move, and prepare data to power analytics and AI. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a product area that simplifies complex data integration workflows for data engineers, developers, and enterprise customers. This role combines customer-centered product design with the technical challenges of building reliable, secure, and scalable cloud capabilities. You will work directly with customers and partner closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market teams to identify unmet needs, define priorities, and deliver improvements from discovery through adoption. You will bring clarity to ambiguous problems, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and measure success through customer outcomes and product impact.

We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • ​​Understand customer needs: Engage customers and partners, analyze product usage and market signals, and translate insights into clearly defined problems and prioritized opportunities.
  • Own product direction: Define the strategy and roadmap for your product area, connecting investments to customer needs, the broader Azure Data Integration strategy, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery: Develop product requirements, success criteria, and release plans. Partner with Engineering and Design to deliver capabilities from discovery and validation through launch and iteration.
  • Apply technical and product judgment: Make informed tradeoffs across customer value, usability, reliability, performance, cost, and delivery timelines. Incorporate accessibility, security, privacy, and compliance requirements throughout development.
  • Lead across functions: Build alignment with engineering teams and cross-functional partners, manage dependencies, and communicate priorities, decisions, and risks clearly.
  • Drive adoption and measurable impact: Partner with Marketing, Sales, Support, and customer-facing teams on launch readiness, documentation, and customer adoption. Define and monitor metrics to identify opportunities and improve product performance.
  • Explore AI-enabled improvements: Identify and validate opportunities to simplify data integration through AI-assisted experiences, applying responsible AI practices where relevant.
  • Embody our culture and values.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • ​​Bachelor’s Degree AND 5+ years of experience in product/service/project/program management or software development, OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check:

  • This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience owning a software product or significant feature area from problem definition and prioritization through delivery and post-launch improvement.
  • Experience using customer research, product telemetry, and quantitative analysis to inform product decisions and assess outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering and design teams, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and translate complex customer needs into actionable product requirements.
  • Experience aligning cross-functional stakeholders and driving decisions without direct authority, supported by clear written and verbal communication.​
  • Experience with cloud data platforms, data integration, or data engineering, including concepts such as ETL/ELT, data pipelines, connectors, APIs, and orchestration.
  • Familiarity with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable cloud data platforms.
    Experience building enterprise or developer-facing products that balance ease of use with reliability, scalability, security, and operational requirements.
  • A track record of improving customer adoption, engagement, or product quality through measurable, iterative improvements.
  • Experience evaluating or delivering AI-assisted product experiences, with an understanding of quality evaluation, customer trust, and responsible AI considerations.​

ABOUT THE PROGRAM
The Social and Economic Systems Program analyzes the behavioral and social sciences – including anthropology, economics, political science, psychology, and sociology – and the statistical and other methods they employ to understand and address issues affecting the complex relationships among people, their communities, and the environments with/in which they interact.

ABOUT THE POSITION
Performs complex clerical and administrative duties under minimal supervision. Coordinates logistical and administrative aspects of meetings. Writes, edits, and formats routine correspondence. Interfaces with committee members and performs duties involving committee activities. Plans administrative aspects of unit and committee, forum, and other types of meeting.

Under minimal supervision, primary function is the performance of clerical and administrative tasks requiring the consideration of multiple variables to determine proper course of action. Secondary function may involve basic research activities. Uses pre-determined guidelines to assist in decision-making.

Job Description:

***COVER LETTER REQUIRED***

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES

1. Administrative: Performs routine and complex clerical and administrative tasks including but not limited to detailed scheduling activities, writing and editing correspondence, compiling and coordinating mailings, taking meeting notes, and facilitating follow-up actions. Updates applicable databases and systems on a timely basis and ensures documents and files are accurately maintained and archived. Maintains email and distribution lists.

2. Event Planning and Management: Coordinates and executes logistical arrangements for internal and external meetings and workshops in both virtual and in-person settings. For in-person meetings, coordinates travel and lodging arrangements, selects menus and arranges catering, arranges for support services (e.g. AV), and registers attendees. For virtual meetings, organizes and sets up virtual meeting platform (e.g. Zoom) according to the needs of the meeting, and coordinates with participants. Whether virtual or in-person, assists at meetings and resolves issues. Assembles meeting materials and briefing books and distributes to meeting participants in advance of meeting. Coordinates and executes post-meeting tasks, such as preparing vouchers and reviewing and processing travel expense reports in compliance with applicable policies and procedures.

3. Communication, Dissemination, and Information Management: Updates applicable databases and systems on a timely basis and ensures documents and files are accurately maintained and archived. Maintains email and distribution lists, and coordinates website updates. Responds to inquiries and follows-up on communications. Communicates with members, sponsors, or other external customers, answering questions and providing information.

4. Publications: May assist with formatting, editing, and proofreading publications, as well as coordinating with printers/publishers to have materials printed.

5. Research Support: May perform basic research activities, including gathering citations and performing literature searches for staff and committee members. May participate in other research efforts including collection, assembly, and tabulation of data and summarizing literature.


NONESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES
Related duties and special projects as assigned.


JOB SPECIFICATIONS
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Ability to plan and support extensive meeting activities. Ability to solve problems with supervisory consultation or by following procedures. Ability to prioritize work and the flexibility to change directions as the job dictates. Ability to work successfully in a team environment. Ability to develop relationships with co-workers and employees in other National Academies’ departments through effective communication. Good communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to effectively interact with all levels of employees.
Minimum Education/Training Requirements: High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent knowledge.
Minimum Experience: Four years of related experience.
Physical Capabilities: Ability to work at a computer for extended periods of time. Ability to travel.
Required Licenses, Certification or Registration: None.
Supervisory Responsibilities/Controls: Reports to program coordinator/officer/director. Supervisor is available to organize work, set objectives, and to assist in problem resolution.

Work Environment: Hybrid Office/Telecommute environment, expected onsite percentage 60%, with occasional travel between National Academies’ facilities and to off-site meeting/sponsor locations.

Compensation & Benefits: An estimated compensation range for this position is $23.97 - $29.96 per hour, plus potential overtime. Compensation offered to the selected candidate will be based on the candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and work experience, commensurate with compensation of current employees in comparable positions with similar knowledge, skills, and work experience, and subject to budget parameters. Note it is not typical for a candidate to be hired at the higher end of the range. This is a benefits-eligible position. Our Benefits Plan offers competitive and comprehensive benefit options, including medical, dental and vision insurance, life insurance, disability coverage, retirement and savings benefits, leave benefits such as paid holidays and paid personal leave, transportation subsidies, and education assistance. For more information, please click here.

title: Library Assistant

Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays 1:00-5:00 p.m.

title: Doradca Klienta operatora sieci komórkowej (K/M)
description:
Dobra rozmowa zaczyna się od słuchania

Są rozmowy, w których od razu wiadomo, czego potrzebuje druga osoba. Są też takie, w których trzeba zadać kilka pytań, dobrze posłuchać i dopiero wtedy znaleźć odpowiednią propozycję.

Właśnie na tym opiera się współpraca na naszym projekcie sprzedażowym dla operatora sieci komórkowej.

Szukamy osób, które chcą rozwijać swoje umiejętności komunikacyjne, poznać od środka sprzedaż telefoniczną i zdobyć doświadczenie w kontakcie z klientem.

Co będzie po Twojej stronie?

Będziesz prowadzić rozmowy z aktualnymi oraz potencjalnymi klientami operatora. Podczas kontaktu poznasz potrzeby rozmówcy, przedstawisz dostępne rozwiązania i pomożesz mu wybrać interesującą ofertę.

W zależności od rozmowy może to być m.in..:

  • przedłużenie umowy,

  • przeniesienie numeru,

  • dodatkowa usługa,

  • inny produkt dostępny w ofercie operatora.

Do tego dochodzi odpowiadanie na pytania klientów oraz uzupełnianie informacji o kontakcie w systemie.

Nie musisz znać się na wszystkim

Przygotujemy Cię do realizacji zlecenia.

6-dniowe szkolenie wdrożeniowe

Poznasz ofertę, narzędzia i sposób prowadzenia rozmów. Przećwiczysz również różne sytuacje, które mogą pojawić się podczas kontaktu z klientem.

Proponujemy:

31,40 zł brutto za każdą godzinę realizacji zlecenia

Ponadto możesz otrzymać wynagrodzenie dodatkowe uzależnione od spełnienia dodatkowych kryteriów jakości wykonania usług.

Jeżeli masz doświadczenie w sprzedaży, możesz otrzymać 400 zł bonusu.

Do tego:

  • umowa zlecenia,

  • elastyczne godziny świadczenia usług,

  • przygotowanie do realizacji zadań,

  • niezbędne narzędzia,

  • możliwość dalszego rozwoju w ramach współpracy,

  • Karta MultiSport

  • konkursy, vouchery i nagrody,

  • wydarzenia integracyjne,

  • 500 zł za skuteczne polecenie osoby do współpracy

Jak wygląda organizacja?

Jeżeli masz taką możliwość, zależy nam na realizacji zlecenia przez około 40 godzin tygodniowo.

Potrzebujesz zmienić godziny? Wystarczy przekazać informację opiekunowi projektu — takie informacje są ważne z punktu widzenia organizacji projektu, który funkcjonuje pomiędzy 7:00 a 23:00

Czy to może być coś dla Ciebie?

Nie szukamy wyłącznie osób z doświadczeniem.

Jeśli dopiero zaczynasz swoją drogę zawodową, studiujesz, uczysz się albo chcesz sprawdzić się w sprzedaży — możesz rozpocząć współpracę bez rozbudowanego CV.

Najważniejsze jest to, jak komunikujesz się z ludźmi, czy potrafisz ich słuchać i czy chcesz nauczyć się skutecznie prowadzić rozmowy.

Jeśli brzmi jak coś, czego chcesz spróbować — poznaj szczegóły projektu i zdecyduj, czy to współpraca dla Ciebie.

Poznaj nas lepiej:

IG: telbridge.torun

TikTok: telbridge_

Informacje Prawne

"Wyrażam zgodę na przetwarzanie danych osobowych przez Telbridge Sp. z o.o. Sp. k. z siedzibą w ul. Zagnańska 49, 25 – 528 Kielce w celach rekrutacyjnych i wykorzystanie mojego numeru kontaktowego i adresu e-mail do w/w celu. Pełna wersja klauzuli informacyjnej znajduje się na stronie ”.

title: Pomocnik / Pomocniczka konserwatora UTB (windy)
description:
Oferujemy szeroką gamę usług, związanych z montażem i serwisem wind oraz schodów ruchomych.
Znamy się na dźwigach jak nikt inny w regionie. Od ponad 30 lat jesteśmy sprawdzonym partnerem setek klientów, dla których instalujemy i serwisujemy windy oraz schody ruchome. Jesteśmy producentem wind i dla każdego klienta.

Opis stanowiska:

  • Jako Pomocnik /Pomocniczka Konserwatora UTB będziesz wspierał Konserwatora w pracach serwisowych, naprawach i konserwacyjnych i zdobywał doświadczenie i praktyczną wiedzę, aby uzyskać niezbędne uprawnienia UDT

  • Jako Konserwator / Konserwatorka UTB będziesz oceniał stan techniczny wind i/lub schodów ruchomych, wykonywał napraw i regulacji w konserwowanych urządzeniach i świadczył usługi pogotowia dźwigowego

Oczekiwania:

  • Jeśli nie masz jeszcze uprawnień UDT na windy, ale możesz i chcesz je zdobyć, zostań Pomocnikiem / Pomocniczką Konserwatora UTB (Urządzeń Transportu Bliskiego), a my pomożemy Ci przejść cały proces szkoleniowy i zdobyć wymagane certyfikaty i kwalifikacje, aby stać się samodzielnym Konserwatorem. Wystarczy, że interesujesz się elektryką/elektroniką/mechaniką, masz doświadczenie lub wykształcenie w tym obszarze i uprawnienia SEP.

  • Jeśli posiadasz już uprawnienia UDT na windy i doświadczenie w konserwacji wind i/lub schodów ruchomych to zapraszamy Cię do naszego zespołu na stanowisko Konserwatora /Konserwatorki UTB. Otrzymasz od nas samochód służbowy.

Mile widziane

  • Uprawnienia SEP

  • Doświadczenie w konserwacji, serwisie lub utrzymaniu ruchu

Co oferujemy?

  • Dołączenie do zespołu lidera rynku, który buduje innowacyjne rozwiązania dla mobilności miejskiej.

  • Twoja wiedza techniczna to nasz priorytet – zapewniamy dostęp do nowoczesnych narzędzi i szkoleń, mamy też własne symulatory szkoleniowe.

  • Szeroki wachlarz benefitów i świadczeń socjalnych: prywatna opieka medyczna w Medicover z możliwością opieki stomatologicznej, możliwość korzystania z karty Multispoirt, dostęp do platformy Mindgram, dodatkowe ubezpieczenie na życie w PZU, kafeteria benefitów MyBenefit, nauka języka angielskiego, niemieckiego, francuskiego i hiszpańskiego na platformie językowej Speexx, dofinansowanie do wypoczynku pracownika i dofinansowanie do zorganizowanego wypoczynku dziecka, zespołowe integracje i pikniki regionalne.

  • Narzędzia pracy niezbędna na w/w stanowisku (telefon, środki ochrony osobistej, narzędzia).

  • Jasno określone możliwości rozwoju w ramach struktury firmy.

  • Finansowanie egzaminów UDT i SEP.

  • Dodatkowo płatne dyżury Pogotowia Dźwigowego.

  • Program Poleceń Pracowniczych.

  • Kulturę organizacyjną, która stawia na otwartość, inkluzywność, bezpieczeństwo i jakość.

title: Technical IT PM
company: WINGED IT SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ
description:
Wynagrodzenie
umowa o pracę: 16000 – 21000 PLN / mies. brutto

Employer: International Sensor Company

Location: Bielsko-Biała (remote)

Rate: 16 000 - 21 000 PLN gross/month on Employment Contract

Cooperation model: Employment Contract

Start date: ASAP

Recruitment process: 2 online interviews

We are looking for a hands-on Technical IT Project Manager to join our international Group Digital Services team.

In this role, you will drive infrastructure and technology projects across our global organization. This includes dedicated infrastructure initiatives as well as technical infrastructure workstreams within application-related projects, such as application implementations, migrations and modernization initiatives.

You will work directly with engineers, application teams, internal stakeholders and external technology partners, combining strong project management with a solid understanding of IT infrastructure and technical dependencies.

This is not a purely administrative project management role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working close to technology, understands technical discussions and can translate them into clear plans, decisions and actions.

Your role is:

  • Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of infrastructure, cloud, and technology projects from initiation through implementation.

  • Own project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.

  • Drive infrastructure initiatives and technical workstreams within application implementations, migrations, upgrades, and modernization programs.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers, architects, application teams, and technology partners to define requirements, priorities, and execution plans.

  • Translate technical requirements and dependencies into structured project plans, milestones, and actionable deliverables.

  • Manage cross-functional dependencies across infrastructure, cloud platforms, integrations, and enterprise applications.

  • Proactively identify and resolve project risks, technical challenges, and organizational obstacles.

  • Coordinate activities across internal teams, business stakeholders, international locations, vendors, and implementation partners.

  • Monitor project progress, budgets, milestones, and deliverables using Jira and provide clear status reporting and escalation when required.

  • Drive accountability, maintain relevant project documentation, and contribute to the continuous improvement of project delivery practices within Digital Operations.

Your skills and experiences:

  • Several years of experience managing technical IT projects in infrastructure, cloud, migration, or modernization environments.

  • Strong working knowledge of IT infrastructure, cloud environments, and the dependencies between infrastructure and enterprise applications.

  • Ability to understand technical discussions, identify risks and dependencies, and translate them into clear decisions, plans, and actions.

  • Strong ownership mentality with a proactive, hands-on approach to driving initiatives and resolving obstacles.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams, application specialists, business stakeholders, management, and external technology partners.

  • Strong organizational skills combined with a pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset.

  • Ability to manage multiple parallel initiatives while maintaining focus on priorities, dependencies, timelines, and delivery outcomes.

  • Very good English communication skills, as you will work in an international environment. Polish is an advantage but not required.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Azure and/or AWS environments.

  • Experience with Jira, Microsoft 365 or comparable collaboration and project management tools.

  • Experience working in international and geographically distributed teams.

  • Project management (PMP, PRINCE2) and/or agile certifications are welcome but not required.

  • Experience managing technical workstreams within enterprise application implementation projects is an advantage.

Our client offers:

  • Great opportunity for personal development in a stable and friendly large multinational company;

  • Career growth and additional education;

  • Training courses;

  • Language courses;

  • Company events;

  • Flexible working hours.

If interested, please apply safely through this portal (application rules are in accordance with GDPR). Employment agency Nr 17138.

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Overview

The CASQ (Copilot, Agents, Search Quality) Search Relevance team is at the forefront of delivering world-class search quality across Microsoft's ecosystem. We are the driving force behind the relevance of results in Copilot Search experiences and serve as the core retrieval layer in the RAG architecture powering Bizchat (CoPilot Chat). Our impact also extends to maintaining high search quality across traditional endpoints like Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint Search. Our team thrives at the intersection of innovation and applied machine learning.

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to help us deliver breakthrough applied machine learning and information retrieval solutions at enterprise scale. This role is a unique opportunity to apply state-of-the-art techniques-including dense retrieval, hybrid search, multilingual large language models (LLMs), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and transformer-based re-ranking models and agentic search-to solve complex challenges in Copilot-driven enterprise search.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you'll be responsible for delivering mission-critical innovations that directly improve Copilot experiences such as:

  • Agentic Search in modern orchestrator architectures

  • Adapting advanced vector search algorithms (e.g., FAISS, ANN, ScaNN) for enterprise-scale semantic retrieval

  • Improving classic and neural keyword search quality through deep language understanding

  • Designing and training relevance models, including LLM fine-tuning and learning-to-rank (LTR) approaches

  • Building robust evaluation pipelines using offline metrics and online A/B experimentation

  • Driving cross-org collaboration with platform partners, other applied science teams, and product teams across time zones

  • Setting vision and directions for agentic search in CoPilot Chat inspired by state-of-the-art and data-driven analysis

This role requires a mix of technical depth, strategic execution, and people management to shape the next generation of AI-powered search experiences.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end applied science projects: From ideation and design to implementation, experimentation, and shipping, you will lead high-impact projects that directly improve Copilot Chat, Copilot Search, and BizChat experiences. This includes identifying search and relevance gaps, formulating innovative hypotheses, and delivering scalable solutions.

  • Inspire help to grow a high-performing applied science team: mentor, and empower a team of applied scientists-owning their technical direction, project execution, and career development. You will guide day-to-day work, ensure scientific and engineering rigor, and be accountable for the team's output and impact.

  • Innovate with scientific rigor: Invent and apply cutting-edge techniques in machine learning, natural language processing, and information retrieval to address real-world challenges at enterprise scale. You will design novel approaches for improving retrieval, ranking, query understanding, and semantic search in Copilot systems.

  • Document, share, and amplify learnings: Promote a culture of transparency and innovation by capturing experimental results, documenting methodology, and publishing internal learnings. You'll drive knowledge sharing that enables broader impact across the organization.

  • Translate business goals into scientific strategy: Partner closely with product and business stakeholders to align team efforts with high-priority objectives. You will translate ambiguous product requirements into clear, data-driven, and technically feasible directions.

  • Collaborate across organizations and time zones: Work cross-functionally with platform engineering teams, peer science orgs, and product managers to ensure alignment, resolve dependencies, and unblock progress. You'll be a key bridge between applied science innovation and product delivery.

  • Embody our Culture and Values



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years related experience (e.g., statistics predictive analytics, research)
    • OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 1+ year(s) related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 9+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience in applied science projects from ideation to production-in high-scale environments such as search, recommendation, or conversational AI.
  • 5+ years experience in data analysis at scale, including working with logs, telemetry, and large datasets to uncover behavioral patterns, build evaluation datasets, and derive insights.
  • 6+ years experience creating publications (e.g., patents, libraries, peer-reviewed academic papers).
  • 2+ years experience presenting at conferences or other events in the outside research/industry community as an invited speaker.
  • 5+ years experience conducting research as part of a research program (in academic or industry settings).
  • 5+ years experience developing and deploying live production systems, as part of a product team.
  • 5+ years experience developing and deploying products or systems at multiple points in the product cycle from ideation to shipping.
  • Experience in search and ranking systems, semantic retrieval, and information retrieval at scale.
  • Applied experience with state-of-the-art sparse and dense retrieval and ranking techniques.
  • Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures using LLMs such as OpenAI GPT, T5, or Llama.

title: Fullstack Developer TypeScript/React
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 19000 – 24000 PLN / mies. netto

To nie jest typowa rola "tylko produkt" ani "tylko platforma" - mniej więcej połowę czasu spędzisz przy rozwoju aplikacji, drugą połowę przy CI/CD i platformie deweloperskiej. Jeśli lubisz, gdy Twój kod trafia na produkcję przez pipeline, który sam współtworzysz i rozumiesz od podszewki - to dobre miejsce.

Zakres obowiązków:

  • Tworzenie i rozwój aplikacji: Rozbudowa warstwy frontendowej i backendowej w oparciu o ekosystem JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Next.js, Node.js).

  • Automatyzacja CI/CD: Projektowanie, optymalizacja i utrzymanie procesów budowy oraz wdrożeń aplikacji z wykorzystaniem GitHub Actions (w tym praca nad rewalidacją workflow, macierzami zadań i skróceniem czasu oraz kosztu buildów).

  • Zarządzanie środowiskami i procesem wdrożeniowym: Rozbudowa wieloetapowego ścieżki deploymentu (Test → UAT → Prod), automatyzacja środowisk tymczasowych (ephemeral environments) dla Pull Requestów oraz obsługa bezprzestojowych migracji baz danych.

  • Konteneryzacja: Optymalizacja i tworzenie obrazów kontenerów (multi-stage builds, kontrola warstw, minifikacja rozmiaru i powtarzalność kompilacji).

  • Zarządzanie infrastrukturą chmurową (Azure): Obsługa usług chmurowych, w tym Azure Container Apps/Jobs, Azure Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure Database for PostgreSQL oraz Azure Container Registry.

  • Bezpieczeństwo i standardy CI/CD: Wdrożenie uwierzytelniania opartego na OIDC, utwardzanie uprawnień i izolacja runnerów CI oraz utrzymywanie bramek jakościowych (quality gates) w podejściu fail-closed.

  • Observability i FinOps: Rozwój monitoringu (logowanie strukturalne, metryki, alerty) oraz kontrola i optymalizacja kosztów chmury i zasobów AI (zużycie tokenów).

  • Jakość kodu i procesy zespołowe: Prowadzenie Code Review (dla kodu tworzonego przez deweloperów oraz narzędzia AI), dbanie o higienę repozytorium (limity PR) oraz automatyzacja przypisywania recenzentów na podstawie analizy ryzyka zmian.

Wymagania stanowiska

  • Bardzo dobrej znajomości TypeScript i Node.js w środowisku produkcyjnym

  • Doświadczenia z React i Next.js (App Router)

  • Znajomości SQL i pracy z PostgreSQL

  • Sprawnego poruszania się w GitHub Actions

  • Praktyki w pracy z Dockerem

  • Doświadczenia z dowolną chmurą publiczną i otwartości na pracę w Azure

  • Rozumienia zasady fail-closed przy projektowaniu zabezpieczeń

  • Umiejętności traktowania CI jako narzędzia egzekwującego jakość i bezpieczeństwo, nie tylko automatyzacji buildów

  • Podstaw obserwowalności (logi, metryki, alerty)

Oferujemy

  • praca zdalna z zastrzeżeniem 1 dzień w miesiącu biuro w Warszawie

  • długofalowa współpraca

  • realny wpływ zespołu na tworzone produkty

  • Data Analytics and Reporting: ability to analyze operational data, identify trends, track performance metrics, and generate recurring reports to support engineering management decisions.

  • Attention to Detail: strong organizational skills and accuracy when maintaining engineering data, specifications, standards, and documentation.
  • Ability to work in an office environment, primarily in a seated position, with occasional lifting of up to 10-15 pounds.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with data analytics, data mining, trend analysis, and performance measurement.
  • Experience maintaining project management databases, operational dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with engineering documentation, technical standards, specifications, and document control processes.
  • Experience with HTML, JavaScript, or C programming languages is a plus.
  • Ability to identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, data quality, and information management processes.

  • Experience with SharePoint.
  • Prior aircraft experience preferred.


Unique Skills:

  • Participation in a DOT/FAA drug and alcohol program may be required.


Purpose:

Under limited supervision, generates various reports & documents and coordinates the control & release of technical data. Primary responsibilities include, but not limited to, gathering, organizing, generating, processing and supporting data & information.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Perform administrative review of the Request for Services (RFS) database and facilitate daily RFS review meetings with group heads and management.
  • Populate and maintain weekly dashboard reports, including ECMs, GBMS, Model Reviews, Document Release, and MRB metrics.
  • Analyze data and provide recommendations on recurring Power BI dashboard trends using data visualization tools.
  • Assist in the development of manuals, procedures, and training materials.
  • Track and monitor job status through established workflow processes.
  • Support the procurement collaboration team to improve communication channels and operational effectiveness.
  • Execute authorship of condition 3 document changes.
  • Support engineering standards document conversions into new formats.
  • Perform data entry and maintenance activities within materials & process engineering SharePoint environments.
  • Interface daily with group heads (GH), PDTs, and management during coordination meetings.
  • Maintain and update the materials and process engineering group's centralized workload management system, including project data, workstreams, and dashboards.
  • Generate routine reports for management to identify workload trends, project risks, resource constraints, and projects that cannot currently be supported.
  • Analyze project queues and track the status of active projects and high-priority requests for services.
  • Support engineering leadership and group heads in tracking action items, project status, priorities, and performance metrics.
  • Participate in recurring meetings with engineering group heads to review service requests, priorities, and workload status.
  • Analyze incoming non-conformances and identify recurring issues, trends, and potential opportunities for root cause and corrective action.

  • Support the maintenance and organization of engineering documentation, databases, and SharePoint resources.
  • Collaborate with engineering leadership and technical staff to improve data visibility, reporting processes, and workload management tools.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

title: Program Manager, Creative Arts Therapies at South Shore Conservatory
description:
About Us:
South Shore Conservatory (SSC) is a community school for the arts on Boston's South Shore, welcoming individuals of all ages and abilities. With campuses in Hingham and Duxbury, SSC’s arts-based programs provide a creative path for a lifetime of learning, from childhood through adulthood, through outstanding faculty and nationally-celebrated programming in music instruction, ensembles, dance, early childhood education, creative arts therapy, performance, community and school partnerships.

About Creative Art Therapies:
The Creative Arts Therapies program is an integral part of SSC’s mission to provide access to exceptional arts education and performance for the South Shore Community, fostering creativity, artistic growth, and well-being for individuals of all ages, background and ability. CAT is a critical component of SSC’s position as an arts leader on the South Shore, demonstrating a commitment to its mission and community service.

SSC’s Creative Arts Therapies uses music, dance, visual arts, and yoga as therapy and to enhance wellness among children and adults with a wide range of health and development challenges. Services are provided in individual and group sessions at SSC facilities, in client’s homes, and through partnerships with several South Shore community organizations.
About the Position:
SSC’s Clinical Program Manager for Creative Arts Therapies is responsible for providing clear clinical oversight for the CAT program to offer supportive programming and services. This position will maintain a cohesive treatment philosophy, serve as a liaison to individual clients and community partners, and provide clinical consultation and training to all clinical faculty to ensure a high quality of service to clients. This position also provides direct music therapy to clients.











Responsibilities, Essential Functions and Skills:
Music Therapy
  • Provide person-centered music therapy groups and individual sessions onsite and in the community.
  • Create measurable goals and treatment plans addressing client needs.
  • Complete necessary documentation in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with an interdisciplinary clinical team as required.
  • Partner with Faculty and Staff to provide clinical consultation for different learning styles.
Administration
  • Serve as the first point of contact for CAT inquiries related to 1:1 services and onsite groups.
  • Conduct intake interviews with potential clients in order to accurately match students with therapists for trial sessions.
  • Work closely with CAT faculty to schedule groups within the community.
  • Compile all necessary billing information on a monthly basis in a timely manner.
  • Communicate clearly with departments involved in the operations of CAT (i.e. Registration)
Supervision
  • Provide support throughout the onboarding process of new hires.
  • Provide weekly group supervision to the CAT team.
  • Observe and provide feedback related to CAT programming in the community.
  • Directly supervise and manage music therapy practicum students and university interns.
  • Participate in annual performance reviews.
Education, Experience and Qualifications Required:
  • Master’s Degree in Music Therapy.
  • Professionally credentialed (i.e. MT-BC).
  • Minimum of 5 years professional clinical experience preferred as well as 1-2 years in a supervisory role in some capacity.
  • Able to work in the U.S. without requiring sponsorship.

Competencies:
  • Music therapy
  • Communication
  • Documentation
  • Clinical Supervision

Work Environment:
This job operates in an office and professional environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers and filing cabinets. On occasion the job will require going out in the field, visiting vendors.

Physical Demands:
This is mostly sedentary outside of travel in an office space. This would require the ability to sit at a desk, frequent walking, bend or stand as necessary.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:
Designated days and schedule will be primarily Monday-Friday though will also be based on the needs of the operation and business, at times requiring weekends, nights and early mornings to support events.

Compensation and Travel:
This is an hourly position. Administration hours are $35 an hour and all clinical work is $45 an hour. Travel is required 30% of the time and based on the needs of the operation and business.

Other Duties:

description:
Requisition ID: 278084

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

About the role

As a Customer Experience Associate, you are the face, character and heart of our branches. Scotiabank is a place where we put our customers first, and our priority is to help them achieve their financial goals.

Our Customer Experience Associates are people-centric and connect with customers in a relatable way. As an essential member of the Canadian Banking Branch network, the focus is to provide exceptional service throughout the customer’s journey by:

  • Taking a proactive approach to discovering our customer’s needs and listening to understand what they are asking for
  • Processing day to day transactions
  • Nurturing rich, long-standing relationships
  • Contributing to the Branch’s targets by identifying and fulfilling simple sales opportunities
  • Being a technology expert and sharing your knowledge by introducing clients to our mobile banking applications and assisting them to better manage their banking needs

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

  • Build strong customer relationships and deliver excellent customer service
  • Uncover and solve customers’ needs
  • Explain complicated concepts simply
  • Demonstrate success in a target-based performance environment, as well as contribute positively to a team-oriented work environment
  • Demonstrate an eagerness to learn and determination to succeed

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? – We’d love to work with you if you:

  • Have proven customer service skills through work or community involvement
  • Are willing to assist in a professional, friendly and efficient manner
  • Are available to work a flexible schedule
  • Are comfortable in simple sales situations
  • Have strong technical skills and the ability to promote digital and self-service banking options to our customers

What’s in it for you?

  • The opportunity to join a forward-thinking organization surrounded by a collaborative team of innovative thinkers
  • A rewarding career path with diverse opportunities for professional development
  • Internal training to support your career growth and enhance your skills
  • An organization committed to making a difference in our communities – for you and our customers
  • You can expect to be recognized and rewarded for high-performance. You’ll be supported by leadership through meaningful development conversations that enable faster advancement and internal training to support your growth and development.
  • A competitive compensation and benefits package

Location(s): Canada : British Columbia : Courtenay

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

description:

Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced Project Lead to drive delivery and coordination one of our teams with a multi-team project. The Projet Lead ensures smooth execution across streams, aligns stakeholders, and enables the team to deliver high-quality outcomes in an agile environment.

title: Sr. Inventory Planner
description:
ABOUT US

Stio® is an omni-channel mountain brand that designs, develops and sells beautiful, functional, and innovative apparel, footwear and other accessories infused with the soul of the mountain lifestyle. With headquarters in Jackson, Wyoming, Stio draws inspiration from the surrounding Teton Range and offers product via Stio.com, catalog, B2B and its Mountain Studio® retail locations.

We live and love mountain life, and as such see ourselves as caretakers of the resources that provide it. We are proud partners of Protect Our Winters and the Conservation Alliance among many other organizations. We have a strong preferred materials platform, use Bluesign® approved textiles wherever possible, audit our supply chains for best practices, and operate our workplaces responsibly.

We think that outside is the best side and that you can’t improve on nature. It’s good for mind, body and soul, and it’s our responsibility to help enable access for all people, regardless of race, gender, beliefs, background or ability. We strive for inclusion at Stio and in our local and national communities.

YOUR ROLE

The Sr. Inventory Planner is responsible for executing and maintaining buy plans to ensure product availability aligns with seasonal and in-season inventory requirements. This role manages purchase orders, maintains accurate receipt and available-to-sell projections, and recommends air or ocean delivery based on timelines, demand, and cost. Working closely with Category Planning, Production/Sourcing, Operations, and Finance, the Sr. Inventory Planner helps ensure the right product arrives at the right time to support business needs.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Translate seasonal and in-season inventory plans into purchase order and supply requirements by style, color, and size.
  • Create, maintain, and manage purchase orders in alignment with approved buys, inventory targets, and delivery requirements.
  • Own and maintain the Planning Buy Plan monthly and as needed, incorporating demand, on-hand inventory, open orders, lead times, vendor capacity, minimum order quantities, and production constraints, to support forecasting and cross-functional partners.
  • Analyze air versus ocean freight options for key deliveries, weighing timelines, demand, current inventory position, and freight cost, and recommend the mode that best balances product availability and margin.
  • Identify styles at risk of missing launch or in-season need dates, and build the business case for air expedites by comparing the added freight cost to the sales at risk.
  • Proactively communicate supply risks and recommend solutions, including delivery prioritization, PO adjustments, cancellations, expedites, or shifts in receipt timing.
  • Manage delivery timing to support seasonal launches, channel needs, and inventory productivity while minimizing early or excess inventory.
  • Partner closely with Category Planning to ensure supply decisions support inventory targets, weeks of supply, sell-through, and overall business objectives.
  • Maintain accurate purchase order, delivery, and supply information within planning systems.
  • Analyze inventory performance and identify opportunities to improve lead times, inventory flow, and freight efficiency.
  • Support monthly and seasonal forecasting, open-to-buy, and inventory review processes with accurate supply and receipt projections, including safety stock analytics and available-to-sell inventory.
  • Partner with Finance to provide visibility into inventory receipts, purchase commitments, freight costs, and changes to planned inventory investment.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships across Planning, Merchandising, Production/Sourcing, Operations, Finance, and other key business partners.

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, engineering, economics, operations management, or equivalent.
  • 4+ years of experience in supply planning, inventory planning, production planning, purchasing, or a related function; apparel, footwear, outdoor, or consumer products experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of seasonal product lifecycles, purchase orders, lead times, inventory flow, and other supply planning elements.
  • Working knowledge of freight modes, transit times, and landed cost, as well as safety stock and available-to-sell concepts.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations and processes.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, charts, and functions such as SUMIF and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
  • Experience with planning software is required; Toolio preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple seasons, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining a broader understanding of business and inventory objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify risks early, solve problems, and communicate clearly across functions.
  • Collaborative, curious, and comfortable operating in an environment where priorities can change quickly.

THE FINE PRINT

  • Medical, Dental Vision plans
  • Company Paid Long Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • 401k with Match
  • Generous paid time off policies
  • Gear test, perks and more

We provide competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives and benefits. The base salary range for this role is $75,000-$89,000. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of the range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors including experience, skills, and qualifications.

This job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts, or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, we reserve the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed. title: Purchasing & Contracts Specialist
description:

Job Title: Purchasing & Contracts Specialist

The Purchasing & Contracts Specialist supports purchasing, vendor management, and contract administration across Accurant International’s portfolio companies. This role sources indirect goods and services, coordinates vendor contract reviews and renewals, maintains accurate records, and helps identify purchasing savings and process improvements.

The position also provides administrative and project support to the General Counsel. As experience develops, this individual will learn to review and redline routine vendor agreements under the guidance of Operations and Legal.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Source and purchase indirect goods and services, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and coordinate purchase orders and renewals.
  • Work with business owners and senior leaders to clarify purchasing needs, ask questions to assess requests, and communicate purchasing requirements, concerns, and decisions.
  • Analyze portfolio-wide purchasing spend, track savings, and identify opportunities for vendor consolidation and improved purchasing arrangements.
  • Administer the P-card program, including card requests, approval workflow, setup, transaction follow-up, and reporting.
  • Administer the portfolio-wide vendor-management process, including onboarding, qualification, classification, documentation, and periodic reviews.
  • Coordinate the vendor contract review process, including gathering business requirements, tracking reviews and approvals, arranging signatures, and following up on outstanding items.
  • Maintain contract and document repositories, approved templates, and renewal dates, ensuring records are accurate and accessible.
  • Prepare routine agreements from approved templates and progressively assume review and redlining of low-value vendor contracts under Operations and Legal guidance, escalating substantive issues as needed.
  • Provide approximately ten hours per week of support to the General Counsel across contract and document administration, research, document preparation, questionnaires, and special projects.
  • Document procedures and help improve purchasing and contract administration processes across the portfolio.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, operations, legal studies, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1 -3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, contract administration, legal support, or a related business support role.
  • Interest in developing vendor negotiation and contract review skills.
  • Strong critical thinking and research skills, with the curiosity to ask thoughtful questions, evaluate business needs, and move loosely defined assignments toward practical resolution.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence and tact to respectfully challenge requests, explain decisions, and remain composed in difficult conversations with senior leaders.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
  • Sound judgment when handling confidential information and determining when additional guidance or escalation is needed.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their responsible use in document preparation, review, and analysis.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel for spend analysis and reporting.
  • Experience with purchasing systems, contract repositories, DocuSign, or Adobe Sign is a plus.

About Us

Accurant Family of companies offer innovative solutions to tackle pressing climate and energy technology challenges through our portfolio companies. Our investments include fields around energy and clean-tech ranging from renewable energy management, smart grid technologies, grid automation and management, demand response and virtual power plants, distribution system sensors and AI analytics, and professional services and expert consulting.

Culture

Privately owned, friendly and family-oriented company with growth and advancement opportunities and learning new advanced technologies. We are a customer focused and employee centered organization. Innovation is the core of our business philosophy.

It is the policy of Accurant not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or any employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status.

title: Wholesale Business Coordinator
description:
Join Our Growing Team!

Vintners Distributors is the corporate arm that oversees West Coast Convenience, Eaton Foods, Eatswell, and Prohas Enterprises. Headquartered in Union City, CA, the company operates a growing network of convenience stores, fuel stations, and car washes across California. Founded in 1978, it also develops real estate and owns and operates its locations.


Vintners Distributors continues to expand and seeks customer-focused individuals who want to make an impact. We are committed to delivering high-quality, better-for-you products and an exceptional store experience, guided by our core values: People, Teamwork, Communication, Training, Results Matter, Fun, Customer-Centered, and Safety.


If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are driven by service, innovation, and teamwork, we invite you to join us in redefining convenience for our customers every day.


Position Summary

The Wholesale Business Coordinator supports both the Director of Wholesale and the Wholesale Billing Lead. You will own tracking, preparation, follow-up and documentation across pricing, customer onboarding, billing support, carriers and oil-company administration. Your work keeps dealers paid, billed correctly, and served on time, so the leaders can focus on growing accounts.


Pricing approvals, credit decisions, and dispatch stay with the current owners. You prepare the work, keep it on track, and close the loop.


Key Responsibilities

Daily pricing support

· Send the morning rack and price notices to the sales reps.

· Keep the price-match log: record each request, check it against pricing guidelines, get approval, and send a weekly recap.

· Prepare quote packages for new and prospective customers for approval from the Director.


New customer onboarding

· Collect and route credit applications, EFT forms, seller permits and setup documents.

· Run a standard onboarding checklist covering credit, system setup, pricing, carrier, tank chart and first delivery date.

· Tell treasury ahead of time about planned bank-detail changes for new accounts.


Billing and back-office support

· Prepare corrected invoices and rebills for the Billing Lead to review and send.

· Act as first contact for dealer requests for invoice copies and EFT notices and reply within one business day.

· Collect delivery documents (BOLs, driver paperwork) for billing disputes before a credit decision is made.

· Track returned ACH payments until the re-draft clears.

· Process supplier EFT and company-name changes, and track oil-company receivables until they are paid.

· Follow up on supplier invoices missing from the billing system.


Carriers

· Set up new carriers (rate sheet, W-9, insurance, company profile).

· Send a monthly scorecard of carrier loads by terminal.

· Log carrier incidents and claims and see them through to closure.


Oil-company and branded administration

· Track branding and incentive funds from approval to receipt.

· Pull delivery records for oil-company compliance requests.

· Help prepare offer comparisons for sales reps.


Reporting and team support

· Pull data for finance requests and period-end margin reports.

· Prepare pipeline updates and weekly meeting agendas.

· Keep the CRM up to date.

· Coordinate fuel deliveries with retail operations for company-operated sites, including site access and new site openings.
