Acts as a technical thought leader by sharing best practices (e.g., architectures, materials) and regularly delivering content at Microsoft events (e.g., TechReady). Provides insight into how to identify opportunities to increase solutions/portfolio understanding, emphasizing continuous security enhancement and regulatory compliance.
Enables and empowers team to develop technical expertise and provide technical insights to internal teams. Acts as a role model by increasing own technical knowledge and serving as a respected technology leader to team. Provides insight onto Corporate, business and product groups, sales strategy, and business reviews for impact.

Leverage Partner Ecosystem

Supports partner technical capacity by monitoring and analyzing resources through interactions, communicating with managers, and identifying new partnership opportunities to build subsidiary strategy.
Maximizes area-level capacity and capabilities by coaching team to grow partner network, identifying gaps and promoting Microsoft within the Microsoft ecosystem (e.g., account teams). Raises escalations or alleviates blockers through collaboration with manager-level counterparts in cross-functional groups.

People Management

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Scale Customer Engagements

Proactively identifies and engages with key customer technical decision makers and influencers while engaging sales team. Coaches and enables team to identify and proactively engage with key customer technical decision makers and influencers to help unblock technical obstacles.
Enables and empowers team to influence customer decisions and ensure technical wins by streamlining processes and managing the flow of wins, leveraging deep knowledge of processes (e.g., Managed Service Provider [MSP], Managed Certified Professional [MCP]), tools, and programs (e.g., FastTrack, End Customer Investment Funds [ECIFs]). Aligns goals across solution areas and facilitates cross-selling with various workloads (e.g., Apps, Data and Infrastructure)
Leverages knowledge of resources (e.g., roles, Microsoft Technology Center [MTC], demo sites, virtual sites, Value Based Delivery [VBD], Customer Success Unit [CSU]) and owns resolution of technical and non-technical blockers by engaging other teams (e.g., engineering, Account Team Unit [ATU], Specialist Team Unit [STU]) and conveying impact. Anticipates and addresses future potential blockers based on needs. Identifies patterns of blockers within area of expertise and drives resolution through local and global escalation.
Uses knowledge of customer context, and deep technical, domain, and industry knowledge to build credibility with customers and act as a trusted advisor to assess and consult on their security needs.
Ensures consistency and quality through capturing, sharing, and adherence of standards and best practices in customer engagements by implementing cross-functional initiatives to different channels across a subsidiary to drive consistency in technical approach and ensure customer technical experience across teams.
Orchestrates team resources and coaches team to maximize impact of customer engagements and drive mid-to long-term strategy through cross-workload capacity planning, prioritization, and utilization of resources. Proactively plans team resources and influences future blueprints. Qualifies and prioritizes opportunities, and holds team accountable for maximizing selling time to achieve scorecard objectives and subsidiary strategy.

Solution Design and Proof

Applies advanced sales methodologies (e.g., challenger sales) and coaches team in guiding customers through digital transformation solutions, underscoring security improvements and using innovation to challenge solutions against changing technology (e.g., Power Apps).
Identifies new technical and business trends and needs, and identifies ideas that can be transformed into solutions that benefit customers/partners, serving as the voice of the customer (VOC) to Microsoft. Ensures input is utilized and solutions for the customer are established at the area level.
Coaches team to envision new and innovative solutions that use Microsoft technology to meet customer needs. Supports team in coordinating with stakeholders to develop solutions for complex sales scenarios. Ensures team capability to execute on those solutions.
Coaches team and oversees demonstrations (e.g., architectural design sessions, and proof of concept [POC] sessions, pilots, hackathons) of solutions based on multiple products and position solutions against competitors. Ensures demonstrations enable customers to identify and resolve technical issues with clear criteria and next steps that guarantee deployment of Microsoft technology.
Promotes adaptation and extension of architecture patterns to accommodate complex customer requirements and drive integration solutions for industry flavor.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR 7+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
  • 3+ years people management experience (including leading virtual teams).

description:

This position may also include interviewing, hiring and training new workers. May have assistance from lead workers.

title: Building Manger
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are currently seeking a Building Manager for a high-rise residential building with 233 units located in Vancouver. This is a full-time position where the Building Manager will serve as the primary point of contact between residents, the strata council, and the property manager, while also overseeing the cleaning, maintenance, and overall daily operations of the building to ensure a high standard of service and resident satisfaction.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage and supervise the site.
  • Perform minor handyman repairs. Monitor and maintain the garbage and recycling room.
  • Provide basic security duties, including checking doors and reporting suspicious activity.
  • Handle key holding and alarm response. Program fobs and enterphones.
  • Call trades in the event of elevator malfunctions, floods, plumbing issues, or emergencies involving police, fire, or ambulance.
  • Coordinate and log move-in/move-out bookings.
  • Collect damage deposits for move-ins/outs.
  • Perform pre- and post-inspections with residents.
  • Perform administrative duties (post notices, collect funds for additional fobs/keys, submit activity reports to the Property Manager).
  • Monitor and address parking violations and improper use of parking areas.
  • Maintain consistent communication with the Property Manager to ensure the building is secure, maintained, and running smoothly.
  • Submit caretaker reports regularly (frequency as requested by the Property Manager).
  • Provide excellent service to residents and guests; respond promptly to tenant questions and requests.
  • Report any concerning issues with tenants/residents to the Property Manager.

  • Proven experience in facility management, preferably in residential settings.
  • Reliable and punctual.
  • Possess a keen eye for detail. Customer service experience is an asset.
  • Occasional use of equipment such as leaf blowers and pressure washers (full training provided).
  • Strong computer skills, including advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.
  • Ability to take the lead and oversee building operations.
  • Ability to deal with residents in a professional, positive, and friendly manner.
  • Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to carry weights up to 35 lbs.

Working Hours: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $24.00 – $25.00 per hour

Shift: 8 hours per day

Starting Date: November 4

Experience:

  • Facilities maintenance: 2 years (preferred)

Work Location: Vancouver, BC

Why Work at Cleantech?

Join a team that values your growth, rewards your hard work, and invests in your future. We offer competitive wages, comprehensive training, and a clear path for advancement. With a strong policy of promoting from within, Cleantech provides opportunities to grow into technical caretaker or leadership roles, creating a fulfilling and rewarding career.

Please apply with your resume — we’d love to hear from you!

title: QC Analyst
description:
QC Analyst

Location: Glenbervie, Aberdeenshire

Permanent | Full Time | Shift Working

Join our Team at Macphie

Let us introduce ourselves...

Macphie, an internationally acclaimed family ingredient manufacturer, proudly situated in the picturesque and tranquil landscapes of Glenbervie in Aberdeenshire with sites in Glasgow and Midlands too. Our expertise spans across a spectrum of delectable delights, including sauces, bakery creations, and heavenly ice cream toppings. We also cater to the evolving culinary landscape with our plant-based and gluten-free offerings. Trusted partners to some of the globe's leading food brands, we are dedicated to transforming ideas and creativity into tangible, delectable solutions.

We're now looking for a QC Analyst to join our Quality team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a keen eye for detail who enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Reporting to the QC Team Leader, you'll play a key role in ensuring our raw materials and finished products consistently meet the high quality standards expected by both Macphie and our customers.

You'll be involved in routine quality control testing, product release, hygiene monitoring, calibration activities and maintaining accurate quality records, working closely with Production, Engineering and the wider Quality team to help ensure our products are safe, compliant and manufactured to the highest standards.

Salary: £31,000 - £34,000 per annum, depending on experience, plus an 8.5% shift allowance for all hours worked on the night shift once fully trained.

Shift Pattern

The role will initially operate on a two-week rotating shift pattern while training is completed:

  • Early Shift: 06:00 – 14:00
  • Back Shift: 14:00 – 22:00

Once fully trained, you'll move onto a three-week rotating shift pattern, which includes:

  • Early Shift: 06:00 – 14:00
  • Back Shift: 14:00 – 22:00
  • Night Shift: 22:00 – 06:00

What you'll be doing

  • Carrying out routine quality control testing on raw materials, finished goods and factored products.
  • Releasing products that meet specification.
  • Completing routine hygiene testing across production areas.
  • Supporting calibration of laboratory and production measuring equipment.
  • Maintaining accurate laboratory records and computer-based quality documentation.
  • Sampling and preparing materials for external laboratory analysis.
  • Supporting weight and volume compliance checks.
  • Working closely with Production and Engineering teams to maintain quality and food safety standards.
  • Ensuring all work is completed safely and in line with company procedures and legislation.

Requirements

We're looking for someone who is motivated, organised and takes pride in producing accurate work.

Ideally you'll have:

  • Previous experience within a Quality Control, Quality Assurance or food manufacturing environment (preferred but not essential).
  • Experience working within a production or manufacturing environment.
  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and web-based systems.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and organisational skills.
  • The ability to work well independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility to work a rotating shift pattern.
  • A basic understanding of food hygiene and health & safety requirements.

We're also looking for someone who demonstrates our values:

  • Attention to Detail – producing accurate work and maintaining high standards.
  • Respect – treating colleagues with dignity and respect.
  • One Team – working collaboratively to achieve shared goals.

Benefits

Indulge in the Sweet Perks of Joining Macphie!

At Macphie, we believe in crafting not only delightful culinary experiences but also providing our team with a recipe for success in their professional lives. Here is a taste of how we'll look after you as part of our Sweet Success:

  • Annual Leave: Recharge your batteries with a generous annual leave entitlement of 23 days, plus 9 public holidays, giving you a refreshing total of 32 days to explore, relax, and savour life outside of work.
  • Profit-Related Pay (PRP): Your dedication will not go unnoticed! Enjoy conditional PRP, aligning with our company's performance and rewarding your commitment to our shared success.
  • Pension Perks: Secure your financial future with our pension enrolment, where you contribute 5%, and we match it with a 3% employer contribution.
  • Health and Wellness Buffet: We care about your well-being. Access our Employee Assistance Program, a 24/7 GP line, and indulge in our cycle-to-work scheme. Keep your mind and body in top shape with our Leisure Subsidy Scheme and free fruit offerings.
  • Eco-Friendly Commute: Embrace sustainable living with our electric car charging stations. Enjoy the convenience of free parking while contributing to a greener planet.
  • Lifelong Learning: Cultivate your mind with our company further education scheme and unlock opportunities for personal and professional growth.
  • Family First: We support your journey into parenthood with enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption pay.
  • Exclusive Employee Benefits: Revel in exclusive benefits like an education bursary via our employee trust and Funeral Concierge provided by Everest Funeral Concierge Service, a brand-new benefit.
  • Beyond Probation: Once you have passed probation over the initial three months, you will then be able to unlock an array of group benefits, including private medical insurance & Westfield Health, permanent health insurance, and 3x death in service life assurance.

To see all of the Macphie employee benefits please click here.

And now, let us talk about what we need from you:

Like every employer, legally, we require to check and confirm that you have the right to work in the UK. If we offer you a job and you accept, there are some checks that we need to complete before you can start with us. In addition to the above, we will also collect satisfactory employment references.

Additional Information

At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must have the right to work in the UK on a permanent basis without requiring sponsorship now or in the future.

We are not seeking assistance from recruitment agencies for this position. Unsolicited CVs will not be considered.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
KingSoft LLC seeks an experienced Construction Project Manager to manage a construction project involving a new boiler plant, associated building and site work, and demolition of an existing facility.

The successful candidate will manage subcontractor scopes, schedules, procurement, costs and project documentation while working closely with the on-site superintendent.

title: ABA Case Supervisor - School and Home Setting.
description:
ABA Case Manager/Supervisor

Join our passionate team of dedicated and educated professionals to help children and families in our communities! Make a difference in the life of a child! For over 40 years, IABA has been providing high-quality treatment for children and families. IABA has been dedicated to Positive Behavior Supports (PBS) since the 1980s--join us in bringing strengths-based, dignity-focused, child-centered ABA to our community! YOU MUST HAVE A MASTER'S DEGREE IN ABA, PSYCHOLOGY, EDUCATION, OR RELATED FIELD AND AT LEAST 1 YEAR SUPERVISING ABA CASES.

Growth opportunities are available throughout the agency!

This is an incredible opportunity to work as a Program Lead case supervisor with clients in the San Diego and Imperial Valley area. Utilize your skillset to help children and families, not only by designing and implementing behavior support programs, but making an impact in the lives of the family unit as a whole and the surrounding community. Work in the school, home, and clinic-based settings is available! Opportunities to use ABA skills with infant development, mental health, as well as autism/DD needs.

AVAILABLE LOCATIONS:
We are currently seeking applicants to work FULL TIME (salaried) in the Los Angeles area.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and oversee behavior treatment programs for clients with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and other developmental disabilities under the supervision of Senior Management staff
  • Work in school and home settings to support children in their natural environments
  • Collaborate with teachers and school sites in the development and implementation of behavior treatment plans for students with disabilities to access their curriculum
  • Provide ongoing training to staff, caregivers, and other professionals to implement ABA treatment plans
  • Conduct face-to-face supervision during direct treatment sessions
  • Conduct team meetings in order to update the client’s treatment plan and to support behavior interventionists and caregivers
  • Conduct functional behavior assessments in order to track progress and create individualized treatment programs
  • Conduct standardized assessments in order to establish treatment goals and baseline levels
  • Document ongoing treatment after each session and regularly summarize/analyze data
  • Write initial assessment and progress reports according to funding source requirements
  • Interface with professionals from funding agencies, attend IEP, IFSP, and other relevant meetings
  • Provide training to caregivers and other stakeholders
  • Participate in individual and/or group supervision
  • Complete all required documentation in a timely manner
  • Perform other job duties, as assigned

This job entails working with staff, teachers, children, and families live, face to face in homes, schools, or clinic settings for the majority of the position.

You will need to be able to run, crawl, kneel, play on the floor, and engage in fast-paced physical activities with young children.

The position may involve work face to face and over video conference.

Work occurring over the internet requires you to have a quiet, private space for the duration of your session.

Requirements

  • Must have Master's degree in education, psychology, counseling, behavior analysis, child development, social work, or related field
  • At least 3 years experience working as a behavior interventionist implementing ABA interventions with children with ASD
  • At least 1 year experience working as a behavior supervisor designing ABA programs for children with ASD, as well as training caregivers or teachers and behavior interventionist staff in how to implement these interventions
  • Experience working with children with autism in the home and school settings for at least 3 years
  • Experience overseeing/managing clinical cases for children with autism for at least 1 year
  • Must be able to work with diverse populations
  • Bilingual candidates encouraged to apply
  • Pay and responsibilities commensurate with experience

Benefits

  • Competitive pay based on experience and certification status: $70,000 -$75,000
  • Earned Paid Time Off/Vacation (for full-time employees)
  • Paid Sick Time
  • Regular training, support, and mentorship from IABA’s team of experienced Behavior Analysts, MFTs, and Psychologists
  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance (for full-time employees)
  • 401(K) plan
  • Comprehensive paid training both when you are hired and ongoing
  • Paid Drive Time & Mileage
  • Employee discounts and Employee Assistance Program including free legal and financial advice, free counseling support and much more
  • Cell phone stipend and laptop
  • BCBA supervision hours #CASHP

title: Director of Operations
description:
Job Title: Director of Operations

Location: Facility

Department: Operations

Reports To: VP’s of Operation, COO

Position Summary

The Director of Operations is responsible for the overall operational performance and strategic implementation of policies, programs, and systems across substance abuse and mental health treatment facilities. This role ensures service excellence, regulatory compliance, fiscal accountability, and employee engagement while driving operational efficiency and enhancing patient experience. The Director works closely with clinical, administrative, and corporate leadership to support the mission of delivering high-quality, evidence-based behavioral health care.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Oversight

  • Direct day-to-day operations across in-patient detox, Residential, and support services.
  • Collaborate with Clinical, Nursing, Admissions, HR, and Compliance to ensure alignment of services.
  • Develop and implement operational policies and procedures to optimize performance and safety.
  • Manage facility licensing and accreditation processes (e.g., Joint Commission, CARF, DCF, SAMHSA).
  • Manage overall patient census.

Strategic Leadership

  • Assist in developing and executing short- and long-term strategic plans.
  • Identify opportunities for program enhancements.
  • Participate in decision making and contribute to organizational planning.

Regulatory & Compliance Management

  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations related to behavioral health, including HIPAA, OSHA, DOH, Joint Commision, CARF, DEA.
  • Lead internal audits and readiness for licensing inspections and third-party reviews.
  • Manage Life Safety, Emergency Management, and Environment of Care.

Team Management & Development

  • Provide overall leadership and direction for all facility staff, while supervising, mentoring, and developing department managers and administrative leadership.
  • Support staff development through coaching, training, and performance management.
  • Foster a positive work culture that prioritizes ethics, accountability, and inclusivity.
  • Apply best practices in recruiting, hiring, and monitoring the onboarding progress of new hires.
  • Ensure that all training and corrective actions are conducted consistently, thoroughly documented, and submitted to Human Resources in a timely manner.

Quality & Performance Improvement

  • Oversee quality assurance initiatives, incident tracking, and risk management.
  • Track KPIs related to census, admissions, patient outcomes, and utilization review.
  • Use data to implement continuous improvement strategies and drive measurable results.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Collaborate with Corporate leadership to develop and monitor departmental budgets, forecasts, and cost-containment strategies.
  • Ensure responsible utilization of resources and procurement of operational needs.
  • Collaborate with Finance to monitor billing, the Utilization Review department, and financial performance.
  • Manage Payroll budgets.

Patient & Community Engagement

  • Promote a patient-centered approach throughout service delivery.
  • Referral Management collaboration with business development department.
  • Supervise Patient Care Specialists and oversee discharge planning.
  • Maintain company hospitality standards and practices.

title: Full Stack Cloud Engineer (AWS, Go, Live Video)
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 12000 – 25000 PLN / mies. netto

DefendEye builds AI-powered drones for first responders and law enforcement. The live video our drones stream is the heart of the product, and DefendEye Cloud is what carries it from the drone to the browser in seconds.

We need one expert to own it. You will run DefendEye Cloud end to end: the AWS infrastructure, the Go services, and the live video pipeline.

What you will do

  • Own and manage DefendEye Cloud on AWS: architecture, deployment, monitoring, security, reliability, and cost.

  • Run the live video pipeline end to end: ingest into AWS, fragment and segment creation, HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) packaging, and delivery to the browser. Today it is pure H.265, with no transcoding to H.264.

  • Cut latency. Find where every second goes, from segment and fragment size to sender and player buffering, and remove it.

  • Track KPIs across the whole chain, from drone and ground station to upload, AWS ingest, and browser playback: bitrate, dropped frames, queue depth, jitter, and rebuffering.

  • Build and maintain our backend in Go. Most of our code is written in Go.

  • Work with our drone and embedded engineers to test in real field conditions.

What you bring

  • 5+ years building and running cloud systems, with expert-level AWS across the stack: compute, networking, storage, IAM, containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability.

  • Production experience with real-time video and broadcast, including HLS and the full HLS workflow: segmenting, manifests, buffering, and player behavior.

  • Strong knowledge of video codecs and compression, especially H.265/HEVC and H.264: bitrate control, keyframes and GOP structure, and the trade-off between quality and latency.

  • Strong Go (Golang) in production.

  • Comfort on the browser side: HLS players such as hls.js, plus JavaScript or TypeScript.

  • Solid networking basics: HTTP/TCP, RTP, packet loss, and jitter.

  • Low-Latency HLS, SRT or WebRTC; FFmpeg or GStreamer;

  • Fluent English, and you are ready to work full-time, in person, in our Kraków office now. (We are looking for candidates that can start working in 30 days or earlier only).

Nice to have

AWS media services (for example Kinesis Video Streams, MediaLive, MediaPackage, CloudFront); experience with drones, robotics, or other field devices streaming live video; a security-first mindset, since our users are first responders and law enforcement.

What we offer

  • Full ownership of the platform at the center of our product.

  • Work that matters: your code helps responders find people faster.

  • A fast-moving team with short decision paths, working in person with the people who build the drones.

title: Maximo Infrastructure Architect/Engineer
description:
IBM Maximo Infrastructure Architect

MAS 9 and AI

Company: MaxAccelerate Technology Group

Location: Fully remote

Projects: Global clients through our nearshore delivery model

Future opportunity: Work from our Dubai offices, planned to open in 2027

The opportunity

Join MaxAccelerate and take technical ownership of the platforms that organisations depend on to manage their critical assets. We are looking for an experienced IBM Maximo Infrastructure Architect to lead complete Maximo Application Suite 9 implementations for clients around the world.

You will work across multiple client engagements and industry verticals through our nearshore delivery model, combining architecture leadership with hands-on installation and engineering. Alongside client delivery, you will contribute to MaxAccelerate AI, helping build the infrastructure and integrations that support AI-enabled asset management.

This is a fully remote role with the opportunity to work from our Dubai offices, planned to open in 2027. It is a chance to broaden your international project experience, influence our technical standards and help shape how Maximo and AI work together.

What you will do

Lead complete MAS 9 implementations. Own infrastructure discovery, architecture, sizing, prerequisite validation, installation, configuration, testing, production go-live and operational handover.

Design and build the platform. Deliver secure, resilient MAS 9 environments on Red Hat OpenShift across IBM Cloud, Microsoft Azure, AWS, private cloud and on-premises deployments.

Deploy the applications clients need. Install and configure MAS core, Maximo Manage and relevant applications, industry solutions and add-ons, working with functional and application specialists.

Deliver upgrades and migrations. Plan environment readiness, migration rehearsals, cutover, rollback and post-go-live support for clients moving from legacy Maximo or earlier MAS releases.

Engineer for reliable operations. Design and validate high availability, backup, restoration and disaster recovery. Use Prometheus and Grafana to establish monitoring, performance baselines and capacity plans.

Automate delivery. Use IBM MAS CLI, Ansible, Terraform and OpenShift Pipelines/Tekton to create repeatable builds and controlled deployment workflows.

Work directly with global clients. Lead technical workshops, explain design decisions, manage infrastructure dependencies and produce clear architecture documents and runbooks.

Contribute to MaxAccelerate AI. Work with AI and data specialists on secure hosting, connectivity and integration between Maximo environments, enterprise data and AI applications.

Strengthen our delivery team. Troubleshoot complex issues, mentor engineers and share practical lessons across international projects.

Essential experience

Proven full end-to-end MAS 9 installation experience. You must have personally led or delivered complete production implementations, from infrastructure preparation through go-live and handover.

Delivery across multiple industry verticals. Demonstrable Maximo/MAS experience in different sectors, such as energy and utilities, renewables, rail and transport, manufacturing, aviation, oil and gas, or facilities management.

Strong Red Hat OpenShift expertise. Hands-on experience with the oc CLI, operators, containers, persistent storage, networking, certificates, security and platform troubleshooting.

Enterprise infrastructure knowledge. Strong Linux skills and experience with DNS, load balancing, TLS, identity integration and access control.

Cloud and deployment architecture. Experience designing and delivering Maximo/MAS infrastructure across IBM Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including networking, storage, security, availability and hybrid connectivity.

Database platforms and SQL. Hands-on experience with IBM Db2, Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server for Maximo Manage, including connectivity, SQL troubleshooting and migrations. Work with database teams on performance, backup and recovery, using configurations supported by the selected release.

Apache Kafka. Experience deploying, configuring, securing and monitoring Kafka for Maximo integrations and event streaming, including brokers, topics and connectivity, where required by the solution architecture.

Production delivery discipline. Experience with release-specific compatibility checks, upgrades, performance tuning, recovery testing and technical documentation.

Confident client communication. Ability to lead technical discussions, explain trade-offs and collaborate with security, cloud, database and Maximo application teams.

Effective remote working. Ability to manage priorities across client engagements and work with agreed time-zone overlap for international delivery.

DevOps tools and platforms

Strong MAS automation and OpenShift skills are essential. The wider toolset will vary by client project.

MAS automation. IBM MAS CLI and Ansible, including the ibm.mas_devops collection, with experience running and troubleshooting OpenShift Pipelines/Tekton.

Infrastructure as code and scripting. Terraform, YAML and Bash or Python for provisioning, configuration and repeatable operational tasks.

Version control and CI/CD. Git and one or more of Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD or Azure DevOps for controlled changes and deployment pipelines.

Container tooling. OpenShift oc, Podman or Docker, and image registries such as Red Hat Quay.

GitOps and configuration. Argo CD/OpenShift GitOps experience is valuable; familiarity with Helm and Kustomize is advantageous.

Monitoring and alerting. Prometheus and Grafana for infrastructure and application metrics, dashboards and operational alerts.

Additional experience we value

Deployment of Maximo industry solutions, Mobile or other MAS applications.

AI infrastructure, private model hosting, data platforms or secure enterprise integrations.

Relevant IBM Maximo, Red Hat OpenShift or cloud certifications.

Consulting, managed services or nearshore delivery experience.

Why join MaxAccelerate

Fully remote working. Contribute to international projects from your remote working location.

Variety and technical ownership. Work with different clients and industries, taking projects from architecture through successful delivery.

A role in our AI work. Help develop the infrastructure behind MaxAccelerate AI and its connection to enterprise asset management.

Influence how we grow. Shape delivery standards, contribute reusable automation and share your expertise with the team.

An optional Dubai opportunity. Have the chance to work from our Dubai offices, planned to open in 2027.

How to apply

Send your CV and a summary of MAS 9 installations you have personally delivered, including your role, cloud and database platforms, DevOps tools, industry sectors and ownership through go-live. Please include your location and availability.

title: TMS Technician
description:
About Us

At Neuro Wellness Spa, we are committed to providing cutting-edge mental health care through a patient-centered approach. Since 2009, our dedicated, knowledgeable, and compassionate team has worked to ensure patients receive the highest quality and most comprehensive mental healthcare possible. As a leading provider of TMS, psychopharmacology, and psychotherapy, we are continuing to expand our services and clinical footprint across California.

Summary of Position

TMS Technicians are responsible for overseeing and coordinating TMS (Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation) services to ensure efficient patient care and clinic operations. This role involves managing patient schedules, operating TMS devices, monitoring patient outcomes, training new TMS technicians, maintaining equipment, ensuring patient comfort and excellent experience, and ensuring compliance with clinic policies and procedures. TMS Technicians must work closely with Medical Directors and Clinic Managers, maintain accurate patient records and demonstrate strong leadership, organizational skills, and a commitment to providing exceptional patient care.


Essential Responsibilities


Patient Interaction:

  • Welcome patients warmly, ensuring a positive experience.
  • Monitor the TMS tech RingCentral, schedule and reschedule TMS appointments as needed.
  • Provide compassionate patient care, fostering trust and rapport.
  • Administer TMS treatments per physician protocols, ensuring patient comfort and treatment accuracy.
  • Counsel patients on the completion of psychiatric rating scales.
  • Communicate with a team of certified TMS psychiatrists overseeing patient treatment.


Administrative Duties:

  • Maintain patient records in DrChrono, including scheduling appointments, writing notes, and tracking insurance authorizations.
  • Create, update and maintain patient records in OutcomesAI, including rating scales, medications and other details.
  • Update Heart & Soul and other administrative documents as assigned.
  • Ensure TMS patients are aware of and have agreed to total cost of treatment.
  • Ensure ROIs are signed with outside providers and therapist/psychiatrist/primary care provider updates and provided via phone, fax or email at all intervals
  • Ensure completion of ‘End of TMS Checklist’ and follow up with items as needed, including requesting additional TMS sessions
  • Request patient reviews, surveys and testimonials, when appropriate
  • Conduct patient recalls and check-ins post TMS discharge at regular intervals
  • Complete insurance authorization forms and monitor authorizations.
  • Assist the Medical Director with consults and calibrations; initiate MD notes as needed.
  • Load updated documents into OneDrive and remove outdated forms as needed.
  • Maintain chart covers, consents, consult sheets, scripts, and other documents with necessary updates.
  • Ensure complete, accurate, and timely submission of TMS authorizations and supporting clinical documentation in accordance with payer and utilization review requirements.


Equipment Maintenance:

  • Ensure TMS machines are maintained, including yearly checks, coolant management, and weekly filter cleaning.
  • Assist with emergency equipment maintenance, ensuring AED compliance, emergency kit readiness, and O2 tank functionality.
  • Assist with staff training on safety protocols and ensure emergency signage and maps are posted correctly.


Office and Inventory Management:

  • Monitor office supplies, restocking items such as tea, cups, utensils, and clinical supplies.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area and lobby.
  • Communicate supply needs with Clinic Manager.
  • Number or renumber appointments when cancellations occur and inform billing of any fees.


Compliance and Confidentiality:

  • Adhere to HIPAA guidelines, ensuring the confidentiality of all patient records and information.
  • Follow clinic policies and procedures related to patient care and documentation.
  • Assist with monitoring site and staff for compliance with company procedures and policies.


Other Duties as Assigned:

title: Designer (Fire Sprinkler Systems)
description:
Designer (Fire Sprinkler Systems)

Williamsport, MD | Full-Time | $80k - $125k

About Us

Regional Fire Protection, part of the Guardian Fire Services family, is on a mission to protect lives and property with trusted Fire & Life Safety Solutions. Regional Fire Protection delivers comprehensive fire and life safety solutions to customers throughout Maryland, Pennsylvania, and West Virginia, offering installation and maintenance services for fire sprinkler systems, alarm systems, extinguishers, emergency lighting, and more.

We’re seeking a motivated and detail-oriented AutoCAD Designer to join our growing team. This role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that protect lives and property while contributing to fire safety compliance across multiple states.

Job Overview

As an AutoCAD Designer, you’ll contribute to creating fire sprinkler systems that make a real difference in safety. Working closely with project managers, field technicians, and clients, you’ll help develop designs, find solutions, and ensure everything meets fire safety standards. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys problem-solving and working as part of a collaborative team.

This role is perfect for individuals with experience in CAD design who are seeking professional growth in a supportive and collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Project Coordination

  • Review construction contract documents to gather project requirements.
  • Design fire sprinkler systems and prepare detailed AutoCAD drawings.
  • Perform hydraulic calculations and create material stock lists.
  • Coordinate pipe and sprinkler locations with building components to ensure functionality and compliance.
  • Conduct feasibility analyses and resolve design challenges for successful project outcomes.
  • Perform field surveys and attend project-specific meetings.

Collaboration and Support

  • Work closely with project managers, foremen, and other team members to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Maintain detailed records of designs and projects for future reference and continuous improvement.
  • Support the field team with technical expertise during installations and field checks.

Who You Are

We’re looking for a designer who enjoys working on technical projects, solving problems, and being part of a supportive team. If you’re excited to use your skills to help create safe and reliable solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

  • Experienced: 3-5 years of fire sprinkler CAD design experience or related field experience.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in AutoCAD and familiarity with design tools (training available for additional software). NICET LEVEL 2 or 3 Preferred.
  • Problem-Solver: Strong analytical skills to assess project feasibility and address design challenges.
  • Organized: Ability to manage and monitor projects for safety, quality, and productivity.
  • Collaborative: Excellent communication skills to effectively interact with clients, contractors, and internal teams.

Your First 90 Days with Us

First 30 Days

  • Orientation and training on company systems and processes, including AutoCAD and other design software.
  • Shadow senior team members to learn workflows and gain insight into project management.
  • Begin working on smaller design projects with supervision.

Next 30 Days (60 Days Total)

  • Take ownership of design tasks for assigned projects with team guidance.
  • Attend site visits to gain hands-on understanding of project requirements.
  • Start collaborating with the field team to ensure successful execution of designs.

By 90 Days

  • Independently manage your design responsibilities and meet project deadlines.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
  • Actively participate in team meetings and contribute to broader operational strategies.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Regional Fire, we invest in our team’s growth and development. You’ll have the opportunity to build a fulfilling career in a stable and growing industry.

  • Competitive Pay: $80k - $125k, based on experience.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Including health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Future Savings: A 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous vacation and holiday schedule.
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training and opportunities for career advancement.

We Value All Experiences

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role and encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for.

We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem-solving and more creative thinking, so we’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Regional Fire is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Regional Fire is committed to an inclusive experience for all applicants and will endeavor to make reasonable accommodations in the interview process, to the known physical or mental limitations of qualified employees with disabilities unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.


How to Apply

If you’re ready to bring your design expertise to a team committed to quality, innovation, and safety, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step in your career with Regional Fire.

Experience/Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or technical related curriculum applicable to the respective job position required or equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

Required Skills:

  • Experience in stress analysis of aircraft systems, preferably supporting multiple aircraft programs.
  • Experience with aircraft systems such as:
    • Flight control systems,
    • Doors and mechanisms,
    • Landing gear systems,
    • Hydraulic and pneumatic systems,
    • Power plant systems and nacelles.
  • Experience supporting system installations and supplier components.
  • Experience in aircraft structural stress analysis, including primary and secondary structures.
  • Knowledge of aircraft composite structures, including sandwich structures and solid laminates.
  • Experience in static stress analysis and fatigue analysis.
  • Knowledge of fatigue analysis methods, including constant-amplitude cyclic loading and fatigue spectrum development.
  • Familiarity with miner's rule for cumulative fatigue damage assessment.
  • Experience reviewing engineering models using CATIA V5 and SmartTeam, or other 3D engineering modeling software.
  • Experience in detailed Finite Element Analysis (FEA) modeling.
  • Ability to review, evaluate, and provide technical comments on supplier/vendor stress reports.

  • Experience supporting component qualification activities and reviewing supplier technical documentation.

Guides successful completion of major engineering programs or conceives research in areas of considerable scope and complexity supporting the development and production of company products and services.

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

A Chief Engineer is responsible for managing technical operations, supervising engineering teams, ensuring safety and regulatory compliance, controlling maintenance costs, and maintaining the reliability of equipment and systems. Responsibilities vary by industry, such as marine, hotel, manufacturing, construction, or facility management.

Key Responsibilities of a Chief Engineer

1. Technical Operations and Management

  • Oversee all engineering operations and technical activities.
  • Ensure the efficient and reliable operation of machinery, equipment, and systems.
  • Develop and implement maintenance schedules and operating procedures.
  • Monitor equipment performance and troubleshoot technical problems.
  • Ensure minimum downtime and maximum operational efficiency.

2. Maintenance and Repairs

  • Plan and supervise preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance.
  • Diagnose equipment failures and coordinate repair activities.
  • Ensure timely servicing, inspection, and replacement of equipment.
  • Maintain maintenance records, technical logs, and reports.
  • Coordinate with external contractors and service providers.

3. Team Leadership and Supervision

  • Lead, train, and supervise engineers, technicians, and maintenance personnel.
  • Assign duties, establish work priorities, and monitor performance.
  • Conduct technical training and safety briefings.
  • Ensure proper coordination between engineering and other departments.
  • Evaluate staff performance and support professional development.

4. Safety and Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable safety standards, laws, and regulations.
  • Implement safe working practices and risk assessment procedures.
  • Conduct safety inspections and ensure corrective actions are completed.
  • Investigate technical incidents, equipment failures, and accidents.
  • Maintain permits, inspection certificates, and statutory documentation.

5. Budgeting and Cost Control

  • Prepare and manage engineering and maintenance budgets.
  • Control expenditure on spare parts, tools, fuel, energy, and repairs.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs.
  • Approve maintenance purchases within delegated authority.
  • Monitor inventory and ensure the availability of critical spare parts.

6. Project Planning and Implementation

  • Plan and supervise equipment installation, upgrades, and modernization.
  • Evaluate technical proposals and engineering designs.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, consultants, and contractors.
  • Monitor project schedules, budgets, quality, and safety.
  • Ensure commissioning, testing, and handover of completed projects.

7. Documentation and Reporting

  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly engineering reports.
  • Maintain equipment history, maintenance schedules, and inspection records.
  • Report equipment performance, breakdowns, costs, and operational risks to management.
  • Develop standard operating procedures and technical documentation.
  • Recommend improvements to systems and engineering processes.

8. Energy Efficiency and Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor energy and resource consumption.
  • Implement measures to improve equipment efficiency and reliability.
  • Identify recurring faults and implement root-cause solutions.
  • Introduce appropriate technologies and maintenance systems.
  • Support environmental protection and waste-reduction initiatives.

Key Skills Required

  • Strong technical and troubleshooting skills
  • Leadership and team management
  • Planning and decision-making
  • Budgeting and cost management
  • Safety and regulatory knowledge
  • Communication and coordination
  • Preventive maintenance management
  • Problem-solving and analytical skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

A Chief Engineer's performance may be measured by:

  • Equipment uptime and reliability
  • Reduction in breakdowns and downtime
  • Maintenance cost control
  • Compliance with safety requirements
  • Completion of preventive maintenance on schedule
  • Energy efficiency and resource utilization
  • Team productivity and project completion

The Night Auditor is also responsible for greeting, registering, and checking guests out of the hotel in the hotel's continuing effort to deliver outstanding guest service and financial profitability.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Audit, post, and balance daily cashiers work for Hotel
  • Accurately post all room fees, related taxes, and other paid services including restaurant, lounge, internet, resort fees, and the like to each guest’s account daily
  • Verify all account entries are balanced; notate and settle any discrepancies uncovered in audit to appropriately settle guest accounts.
  • Ensure Hotel billing standards are followed and create financial reports that detail various aspects of the Hotel’s performance; ensure distributed to the appropriate departments
  • Ensure credit card system reconciles to daily transaction lists
  • Verify cash postings and verify cashier drops to ensure accurate
  • Ensure daily turn of Hotel and paperwork associated with all transactions is compiled and organized as set forth by management

ADDITIONAL GUEST SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Greets all guests in a pleasant and professional manner
  • Completes the guest registration and check-out procedures
  • Answers telephone, transfers calls, and takes messages when applicable
  • Makes hotel reservations for guests, including changes and cancellations
  • Follows proper credit card procedures
  • Maintains accurate bank during shift and uses correct vouchers for specified transactions
  • Responds to all guest needs and requests in a timely fashion
  • Follow-up to ensure guest requests have been responded to appropriately and to guest satisfaction
  • Understands hotel service and programs
  • Knowledgeable of geographical area and points of interest
  • Files appropriate paperwork as directed
  • Ensure the front desk is adequately stocked of all supplies
  • Understands hotel emergency procedures and evacuation protocols
  • Collects payment for all guests at check-in and check-out. Makes changes as necessary
  • Keeps Front Office and Lobby area near, clean, vacuumed, and dusted daily
  • Follow all company safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager
  • Ensure uniform and personal appearance is clean and professional
  • Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets
  • Speak with others using clear and professional language
  • Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and fellow management team members.
  • Perform all reasonable job duties as requested.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • High School diploma or equivalent and/or experience in a Hotel or a related field preferred
  • Significant attention to detail.
  • Ability to operate front desk equipment: computer, switchboard, credit card machines, etc.
  • Understanding of basic math skills
  • Good verbal and guest interaction skills
  • Collect money and issue change where applicable
  • Ability to work as a cohesive team member - relaying information appropriately from shift to shift
  • Must be able to stand for several hours at a time
  • May be required to lift items up to 25 lbs.

title: Senior Director, Development & Philanthropy
description:
Senior Director, Development & Philanthropy

Location: Remote (US-based)

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Direct Reports: Development Coordinator (to be hired)

Application Submission Deadline: November 16, 2026

About Propel America

Propel America addresses a broken workforce system that fails both young adults and healthcare employers, sidelining talented individuals from entering healthcare careers and contributing to critical workforce shortages that threaten community health . Propel’s work centers on bridging this gap by creating alternative, debt-free career pathways into healthcare for young adults ages 18–26, particularly those from underrepresented and low-income backgrounds, while helping employers access the trained, diverse talent they urgently need. Today, over 13 million young adults in the U.S. are either not in school, not working, or stuck in low-wage jobs with little room for growth. Traditional college remains financially and logistically out of reach for many, especially young people from low-income communities, forcing them into a false choice: sacrifice income to pursue an expensive degree or remain in low-wage work without upward mobility.

Propel America aims to solve both sides of the equation by equipping young adults with the skills and support to launch healthcare careers and by helping employers build stronger, more diverse, and more stable workforces. To learn more, please visit

The Opportunity

Propel America is seeking an entrepreneurial, results-driven Senior Director, Development & Philanthropy to lead our philanthropic revenue strategy and growth.

Reporting directly to the CEO, this leader will own Propel’s philanthropic strategy, pipeline, and portfolio across institutional foundations, corporations, family philanthropy, and individual major donors. They will be directly accountable for securing the significant, multi-year philanthropic revenue Propel needs to advance its mission and build a more sustainable organization.

This is a highly external, hands-on fundraising role. The Senior Director will personally cultivate, solicit, close, and steward high-value relationships while partnering closely with the CEO on Propel’s highest-priority funders and prospects. A key priority will be diversifying Propel’s philanthropic revenue base, particularly by growing individual and family philanthropy alongside our institutional foundation portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

The Senior Director, Development & Philanthropy leads four core areas:

Philanthropic Revenue & Major Gifts
Own and grow a portfolio of high-value philanthropic relationships, personally securing significant and multi-year commitments.

Philanthropic Strategy & Pipeline
Build and execute Propel’s annual and multi-year fundraising strategy, translating organizational priorities into a healthy, diversified, and predictable philanthropic pipeline.

CEO Partnership & Executive Fundraising
Serve as the CEO’s strategic fundraising partner, ensuring executive time and relationships are focused on Propel’s highest-value philanthropic opportunities.

Development Team & Infrastructure
Build the people, systems, data, and operating discipline required for an effective and scalable development function.

Role & Responsibilities

Philanthropic Revenue & Major Gifts | 55%

  • Personally cultivate, solicit, close, and steward a portfolio of institutional foundations, corporations, family foundations, and individual major donors.
  • Lead the full fundraising cycle, from prospect identification and cultivation through solicitation, negotiation, close, renewal, and stewardship.
  • Secure six- and seven-figure gifts, with an emphasis on significant multi-year commitments.
  • Build Propel’s individual and family philanthropy strategy, expanding and diversifying the major-donor base.
  • Deepen existing funder relationships to drive renewals, increased investment, and long-term partnership.
  • Provide strategic oversight and final approval of grant submissions.

Philanthropic Strategy & Pipeline | 30%

  • Translate Propel’s annual and multi-year financial needs into fundraising targets, pipeline requirements, and portfolio strategies.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of high-potential institutional, corporate and individual prospects.
  • Monitor fundraising performance and adjust strategy when revenue or pipeline performance is off track.
  • Partner with organizational leaders to translate Propel’s strategy, workforce solutions, employer partnerships, and Fellow outcomes into compelling investment opportunities.
  • Partner with Workforce Partnerships and market leaders to identify regional philanthropic opportunities.
  • Represent Propel externally with funders, philanthropic leaders, and other strategic audiences.
  • Develop and execute strategies for Propel's highest-priority funders and prospects in partnership with the CEO and determine where CEO involvement can most advance a relationship or solicitation, and coordinate clear next steps and follow-through.
  • Ensure the CEO's philanthropic portfolio is prioritized against organizational fundraising goals and opportunities.

Team & Development Infrastructure | 15%

  • Hire, manage, and develop the Development Coordinator, establishing clear ownership of grant administration, donor tracking, reporting, and stewardship workflows.
  • Maintain disciplined Salesforce data, pipeline forecasting, portfolio management, and revenue reporting.
  • Leverage technology and AI to strengthen prospect research and fundraising productivity.
  • Partner with the CEO and COO to align fundraising forecasts, grant budgets, and organizational financial needs.
  • Collaborate across Workforce Partnerships, Solutions Design, Finance, and other teams to ensure philanthropic commitments align with Propel’s strategy and delivery capacity.
  • Work closed with regional staff to set the regional fundraising target and review grant applications

Success Profile

Within the first 12–24 months, the Senior Director, Development & Philanthropy will have:

  • Built a healthy and predictable philanthropic pipeline that supports Propel’s annual and multi-year revenue goals.
  • Secured significant six- and seven-figure gifts and increased multi-year philanthropic commitments.
  • Diversified Propel’s revenue base, with measurable growth in corporate, individual and family philanthropy.
  • Increased retention and investment among Propel’s strongest existing funders.
  • Established a clear portfolio strategy for Propel’s highest-priority prospects and funders.
  • Built an effective CEO fundraising portfolio and strengthened the CEO’s ability to cultivate and close high-value relationships.
  • Established disciplined fundraising systems, forecasting, stewardship, and development operations.
  • Built a high-performing development function with clear roles, accountability, and strong cross-functional partnerships.

Performance Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Achievement of annual and multi-year philanthropic revenue goals.
  • Value and number of significant, multi-year philanthropic commitments secured.
  • Growth and health of Propel’s qualified fundraising pipeline.
  • Growth and diversification of individual, family, corporate, and institutional philanthropy.
  • Funder renewal, retention, and expansion.
  • Effectiveness of CEO-led fundraising and movement of priority prospects through the pipeline.
  • Accuracy of revenue forecasting and quality of Salesforce and portfolio management.
  • Timely and effective grant reporting, stewardship, and development operations.
  • Performance and development of the Development Coordinator.

Qualifications & Experience

We are looking for a senior fundraising leader who combines exceptional relationship-building with strategic revenue leadership and strong execution. The strongest candidates will bring:

  • 7–10+ years of progressive experience in nonprofit development, philanthropy, fundraising, external affairs, or a related field.
  • A demonstrated track record of personally cultivating, soliciting, and closing six- and seven-figure gifts from institutional funders, corporations, family philanthropy, and/or individual major donors.
  • Experience owning a significant fundraising portfolio, pipeline, and revenue target.
  • Experience developing and executing strategies across both institutional and individual philanthropy.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior philanthropic decision-makers.
  • Experience partnering closely with a CEO, founder, or senior executive on major-donor and fundraising strategy.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex organizational strategies and outcomes into compelling investment opportunities.
  • Strong pipeline management, prospect qualification, forecasting, and CRM discipline, ideally using Salesforce or a similar platform.
  • Experience managing and developing staff while building effective systems and operating practices.
  • Comfort using technology and AI to improve prospect research, relationship management, and development workflows.
  • Strong strategic judgment, initiative, and ability to operate effectively in a growing and evolving organization.
  • Deep commitment to Propel America’s mission and the young adults and communities we serve.

Experience in healthcare, workforce development, or related sectors is a plus, but not required.

Compensation & Benefits

The annual target salary range for this role is $124K-168K, depending on candidate experience and geographic location. Propel America offers a comprehensive total rewards package, including:

  • 90% employer-covered health, dental, and vision premiums .
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holiday breaks .
  • Fully remote and flexible work schedule .
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching options.
  • Professional development stipend.

To Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume and a concise cover letter outlining their track record in major gift fundraising and institutional pipeline development via our online career portal. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Propel America is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive and diverse team. Candidates from historically underrepresented backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.

Senior Data Engineer

Real-Time Data & Streaming | Data Platforms, Analytics & Event Processing

West Code is looking for experienced Data Engineers interested in building modern data platforms and working on projects involving large-scale data processing, real-time analytics and event-driven systems.

We are particularly interested in engineers who enjoy solving complex data challenges, designing reliable pipelines and working with technologies that support real business decisions.

Depending on the project, you may work on streaming data platforms, sports analytics, financial data processing, predictive analytics or modern cloud-based data solutions.

What You’ll Work On

  • developing data solutions supporting analytics and machine learning

Technology

We are particularly interested in engineers working with:

  • Python and SQL

  • Apache Spark / PySpark

  • Apache Kafka or other streaming technologies

  • AWS, Azure or GCP

  • Databricks or similar data platforms

  • Airflow or other orchestration tools

You don't need to know every technology listed above. What matters most is strong engineering experience and the ability to work with complex data systems.

Must Have

  • strong SQL skills and solid understanding of relational databases, data modelling and transactional data

  • experience with CDC and streaming data ingestion (Kafka, Debezium or equivalent technologies)

  • experience optimizing large-scale datasets through partitioning, file layout and query performance tuning

  • understanding of data quality, consistency, reconciliation and monitoring in production environments

  • practical knowledge of data governance, including access control, data lineage, PII protection and retention

  • working knowledge of Python and orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster

  • good English and ability to independently own technical solutions and collaborate with engineering teams

Strong Advantage

  • experience with financial transactions, payment systems, wallets or ledger data

  • background in fintech, iGaming, betting or other regulated industries

  • experience designing bronze/silver/gold lakehouse architectures

  • experience with Trino, Athena or large-scale analytical query engines

  • hands-on experience with late-arriving events, deduplication and schema evolution

  • experience with regulatory data retention, GDPR requirements and auditability

  • cloud infrastructure cost optimization and storage lifecycle management

Working Model

  • B2B cooperation

  • remote or hybrid work depending on the project

  • international engineering teams

  • projects involving modern data platforms and complex data processing

  • English used on most projects

B2B Rate

150–200 PLN/h + VAT

Final rate depends on seniority, technical expertise and project scope.

Why West Code

West Code builds engineering teams around strong technical delivery, ownership and practical problem-solving.

We work on technology projects where engineering quality, modern tools and understanding the business context matter.

Our approach combines experienced engineers, AI-enabled delivery practices and accountability for the quality of what we build.

We value engineers who are curious, take ownership and enjoy working on challenging technical problems.

description:

About Entrada AI

Entrada AI is a specialized consulting partner and a strategic portfolio company of Databricks Ventures. We were recently named the Genie Partner of the Year (2026) for our work deploying Databricks Genie at enterprise scale—bridging the gap between AI ambition and the trusted, governed data required for accurate responses. With over 150 Databricks projects delivered, we unlock self-service analytics for Fortune 500 leaders.

Databricks invested in us because of our technical excellence, placing us in the "inner circle" of the ecosystem. For our engineers, this means direct access to product roadmaps, private previews, and the teams building the platform. You will join a team of industry veterans who value clean architecture over quick fixes. We don't just maintain pipelines; we solve complex architectural challenges.

About the Role

Entrada AI, Inc. is seeking an experienced AI Architect (Generative AI & Databricks) to join our growing team of consultants to lead the design and implementation of an enterprise GenAI platform for a marquee client.

In this role, you will architect an intelligent ingestion pipeline and an Anti-Hallucination & Zero-Inference Architecture designed to automate the triage, parameter extraction, and staging of incoming customer commercial pricing requests. You will bridge advanced LLM orchestration with production Lakehouse patterns, replacing manual data re-keying with high-throughput unstructured parsing, automated guardrail verification, an interactive Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review cockpit built on Databricks Apps.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and oversee the end-to-end GenAI Lakehouse architecture on Databricks, transforming unstructured email threads and complex attachments into fully verified, ERP-ready tabular data.

  • Architect secure, incremental ingestion pipelines via Microsoft Graph API and PySpark parsing engines to process multi-page PDFs, Excel workbooks, and HTML bodies directly into Unity Catalog Volumes and Bronze Delta tables.

  • Lead the development of deterministic extraction workflows on Databricks Model Serving (Claude/GPT), enforcing strict Pydantic schemas to accurately extract commercial attributes without arbitrary prose.

  • Implement a 3-layer anti-hallucination verification engine combining strict schema constraints, mandatory source citations, and PySpark string-assertion to ensure zero hallucinated data reaches production.

  • Architect and deploy an interactive Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review application natively on Databricks Apps (Streamlit/Dash) featuring side-by-side reconciliation, manual override capabilities, and secure SSO/OBO authentication.

  • Model Gold-layer pricing staging tables and design automated batch feeds for downstream ERP consumption via Databricks SQL Warehouses and REST APIs.

  • Establish best practices for Unity Catalog governance, data lineage, error-quarantine routing, and system security across client engineering teams.

  • Create and maintain comprehensive architectural documentation, data models, and interface specifications while mentoring client teams.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or applied machine learning systems.

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse Platform (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks Model Serving, and Databricks SQL).

  • Demonstrated experience as an Applied GenAI / LLMOps Engineer/Architect, specifically building structured extraction pipelines using function calling, Pydantic validation, and custom guardrail/citation-verification systems.

  • Proven track record parsing dirty, semi-structured, and unstructured business documents using Python and PySpark libraries (PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, OpenPyXL, BeautifulSoup4).

  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying interactive data applications using Streamlit or Dash, with specific experience deploying containerized apps natively inside Databricks Apps.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise identity and API integrations, including Microsoft Graph API, OAuth 2.0 client credential flows, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Databricks Secret Scopes.

  • Solid background in data modeling, governance, and auditability inside Unity Catalog (handling Volumes, Delta Tables, ACLs, and row/column-level security).

  • Experience or working familiarity with downstream enterprise ERP integration patterns.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to design resilient, production-ready systems that prevent hallucinated data from touching financial systems of record.

  • Excellent communication, consulting, and client-facing skills, with the ability to articulate complex GenAI concepts clearly to both technical teams and executive business stakeholders.

The Offer

Cooperation Models:

Poland: Available via Employment Contract (UoP) or B2B.

  • 100% Remote: Full flexibility to work from anywhere in Poland/ Romania / Greece

  • High-End Tech: Apple MacBook Air M4 15" provided to all engineers.

  • Referral Bonus: Bonus for bringing other top-tier engineers to the team.

  • Professional Growth:

    • Certification Support: Coverage for all Databricks technical certifications.

    • Industry Leadership: Support in reaching the highest tiers of Databricks expertise (such as the Champion program) tailored to your specific career track.

    • Personal Branding: Opportunities to present at global industry conferences and contribute to technical thought leadership.

    • Expert Mentorship: Direct collaboration with Databricks MVPs and core product teams, giving you a front-row seat to the platform's evolution.

Recruitment Process

  • Introductory Call (20 min): Short conversation with our Recruiter to discuss your background and expectations.

  • Technical Interview (60 min): Deep dive into your technical skills with our engineering team.

  • Optional Client Interview: Required only in specific cases.

  • Decision & Offer: We aim to close the process and provide feedback efficiently.
