title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Total Comp: $90,000 - $140,000 Yearly (base + bonus)
Also Known As: Program Manager
Location: Overland Park, KS
Company: DataMap
Client Work:

About DataMap

DataMap.ai is an AI-first technology consulting and solutions company focused on enterprise systems and automation. We build applications, implement ERP platforms, and provide managed services and production support at scale. Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth companies such as Google. They rely on us to modernize operations and automate workflows in ways that produce measurable business value.

DataMap is growing fast. We value innovation and collaboration, we work with urgency, and we reward speed, precision, and accountability. Teams here have the authority to solve complex enterprise problems and deliver results.

Why Join DataMap

At DataMap, projects run the way we expect every project to run in five years, with AI copilots drafting plans, surfacing risks, and writing first-draft status reports. At this level you set up that workflow for the teams you lead and refine the methods your programs run on. When the results show an improvement works, you bring it to the Director of Project Management for practice-wide adoption.

For Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth companies, you'll deliver AI and automation programs built on DataMap's proprietary products (Positron, RoboApprover, Itemova EDI SaaS) and on enterprise platforms like Coupa, D365, NetSuite, SAP, and Boomi, and you'll grow those accounts as you deliver. You also lead partner, internal, and operations programs alongside client work.

Role Overview

As a Senior Project Manager, you lead programs and multiple concurrent projects, including some of DataMap's most visible engagements. Project management at DataMap owns the management of all of our work, which covers everything: customer work, partner work, partnership growth, internal projects, and operations projects. Across your programs, that includes partner-platform implementations for enterprise clients, development of the products and customer portals we build and sell, and the partnership-growth, internal, and operations programs that make DataMap itself run and grow. DataMap project managers manage the work, grow the accounts they serve, and lead their teams toward business results; at this level you expand those practices to program and account scale. You are accountable for program outcomes and commercial health (SOWs, change orders, margin, and forecasting), and you build trusted-advisor relationships with executive sponsors.

You lead others inside the PMO (project managers and coordinators) and outside it (functional and technical consultants, developers, QA/test, and client and vendor teams). You drive change across your programs and into the wider delivery organization in process, structure, visibility, communications, and change management. You plan how your programs reach the goals set with delivery leadership, keep leadership informed, and escalate when you need to.

You will use AI tools every day, run the AI delivery workflows of the teams you lead, measure their gains, and help evolve DataMap's AI-first delivery methodology.

Your Growth Path

Project management at DataMap has a defined five-level ladder that runs from delivery support to leading the practice: Project Coordinator, Senior Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, and Director of Project Management. We post every level and promote from within, and moving up depends on performance and on the needs of the business. Beyond the Director level, the path continues into executive leadership, such as DataMap's Vice President, Operations & Delivery.

This is the senior delivery seat: you are accountable for every type of work in your programs and for their outcomes, margin, and account growth, within goals set with delivery leadership, and you lead people inside and outside the PMO. Strong Senior Project Managers can grow into Director of Project Management, where they lead the practice that owns the management of all of DataMap's work, are accountable for portfolio health, PMO standards, and commercial results, and drive change in process, structure, visibility, communications, and change management across the organization. You help build a practice that is still growing, and you work with executives on the client side and inside DataMap.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery leadership

  • Lead programs of every type end to end, including customer, partner, partnership-growth, internal, and operations work, and be accountable for delivering them on time, within scope, and on budget.
  • Manage the integrated master schedule, critical path, and dependencies, and coordinate multiple workstreams across DataMap teams, third-party vendors, and client stakeholders.
  • Set program milestones, governance, and operating cadence, run steering committees with executive sponsors, and produce the executive-ready materials behind them: integrated plans, status reporting, and steering committee decks.
  • Be the escalation point for your programs: resolve cross-project risks and issues, exercise sound judgment on program decisions and escalate appropriately, and share lessons learned across projects to prevent duplicated effort.

Business development and account growth

  • Go after business development at program and account scale: identify leads for new software and service sales, draft the orders, and get customer signatures, whether for DataMap's own products (Positron, RoboApprover, Itemova EDI SaaS), partner platforms, or follow-on services.
  • Manage program financials and staffing: SOWs, forecasts, actuals, margin, revenue forecasting, commercial change control, and staffing plans for current and upcoming skill needs.
  • Partner with Sales and pre-sales on scoping, estimates, and operationally achievable commitments for new pursuits.
  • Build executive-level client relationships, grow your accounts over the long term, and coach the project managers you lead to find expansion work, draft the orders (order forms, change orders, and SOW amendments), and get them signed on their own projects.

Leading others and driving change

  • Lead others inside and outside the PMO. Inside it, give direction to the project managers and coordinators on your programs, unblock them, give feedback, and develop their skills. Outside it, lead the functional and technical consultants, developers, QA/test, and client and vendor teams on your programs.
  • Coach other leaders to proactively engage team members, ask what they're working on, suggest course corrections, and drive business outcomes, and lead your own teams the same way.
  • Drive change across your programs and into the wider delivery organization in process, structure, visibility, communications, and change management, and share what works with other program teams.
  • Drive change management on your programs: secure sponsor and stakeholder support, and build readiness and adoption milestones into the program plan so the client and DataMap teams that receive new platforms, products, and processes adopt them.

AI-first delivery

  • Set up the AI workflows your teams use: prompt libraries, workflow templates, automated status and RAID cadences, and AI-assisted business development that surfaces leads and drafts orders for your review.
  • Deliver AI and automation programs end to end, including enterprise client rollouts of Positron and RoboApprover and the development programs behind the products and portals themselves.
  • Pilot delivery improvements and AI-enabled governance on your programs, measure the gains in cycle time, quality, and margin, and bring the proven ones to the Director of Project Management for practice-wide adoption.

Qualifications

  • 6 to 10 years of project delivery experience, including leading and developing other project managers or coordinators and leading people outside your direct line, such as consultants, developers, QA/test, vendors, or client teams.
  • Sound judgment as a program leader: given a goal, you build the plan and the team, deliver the result, and know when leadership needs to hear about something.
  • A track record of growing accounts through delivery: spotting the opportunity on your own projects, drafting the order, and getting it signed.
  • A record of leading change in process, structure, visibility, and communications across teams beyond your own projects, with working knowledge of a structured change management approach.
  • A habit of engaging team members directly, course-correcting early, and coaching other leaders to do the same.
  • Experience embedding AI tools in a team's delivery workflow and measuring the gains in cycle time, quality, or margin.
  • Proven ability to manage executive-level client relationships, with commercial accountability for SOWs, change orders, margin, and forecasting.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience

  • PMP certification or equivalent experience (PMI-ACP or SAFe a plus).
  • SaaS and ERP implementations (e.g., Coupa, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce); Source-to-Pay or procurement depth and Coupa certifications a plus.
  • Consulting or professional services delivery background, including account management or expansion work.
  • Experience managing software product development with Agile/Scrum: sprint planning, backlog management, and release delivery.
  • Familiarity with established change models such as Lewin's change model and Kotter's 8 steps; Prosci's ADKAR model, the Bridges Transition Model, or the McKinsey 7-S Framework a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM or agentic tooling beyond chat assistants.

Benefits & Perks

  • Total compensation of base salary plus bonus.
  • Unlimited vacation and a flexible work environment.
  • Free catered lunch on Fridays at headquarters.
  • On-site gym at headquarters.
  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Health insurance with generous employer contribution.
  • Dental, life, and disability insurance.
  • Hands-on mentorship and career development opportunities.

Why Apply?

  • Build your career in enterprise technology consulting.
  • Run programs on AI copilots and major financial and supply chain systems, and deliver AI programs for enterprise clients.
  • Work at a company that values innovation, collaboration, and professional growth.

If you're experienced and have strong delivery instincts, apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

title: Product Owner
description:
What is Aviture?

Aviture is a full-service technology consulting firm with expertise in software solutions for both commercial and government organizations.

We believe software doesn’t mean anything unless it solves a problem, so we create technology to enable users, open possibilities, and create meaningful impact.

“I wanted to create a company that I would have wanted to work at when I was an engineer.” — Mark Griffis, President

We are headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, with remote employees across the nation: Las Vegas, Washington D.C., Austin, Dallas, Portland, Green Bay, Kansas City, Madison, Minneapolis, and Orlando, just to name a few.

What is Aviture’s Art of the Possible?

Along with our mission-driven team’s deep expertise in a wide range of development languages, we employ a disciplined agile approach to define goals upfront, keep organizational value at the forefront, and set the pace for rapid, iterative innovation that transforms organizations. We call this the Art of the Possible.

The solutions we’ve created have:

  • Saved lives in the California wildfires and southern U.S. flooding
  • Provided security for the 2020 Presidential Inauguration, Super Bowl, and post-attack Boston Marathon
  • Enabled augmented-reality training environments for surgeons
  • Increased transparency and promoted patient wellness in hospitals and senior care facilities
  • Combined computer vision and robotics to automate dangerous manual labor tasks
  • And much more!

Why You’ll Want to Live Aviturian

Aviturians create technology that makes a meaningful difference in someone’s life. We’re a team made up of designers, engineers, developers, and inventors who believe technology’s purpose is to empower users to change the world. Here are the values that guide us:

  • Embody integrity
  • Seek ownership
  • Stay hungry
  • Remain grounded
  • Create impact
  • Challenge with respect

We’ve built our culture around creativity, continuous learning, and our shared values. If that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, then join us today!

Product Owner

As the Product Owner at Aviture, you will be responsible for defining the features and direction of the products that Aviture builds for its external clients. This includes working with clients and Aviture's creative engineering teams to help facilitate innovation and visioning of products that meet the needs and goals of the clients. You will work closely with the development team to prioritize and schedule work, and will be responsible for communicating product plans and progress to both the development team and the client. You will also be responsible for ensuring that the products delivered meet the needs of the client and are of high quality.

To be successful in this role, you should have a strong understanding of product development methodologies and have experience working with cross-functional teams. You should also have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and be able to effectively manage and prioritize a backlog of product features. You should also have a strong ability to facilitate collaboration and visioning between clients and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Working with clients and Aviture's engineering teams to facilitate innovation and visioning of products that meet the needs and goals of the clients
  • Prioritizing and scheduling work for the development team
  • Communicating product plans and progress to both the development team and the client
  • Ensuring that delivered products meet the needs of the client and are of high quality
  • Managing and prioritizing the product backlog

Requirements

  • 1-3 years experience acting as Product Owner for a software development team
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field (e.g. Computer Science, Management, Business)
  • Good understanding of product development methodologies
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to manage and prioritize a backlog of product features
  • Strong ability to facilitate collaboration and visioning between clients and engineering teams

Benefits

  • PPO or a High Deductible Health Plan, HSA eligible plan, Dental, Vision, and Supplemental Life.
  • Generous paid time off that starts accruing on day one.
  • Matching 401k with 100% vesting in six months.
  • Pick your preferred workstation! Mac? PC? We’ll support you with the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Get paid to go to national and international conferences and training, so that you can stay up to date with the latest innovations.
  • Flexible work schedules: Work the times that fits your schedule, with all meetings required to be scheduled between 9 am and 3 pm CST.
  • Free lunch every Friday and recurring team events for you and your family to enjoy.
  • Incentive and bonus pay.
  • Opportunities for connection and growth through peer coaching, recurring Lightning Talks to share things we’re passionate about, and a bi-weekly company-wide All Hands.

title: Quality Management & Executive Administrative Associate
description:
NetCentrics Corporation is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Quality Management & Executive Administrative Associate to support corporate quality management initiatives, executive leadership, and daily office operations.

This hybrid role combines Quality Management System (QMS) coordination, compliance documentation, executive administrative support, and corporate office management. The ideal candidate will possess strong organizational and communication skills, demonstrate initiative, and be comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic government contracting environment.

The position will initially be structured as part-time, with the potential to transition into a full-time role based on organizational needs, performance, and expanded responsibilities. A flexible on-site/hybrid schedule may be available, with in-office presence required for designated administrative activities, meetings, and corporate events.


Key Responsibilities


1. Quality Management & Compliance Coordination

  • Provide administrative and operational support for the company's Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring documentation, records, and compliance activities remain organized and current.
  • Assist with the coordination, maintenance, and continuous improvement of corporate quality processes, procedures, and documentation.
  • Support Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI) appraisal preparation, internal readiness assessments, evidence collection, and documentation reviews.
  • Assist with ISO 9001 quality management activities, including audit preparation, document control, and compliance tracking.
  • Maintain quality-related documentation, policies, procedures, templates, and records within designated SharePoint repositories.
  • Track quality management action items, corrective actions, process improvement initiatives, and assigned compliance deliverables.
  • Coordinate with Quality Management, Human Resources, Security, Corporate IT, and executive leadership to support compliance requirements and organizational objectives.
  • Assist in preparing quality management reports, presentations, meeting materials, and supporting documentation for leadership and management reviews.
  • Support internal and external audit activities by organizing requested documentation, tracking evidence submissions, and coordinating schedules.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, documentation accuracy, and overall operational efficiency.

2. Executive & Corporate Administrative Support

  • Provide administrative and organizational support to executive leadership and designated corporate departments.
  • Coordinate executive calendars, appointments, meetings, conference room reservations, and scheduling requirements.
  • Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, correspondence, reports, and other executive-level materials.
  • Attend assigned leadership, departmental, and corporate meetings to document meeting minutes, action items, and follow-up requirements.
  • Maintain meeting records, presentations, and supporting documentation within designated SharePoint sites.
  • Assist with the coordination and preparation of Board of Directors meetings, Management Review Board (MRB) meetings, and other corporate leadership activities.
  • Track assigned administrative projects, deadlines, and follow-up items to support timely completion.
  • Assist with corporate communications, employee announcements, and internal organizational initiatives.
  • Handle confidential business, employee, and executive information with professionalism and discretion.

3. Corporate Office Administration & Facilities Coordination

  • Support daily administrative operations to maintain an organized, professional, and efficient corporate office environment.
  • Answer incoming telephone calls, greet visitors, route inquiries, and provide general administrative assistance.
  • Coordinate incoming and outgoing mail, packages, deliveries, and correspondence.
  • Maintain conference rooms, common areas, and shared workspaces to ensure readiness for daily operations and meetings.
  • Monitor and replenish office supplies, beverages, kitchen inventory, and general office necessities.
  • Coordinate routine purchasing and office supply orders within approved budgets.
  • Serve as a point of contact for office service providers, including building maintenance, printing, document shredding, water delivery, and other facility vendors.
  • Assist with facility-related activities, including office equipment maintenance, security camera battery checks, workspace organization, and inventory management.
  • Support office relocations, furniture inventory, asset tracking, and other administrative projects as needed.
  • Ensure meeting rooms, audiovisual equipment, and conference systems are prepared for executive meetings and corporate events.
  • Maintain accurate and organized physical and electronic administrative records.

4. Human Resources & Corporate Operations Support

  • Provide general administrative assistance to Human Resources and Corporate Operations as needed.
  • Assist with maintaining employee records, organizational documentation, and internal tracking systems.
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including administrative coordination, documentation, and scheduling.
  • Assist with tracking employee training requirements, completion records, and corporate compliance deadlines.
  • Coordinate employee engagement initiatives, recognition activities, company events, and internal communications.
  • Assist with the preparation and maintenance of corporate presentations, organizational reports, and administrative trackers.
  • Support timesheet reminders, routine reporting, and other assigned corporate operational activities.
  • Perform additional administrative and operational duties as assigned to support organizational priorities.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

About the project
We're recruiting for a project, where the team turns social media data (TikTok, Reddit and other platforms) into trend signals that feed the company's products. You'll join a small, senior data team. Your work is the data layer: pipelines, models, signal quality and new data sources. The dashboard UI is built by another team.

What you'll do

  • Extract, clean and model large social media datasets (posts, hashtags, engagement) from TikTok and other platforms

  • Build and maintain dbt models and data pipelines, with automated tests for data quality

  • Prototype pipelines and metrics for new data sources (starting with Reddit) and check whether they're useful

  • Help map trend signals to new business categories (taxonomy, categorisation, validation)

  • Work independently on scoped deliverables, document your work in Jira and write clean, reusable code

  • Build quick prototypes to validate approaches with stakeholders

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years in a data engineering, analytics engineering or technical data analyst role (5+ years for Senior)

  • Hands-on, commercial experience with dbt. You've built and tested models yourself, not just read about it

  • Strong SQL: window functions, CTEs, deduplication, incremental logic

  • Strong Python for data work: API extraction, data cleaning, pipeline scripting

  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse. Snowflake is preferred; BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks or similar is fine for Mid

  • Git in everyday work

  • Comfortable working autonomously with limited onboarding

  • Good English, as the whole team communicates in English

  • You use AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code etc.) and take full ownership of the output

Nice to have

  • Experience with social media or web data (TikTok, Reddit, Instagram, X) or public APIs

  • Airflow or another orchestrator

  • Data Vault modelling

  • Trend or signal analysis: growth metrics, anomaly and bot detection, sentiment

What we offer

  • B2B contract, fully remote

  • A data-heavy project with real product impact and a modern stack

  • A small team with direct access to the Head of Data

  • Quick recruitment process: a short call with us, a technical interview (dbt, SQL, Python) and a final interview with the project lead

title: Summer Research Program Graduate Intern 2027, Tactical Defense Systems (Group 10-08)
description:
The Tactical Defense Systems Group works to understand air defense issues, in particular, air vehicle survivability, vulnerability of U.S. Air Force (USAF) aircraft to weapons systems, electronic countermeasures, and air surveillance for homeland defense. The group focuses on understanding USAF and threat air defense systems through tests and measurements. Test activities include flight, field, and laboratory testing. The group operates two airplanes, all highly instrumented, and numerous ground systems as needed for test efforts. The group also develops new hardware for testing and prototype systems as well as for instrumenting existing sensors. There are a few major field-testing campaigns each year. Local testing is used to validate flight readiness. Data collected from testing are analyzed and compared with models in concert with Group 109, Systems and Analysis. The group's activities continue to evolve in parallel with USAF efforts, but the emphasis remains on providing answers to questions from our Air Force sponsors by conducting field measurements using state-of-the-art instrumentation and then analyzing the resulting data.

Position Description

The group seeks a summer intern to assist our engineering staff with advanced concept demonstrations in the areas of data analysis, algorithm development, software development, and digital signal processing. At the conclusion of these demonstrations, the successful intern will have the opportunity to document and present their results to the group.

Preferred Qualifications

The successful candidate will be pursuing a graduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or a related field with hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: software development, graphical user interface development, real time software, MATLAB or C++ programming, FPGA programming, digital design, digital signal processing, image processing, data analysis or artificial intelligence / machine learning.

Selected candidate will be subject to a pre-employment background investigation and must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret level DoD security clearance.

Summer Research Program Overview

The Summer Research Program offers students the chance to apply their academic knowledge to real-world national security challenges while working alongside leading scientists and engineers. As an SRP intern, you’ll engage in hands-on research, receive dedicated mentorship, and take part in professional development opportunities including workshops, tech talks, and networking events—all while building connections within a vibrant community of peers.

  • Internships are typically 10–12 weeks, with flexible start and end dates, typically May through early August.
  • Housing support is available for eligible non-local interns, including access to discounted university housing in Boston and a one-time taxable relocation payment.
  • Complimentary daily shuttle transportation is provided from Boston-based housing to and from the Lab.

The New Life Fellowship Program is first and foremost a Christ-centered ministry focused on meeting the practical, emotional, relational, and spiritual needs of homeless women and children while guiding them toward lasting life transformation through the grace of Jesus Christ. title: Product Manager - Enrollment
description:
Position Overview

Join our team as a Product Manager, Enrollment and own the technology that enables family caregivers to discover, enroll in, and onboard into Ceresti's dementia care program. This role develops and leads cross-functional initiatives to drive caregiver enrollment at scale, owning a roadmap that spans marketing and referral channel development, outbound call operations, CRM strategy, web and form experiences, and the onboarding journey onto our platform.

You will be the connective tissue between enrollment operations, marketing, clinical, and engineering where you will lead and influence without direct reporting lines. You will partner with operations to define and accelerate the end-to-end enrollment funnel: defining the metrics, instrumenting the analytics, running a continuous cadence of experiments, and shipping the products and automations that move conversion. You will own a roadmap of improvements to existing systems (e.g. AI-powered enrollment intelligence engine) as well as high-leverage, zero-to-one bets such as referral programs and self-serve onboarding. This is a role suited for a product manager who is growth-oriented, experiment-driven, scrappy, and energized by ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces with a direct line to business growth.

About Us & What We Do

Ceresti is on a mission to reduce avoidable hospitalizations and improve care for people living with dementia while improving the lives of their families and caregivers. We envision a world in which family caregivers of people living with dementia are supported and have the knowledge, skills, and confidence to provide the best possible care for their loved ones.

Ceresti is a tech-enabled dementia care provider with a differentiated model of care that improves outcomes and delivers guaranteed cost savings by including family caregivers in the care team. We offer health plans and accountable care organizations a turnkey solution for impacting a population that has limited engagement in traditional clinical programs.

Our culture is rooted in agility, innovation, and collaboration. We believe that every idea—no matter how small—can spark a meaningful improvement. Together, we create solutions that make a lasting impact on the healthcare ecosystem, enabling more compassionate and cost-effective care for those who need it most.

Responsibilities

Enrollment Strategy & Roadmap Ownership

● Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the technology that drives caregiver enrollment, from first touch through activation on the Ceresti platform.

● Translate company growth targets into a prioritized, sequenced roadmap of enrollment initiatives.

● Build the business case for each initiative, sizing the enrollment opportunity against the investment required.

● Balance near-term conversion wins against the zero-to-one bets that unlock step-change growth across channels, partners, and markets.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

● Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning marketing, sales, operations, clinical, data, and engineering, driving alignment and outcomes without direct reporting lines.

● Partner closely with marketing on campaign strategy, channel mix, messaging, and the lead-to-enrollment handoff.

● Partner closely with outbound call operations to turn frontline insight into product, process, automations, and tooling improvements.

● Define clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering to scope, prioritize, and ship.

● Use modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, requirements generation, and iteration.

● Be hands-on and scrappy. Unblock teams, force decisions, and drive momentum when things get ambiguous.

● Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, experiment results, and progress clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

Enrollment Systems & Technology

● Own the strategy and roadmap for HubSpot as the system of record for enrollment including lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, automation, and reporting.

● Own the technology that enables outbound call operations, including dialing, queueing, call routing, scripting, disposition capture, and AI-assisted agent tooling.

● Own the technology that enables efficient handling of inbound leads

● Own the product side of Ceresti's websites, ensuring landing pages and forms flow cleanly into the right enrollment pipelines with accurate attribution.

● Ensure clean, trustworthy data flows across marketing, CRM, telephony, and platform systems so every lead is routed, worked, and measured.

Caregiver Onboarding

● Own the caregiver onboarding experience end to end — what happens from the moment a caregiver says yes through to an activated, engaged user.

● Partner with platform product and engineering teams to design and ship onboarding experiences that are empathetic, simple, and fast to value.

● Continuously reduce friction, drop-off, and time-to-activation at every step of onboarding.

● Own the handoff from enrollment into ongoing engagement and coaching.

Funnel Analytics & Experimentation

● Define, instrument, and own the enrollment funnel: stage definitions, conversion rates, channel and cohort performance, and cost per enrollment.

● Build the reporting and dashboards that give the company a shared, real-time view of enrollment performance.

● Run a continuous, high-velocity experimentation program: form hypotheses, design tests, measure results, iterate quickly, and scale what works.

● Pair quantitative funnel data with qualitative caregiver feedback to identify the next constraint and deliver business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Education

● BS/BA degree or higher.

Experience

● 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager or equivalent, ideally owning growth, enrollment, or acquisition funnels.

● Demonstrated track record of leading cross-functional teams and driving outcomes through influence rather than authority.

● Experience owning a funnel end to end — defining the metrics, running the experiments, and moving conversion.

● Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms as the system of record for a funnel; HubSpot strongly preferred.

● Experience with outbound, contact center, or sales engagement technology is a strong plus.

● Experience building or managing onboarding experiences, self-serve flows, or referral programs.

● Experience working with AI-enabled products, personalization systems, or data-driven user experiences is a strong plus.

● Experience translating user needs and business goals into shipped product features and user experiences.

● Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where scrappiness and ownership are required.

● Experience in healthcare or caregiving is a strong plus.

Skills

● Strong product judgment with a user-centered mindset.

● Strong analytical skills; fluent in funnel metrics, cohort analysis, and experiment design.

● Highly experiment-oriented, with a bias toward testing and measuring over debating.

● Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional groups without direct reporting lines.

● Comfortable with HubSpot CRM workflows, automation, and reporting.

● Comfortable in analytics and BI tooling; able to get to an answer in the data without waiting on someone else.

● Ability to design intuitive experiences for complex or emotionally sensitive user journeys.

● Strong judgment around applying AI responsibly in emotionally sensitive user experiences.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

● Highly collaborative; able to build trust across functions.

● Organized, pragmatic, and execution-focused.

● Curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning new domains.

● High integrity, transparency, and ownership mindset.

● Must be able to pass a background check.

description:

Your focus is to deliver a fantastic, high-energy Meetings & Events operation, working closely alongside your manager. You will ensure that our conference and banqueting spaces consistently offer the highest professional standards of service while maximizing overall profitability. Why Village?

At Village, we do hospitality a little differently. We are all about personality, genuine connections, and creating great experiences for our guests and each other. That is why we back our teams to be themselves, take ownership, learn new skills, and grow their careers.

Previous experience is great, but your attitude and energy matter much more to us. If you are friendly, positive, love working with people, and enjoy being part of a busy team, we will give you all the support, training, and opportunities you need. Because it really does take a Village.

How the Village Thrives

  • We Can & We Do: We show up to make a genuine difference and do fantastic work everyday, with purpose. We welcome change, support our management team, and actively participate in building a vibrant department culture.

  • We Care: We care about our impact on guests, the community, and each other. We love to WOW our conference and banqueting guests with enthusiasm and meticulous attention to detail from welcome to farewell.

Your Shift: What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As our Meetings & Events Team Leader / Assistant Manager, you are the operational spark on the floor. We trust you to handle:

  • Shift & Event Leadership: Leading busy event shifts, coaching team members to deliver excellence, and ensuring spaces are set up perfectly to brand standards.

  • Commercial & Financial Support: Reviewing departmental performance against budgets, tracking payroll percentages, and driving revenue across bar spend and wet targets.

  • Tech & Setup Supervision: Operating and demonstrating complex AV equipment safely and efficiently, while ensuring all event kit is stored securely.

  • Food & Drink Excellence: Serving with confidence and flare, role-modelling natural upselling behaviors to maximize shift profitability.

  • Compliance & Audits: Conducting health and safety training, food safety checks, licensing law compliance, and statutory audits as directed.

How We Succeed Together

We do not micromanage. It takes a village, so we believe in Ownership & Integrity, giving you the autonomy to run your shifts, manage client needs on the fly, and meet your personal objectives.

We Empower & Elevate our people. If you want Room to Grow, we provide funded qualifications, structured 1:1 reviews, and joint objective planning to actively map out your leadership career. We constantly Innovate & Progress so we can Inspire Excellence and smash our regional ReviewPro and BDRC score targets together.

The Perks: What’s In It For You?

  • Gym Membership: 2 x complimentary gym memberships at your home hotel.

  • Hotel Stays: Hotel rooms from £20 across 35 hotels.

  • Food & Drink: 50% off food and drink for you and up to 5 guests, plus 75% off Sunday dinner for up to 6 people.

  • Retail & Lifestyle: Hundreds of brand discounts via the Village app.

  • Support: 24/7 Mental Health support via our Employee Assistance Programme.

Think You’ve Got the Right Energy?

We are not looking for perfect CVs, we are looking for great leaders. If you enjoy creating an engaged team through development and recognition, and love the fast-paced world of live events, we want to hear from you.

At Village, we’re all about personality, ambition, and bringing your real self to work. Diverse perspectives are what keep our business buzzing, so whatever your background, you’ll find a welcoming place to build your career here.

Please note that we often receive a high volume of applications. Because of this, job roles may close earlier than the advertised closing date, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Bring your personality, your drive, and your ambition. Hit apply, tell us why you love working with people, and let's see if we are a match.

  • Experience with Apache Cassandra and Redis.

  • Familiarity with IoT data flows and telemetry.


What We Offer



  • Flexibility: a 100% remote position based in Brazil.

Compensation


CLT: 14.000 BRL - 16.000 BRL per month (commensurate with experience)


Other information


xFarm Technologies is committed to creating a work environment where diversity and inclusiveness are critical to the well-being and growth of all employees.

title: Databricks Data Architect (Healthcare & Life Sciences)
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 200 – 250 PLN / godz. netto

About Entrada AI

Entrada AI is a specialized consulting partner and a strategic portfolio company of Databricks Ventures. We were recently named the Genie Partner of the Year (2026) for our work deploying Databricks Genie at enterprise scale—bridging the gap between AI ambition and the trusted, governed data required for accurate responses. With over 150 Databricks projects delivered, we unlock self-service analytics for Fortune 500 leaders.

Databricks invested in us because of our technical excellence, placing us in the "inner circle" of the ecosystem. For our engineers, this means direct access to product roadmaps, private previews, and the teams building the platform. You will join a team of industry veterans who value clean architecture over quick fixes. We don't just maintain pipelines; we solve complex architectural challenges.

About the Role

As a Data Architect, you will lead the design and deployment of end-to-end AI lifecycles for global healthcare and life sciences clients. You will move beyond building isolated models to architecting scalable, production-grade ML systems on the Databricks Lakehouse. This role requires a unique intersection of deep learning expertise, data engineering rigour, and a consultant’s mindset — balancing technical sophistication with the ability to advise stakeholders on clinical validation, regulatory compliance, and long-term AI strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Architecture & Development: Design and implement scalable computer vision pipelines using PyTorch or TensorFlow, leveraging Databricks Runtime for ML to process large-scale medical imaging datasets (DICOM, NIfTI).

  • Production MLOps: Architect end-to-end MLOps workflows using MLflow for experiment tracking, model versioning, and seamless transition from research to production-grade Model Serving.

  • Imaging Optimization: Develop efficient data loaders and preprocessing steps for high-dimensional medical data, utilizing Apache Spark to parallelize image transformation and feature extraction.

  • Governance & Compliance: Enforce rigorous data lineage and security protocols via Unity Catalog, ensuring all model training and inference processes meet healthcare regulatory standards (HIPAA/GDPR/HITRUST).

  • Technical Leadership: Act as a strategic advisor for clients, guiding them on the "build vs. buy" of medical AI tools and sharing best practices on model interpretability and bias mitigation in clinical settings.

  • Standardization: Implement CI/CD for ML (Git integration, Databricks Asset Bundles) and promote the use of Feature Stores to ensure consistency between training and real-time inference.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in Machine Learning or Data Science, with at least 3 years of deep, hands-on experience deploying models within the Databricks ecosystem.

  • Medical Imaging Domain: Proven experience handling medical imaging formats (DICOM, NIfTI, WSI) and familiarity with specialized libraries such as MONAI, SimpleITK, or OpenCV.

  • Core Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python (specifically the PyData stack) and SQL. Experience with PySpark for large-scale data manipulation is essential.

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Production experience in Azure (Azure Machine Learning, ADLS Gen2) or AWS (SageMaker, S3), with a focus on GPU instance management and cost optimization.

  • Modern ML Stack: Expertise in MLflow for the full lifecycle and experience with Delta Lake to manage unstructured imaging metadata. Familiarity with Databricks Model Serving or TorchServe.

  • Modeling Depth: Strong understanding of Deep Learning architectures (CNNs, Transformers, SegNet) and evaluation metrics specific to medical diagnostics

  • Communication: Fluent English (C1+) for direct client collaboration; ability to translate complex algorithmic concepts into strategic business value for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Credentials: A commitment to technical excellence, ideally backed by certifications such as Databricks Machine Learning Professional or specialized Cloud AI certifications.

The Offer

Cooperation Models:

Poland: Available via Employment Contract (UoP) or B2B.

Romania/ Greece: Available via B2B only.

  • 100% Remote: Full flexibility to work from anywhere in Poland/ Romania / Greece

  • High-End Tech: Apple MacBook Air M4 15" provided to all engineers.

  • Referral Bonus: Bonus for bringing other top-tier engineers to the team.

  • Professional Growth:

    • Certification Support: Coverage for all Databricks technical certifications.

    • Industry Leadership: Support in reaching the highest tiers of Databricks expertise (such as the Champion program) tailored to your specific career track.

    • Personal Branding: Opportunities to present at global industry conferences and contribute to technical thought leadership.

    • Expert Mentorship: Direct collaboration with Databricks MVPs and core product teams, giving you a front-row seat to the platform's evolution.

Recruitment Process

  • Introductory Call (20 min): Short conversation with our Recruiter to discuss your background and expectations.

  • Technical Interview (60 min): Deep dive into your technical skills with our engineering team.

  • Optional Client Interview: Required only in specific cases.

  • Decision & Offer: We aim to close the process and provide feedback efficiently.

title: Clerk
description:
About the Firm:

Our mission: Transforming Infrastructure with Passion and Kindness.

We provide quality, cost-effective engineering services to state and local governments and private-sector clients across New York State and Pennsylvania. Our project portfolio features experience in Bridge, Highway, and Structural Design, Condition and Safety Inspection, Civil and Site Engineering Support, Construction Inspection and Administration, Survey and Mapping, and Hydrographic Services.
Prudent Engineering is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

About the Position

Prudent Engineering, LLP is seeking a Construction Inspection Quality Control Clerk (CIQC) to join our team at our main office in Syracuse, NY. The CIQC Clerk provides essential administrative and records support to the Construction Inspection Quality Control team on NYSDOT Design-Build projects. This role maintains accurate project documentation, supports data entry and filing in accordance with NYSDOT Manual of Uniform Record Keeping (MURK) requirements, tracks materials and correspondence, and assists the field and office staff so that quality control, inspection, and contract administration records remain complete, timely, and audit-ready.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Establish and maintain organized project files (electronic and hard copy) in accordance with NYSDOT MURK, ProjectWise (or equivalent), and company document-control procedures.
  • Perform accurate data entry of daily inspection reports, material certifications, test results, quantities, and other CIQC records into AWP, ProCore, ProjectWise, or other required systems.
  • Track, log, and file incoming/outgoing correspondence, RFIs, submittals, change-order documentation, force-account records, and material acceptance documentation.
  • Assist with preparation and distribution of meeting minutes, progress reports, and routine administrative correspondence.
  • Support quantity tracking and progress-estimate preparation by compiling inspector data and verifying basic calculations under supervision.
  • Maintain logs for material certifications, sample tracking, non-conformance reports, and corrective-action documentation.
  • Coordinate with field inspectors, Office Engineer, Resident Engineer, and materials testing staff to ensure timely submission and completeness of required records.
  • Perform general clerical duties including photocopying, scanning, filing, mail handling, and office supply coordination for the project field office.
  • Assist with project close-out documentation and final records package assembly.
  • Uphold confidentiality and maintain professional communication with contractors, NYSDOT staff, and internal team members.
  • Perform other related administrative duties as assigned to support the CIQC and construction inspection effort.

The Minimum Requirements we seek:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1–2 years of clerical, administrative, or office experience preferred (construction, engineering, or public-works setting a plus).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and basic data-entry accuracy.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment.
  • Ability to follow written procedures and maintain accurate records.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation may be required.
  • Ability to work in a field-office setting and adapt to project schedules (occasional overtime or adjusted hours possible).
  • Primarily office-based within a project field office, with occasional site visits in a deadline-driven environment requiring accuracy and adaptability to varying project demands.
  • Requires prolonged periods of sitting and computer work, occasional lifting of files or boxes weighing up to 25–30 lbs., and the ability to navigate a construction field office environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting NYSDOT, Thruway, or similar transportation construction inspection projects.
  • Familiarity with MURK forms, SiteManager, ProjectWise, or comparable construction management software.
  • Experience handling material certifications, daily reports, or contract documentation.
  • Associate degree or coursework in business administration, construction technology, or related field.

What we will offer

  • An annual salary: $45,000- $50,000 per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off plus paid holidays
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement

*Actual compensation may vary based on work experience, location, market conditions, education, training, certifications, and other credentials, as well as applicable knowledge and skills.

title: Summer Research Program Intern 2027, Tactical Satellite Communications (Group 06-64)
description:
The Tactical SATCOM Systems Group is developing technologies for the most advanced communication satellites, and SATCOM systems in the world. The Group is involved in a synergistic combination of research, prototyping, and experimentation efforts focused on the goals of enhancing the capacity, robustness, and the flexibility of future generations of communications satellites and systems.

Current research areas draw from advanced concepts in Information Theory, Communication Theory, Network Theory, Array Processing, Estimation and Detection, Machine Learning, Antennas and Arrays, Dynammic Resource Allocation, and Optimization. Promising research results are verified in hardware and software prototypes that provide quantitative performance data in relevant environments. Exceptional candidates seeking to become experts in these fields and advance the state of SATCOM technology are encouraged to apply.

Position Description

The Advanced Satcom Systems and Operations Group seeks a summer intern to engage in design, analysis, modeling, and/or simulation of novel aspects for future wireless communications systems. The work may include signal processing, machine learning, information theory, and/or algorithm development for the most advanced communication satellites being developed.

The successful candidate must be working on a PhD, MS, or BS degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science and have the ability to work with abstract concepts. Skills and experience in one or more of the following areas are required: C/C++ and/or Java, database design, graphical user interfaces, and XML. A background in signal processing or digital communications is beneficial, but not required.

Summer Research Program Overview

The Summer Research Program offers students the chance to apply their academic knowledge to real-world national security challenges while working alongside leading scientists and engineers. As an SRP intern, you’ll engage in hands-on research, receive dedicated mentorship, and take part in professional development opportunities including workshops, tech talks, and networking events—all while building connections within a vibrant community of peers.

  • Internships are typically 10–12 weeks, with flexible start and end dates, typically May through early August.
  • Housing support is available for eligible non-local interns, including access to discounted university housing in Boston and a one-time taxable relocation payment.
  • Complimentary daily shuttle transportation is provided from Boston-based housing to and from the Lab.

title: Customer Fulfilment Specialist
description:
About the Company

MSR-FSR is an international managed engineering services provider supporting leading organisations in the high-technology sector. We collaborate with major global clients and are recognised for delivering high-quality engineering solutions.

We offer structured training, career development opportunities, and the chance to work on large-scale projects across Europe.

Role Summary:

The Customer Fulfilment Specialist manages and controls semiconductor manufacturing spares across plants/production lines to ensure equipment uptime.

This role focuses on accurate spare part master data, inventory control, spare request fulfillment, stock audits, and readiness planning aligned with semiconductor manufacturing requirements.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

Administer the spare parts management system (spare module/ERP/CMMS integration), ensuring accurate item setup and lifecycle status.

- Maintain complete and correct critical spares master data:

- part numbers, alternates, BOM/kit definitions (if used), manufacturer references, compatibility, and substitutes

- lead times, MOQ, storage requirements, and serialization/traceability rules (if applicable) - Manage the full spare flow:

- receiving/put-away confirmation - inspection/quality checks coordination (as required)

- issuance to maintenance/production teams based on approvals and procedures - returns, scrap/write-off processing, and root-cause support for discrepancies

- Monitor stock health for critical equipment: - min/max levels, reorder points, safety stock, and buffer planning

- ensure correct part selection for equipment models/lines - ensure timely fulfillment to support downtime reduction targets

- Conduct and support cycle counts, audits, and reconciliations:

- investigate variances and ensure corrective actions are recorded - Support uptime strategy by identifying and maintaining:

- A/B/C critical spares classification (or company-defined criticality tiers) - consumption trends, slow-moving/excess stock reporting

- Track and report spare performance metrics to leadership: - stock availability/service level, stock-out causes, turnaround time for requests

- overdue orders, supplier performance inputs (lead time adherence)

- Work closely with Procurement/Supply Chain: - trigger replenishment actions

- manage vendor documentation and ensure part data alignment with purchasing

- Ensure compliance with semiconductor-specific requirements:

- ESD-safe handling/storage rules, cleanliness/packing standards when applicable

- traceability and documentation retention for regulated/critical components

- Maintain controlled access and governance: - standard approval workflows

- change management for master data updates

Required Qualifications

- Diploma/Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Business (or equivalent experience).

- Proven experience in spares/inventory administration and/or equipment maintenance support.

- Hands-on experience with **ERP/CMMS or inventory systems** (SAP, Oracle, Maximo, etc.).

- Strong data accuracy and reconciliation skills.

- Intermediate-to-advanced Excel (reports, pivot tables, inventory analytics).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in semiconductor manufacturing or high-tech maintenance environments.

- Familiarity with equipment spare criticality, lead-time planning, and reliability-driven inventory.

- Knowledge of maintenance/production downtime processes (CMMS workflows). Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Inventory accuracy (audit variance %) - Spare request cycle time (request-to-issue) - Stock-out frequency and severity (critical spares)

- Reorder compliance (on-time replenishment) - Reduction in excess/obsolete spares while maintaining availability

Benefits

Salary : 19€ per hour

Initially a 12 month contract with a possibility of extension

VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.

Role

Category Lead – Financial services and payments

Job Level / Designation

General Manager / Band M3

Function / Department

Digital – Partnerships & Growth

Location

Corporate Office, Mumbai

Context for the new role

Vi Finance is a strategic growth agenda to bring relevant financial propositions for Vi’s captive customer base. The business will operate through a partnership-led model, bringing credible banks, NBFCs and fintechs onto the Vi platform across lending, cards, deposits and payments. Personal Loans will be the anchor portfolio within the broader Vi Finance proposition.

The immediate priority is to establish a high-quality, compliant multi-lender Personal Loan proposition: identify and onboard credible lending partners, define the right operating and commercial model, build seamless customer journeys, launch the go-to-market, and scale disbursals profitably. The role therefore requires a techno-commercial leader who can combine lender partnerships, product and platform execution, funnel analytics, regulatory governance and P&L ownership.

Proposal

We propose to appoint a Category Lead – Vi Finance to build and scale the Financial Services & Payments business, with Personal Loans as the primary growth portfolio.

The incumbent will first create a credible lender network and take partners from evaluation to launch readiness across commercials, contracting, API integration, information security, compliance and operating SLAs. Thereafter, the individual will define and execute the GTM, optimise the end-to-end funnel, expand distribution across Vi channels, build new platform capabilities, and scale disbursals and revenue while maintaining portfolio quality and sustainable unit economics.

The role will continuously benchmark Vi Finance against best-in-class lending and fintech platforms, translate market insights into a prioritised capability roadmap, and deliver customer adoption, conversion, disbursals, incremental revenue, partner productivity and customer experience in line with the annual operating plan.

Job purpose

Build and scale Vi Finance as a trusted, partnership-led financial-services platform, with primary ownership of Personal Loans. Create a differentiated multi-lender proposition, deliver a seamless customer experience, and drive profitable growth in adoption, disbursals and revenue.

Key Result Areas / Accountabilities

Product and Growth

  • Own the end-to-end vision, business plan and roadmap for Vi Finance, with Personal Loans as the principal focus alongside Credit Cards, Fixed Deposits, Payments and adjacent propositions.
  • Build a scalable multi-lender Personal Loan platform by defining lender-selection criteria and onboarding credible banks and NBFCs and work across commercials, legal agreements, APIs, Design team, information security, compliance, etc. to define SLAs and create launch readiness.
  • Design and execute the GTM across Vi digital assets, partner with CVM, retail & mass retail distribution and appoint channel partner; establish the proposition, segmentation, communication, offer architecture and acquisition playbook.
  • Own the complete lending funnel from eligibility and pre-qualified leads through application, approval and disbursal; use funnel, cohort and lender-level analytics to improve conversion, approval rates and lead quality.
  • Manage lender mix, commercials, CAC, unit economics and portfolio P&L to balance customer scale, partner productivity, portfolio health and profitability.
  • Benchmark leading fintech and lending platforms, identify customer-experience and technology gaps, and prioritize capabilities such as multi-lender routing, straight-through processing, decisioning, experimentation, reporting and partner governance.
  • Lead zero-to-one launches and subsequent scale-up of adjacent financial-services and payment categories in line with the portfolio strategy.

New Partnerships & Business Development:

Develop and manage a high-quality ecosystem of banks, NBFCs, fintechs and payment partners. Create a structured partner-evaluation framework covering customer fit, scale, approval and fulfilment capability, economics, technology readiness, data security and regulatory compliance. Negotiate commercials and contracts, establish partner governance and performance scorecards, resolve integration and operating dependencies, give visibility to leadership team, keep evolving the finance business roadmap and maintain a pipeline of prospective partners to strengthen proposition breadth and resilience.

Other tasks
  • Translate the business blueprint into prioritized customer journeys, platform requirements and a sequenced delivery roadmap.
  • Lead cross-functional execution with Product, Technology, Analytics, CVM, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, InfoSec, Finance, Customer Service and Retail teams.
  • Create points of ingress across Vi App, web, CVM, prepaid and postpaid journeys, generate top of the funnel from the retail touchpoints and partner ecosystems.
  • Plan and run performance campaigns, experiments and tailored offers to drive qualified traffic, application starts, approvals and disbursals.
  • Establish daily and monthly MIS covering funnel conversion, lender performance, customer cohorts, CAC, revenue, unit economics, SLA adherence and customer experience.
  • Institute compliance-by-design and operating governance in line with applicable RBI digital-lending requirements, data-privacy standards and Vi policies.
  • Review performance, identify bottlenecks and lead course corrections with partners and internal teams to deliver the annual operating plan.
  • Provide leadership with market intelligence, competitor benchmarks, forward-looking risks and recommendations for the next phase of growth.

Key Performance Indicators
  • Personal Loans: active lender count, lead volumes, application-to-disbursal conversion, approval rate, monthly disbursals and revenue.
  • Economics: CAC, revenue per disbursal, contribution margin, partner payouts and portfolio P&L.
  • Execution: time to onboard and launch partners, API and journey delivery milestones, SLA adherence and funnel improvements.
  • Customer: adoption, repeat engagement, journey completion, complaint rate and NPS.
  • Broader portfolio: customers, transactions, GMV and revenue across Cards, Deposits and Payments.

Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience

Demonstrated experience in digital lending, preferably building or scaling a multi-lender LSP or marketplace model. Strong lender-partnership and business-development capability across banks and NBFCs, including commercial negotiation, contracting, API integrations, InfoSec, compliance and operating governance. Deep understanding of Personal Loan funnels, credit journeys, customer segmentation, cohort analytics, CAC/LTV, unit economics and P&L. Working knowledge of RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, data privacy and partner-risk management. Proven ability to lead zero-to-one launches, scale GTM across large consumer ecosystems, benchmark best-in-class practices and influence senior stakeholders while leading large cross-functional teams.

Preferred profile: 7–12 years across fintech, banks, NBFCs or large digital ecosystems, with meaningful ownership of Personal Loans, lender partnerships, digital product or platform delivery, analytics-led growth and business planning.

Must have technical / professional qualifications

MBA preferred

title: Remote Bookkeeping Manager
description:
Remote Bookkeeping Manager

Full Time | Fully Remote | Accounting and Finance | Quirk Auto Group

Quirk Auto Group is seeking an experienced Remote Bookkeeping Manager to oversee accurate, timely bookkeeping and financial recordkeeping across automotive dealership operations. This full time, fully remote role is suited to a detail oriented accounting professional with 2 to 5 years of relevant experience, strong knowledge of bookkeeping processes, and the ability to manage financial workflows with consistency and discretion. The successful candidate will help maintain reliable financial information, support effective business decisions, and strengthen accounting procedures across dealership activities.

The Role

The Remote Bookkeeping Manager will coordinate daily bookkeeping activities and help ensure that financial transactions are recorded accurately, reconciled regularly, and organized for reporting. The role requires sound judgment, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently while communicating effectively with finance colleagues and operational teams. The manager will monitor routine accounting processes, identify discrepancies, maintain appropriate documentation, and support a dependable financial close process

What You'll Do

• Oversee daily bookkeeping activities, including transaction entries, account coding, accounts payabl, accounts receivable, and general ledger maintenance

• Review financial records for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate supporting documentation.

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit card accounts, vendor statements, and general ledger balances on a regular schedule

• Monitor invoices, payments, receipts, deposits, and outstanding balances, following established approval procedures.

• Coordinate month end activities and prepare schedules and supporting records for financial reporting.

• Maintain organized digital files and ensure financial documentation is accessible to authorized team members.

• Review bookkeeping workflows, identify inconsistencies, and recommend practical improvements to accuracy and efficiency

• Communicate with internal departments and external vendors to resolve routine billing, payment, and account questions

• Assist with budgets, expense tracking, audit preparation, and other accounting projects as needed.

• Protect confidential financial information and follow company policies, internal controls, and applicable accounting practices

What We're Looking For

• Two to five years of professional experience in bookkeeping, accounting, or a related finance role.

• Demonstrated ability to manage general ledger activity, reconciliations, payables, receivables, and financial documentation.

• Working knowledge of standard accounting principles and routine month end procedures.

• Proficiency with accounting software, spreadsheets, and digital recordkeeping systems.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and problem solving skills.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across departments.

• Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently in a fully remote environment.

• Sound judgment when handling confidential information and sensitive financial records.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; additional coursework or a degree in accounting, finance, or business is an advantag

Bonus Points

Experience supporting an automotive dealership, multi location business, or service based operation is beneficial. Familiarity with dealership transactions, vehicle inventory accounting, parts and service revenue, floorplan accounts, or manufacturer and vendor statements is an advantage. Experience improving bookkeeping procedures or supporting accounting software transitions is also welcome

Quirk Auto Group offers a professional work environment with the flexibility of a fully remote position. Benefits include health insurance, retirement benefits, and paid leave, subject to applicable plan terms and company policies. Team members can contribute to organized financial operations while working with colleagues across the business. We value accuracy, accountability, respectful communication, continuous improvement, and responsible handling of company information

title: Mountain Studio Associate Manager | Boulder, CO (FT)
description:
Mountain Studio Associate Manager

Retail | Boulder, Colorado | Full-Time Salaried

ABOUT US

Stio® is a mountain apparel brand that designs, develops and sells beautiful, functional, and innovative apparel infused with the soul of the mountain lifestyle. With headquarters in Jackson, Wyoming, Stio® draws inspiration from the surrounding Teton Range and offers product via Stio.com, catalog and its Mountain Studio® retail locations in Jackson Hole, Wyoming; Park City, Utah; Boulder, Colorado; Freeport, Maine; Bend, Oregon; Boise, Idaho; Boston, Massachusetts; South Lake Tahoe, California and opening soon in Bozeman, Montana.

YOUR ROLE

As the Associate Studio Manager (ASM) - Boulder, you share responsibility for the performance of Stio’s Boulder retail store location. Your main goals are to drive sales, ensure store profitability, provide an exceptional customer experience that’s true to the Stio brand, and build new customer acquisition. You are responsible for supporting budget objectives for both revenue and operating expenses. You will help oversee operational procedures, sales and merchandising efforts. You help lead the store staff and share responsibility for hiring and training seasonal team members, ensuring a consistently high level of customer service in your store. You will foster a culture of trust, accountability and excellence amongst the staff, ensure a strong working knowledge of Stio products and implement best practices in the areas of customer engagement, operations and visual merchandising.

The ASM reports to the Mountain Studio Manager (Store Manager).

This role is performed in our Mountain Studio location. The Mountain Studio Associate Manager must live within a reasonable commute of the Boulder Mountain Studio.

YOUR SKILLS

The ASM is a self-starter with exceptional customer experience, organizational and leadership skills. You have strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of guiding staff members with a wide array of experience and abilities to success. You are team-oriented, comfortable with multi-faceted responsibilities, and able to maintain a positive attitude in the workplace. The ASM supports training for hourly and seasonal employees and works alongside the team to elevate customer experience and drive sales in their location.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • As Associate Store Manager, you will manage the details of the retail store including but not limited to hiring, training and coaching retail staff, inventory management through receiving, selling and merchandising, and driving sales. As ASM, you will communicate directly with Store Manager and Retail Leadership, corporate Operations, Marketing, Product, and Customer Service teams as needed.
  • Excellent communication skills with prior customer service experience and excitement for a customer-facing leadership role working alongside the team from the sales floor
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and prioritization skills
  • Self-motivated and proactive with operational tasks
  • Implementation of strategies to drive new customer acquisition
  • Planning and execution to achieve an exceptional retail environment for customers, setting an example for your team in how you show up on the sales floor working alongside them each day
  • Support planning and delivery of visual merchandising and marketing plans
  • Available to work a combination of opening, closing, weekend and holiday season shifts to support the business and scheduling needs in combination with the Mountain Studio Manager

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 1+ years of retail experience preferred
  • Leadership experience preferred
  • Preferred experience with visual merchandising and/or retail marketing, and working with a team towards shared goals
  • Effective with Microsoft Office and Google Suite

THE FINE PRINT

  • Annual salary $52,000 - $60,000 based on experience
  • Available to work a combination of opening, closing, weekend and holiday season shifts to support the business and scheduling needs in combination with the Mountain Studio Manager
  • Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • 401k with employer match
  • Generous paid time off policies
  • Annual gear allowance
  • Wellness benefits
  • Generous employee discount, industry perks, and more
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Company Paid Long-Term Disability
  • Must be able to move around the retail space for 8-12 hours per day

title: Quality Assurance Supervisor - UniClean
description:
Location Quality Assurance Supervisor

UniClean, a specialized division of UniFirst Corporation, provides cleanroom cleaning and garment services to the pharmaceutical, biotech, semiconductor, electronics, and other controlled environment industries. Our specialized services help customers maintain the strict cleanliness and contamination-control standards required in these critical environments.

As a Quality Assurance Supervisor lead day-to-day quality activities at one of UniClean’s largest processing facilities. Reporting directly to the Director of Quality Assurance & Strategic Projects, this position drives the facility’s quality management system, oversees quality control, and works with Operations to maintain consistent execution of approved processes and customer requirements. The Supervisor ensures that quality decisions are supported by accurate records, effective controls, and clear accountability so the facility can defend its processes and demonstrate product conformity.

Essential Responsibilities

Quality Systems and Compliance

· Maintain the facility’s quality management system in alignment with UniClean procedures, ISO 9001 requirements, and applicable customer and regulatory requirements. Maintain audit readiness through routine floor presence and verification of actual practices.

· Support ISO certification and surveillance audits, including preparation, participation, evidence gathering, responses, and follow-up on findings. Provide facility quality performance and action status for management review.

· Administer controlled procedures, work instructions, forms, and quality records. Verify that current documents are available, records are complete and traceable, and changes receive required review, approval, and training.

· Lead investigations of nonconformances and customer complaints. Manage corrective action requests and corrective and preventive actions through containment, root cause analysis, assigned actions, and documented effectiveness checks.

Quality Control and Product Conformity

· Oversee in-process testing, inspection, sampling, and garment grading against approved methods, specifications, and acceptance criteria. Review results and trends, investigate failures, and verify completion of required follow-up.

· Control nonconforming product through identification, segregation, documented holds, evaluation, and authorized disposition. Verify reinspection or retesting when required and prevent unintended use or shipment.

· Maintain consistent inspection and grading practices. Review defect classifications, garment condition, rejection and loss trends, and disposition records with Operations to improve product quality and grading accuracy.

· Verify that required quality testing equipment is within calibration or verification status and that testing personnel are trained. Escalate conditions that call the reliability of results into question.

Risk Assessment and Process Assurance

· Conduct and maintain process risk assessments, including process failure mode and effects analysis where appropriate. Evaluate changes, recurring defects, and audit findings to identify risks and confirm effective controls.

· Assist the Division Quality team with validation protocols, execution, data review, and report preparation. Review proposed process or equipment changes for quality impact and required documentation before implementation.

Audits and Customer Quality

· Plan and conduct internal audits of facility processes and quality controls. Document objective evidence, communicate findings, track actions to closure, and verify that corrective actions are effective.

· Coordinate and support customer audits and quality visits. Gather records, explain process controls, and prepare accurate responses with the Director of Quality Assurance & Strategic Projects and facility leadership.

· Assist with supplier qualification, supplier audits, and supplier corrective actions as assigned. Evaluate quality concerns involving purchased materials or services and track required follow-up.

· Serve as a facility resource for customer quality questions, complaints, specifications, and quality commitments. Coordinate responses with Quality, Operations, and Service and escalate significant or recurring concerns promptly.

Reporting and Quality Leadership

· Prepare and issue routine customer quality reports, including inspection and grading results, nonconforming product quantities, disposition status, and corrective actions, in accordance with approved reporting requirements.

· Maintain accurate facility quality metrics covering testing, defects, complaints, audit findings, corrective actions, and grading or loss trends. Verify source data, identify adverse trends, and report risks and overdue actions to leadership.

· Coach employees and supervise assigned quality personnel on procedures, inspection methods, documentation, and escalation. Verify training effectiveness and reinforce that records must accurately reflect work performed.

· Work with Operations to resolve quality issues and sustain improvements across shifts. Escalate unresolved risks directly to the Director of Quality Assurance & Strategic Projects and perform other related quality duties as assigned.

Quality Authority and Accountability

Initiate quality holds and request suspension of affected processing or shipment when evidence indicates that product or process requirements may not be met. Notify facility leadership and the Director promptly, document containment, and ensure release or disposition occurs only through authorized personnel under approved procedures. Maintain independent quality judgment and escalate unresolved concerns. Responsibility for process execution remains with the applicable operational owners.
