title: Change Manager
description:
Total Comp: $60,000 - $90,000 Yearly (base + bonus)
Location: Overland Park, KS
Workplace: In person (not remote)
Company: DataMap
Client Work:

About DataMap

DataMap.ai is an AI-first technology consulting and solutions company focused on enterprise systems and automation. We build applications, implement ERP platforms, and provide managed services and production support at scale. Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth companies such as Google. They rely on us to modernize operations and automate workflows in ways that produce measurable business value.

DataMap is growing fast. We value innovation and collaboration, we work with urgency, and we reward speed, precision, and accountability. Teams here have the authority to solve complex enterprise problems and deliver results.

Summary

Ready to help people adopt new technology and stick with it?

Every platform DataMap implements and every product we build changes how people work, and the change pays off only when they adopt it. As a Change Manager, you lead the people side of change on your engagements: rollouts of the partner platforms we implement (Coupa, D365, NetSuite, SAP, and Boomi), adoption of our own products (Positron, RoboApprover, Itemova EDI SaaS), and change inside DataMap itself. You prepare every group the change touches, from executives and people managers to end users, along with the suppliers, customers, and other implementation service providers outside the organization. Success means people are ready at go-live and still working the new way months later. This role is in person at DataMap's office in Overland Park, Kansas, and is not remote.

Change management is a career path at DataMap, from Change Manager to Senior Change Manager to Director of Change Management. Beyond the Director level, the path continues into executive leadership, such as DataMap's Vice President, Operations & Delivery. We promote from within, and moving up depends on performance and on the needs of the business.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Change strategy and execution

  • Plan and run the change workstream on each engagement, from the case for change through go-live and reinforcement, and build the change activities into the project plan with the project team.
  • Run change impact and readiness assessments that show how processes, tools, roles, and daily work change for every internal group and third party, and give readiness input before each go-live.
  • Draft impact assessments, stakeholder maps, communications, and training content with AI tools, and review every draft before it goes out.

Stakeholder engagement

  • Map every stakeholder group by influence and impact, from executives, people managers, and end users to suppliers, customers, and other implementation service providers, and sort the groups by stance into Allies, Opponents, Neutrals, and Adversaries to plan how you engage each one.
  • Coach sponsors and people managers to lead their teams through the change, and set up a RACI matrix (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed) for change decisions and sign-off.
  • Work with the client teams that own supplier and customer relationships to lead the change for those groups, and line up the other implementation service providers on the program behind the same timeline, messages, and training.
  • Lead the change champion networks, super-users, and trainers on your engagements: engage them often, ask what they're seeing, suggest course corrections, and keep the focus on adoption.

Communication, training, and adoption

  • Build the communication and feedback plan for each rollout, with WIIFM ("What's in it for me?") messages for each group, town halls, Q&A sessions, brown bag lunches, and pulse surveys that show what is landing.
  • Run the training needs analysis, build role-based training and job aids, deliver sessions, and set up train-the-trainer and super-user programs, including training for the suppliers and customers who have to work the new way.
  • Track adoption and proficiency after go-live, find the root cause of resistance, and add reinforcement, refresher training, or in-app guidance through digital adoption platforms such as WalkMe or Whatfix where people struggle.
  • Spot the needs your change work uncovers, such as more training, adoption support, or follow-on phases, and work with the project manager to turn them into signed orders.

Education and Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience leading organizational change management, adoption, or training on technology rollouts.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Working knowledge of a structured change management approach, with hands-on stakeholder mapping, impact assessments, communication plans, and resistance management on real rollouts.
  • Hands-on training experience: needs analysis, role-based materials and job aids, live and virtual sessions, and train-the-trainer or super-user programs.
  • Experience leading change for internal groups at every level and for third parties such as suppliers, customers, or other implementation service providers.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a system or process change in the terms each group cares about.
  • Regular use of AI assistants (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot) in your daily work.
  • Ability to work in person at DataMap's office in Overland Park, Kansas. This role is not remote.
  • Knowledge of established change models, especially Lewin's change model and Kotter's 8 steps, as well as Prosci's ADKAR model, the Bridges Transition Model, the McKinsey 7-S Framework, or force field analysis, is a plus. Prosci or CCMP certification is a strong plus.
  • Experience with SaaS or ERP rollouts (such as Coupa, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365) is a plus.

Benefits & Perks

  • Total compensation of base salary plus bonus.
  • Unlimited vacation and a flexible work environment.
  • Free catered lunch on Fridays at headquarters.
  • On-site gym at headquarters.
  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Health insurance with generous employer contribution.
  • Dental, life, and disability insurance.
  • Hands-on mentorship and career development opportunities.

If you're eager to learn and grow, apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

title: Senior Scala Engineer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
umowa o pracę: 20000 – 24000 PLN / mies. brutto

Responsibilities

As a Senior Scala Engineer at Nexi Digital, you will join the Cards team, which builds and runs e-commerce card payment acceptance and processing for Nexi's Payment Service Providers and large merchants. The team has full ownership of its solution – from code, through the AWS infrastructure, to operations in a PCI DSS-certified environment.

This is a role for someone who takes topics end-to-end: you pick up a problem, work it out with the team, ship it to production, and own it afterwards. You will work remotely with colleagues in four countries, so clear, proactive communication is as much part of the job as the code.

  • Developing and maintaining the main payment gateway written in Scala (Play Framework), running on AWS.

  • Building the new standalone Network Tokenization service, managing Visa, Mastercard and other scheme integrations and the token lifecycle.

  • Integrating with acquiring systems over ISO 8583 and with Visa and Mastercard APIs for network tokenization.

  • Building and maintaining the team's AWS infrastructure, together with the rest of the team.

  • Developing supporting components as AWS Lambdas in TypeScript and Python, and Python-based test tooling.

  • Working with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB.

  • Applying security practices required by PCI DSS across development, deployment, and operations.

  • Collaborating with other Relay teams (merchant management, notifications) in an English-speaking team spread across Sweden, Switzerland, Germany, and Finland.

  • Taking ownership of your topics end-to-end and driving them forward proactively, in close contact with the team.

  • Sharing knowledge and supporting less experienced engineers in the team.

Benefits

  • Motivizer Benefits Platform to choose and manage all your benefits in one place. You receive a budget (550 PLN monthly). You can choose medical care package, meal tickets, sports cards (we have Multisport and on preferential terms, we have membership cards to one of the most popular Gyms), cinema tickets, shop vouchers, discounts and many more.

  • Language Courses – you'll have access to a multi-language learning platform enabling you to practice you language skills and learn new ones!

  • Regular and systematic further training opportunities - both internally and from external providers. We support your ongoing learning and development.

  • Cooperation within an internal community is our everyday reality. We have networking events, coding challenges, and company parties for different occasions.

Qualifications

  • Successfully completed university degree in computer science or a comparable field of study.

  • 5+ years of hands-on backend development, including production-critical systems.

  • Willingness to write production code in Scala – your language background doesn't matter; Scala experience is a strong plus.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, including building and maintaining it (not only using it).

  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

  • End-to-end responsibility – you own your topics from analysis through production and operations, not just the code you write.

  • Self-driven – you take ownership, find answers on your own, and move topics forward without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • Strong communication – you keep the team informed, ask early, say when something is at risk and feel comfortable working remotely with colleagues across several countries.

  • Fluency in Polish and very good communication in English.

  • Availability to work in a hybrid mode. Remote workers, we invite to the office once every month.


Nice to have

  • Commercial experience with Scala and Play Framework, or with another functional language.

  • Interest in joining the team's on-call rotation after onboarding (optional, not a requirement).

  • Frontend experience – full-stack profile is a great fit for the team.

  • Experience with TypeScript or Python (AWS Lambda).

  • Background in payments / card processing: acquiring, ISO 8583, card schemes, network tokenization.

  • Knowledge of PCI-DSS requirements.

About Nexi Digital

Nexi is Europe's PayTech company operating in high-growth, attractive European markets and technologically advanced countries. Listed on Borsa Italiana's MTA, Nexi has the scale, geographic reach and abilities to drive the transition to a cashless Europe. With its portfolio of innovative products, e-commerce expertise and industry-specific solutions, Nexi provides flexible support for the digital economy and the entire payment ecosystem globally, across a broad range of different payment channels and methods. Nexi’s technological platform and the best-in-class professional skills in the sector lets the company operate at its best in three market segments: Merchant Services & Solutions, Cards & Digital Payments and Digital Banking & Corporate Solutions. Nexi constantly invests in technology and innovation, focusing on two fundamental principles: meeting, together with its partner banks, customer needs and creating new business opportunities for them. Nexi is committed to supporting people and businesses of all sizes, transforming the way people pay and businesses accept payments. It offers companies the most innovative and reliable solutions to better serve their customers and expand. By simplifying payments and enabling people and businesses to build closer relationships and grow together, Nexi promotes progress to benefit everyone.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
Help shape the commercial future of a growing healthcare consultancy

At HEOR, we’re looking for a commercially-minded finance business partner to join our finance leadership team and play a pivotal role in driving profitable growth across the business.

This is a newly created role, offering a unique opportunity to work closely with our chief financial officer, financial controller, senior finance assistant and operational leaders to influence strategic decision-making across sales, pricing, forecasting, capacity planning and business performance.

We’re seeking someone who goes beyond the numbers. You’ll be a trusted advisor to business leaders, helping them make informed commercial decisions, maximise profitability and identify opportunities for sustainable growth.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your insights genuinely influence business outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

As a finance business partner, you’ll work across the organisation to ensure financial insight is embedded into commercial decision-making.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Partnering with operational leaders to drive revenue growth, profitability and business performance
  • Leading revenue and sales forecasting activities, ensuring clear visibility of performance and opportunities
  • Supporting commercial tenders, contract negotiations and client pricing strategies
  • Developing financial models to support strategic and operational decision-making
  • Managing annual budgeting and rolling forecasting processes
  • Conducting scenario planning and providing recommendations to support business growth
  • Collaborating with HR and operational teams on resource planning and capacity management
  • Supporting Board reporting, investment decisions and strategic planning activities
  • Leading the adoption and utilisation of Power BI across the business
  • Supporting continuous improvement across finance systems, reporting and technology
  • Acting as a trusted partner and advisor to colleagues across the organisation

Requirements

We’re looking for a qualified accountant with strong commercial acumen and a proven track record of successful business partnering.

You’ll likely bring:

  • ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualification
  • Significant experience in a Finance Business Partner, Commercial Finance or similar role
  • Experience partnering with operational or commercial teams to improve business performance and profitability
  • Strong financial modelling, forecasting and analytical skills
  • Experience supporting pricing decisions, tenders, bids or commercial negotiations
  • A track record of influencing stakeholders outside of finance and building trusted relationships
  • Experience working within professional services, consulting, healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotechnology or another knowledge-based service environment
  • Experience within a growing SME, founder-led or private equity-backed business would be advantageous
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to challenge constructively

Benefits

Competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

  • A ‘learning’ culture focused on personal development and supported by study bursaries
  • Workplace pension scheme
  • Range of high street, supermarket, restaurant, gym membership, holiday and entertainment discounts via Sodexho
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Employees are given an additional day of leave for: their wedding and moving house
  • Annual leave purchase scheme of up to 10 additional days’ leave per year

Hybrid working

At HEOR, we believe that collaboration, learning, and innovation are at their best when people have opportunities to work together in person. This role is based within either our Cardiff or Bicester office, operating under a hybrid working model with an expectation of at least three days per week in the office. This approach supports close teamwork, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and the strong culture that underpins our success.

If you would like to request any reasonable adjustment, for any part of the recruitment process (including application), please let us know by emailing careers@heor.co.uk

title: IT Help Desk Specialist (Entry-Level)
description:
Bachelor's Degree Required to Apply

Katapult Network is designed to help college graduates with zero to two years of professional experience find their next professional career opportunity. We focus on helping recent college graduates, with no experience, get access to full-time, entry-level opportunities with some of the nation’s top employers. Our clients include ground-breaking start-up companies and well-established billion-dollar organizations that want to find their next generation of talent.

The Job

We are currently recruiting an entry-level IT Help Desk Specialist to support both technical troubleshooting and customer experience within a growing organization. This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy working with technology and helping people solve problems in real time.

In this position, you will serve as a key point of contact for users experiencing technical issues, guiding them through solutions while providing clear and professional communication. You’ll work closely with internal teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction. This is a great opportunity for recent graduates looking to build a career in IT support, technical services, or systems administration.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Provide technical support to users by diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and system issues
  • Communicate with customers to understand problems and guide them through solutions step-by-step
  • Explain technical concepts in a clear, user-friendly way
  • Track, update, and manage support tickets to ensure timely resolution
  • Escalate complex issues to appropriate teams while maintaining communication with users
  • Collaborate with internal teams to identify and implement solutions
  • Monitor support trends and suggest process improvements
  • Participate in occasional customer meetings or site visits as needed

What We’re Looking For

  • Technical foundation: Understanding of computer hardware, software, and operating systems
  • Customer-focused mindset: Enjoys helping others and providing a positive support experience
  • Communication: Able to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical users
  • Problem-solving: Comfortable troubleshooting and working through technical challenges
  • Organization: Able to manage multiple support requests and follow through on tasks
  • Adaptability: Willing to learn new systems, tools, and technologies

Katapult Network is an equal-opportunity employer and celebrates diversity in all of its forms. People of all identities and backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

title: Foundational Offers Sr. Product Manager, Regulated Markets
description:
Overview

Candidate-facing role description

With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer and Commercial Success (CCS) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction — whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CCS is responsible for end-to-end services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CCS and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.

The Service Portfolio and Delivery organization, part of CCS, is leading the effort to enable customer success on the Microsoft Cloud by harnessing leading, AI-powered capabilities and human expertise to deliver innovative solutions that accelerate business value, drive operational excellence, and nurture long-term loyalty. One of the key mechanisms through which Microsoft activates the incredible talent of its technical teams for customer success is Microsoft Unified. Unified enables a proactive approach with customers that accelerates value creation and sustains growth for the Microsoft Cloud. It serves as a growth engine for the company by getting hands-on with customers to understand their priorities and help drive adoption and optimization at speed.

The Unified Foundational Offers team creates and brings to market commercial offerings that provide expert guidance and problem resolution, ensuring customers get value and success from their Microsoft technologies.

Role overview

Microsoft is expanding our sovereign cloud portfolio to enable cloud and AI innovation in regulated markets, giving customers greater control over where their data resides, how it is protected and governed, and how workloads operate across public, hybrid, private, and disconnected environments. As the Foundational Offers Product Manager, Regulated Markets, you will translate evolving regulatory, sovereignty, and customer requirements into scalable service offers and differentiated customer experiences. You will own the end-to-end offer strategy and design across Microsoft Solution Areas and partner closely with Finance, Sales, Delivery, Operations, GTM, Deal Desk, and Customer Success to develop, launch, scale, and manage these offerings globally.



Responsibilities

  • Define Offer Product Strategy: Craft the vision and business goals that drive the strategy for offers in the regulated market segment, with a strong emphasis on customer success, resilience, security, and AI-driven innovation. Define and prioritize a multi-year regulated-market support roadmap, balancing customer demand, market opportunity, delivery feasibility, investment requirements and business impact. Simplify the portfolio by establishing clear offer differentiation and planning the transition of legacy offerings into scalable, standardized commercial models.

  • Offer Scope & Compliance by Design: Define supported customer scenarios, environments, personnel requirements and delivery boundaries. Partner with CELA, security, privacy and Delivery to ensure commercial commitments are supported by operational controls and validated capabilities. Establish clear processes for evaluating new requirements and preventing unsupported customer commitments.

  • Customer & Market Insights: Translate customer feedback, field insights, regulatory developments and competitive intelligence into prioritized requirements for government and regulated commercial customers

  • AI-Driven Innovation: Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to embed AI capabilities into product design and delivery, enhancing customer outcomes and operational efficiency.

  • Cross-Functional Enablement: Partner with engineering, Delivery, and other operations teams to translate product vision into scalable support models, consistent delivery frameworks, and global capacity planning; including our Government Cloud. Translate offer requirements into business requirements, entitlement, onboarding, case-routing and access controls, personnel verification, tooling and capacity plans. Validate end-to-end customer scenarios through product design, UAT and ensure readiness across supported commercial and government environments.

  • Business & Portfolio Economics: Develop and maintain market sizing, adoption forecasts, pricing and investment cases in partnership with Finance and Delivery. Evaluate cost-to-serve, capacity requirements and profitability; use actual customer adoption and delivery experience to refine assumptions and prioritize investments.

  • Operational Execution: Own the operational strategy for new and existing offerings, including customer transitions, renewals, SKU architecture, packaging, pricing, and incentives.

  • GTM, Field Activation & Adoption: Partner with Sales, Product Marketing and Customer Success to define target segments, customer value propositions and routes to market. Drive role-based field readiness, early-adopter customer engagement and repeatable sales motions, with clear ownership of activation milestones and adoption outcomes. Business Process: Establish and manage core business processes including taxonomy, business rules, and performance reporting. Ensure adherence to the full product lifecycle with clear go/no-go checkpoints.



Qualifications

Required / Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or a related field AND 10+ years of experience in product management, program management, process management, or process improvement —
    • OR equivalent experience.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or a related field.
  • Sovereign market expertise: Understand the requirements driving government and regulated customers, including data residency, operational sovereignty, security, compliance, local personnel/access requirements, and disconnected or customer-controlled environments.
  • Proven track record in end-to-end product or offer management, from ideation to launch and scale, with measurable business impact.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Customer Support or Professional Services organizations, including their operational models and customer engagement strategies.
  • Experience bringing commercial offerings to market — including pricing, packaging, SKU/offer architecture, and incentive design.
  • Experience partnering with engineering or data science teams to embed AI/ML capabilities into products or services.
  • Exceptional strategic analysis and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage ambiguity and deliver clear, actionable solutions.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across all levels.
  • Experience presenting product strategy, roadmaps, and business outcomes to senior executives.
  • Deep understanding of Microsoft’s solution areas: Infrastructure; Digital & App Innovation; Data & AI; Business Applications; Modern Work; and Security.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Unified Support and competing offerings from AWS, Google Cloud, Salesforce, and others is a plus.


Business Program Management IC6 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $130,900 - $277,200 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $165,600 - $303,600 per year.

title: Project Manager, PMTA Programs
description:
About McKinney Regulatory Science Advisors


McKinney Regulatory Science Advisors (MRSA) helps clients thrive in a regulated environment by providing regulatory, scientific and stakeholder engagement leadership. We are passionate about guiding companies of all sizes successfully through every step of a complex regulatory process.


At McKinney Regulatory Science Advisors, we’re not just shaping the future of nicotine product testing; we’re creating a workplace where talented professionals can grow and thrive. We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as a 401(k)-retirement plan.


Position Summary


The Project Manager, PMTA Programs is responsible for managing client Premarket Tobacco Product Application (PMTA) programs from initial planning through FDA submission and post-submission activities. This role oversees project timelines, budgets, scope, and deliverables while coordinating cross-functional teams in chemistry, toxicology, clinical and behavioral science, and regulatory affairs.


The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for clients and works closely with internal subject matter experts, external laboratories, manufacturers, and suppliers to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and in accordance with quality expectations. While scientific and regulatory experts are responsible for technical decisions, the Project Manager ensures effective coordination, communication, issue resolution, and overall project execution.


Projects may range from individual product applications to large, multi-product portfolios across various tobacco and nicotine product categories.


Essential Responsibilities


Program Planning and Delivery

  • Build and maintain the integrated master schedule for the entire program, covering administrative sections, writing summaries, product chemistry, HPHC and stability testing, nonclinical toxicology, clinical and behavioral studies, perception studies, environmental assessment and manufacturing sections.
  • Explicitly link laboratory reports, supplier documents, scientific analyses, narratives, reviews, and submission assembly in the schedule.
  • Define scope, work breakdown structures and resource plans; track progress against milestones and the critical path.
  • Track deliverable owners, due dates, acceptance criteria, and objective evidence of completion; maintain a submission-readiness tracker showing ready, in progress, blocked, and deferred items.
  • Run gap assessments against current FDA CTP requirements, guidance and the PMTA content rule (21 CFR Part 1114), and translate gaps into workplans.
  • Lead Work Stream Owners to coordinate technical gap assessments with qualified regulatory SMEs rather than independently determining scientific or regulatory sufficiency.
  • Coordinate assembly, QC and electronic submission of applications, amendments and responses to deficiency letters.
  • Develop recovery plans for threatened milestones and coordinate documented submission-versus-amendment decisions with authorized regulatory and client stakeholders.

Client and Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as primary client contact; lead kickoffs, status meetings and steering committees.
  • Lead decision-oriented meetings that produce documented decisions, named owners, deliverables, and firm follow-up dates.
  • Support preparation for FDA pre-submission meetings and correspondence.
  • Manage expectations, escalate risks early and document decisions and change requests.
  • Translate technical issues into concise executive updates identifying impacts, options, recommendations, and decisions required.

Team Coordination

  • Direct internal subject-matter experts and writers across concurrent workstreams.
  • Lead through influence across Work Stream Owners, internal SMEs, laboratories, suppliers, manufacturers, and client teams; establish roles, handoffs, and escalation paths.
  • Surface resource conflicts early, challenge unsupported commitments constructively, and facilitate working sessions focused on removing blockers.

Financial Management

  • Own budgets, forecasts, invoicing milestones and margin.
  • Monitor estimates to complete, scope changes, and financial variances; escalate pricing or contract decisions through approved commercial authority.
  • Prepare estimates and contribute to proposals and statements of work for new and expanding engagements.

Quality and Risk

  • Maintain risk and issue registers, RAID logs and lessons learned.
  • Maintain explicit dependency and decision logs, with mitigation owners, dates, and critical-path impacts.
  • Ensure deliverables follow firm SOPs, document control and data-integrity (ALCOA+) practices.
  • Lead in distinguishing, organizing and managing draft, received, reviewed, approved, and submission-ready documents; verify completion against acceptance criteria.

Travel Requirements


Approximately 10–20% travel, based on client and business needs.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
  • 5+ years of project or program management, with at least 3 years in a regulated product environment (tobacco, pharmaceutical, medical device, food or consumer product).
  • Proven ownership of budgets, schedules and client relationships on concurrent engagements.
  • Proficiency with MS Project, Smartsheet or equivalent scheduling tools, and Microsoft 365.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and executive audiences.
  • Eligibility to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and work in U.S. jurisdiction as required by client contracts.
  • Demonstrated leadership of multidisciplinary teams without direct reporting authority, including difficult stakeholder conversations and conflict resolution.
  • Experience managing integrated dependencies, evidence-based deliverable completion, and recovery of at-risk projects.
  • Ability to provide concise, decision-ready executive reporting and escalate risks with options and consequences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PgMP or RAC certification.
  • Experience with FDA eSubmitter, the CTP Portal and eCTD-style document assembly.
  • Familiarity with analytical testing methods (ISO/CORESTA), HPHC reporting and stability study design.
  • Background in a consulting or client-service firm.
  • Experience with current FDA CTP electronic submission workflows, including CTP Portal NextGen, version control, and submission QC.
  • Experience coordinating external laboratories and suppliers on fixed-date regulatory submissions.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees so classified.


We believe in transparent compensation practices. The expected salary range for this position is $105,000.00 – $120,000.00 per year. Starting pay will be based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and the requirements of the role.


Application Process

McKinney Regulatory Science Advisors does not discriminate in hiring or employment practices based on race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, marital or familial status, national origin, non-job-related disability, or status as a veteran.


If you are looking to make an impact in a dynamic and visionary company, we invite you to apply for this opportunity at McKinney Regulatory Science Advisors.

Are We The Right Fit For You?

Are you passionate about helping others?

Do you enjoy making a positive difference in people’s lives?

We certainly do.

We believe that work should be a place where you can have fun while doing something meaningful.

We’re currently looking for like-minded team members to join our movement, which is to provide the very best care and service to our clients.

We don’t claim to be perfect, but we try very hard to be there for our clients when they need us and to guide them through the changes in their lives.

As healthcare becomes more complex, we continually need more like-minded people to join our team and serve our clients.

If this sounds like you, you may be a great fit for our team!

Why Join Us?

There are lots of great employers out there, and we believe that there is a right place for everyone.

We believe in lifelong learning. We’ve been out in front of, and welcomed, the major evolutions in the profession over the past 40 plus years. And we are excited about what’s next.

We understand that your time at work is an important part of your life’s journey, so we believe in providing ongoing training and opportunities for you to grown your skills and advance with us.

Taking care of those that provide care is important to us. As part of our benefits package, we provide annual fitness membership subsidy and access to mental health support and other counselling, should you ever need it.

We want you to be supported during your entire time with us and beyond, so we provide a competitive benefits package including health, dental and life insurance, drug coverage, and a pension plan.

How You’ll Spend Your Time…

Like any role, there are, of course, some precise duties that will need to be performed and we’ll tell you all about them.

But there are a few simple things that will determine your success on our team, and your enjoyment in your role.

Quite simply, treat your fellow team members as you would like to be treated.

Our most successful team members will always aim to do what is right, while keeping things simple and predictable. Our team members continuously look for opportunities to improve the clients’ experience. It’s what we believe in.

What You Will Bring To The Team

Our team is client-focused and believes in a high level of attention to detail, professionalism and discretion. We value diverse backgrounds and what that brings to our team and we want to hear more about what makes you unique.

In addition to what makes you unique, there are a few basics that we require for this role:

  • You enjoy working in a team environment while providing exceptional care to clients
  • A passion for helping people in a healthcare environment

Your Role

While we all collaborate to provide services to clients, we all play different roles to make this happen. You’ll contribute by:

  1. Collaborating with other team members to provide timely high quality healthcare service delivery and exceptional client experience.
  2. Having meticulous attention to detail in your work.
  3. Being highly client service focused

Prescription & Dispensing Support

  • Prepare and package prescriptions under pharmacist and/or pharmacy technician supervision
  • Input accurate patient and prescription data into pharmacy software
  • Process refill requests and third-party billing

Client Service & Experience

  • Greet and assist customers in a friendly and professional manner and refer clinical questions to the pharmacist
  • Collect prescription information accurately
  • Handle cash and card transactions, assist with OTC product inquiries

Inventory Management

  • Receive, stock, and organize medications and health supplies
  • Track expiration dates and manage returns or waste in compliance with regulations
  • Monitor stock levels and help with order preparation

Administrative Duties

  • Maintain patient records and filing systems
  • Assist in managing faxes and coordinating follow-ups

In addition to what makes you unique, there are a few basics that we require for this role:

title: Tier 2 Security Analyst
description:
• 8WEBIT Services is an employee-owned Managed Services Provider committed to delivering an exceptional IT solution. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Tier 2 Security Analyst to protect our clients' environments and raise the quality of security work across the Naperville, Illinois team.

Position Summary

The Tier 2 Security Analyst is the working core of WEBIT's security function. You lead incident response for security events, from containment and investigation through remediation, own alert tuning and detection rules in our SIEM/MDR platform, run the vulnerability management lifecycle for assigned clients, and author the runbooks that Tier 1 analysts work from. This hands-on role: you are the person that turns an alert into a confirmed finding, a finding into a remediation ticket, and a resolved ticket into a runbook the next analyst can follow.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead incident response for security events, from containment and investigation through eradication and remediation, document each incident to a reviewable standard.

- Run incident bridges calmly, keep infected clients informed, and lead the post incident review.

- Own SIEM/MDR alert tuning and detection rule management for the assigned clients, reducing noise without reducing coverage.

- Invest escalated alerts from the EDR/MDR platform, Microsoft 365 Defender, Entra ID sign-ins logs, and our email security platform.

- Administer EDR policies and exclusions and the email security rule set.

- Own the vulnerability management lifecycle assigned for clients: scan, prioritize, open remediation tickets to the Help Desk and Field Teams and track them to closure.

- Verify MFA, Conditional Access, and backup status across prioritize by risk, and remediate gaps against the WEBIT security baseline.

- Lead quarterly reviews and present findings.

- 2+ years of experience in IT support or security operations including 1 year investigating and responding to security alerts or incidents.

- Hands on experience with EDR/MDR platform. Microsoft 365, Defender, and Entra ID.

- Able to explain a security finding to a non-technical client contact.

Preferred

- Prior MSP experience: multi-tenant environments, SLA driven delivery, and PSA workflows.

- Certifications CompTIA Security, Microsoft SC-900, CompTIA CYSA+ or Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA Network+,

Microsoft AZ-900, certifications for EDR/MDR platforms.

title: Grants Specialist
description:
Job Title - Grants Specialist

Company - Zero To One Strategic

Location - Remote, Canada-based

Position Type - Full-time

Start date - Immediate

Salary - $75,000 - $80,000 / yr

About Us

Zero To One Strategic is a specialized consultancy that helps innovative companies maximize revenue from Canadian R&D and innovation programs. We work with startups and scale-ups across multiple sectors and take a long-term, outcomes-driven approach to non-dilutive funding, including grants, subsidies, and tax credits.

The Grants team works closely with founders and technical leaders to design and execute integrated funding strategies that support R&D, commercialization, and scale. To date, we have helped clients secure millions of dollars in non-dilutive funding and continue to grow as demand increases. We support clients end-to-end, from identifying and matching to the right funding opportunities, through grant writing and submission, to post-award support, delivering a well-rounded, non-dilutive funding experience.

We operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are passionate about supporting Canadian innovation and entrepreneurship. Our team works across disciplines and in close partnership with founders to help translate key milestones, technical ideas, and growth plans into funded, scalable outcomes. We look for team members who are equally excited to work alongside founders to help bring ambitious ideas to life.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Grants Specialist to manage and execute grant strategies across a large portfolio of active clients. This role focuses on client management, opportunity oversight, and ownership of funding outcomes, not grant writing alone.

You will be responsible for managing 50+ client accounts, staying ahead of new and existing funding opportunities, coordinating contractors and internal resources, communicating with funding agencies, reviewing and editing submissions, and ensuring applications are delivered on time and to a high standard.

This is an integral role on our Grants team and is well suited to someone who is highly organized, tech-savvy, comfortable operating at scale, and confident managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

Client / Portfolio Management

  • Own a portfolio of 50+ active clients with ongoing grant strategies
  • Serve as the primary point of coordination for grant-related work
  • Work directly with founders and their leadership teams to translate business priorities, projects, and technical roadmaps into fundable grant strategies
  • Ensure clients are informed of relevant opportunities and timelines
  • Manage active, submitted, and awarded opportunities through to final outcome & reporting

Grants Opportunity Management

  • Monitor federal and provincial funding programs relevant to assigned clients
  • Assess eligibility, effort, timing, and likelihood of success
  • Advise clients on which opportunities to pursue or deprioritize based on eligibility, past success, etc.
  • Maintain visibility across the full grants pipeline for each client
  • Proactively flag risks, dependencies, and resourcing needs

Contractor and Workflow Management

  • Coordinate internal and external grant writers and subject matter experts
  • Provide clear briefs, context, and deadlines
  • Review, edit, and quality check all submissions before final delivery
  • Ensure alignment with client positioning and funder requirements
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, SR&ED, and other internal teams to ensure a well-rounded, client-first funding experience.

Writing Support

  • Contribute to writing full applications, where appropriate
  • Edit and strengthen drafts written by others for QC, clarity, compliance, and impact
  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude to support research and drafting with strong human oversight

Process, Documentation, and Follow-Up

  • Track deadlines, submission status, and outcomes across your portfolio
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation
  • Support post-submission follow-ups and funder questions

Qualifications

  • Two or more years of experience in grants, funding advisory, or related roles
  • Experience managing a high volume of clients or projects simultaneously
  • Strong editing, review, and QC skills
  • Solid understanding of Canadian government funding programs (e.g., federal, provincial, municipal, sector-specific)
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using tools such as G Suite, CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot), and modern AI-assisted productivity tools
  • Excellent organization and time management skills
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication
  • Experience working with startups or scale-ups is a strong plus
  • Exposure to software, AI, med tech, cleantech, or advanced manufacturing is beneficial
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced consulting environment with evolving priorities
  • Experience working with startups or scale-ups is a strong asset

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive full-time salary based on experience
  • Remote-first work environment
  • Opportunities for growth as the grants function scales
  • Work closely with a senior team in the innovation funding space

Job Type: Full-Time, Salaried

Pay: $130,000–$150,000/year, depending on experience

Schedule: Monday–Friday, in the Gardena office

About the Role

You’ll be the technical lead for architecture across our internal ADU and multifamily portfolio in Los Angeles. That means owning design strategy, running our permitting playbook through LA’s toughest jurisdictions, and holding the line on quality and buildability from concept through RTI. You bridge our development goals and the drawings that get built — working daily with project managers and the construction team.

A Note on the Work

This is an in-house role at a design-build developer, not a design studio. The portfolio is ADUs and multifamily, built at scale and on repeat. The people who do best here like solving permitting puzzles, care about details that make a building cheaper and faster to construct, and want to see their work go vertical — not sit in a portfolio.

What You’ll Do

  • Direct conceptual layouts and construction documents for ADU and multifamily projects, and hold them to company quality and buildability standards
  • Define and execute permitting strategy for complex LA jurisdictions; manage the submittal, correction, and clearance process through to Ready-to-Issue (RTI)
  • Oversee and review deliverables from structural, MEP, civil, and Title 24 consultants to keep sets consistent and coordinated

title: Manager
description:
Summary Description: The Manager is a business partner accountable for leading the Restaurant Associate team to deliver Steak ‘n Shake operational and financial standards on each scheduled shift as well as building a well cross trained staff within the Restaurant. The Manager is responsible for assessing Associates performance to identify opportunities and coach for improvement. This position has accountability on his/her shift for the correct delivery of Steak ‘n Shake procedures, policies and specification which deliver the Steak ‘n Shake Vision and Mission. The Manager will partner directly with his/her Restaurant and General Manager and/or Franchise Partner Designate and will receive market level support from his/her Human Resource Manager and Field Training Manager / Coordinator to meet the business and strategic objectives of the organization.

Department: Operations - Restaurant Reports to: General Manager and/or Franchise Partner Designate FLSA: Non-Exempt Direct reports: Trainers and all Restaurant Associates

1. RESPONSIBILITIES: Major functions/tasks performed in the job and the deliverable (report, product, output, etc.) produced.

Primary and On-Going Accountabilities

• Effectively Manage a Steak ‘n Shake Shift

• Execute the 14 point walk and correct deficiencies as they arise

• Ensure food is properly stored and prepared in compliance with food safety regulations and recipe adherence

• Ensure service, hospitality, accuracy and speed standards are achieved

• Maintain strict compliance with health, safety and security standards and procedures • Train, coach and inspire Associates to deliver exceptional service, food quality and environment to the Guest

• Demonstrate effective decision making and problem solving skills that support the Steak ‘n Shake Principles; Relentless Pursuit of Excellence, Exceed Guest Expectations, Golden Rule, Economic Objective and Entrepreneurial Approach

• Ensure accurate adherence to all State and Federal laws on assigned shift

• Lead by Example

• Has authority to discipline associates

• Recommends associates for hiring and promotion

• Recommends associates for termination


Specific Duties and Responsibilities

Customer Satisfaction: Build the business by relentlessly pursuing excellence and growing customer traffic over prior year:

Effectively interact with Guests to ensure we exceed their expectations with the highest quality food and great service

Immediately address Guest concerns and complaints utilizing the Steak ‘n ShakeGuest Recovery Model - L.E.A.R.N.

Ensure Guests are immediately recognized upon entering and as they are leaving

Motivate all Associates to deliver great hospitality toward all guests and other associates

Create a positive team environment with knowledgeable associates working together through shift huddles and ongoing coaching

Brand Protection: Operate in accordance with our Quality, Service and Cleanliness Standards(QSC) and other food safety practices, delighting our Guest with outstanding fresh food and training our valuable people:

Execute the 14 point walk – ensuring the facility is radiant, the associates are motivated, the stations are appropriately set up / re- stocked for meal periods, and constantly moving through the restaurant coaching and directing associates to ensure quality adherence and speed standards are achieved

Interview candidates using the Select the Best 1st interview guide and recommend enthusiastic / Guest centric candidates to the General Manager for employment

Ensure associates are effectively trained using the Steak ‘n Shake training program,Earning your Wings

Monitor food quality, portioning and speed from the EXPO window and resolve any issues immediately

Assign and verify all side work is accurately and efficiently completed

Verify accurate adherence to the Prep and Pull and cooling charts as well as complete HACCP and line checks on assigned shift ensuring food quality and quantity

Ensure all Safety procedures and policies are strictly adhered to


Financial Growth: Manage profitable shifts focused on delighting our guests, increasing quality and reducing prices:

Deploy associates appropriately as planned on the Schedule and Line up sheets

Ensure appropriate staffing levels of well-trained associates on assigned shifts

Complete shift and daily inventory and accurately post into the back office POSSystem

Check in food delivery, ensure proper storage and post-delivery into the POS.

Complete food order based on commissary order guide and enter into ordering system

Maintain strict adherence to cash handling and banking policies and procedures

Complete shift tools and administration duties as assigned by General Manager



2. SCOPE: Impact this job has in terms of decisions made, direction given, number of employees supervised, size of organization managed or supported, impact of errors, dollars, etc.

• Enforce procedures, training and other programs designed by Steak ‘n Shake to effectively deliver the Steak ‘n Shake Vision, Mission and Principles

• Interviews and recommends Associates candidates to GM within compliance of FLSA and Steak ‘n Shake guidelines

• Takes responsibility for shift financial results

• Serves as a resource to colleagues and as a mentor to less experienced Managers

• Actively manages the shift ensuring speed and food quality

3. KEY RELATIONSHIPS: Position’s key contacts and relationships.

Primary:

• Restaurant Associates • Restaurant Trainers • Restaurant Management

Secondary:

• Division President

• Field Training Manager • Human Resource Manager

Manager 12.1.2021

• High School graduate or equivalent education preferred

• Certified in all Stations at Steak ‘n Shake or equivalent experience

• ServSafe certified (based on local regulations)

• Understand Steak ‘n Shake policies, procedures, state laws, Health codes, Safe food handling and Sanitation procedures

• Positive, motivating communication skills • Strong organization and time management skills

• Strong coaching and mentoring skills • Flexible and adaptable to changing circumstances

• Ability to read, write, perform mathematical calculations and analyze data

• Demonstrate key principles: Golden Rule, Relentless pursuit of Excellence, Exceeding guest expectations, Economic objective, Entrepreneurial approach

• Able to work in excess of 40 hours per week while standing, walking and stretching • Able to lift, carry, push and pull 30 lbs • Able to perform any task performed by a service or production associate

• Able to see across the restaurant to monitor and oversee the operation

• Able to legally operate a motor vehicle • Able to hear, understand and professionally respond to guest and employee inquiries, comments and concerns

5. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS: Key indicators to be used to measure job performance. • Field Results Report

• Key Metrics

• Effective working relationship with Above Store Leaders, Restaurant Management, colleagues and direct reports

6. CAREER PATH: Logical positions along the career path, vertical and/or lateral.

• Restaurant Manager

• General Manager

• Franchise Partner

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Location: This is a remote role, offering the flexibility to work virtually from anywhere within Poland.

Contract Type: full-time (contract of employment)

The Opportunity

As a Lead Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and advancing RS’s Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), built on Snowflake. Combining technical expertise, people leadership, and delivery ownership, you will lead the design, development, and operation of scalable, reliable, and high-performing data products and pipelines that power data-driven decision-making across our global organisation.

This is an exciting opportunity to translate data architecture strategy into impactful solutions, ensuring trusted, timely, and accessible data is available to support analytics, innovation, and business growth. Working at the heart of our Group Data function within IS&T, you will lead and mentor a team of Data Engineers, champion engineering best practices, and drive the delivery of high-quality data solutions aligned with enterprise priorities.

With visibility across the entire business, you will collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, helping to unlock the value of data and accelerate RS’s transformation into a truly data-driven organisation.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable data pipelines and products on the Enterprise Data Platform.
  • Define and champion engineering standards, best practices, and modern data engineering methodologies.
  • Collaborate with architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Ensure data platforms and pipelines are reliable, secure, performant, and cost-effective.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through solution design, coding, and peer reviews.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for complex data engineering and platform challenges.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Data Engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Drive automation, AI-enabled engineering practices, and operational efficiencies across the data ecosystem.
  • Support the transition of innovative data use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.
  • Contribute to major data platform transformation and migration initiatives across the organisation.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience in a Senior or Lead Data Engineering role, delivering scalable data solutions in production environments.
  • Strong expertise in Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Hands-on experience with modern data engineering tools such as dbt, Dagster, Airbyte, or equivalent.
  • Solid understanding of ELT/ETL, data modelling, SQL, and pipeline orchestration.
  • Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, and performance optimisation practices.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and support Data Engineers while providing hands-on technical leadership.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • A collaborative, delivery-focused mindset with a passion for high-quality data solutions.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA, AI-enabled engineering, or global enterprise-scale data environments would be advantageous.

We Are RS

At RS, we are making amazing happen for a better world.

As a global product and service solutions provider, we help industrial customers operate more efficiently and sustainably. Operating in 33 markets, we support around one million customers worldwide with more than 875,000 stocked products, access to over five million additional products, and a range of service solutions designed to help businesses thrive.

What sets us apart is our people. More than 8,500 colleagues around the world bring technical expertise, digital innovation, and a customer first mindset to everything we do. Guided by our values – We are one team, We deliver brilliantly, We do the right thing, and We make every day better, we're creating an environment where our people can grow, contribute and make a meaningful impact.

Join us and help make amazing happen.

Rewards

Our Reward Strategy Philosophy is designed to offer market competitive base salaries and provide all of our people the opportunity to participate in a short-term incentive, enabling them to share in the success of the Company.

Our total reward package is more than just the cash; our recognition and benefit offering provide the opportunity for us to recognise, reward and enable the wellbeing of our people at all stages of their journey with RS. Our rewards and benefits vary by country, but in Poland include:

  • Financial – pension scheme, annual bonus
  • Wellbeing – private medical care (Allianz), subsidy for Multisport card, holiday allowance
  • Lifestyle – lunch card, subsidy for learning English language, employee referral scheme
  • Spotlight – our global recognition programme provides a platform to highlight and recognise people role modelling our values

Ready to Make Amazing Happen?

Join over 8,500 colleagues and help us shape the future of our industry. Whoever you are, wherever you are – it all starts here.

Apply now and make RS a part of your journey.

title: Satellite Operations Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Satellite Controller to join our Flight Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for the safe and efficient operations of spacecraft, supporting all mission phases from satellite development to launch and then through routine operations and anomaly resolution.

This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge satellite missions within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and execute spacecraft operations by performing Flight Operations Procedures (FOPs) from the mission control center

  • Support the development, coding, validation, and maintenance of operational procedures

  • Participate in pre-launch activities, including:

    • System Validation Tests (SVTs) with spacecraft or simulators

    • Ground segment validation campaigns

  • Monitor spacecraft health and status, ensuring compliance with mission constraints

  • Identify, investigate, and escalate spacecraft anomalies in accordance with established protocols

  • Execute contingency and recovery procedures following anomaly resolution approval

  • Support mission readiness activities, including simulations and training campaigns

  • Maintain accurate operational logs and contribute to post-operations reporting

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a control centre environment (space or comparable high-reliability industry), or in aerospace testing (hardware and/or software)

  • Sound technical background in at least one of the following disciplines:

    • Avionics

    • Electrical Engineering

    • Electronics

    • Thermal Engineering

    • Software Engineering

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a structured approach to problem-solving

  • Ability to operate effectively under pressure in time-critical situations

  • Excellent command of English (written and spoken)

  • Willingness to work in shift patterns in a control center located in Warsaw, including critical mission phases such as LEOP (Launch and Early Orbit Phase)

  • Commitment to training and certification for flight operations

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in satellite operations or mission control environments

  • Knowledge of Python or other scripting languages used in operations automation

  • Experience of writing procedures for control or tests of a system

  • Familiarity with space operations standards and procedures (e.g. ECSS)

Personal Attributes

  • Strong attention to detail and operational discipline

  • Team-oriented with effective communication skills

  • Proactive and resilient mindset

  • High level of responsibility and commitment to mission success

title: Head of Account Management
description:
We’re Rydoo, an AI-driven B2B SaaS company that simplifies how businesses manage spend, from employee expenses to supplier invoices.

Our two business lines—expense management and accounts payable—help finance teams work more efficiently and stay in control of company spending. Our expense management platform makes submitting, approving, and reimbursing expenses easy, while our accounts payable solution uses AI to automate invoice processing and approval workflows.

Behind our products is an international team of more than 250 colleagues. Join us to solve practical challenges, take ownership of your work, and help develop technology that finance teams rely on every day.

Rydoo in a snapshot

  • Ambitious international team
  • 40+ nationalities speaking over 15 languages
  • 250+ employees across multiple countries
  • Easy-to-use spend management app available on iPhone and Android
  • Supporting over 10,000+ clients and 1 million+ users worldwide
  • 4.5 employer score on Glassdoor
  • Hybrid work policy

The Role

As the Head of Account Management, you will lead Rydoo's team of Account Managers and own revenue growth within our existing customer base across both products: Expense and Accounts Payable. Your team’s mission is to expand our enterprise customers and turn single-product customers into multi-product customers.

You will build a structured, repeatable expansion motion: identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities, equipping Account Managers to position both products credibly, and running a disciplined pipeline and forecast.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Build, lead, coach and develop a talented international team of Account Managers with clear performance standards.
  • Recruit, retain, mentor and grow top talent.
  • Train and coach the team on:
    • Sales methodology and execution
    • Forecasting
    • Product knowledge across Expense and AP
    • Competitive positioning
    • Account planning and territory management

Upsell and Cross-sell

  • Own the upsell and cross-sell targets for the Account Management team and contribute directly to the company's Expansion ARR targets.
  • Design and run a systematic expansion motion between Expense and Accounts Payable: target account selection, role plays, messaging and enablement.
  • Identify whitespace across the customer base and build account plans that grow adoption, users, entities and regions.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Marketing and Product on campaigns, customer-facing content and packaging of the two products.

Enterprise Accounts

  • Lead the growth strategy for our largest enterprise accounts, including multi-entity and multi-country customers.
  • Build executive relationships with key customer stakeholders (CFOs, Finance Directors, Procurement) and sponsor complex expansion deals.
  • Own renewal negotiations for expansion-driven accounts, in line with pricing and negotiation frameworks set with the VP Customer Growth.

Pipeline, Forecasting and Process

  • Lead the team in building and managing a robust expansion pipeline: identifying, qualifying and advancing opportunities.
  • Deliver regular, data-driven forecasts to leadership using Salesforce dashboards and reporting.
  • Continuously improve the Account Management process, tooling and handovers with RevOps.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success to align on account health, risk and expansion signals.
  • Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance and RevOps on go-to-market alignment.
  • Bring customer feedback into product decisions.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in SaaS enterprise sales or account management.
  • 2+ years managing a sales team of at least 5 people.
  • Proven track record of driving expansion revenue, including cross-selling a multi-product portfolio.
  • Hands-on experience closing complex enterprise deals.
  • Experience managing international markets; Benelux, DACH or UK is a strong plus.
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of structured sales processes (MEDDIC or similar) and Salesforce.
  • Analytical, hands-on and collaborative, with the ability to translate data into action.
  • Excellent executive communication and negotiation skills.
  • Comfortable operating and adapting in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.

Practicalities

  • Reports to the VP Customer Growth
  • Leads the Account Management team of 5 Account Managers based across our offices in Antwerp, Lisbon and Oslo, selling both Expense and Accounts Payable solutions.
  • Part of the Customer Growth team, working closely with Customer Success, Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, Sales and Marketing.
  • Location: Antwerp, Belgium (hybrid model)
  • Start date: January 2027

Benefits

Next to our amazing team, informal & international company culture and our mission to become the #1 spend management tool, we offer some nice benefits that make working at Rydoo even more fun:

  • A competitive package, including salary and benefits
  • Upskilling through training and coaching programs
  • Hybrid Work Policy
  • Professional freedom and a flexible work environment
  • Regular company and team events
  • Wonderful international team with more than 30 + different nationalities
