title: Director, Hyderabad Office - Verr Financial
description:
Build the operational heart of an AI-native finance firm.

We're looking for a high caliber finance and accounting operator who wants to build and run our Hyderabad hub — not manage a back office — and set the standard for how modern finance gets delivered to U.S. consumer founders.

Who we are - Linkedin | Website

Verr Financial is a seven-figure accounting, finance and CFO firm serving founders building ambitious e-commerce, CPG and consumer software/AI brands. We bootstrapped to $1M in annual revenue by being faster, sharper and clearer than firms many times our size.

We’ve partnered with the founders of companies including Magic Mind, Halfday, WOLACO, Dr. Woof and more. We have helped founders strengthen cash visibility, build decision-ready financial models, and raise capital.

We are deliberately lean and high-horsepower. Our founder, Reva Reddy, is Wharton and ex-McKinsey, previously co-founded a fintech with an eight-figure exit and later led a venture-backed company through 10x growth. Our Director of Finance in Los Angeles came from investment banking.

Everyone here punches above their weight, and everyone owns their work.

*"*It's remarkable how much value can be created by a small group of really talented people.” —David Wargo, Putnam Investments

Why founders hire us

Consumer founders are exceptional at product, brand and growth. What many lack is financial discipline: the rigor to manage cash, read the numbers honestly and put capital where it actually compounds. The gap between a sharp decision and an expensive one often comes down to whether someone brought that discipline in time.

That's what we do. We give founders clean books, an actionable financial model and the clarity to turn both into real capital-allocation decisions. The work you'll own is not paperwork; it is the instrument panel a founder runs the business on.

Why this role exists

Most firms treat India as a back office: a place to push low-cost work. We reject that entirely.

Hyderabad is one of our two hubs; the other is Los Angeles. It is where our core deliverables are produced, our processes are invented and refined, and over time where accounting/finance and technical talent will work together as the line between financial workflows and AI systems blurs.

We need a long-term partner to help build and run it.

What you'll own

This is a builder-operator role: part hands-on execution, part building the team and systems that execute. No one at Verr manages from a distance. Early on, you'll be close to the work; over time, you'll build the machine that runs it.

• Operational finance. Own the quality of cash operations — including A/P, A/R and commissions — as well as weekly flash financials reporting and most importantly, the monthly close. These are the foundations that stand up all of our CFO and advisory work.

• The team. Build and lead the Hyderabad team, beginning with three people and hiring as the hub scales. You'll recruit, develop talent and set the bar — not simply supervise.

• The systems. Turn heroics into repeatable process. Design workflows, controls and review mechanisms that allow the team to move quickly without sacrificing accuracy.

• Verr OS: the agentic layer. Help redesign how the work gets done: identifying what should be automated, where human judgment must remain and how the two reinforce each other. You do not need to write code, but you need sharp instincts for where AI creates leverage.

• The hub. Help shape the culture, operating rhythm and long-term mandate of Hyderabad, with room to expand into technical and engineering talent as Verr grows.

Our CFO and advisory layer sits primarily with the Los Angeles office, alongside an exceptional IC in the Philippines. Your work is the bedrock that makes that advisory work credible.

How we measure ourselves

1. Speed: we move faster than anyone expects with the goal of zero-day close.

2. Accuracy: finance cannot make an error. The numbers are right, substantiated and polished, every time. AI can create enormous leverage, but accountability for the financial output remains human.

3. Clarity: we do not merely close the books; we make the numbers mean something.

How we work

We are async-first. Los Angeles and Hyderabad operate as our hubs. Our founder visits India at least twice a year; the rest runs on trust, clear systems and ownership.

This role will be based in Hyderabad, where we expect to establish a physical office, likely in HITEC City. We currently envision a hybrid arrangement of approximately two to three days per week in person, but the right leader will help us shape how the office works.

Because we operate as one team across Hyderabad and Los Angeles, regular overlap with U.S. working hours is required. We will design the schedule thoughtfully; this is not intended to mean living permanently on a U.S. clock.

If you need someone looking over your shoulder to do great work, this is not the seat. If you want the autonomy to build something and be judged on outcomes, it is.

Requirements

Who you are

We care far more about judgment, ownership and systems thinking than any single résumé archetype. This is a senior seat, and we are not looking for someone learning how to lead for the first time.

The gold-standard profile is a technically exceptional finance professional who has also proven they can operate: someone with deep accounting and finance fundamentals, real ownership experience and the judgment to build a team and delivery engine around them.

You might come from:

• A finance or accounting leadership role at a high-growth startup or technology company such as Ramp, Rippling, Stripe, Mercury, Brex, Deel, Amazon or a similar environment — especially if you have helped build the function, not merely participated in it.

• A startup CFO or senior finance leader who has experienced meaningful company-building, including through an exit or other major scaling event.

• Investment banking, strategic finance or another rigorous finance environment, followed by enough operating experience to understand how the numbers actually get produced.

• A strong accounting or professional services firm, particularly if you are a Chartered Accountant with an exceptional academic record or CA rank, and have moved beyond advisory into genuine operating ownership.

Regardless of your path:

• You have exceptional finance and accounting fundamentals. You can get into the numbers yourself, understand how the general ledger and close actually work, and know what excellent output looks like.

• You have been an operator, not merely an advisor. You are comfortable owning outcomes when there is no one else to hand the problem to.

• You communicate exceptionally well. You can speak and write with U.S. founders and executives naturally, credibly and directly — translating technical finance into clear business judgment.

• You are a builder, not a manager who delegates from above. You have led people and operations and are energized by creating the team, standards and systems around you.

• You think in systems and are energized — not threatened — by AI-enabled workflows.

• You want to build and own something over the long term, not clock in.

Benefits

Compensation and long-term upside

Compensation will be top of market for the right candidate, with a meaningful discretionary annual bonus and substantial upside as the role and firm scale. We also expect meaningful compensation growth in year two, aligned with performance.

For an exceptional long-term leader, there is potential for meaningful profit participation and/or equity participation over time. We want the person who helps build this institution to participate in the value they create, rather than treat this as a conventional salaried role.

This is a founding seat. You'll shape a hub that is central to where Verr is going, gain unusual exposure to ambitious U.S. founders, and have room to expand the mandate as the firm grows.

You may not be actively looking for your next role. That's okay. We suspect the right person is already doing meaningful work somewhere else. If this mission resonates, we'd still love to start a conversation.

title: Technical Systems Support Engineer
description:
Role: Technical Systems Support Engineer

Location: Hybrid - Liverpool, Merseyside (3 days a week on site, 2 days remote following probation)

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent (37.5 hours)

Salary: Competitive, based on experience + benefits + package

Security Clearance Requirements

Please note that holding a current Security Clearance is not essential at the time of application, but eligibility is required.


This role requires the successful candidate to be eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. To meet this requirement, applicants must:

  • Have the right to work in the UK
  • Have lived in the UK continuously for the past 5 years
  • Not have spent more than 6 months outside the UK in total during that period
  • Be willing to undergo security vetting as part of the onboarding process

About Us

Come and be a part of The Investigo Group (TIG), a dynamic coalition of cutting-edge tech firms specialising in Platform, Software, Data, AI and other bleeding-edge technology solutions. Our innovative prowess spans the globe while proudly hailing from the United Kingdom.

The group is multi-functional with a large portfolio of B2B products and services.

Our ecosystem is made up of:

Voixtel, secure communications and voice platforms for regulated and critical environments.

IIS, Providing secure internet access in both the public and private sectors. Its mission? To deliver world-class secure internet capabilities enhancing productivity across diverse skillsets and organisations.

Vestigo Consulting is our training and consultancy company, tailored around specialist sector-specific knowledge, and provides regular courses and CPD for our community. The Consultancy side concentrates on expert support of our customers as well as specifically assigned individual deployments.

Collaboraite is a bleeding-edge company that provides our Data and AI capability. A collaborative partner for designing user-centred secure data solutions to overcome operational hurdles, delivered through design thinking and agile coaching.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) are at the heart of The Investigo Group (TIG). We're dedicated to creating a workplace where people from all backgrounds are not only welcome but empowered to excel. We actively seek diverse talent, promote fairness, and foster an inclusive environment where every voice matters, driving innovation and progress in our dynamic tech community.

The group provides bespoke, secure, user-centric products fuelled by deep technical knowledge advanced data and analytical skills.

We proudly stand as a global leader in this space, partnering with esteemed entities that require these advanced forward-thinking capabilities. These partnerships have been forged from our understanding of customer challenges, as well as our expertise in developing world-leading enterprise product sets.

Join us at TIG, where innovation knows no bounds, and together, we'll shape the future of technology solutions for a safer, more efficient world.

About the Role

Are you an experienced IT support professional who enjoys getting to the root cause of technical issues rather than simply logging and escalating them?

We're looking for a Technical Systems Support Engineer to join our Service Operations team, supporting a highly specialised and technically diverse environment.

This isn't your typical Service Desk position. Whilst you'll be a primary point of contact for incidents and service requests, the role goes beyond traditional first-line support, combining customer-facing responsibilities with more advanced technical troubleshooting, investigation and problem-solving.

You'll work across specialist applications, cloud services, identity platforms, infrastructure technologies and integrated business systems, taking ownership of technical issues and investigating how different systems interact.

Working alongside experienced technical specialists and platform engineers, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of technologies while building the knowledge and skills required to progress into more advanced technical roles.

We don't expect you to arrive knowing every specialist platform or system we use. What matters is having a solid technical foundation, a logical approach to troubleshooting and the curiosity to investigate and understand how things work.

If you're passionate about technology, enjoy solving complex problems and want a role that offers significantly more technical depth than a traditional Service Desk position, we'd love to hear from you.

About the team

You'll join our Service Operations team, working alongside experienced technical specialists and platform engineers in a highly specialised, business-critical technology environment.

The team supports a broad range of interconnected applications, platforms and services, providing technical support whilst investigating and resolving issues across different technologies.

You'll have the opportunity to develop knowledge of our specialist systems, collaborate with colleagues across technical disciplines and build your capability in a role that bridges traditional IT support and technical engineering.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Acting as a primary point of contact for technical incidents and service requests.
  • Investigating and troubleshooting technical issues across applications, endpoints, identity services, networks and supporting infrastructure.
  • Taking ownership of incidents, using structured diagnostic techniques to identify and resolve underlying issues.
  • Analysing logs, system events, monitoring tools and other diagnostic information to investigate technical problems.
  • Supporting Microsoft 365, Entra ID and on-premise Active Directory environments.
  • Investigating authentication, access management, permissions and connectivity issues.
  • Supporting enterprise applications, business-critical systems and their associated integrations and dependencies.
  • Troubleshooting issues involving cloud services, hosted platforms, infrastructure and endpoint environments.
  • Working with technical specialists and platform engineers to investigate more complex incidents.
  • Managing and prioritising incidents and service requests in line with service levels and operational requirements.
  • Communicating effectively with users and stakeholders, providing clear updates throughout the support process.
  • Developing technical knowledge of our specialist platforms, applications and supporting infrastructure.
  • Participating in a paid out-of-hours on-call support rota, approximately one week in five, after successful completion of probation.

What We Are Looking For

More than anything, we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys technology and solving technical problems.

You'll be comfortable investigating an issue that doesn't have an obvious answer, working through potential causes, using available tools and information, and taking ownership of the problem as far as reasonably possible before escalating.

We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate hands-on technical experience rather than simply familiarity with technologies listed on a CV.

You'll have a strong foundation in IT support, with experience across Microsoft environments and an understanding of how applications, identity services, networks and infrastructure interact.

You won't necessarily have worked with every technology in our environment. We're looking for technical curiosity, a methodical approach to problem-solving and the ability to learn and develop expertise in specialist systems.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is about more than managing tickets or passing incidents between teams.

You'll demonstrate the confidence and technical ability to investigate issues independently, understand how different technologies and services interact and take ownership of problems through to resolution or appropriate escalation.

You'll deliver a positive support experience for our customers whilst developing a deeper understanding of our specialist technology environment.

Over time, you'll become increasingly confident across our applications, platforms and infrastructure, building technical expertise and contributing to the wider effectiveness of the Service Operations team.

Requirements

Skills & Experience We Are Looking For

You don’t need to tick every box. We’re looking for candidates with good experience across some of the areas below, alongside the enthusiasm and ability to learn and develop.

Minimum two years' experience in an IT support, technical support or service operations role.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Strong troubleshooting, diagnostic and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Experience investigating technical issues across multiple technology areas.
  • Experience analysing logs, system events and diagnostic information.
  • Confidence supporting both end users and business-critical services.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple incidents and service requests.
  • A proactive, ownership-driven approach to investigating and resolving issues.

Applications, Platforms & Systems

  • Experience supporting enterprise applications and business-critical systems.
  • Understanding of application configuration, integrations and service dependencies.
  • Hands-on experience supporting Microsoft 365, Entra ID and on-premise Active Directory.
  • Familiarity with identity, authentication and access management technologies.
  • Understanding of how applications, infrastructure and networks interact.
  • Experience supporting Windows desktop environments.

Infrastructure & Networking

  • Exposure to enterprise server and infrastructure environments.
  • Understanding of virtualisation technologies and hosted platforms.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, alerting and system health tools.
  • Awareness of backup, recovery and service resilience principles.
  • Understanding of endpoint, operating system and device management concepts.
  • Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and VPN technologies.
  • Ability to investigate connectivity, performance and service access issues.
  • Understanding of core networking, security and infrastructure principles.

Service Management & Communication

  • Experience working within SLA-driven support environments.
  • Understanding of incident, request and major incident management processes.
  • Familiarity with ITSM platforms and service management best practices.
  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage your own tickets and prioritise workload.
  • Ability to work independently whilst collaborating effectively with wider technical teams.
  • A genuine passion for technology, technical problem-solving and continuous learning.

Nice to Have

Experience or exposure to some of the following would be beneficial:

  • VMware, Hyper-V or other virtualisation technologies.
  • Windows Server or Linux administration, or support of Linux desktop environments.
  • PowerShell, scripting or automation.
  • Infrastructure monitoring and event management tools.
  • SQL, PostgreSQL and database fundamentals.
  • Endpoint security technologies.
  • Identity and access management platforms.
  • Application deployment and release management.
  • Experience supporting secure, regulated or highly available environments.
  • ITIL Foundation certification.

Benefits

    • Private Medical & Health Cash Plan
    • 4x Life Assurance
    • Inclusive Culture: Enjoy an inclusive culture and environment.
    • Holiday: Generous holiday allowance.
    • Learning: Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
    • Bonus Potential: Bonus potential based on performance and business-related factors.
    • Pension: Pension scheme contributions.
    • EV Car Scheme
    • Hybrid Working Policy
    • More Benefits: Explore additional benefits on our career site.

How to Apply

Please note that the talent acquisition team is managing this vacancy directly and we do not require agency support.

Candidates who are successful will be required to undergo relevant security checks.

Our Process

As an inclusive employer, please inform us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Equal Opportunities

Here at TIG we are committed to equal opportunities and value diversity, equity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: HR Graduate
description:
Annan House

Staff

COMPANY OVERVIEW

EnQuest is an independent oil and gas company, recognised for its expertise in maximising the value of mature and underinvested hydrocarbon assets. The Group is focused on sustainably extending field life and unlocking value across the asset lifecycle. EnQuest’s operations are centred in the UK and Southeast Asia, with transformational growth across both regions representing a core strategic priority. As a key player supporting a pragmatic and responsible energy transition in the UK, EnQuest is advancing the transformation of the Sullom Voe Terminal on Shetland into a major decarbonisation and renewable energy hub.

Fundamental to EnQuest’s success to date is our greatest asset, our people. Their talent, expertise, knowledge, and commitment have delivered remarkable results, and we continue to look for the same attributes in prospective employees as we pursue plans for further development across our global operations.

At EnQuest, we support a diverse and inclusive workplace and continually look to improve and develop our culture. We are respectful and open with others, valuing the diversity of all our people and listening to the views they bring. Our focus on diversity and inclusion makes our performance stronger and enhances our business.

The successful candidate will become part of a progressive, innovative and ambitious organisation that holds a distinct set of values based on respect for the individual. As well as having the opportunity to pursue your goals and achieve your ambitions, you will be encouraged to contribute fresh ideas and take on new challenges that test your abilities and elevate your performance to new levels.

This is a permanent role, with the graduate training programme lasting two years.

THE ROLE

The HR Graduate is a key role within EnQuest's Human Resources team, supporting a wide range of HR activities that contribute to attracting, developing, engaging, and retaining our people.

This exciting opportunity will provide exposure across multiple HR disciplines, including operations, talent management, learning and development, recruitment, employee relations, organisational development, reward, employee engagement, and HR data/systems. Working alongside experienced HR professionals, you will gain valuable insight into how a people function supports a dynamic international energy business.

The role is based in Aberdeen and will involve collaborating with employees and stakeholders across our UK operations, providing an excellent foundation for a long-term career in HR.

The successful candidate will be given the opportunity to contribute to key people initiatives and projects, helping to support business performance while developing the skills, knowledge, and experience required to become a HR professional.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER

  • During the two-year graduate programme, we will provide structured on-the-job training and opportunities to develop practical HR knowledge and broader business understanding across the organisation.
  • Throughout the programme, group learning and personal coaching will be provided to help develop competence, confidence, and personal effectiveness. The programme includes a structured series of modules aligned to the EnQuest Values and incorporates interactive learning events, behavioural development training, and 1:1 coaching.
  • A strong mentoring culture, with each graduate assigned a mentor to support their personal and professional development.
  • Exposure to a broad range of HR activities and projects that will help build a well-rounded understanding of the employee lifecycle.
  • Based in our Aberdeen office, with opportunities to visit operational sites and engage with employees across the business.
  • Competitive benefits package including 33 days holiday, private medical insurance, company pension, and life assurance.
  • Flexible working culture, including hybrid working arrangements.
  • Support towards professional development and progression within the HR profession.

We are looking for high-achieving graduates with a desire to learn. The ideal candidate should enjoy problem solving, detailed analysis, willing to innovate and embrace new ideas and take on projects where the approach or solution isn’t known from the outset.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We are looking for talented individuals who are passionate about developing a career in Human Resources and making a positive impact through people.

We are making a significant investment in our future talent and are looking for individuals who demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a genuine interest in people, organisational culture, and employee development.
  • Enjoy building relationships and working collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Possess strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with confidential information.
  • Demonstrate strong organisational and planning skills.
  • Show initiative and be comfortable taking ownership of tasks and projects.
  • Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Display a growth mindset and a desire for continuous learning and development.
  • Demonstrate agility and adaptability, embracing change and thriving in a fast-paced environment where priorities, challenges, and opportunities can shift quickly.

GRADUATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree (2:1 or above) or a Master's degree in Human Resource Management, Business Management, Psychology, Social Sciences or another relevant discipline.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building capabilities.
  • High levels of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Ability to work effectively, both independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility, adaptability, and a positive attitude towards learning and development.
  • A strong commitment to developing a long-term career within Human Resources.

Working towards or having an interest in pursuing CIPD qualifications would be advantageous but is not essential. EnQuest will support the successful candidate in pursuing this further.

ELIGIBILITY

Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.

OUR APPLICATION PROCESS

Interviews and assessments are designed to measure your skills for success, while also providing you with an understanding of the graduate programme, our company, and the role itself. You will have plenty of opportunity to ask questions throughout the process.

Application Stages

  • Online application via our Careers Portal - Careers (myworkdayjobs.com)
  • Online Interview with HR Stakeholders (February – March 2027)
  • Group Assessment Centre Day (Mid-April 2027)

WHY JOIN ENQUEST?

At EnQuest, you'll have the opportunity to build your career in a business that values its people, encourages innovation, and supports professional growth. As a HR Graduate, you'll play an important role in helping to shape the employee experience while developing the skills and experience needed for a successful career in HR.

Join us and be part of our journey as we support the energy transition and develop the talent that will drive our future success!

CLOSING DATE FOR APPLICATIONS: 31 DECEMBER 2026

description:

title: Director of Training (Client & Site Operations)
description:
The Director of Training (Client & Site Operations) is responsible for the vision, strategic architecture, and operational governance of site-level and customer-facing training programs across EverOn Data Center Services. This leader serves as the ultimate authority for site training compliance, client training engagement, and operational talent readiness.

The primary focus of this role is to ensure 100% compliance with facility operations standards, accelerate speed-to-competency for new hires, and provide robust visibility to clients through structured financial reporting and specialized training solutions. This role acts as a bridge between high-level client expectations, commercial pursuits, and ground-level technical mastery across the data center portfolio.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Qualification Systems: Oversee and enforce the execution of technical site qualification programs, including site-specific qualification cards and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Compliance Enforcement: Establish rigorous auditing and enforcement mechanisms to ensure all critical facility technicians and site leadership maintain up-to-date mandatory qualifications.
  • Manager Compliance: Track, audit, and enforce compliance for all new critical facility managers, ensuring they successfully complete site leadership and technical orientation matrices.
  • Onboarding Frameworks: Design, implement, and optimize standardized technician onboarding pathways to accelerate site integration and operational readiness.
  • Client Portfolio Oversight: Oversee all external and customer-focused training programs, ensuring educational delivery aligns with contractual client agreements.
  • Financial Reporting: Own and manage financial reporting tied to client training accounts, including budget trackability, billable training allocations, and resource utilization.
  • Consultation Services: Pursue and manage technical training consultation opportunities and revenue-generating training projects for external customers.
  • RFP Strategy Coordination: Partner with Sales, Operations, and Executive leadership to coordinate and author winning training strategies for Request for Proposals (RFPs).
  • Capability Articulation: Clearly define and communicate EverON’s technical training advantages, qualification frameworks, and safety culture to prospective clients during the bidding process.
  • Portfolio Standardization: Identify and define strategic training objectives throughout the operations portfolio; design, plan, and implement programs, policies, and procedures to fulfill those needs.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Lead meetings with executive management, site training representatives, and corporate training teams to drive portfolio cohesion and operational alignment.
  • Technical Industry Standards: Stay updated on legal requirements, data center operational developments, and best practices in mission-critical technical training.
  • Site Evaluation: Conduct routine site visits to facilitate in-person operational assessments, audit qualification records, and develop strong working relationships with site-level teams.
  • LMS Tracking: Direct the utilize of Learning Management Systems (LMS) and tracking tools to maintain accurate participant progress and automated compliance records.
  • Executive Reporting: Provide regular, data-driven reporting to senior leadership and external clients regarding training effectiveness, qualification metrics, and operational readiness.

title: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Officer
description:
About Trócaire

Trócaire is an International NGO. We work with local partners in the world’s most at-risk communities and with people in Ireland to tackle the underlying causes of poverty and injustice and respond to the crises they create. Together we bring about positive and lasting change for a just world. Trócaire works in up to 20 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Middle East. We work towards five goals:

• Defend Human Rights and Promote Access to Justice.

• Achieve Climate & Environmental Justice.

• Ensure Women & Girls’ Protection, Voice & Influence.

• Save Lives and Protect Human Dignity and

• Mobilise the Public on the island of Ireland to achieve Global Justice.

About Trócaire Somalia

Trócaire Somalia has worked in Somalia since the early 1990s, with a strong presence in Gedo and operations across five districts, as well as in Kismayo. The programme combines direct implementation with local partnerships to save lives, reduce suffering, and protect human dignity in times of crisis. Using a humanitarian–development–peace nexus approach, the programme integrates Health, Nutrition, Protection, WASH, Resilience, and Education in Emergencies. These sectors work together to deliver multi donor funded coordinated, life-saving services while strengthening recovery and long-term stability for vulnerable communities.

Trócaire Somalia’s seeks to recruit a dedicated Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Officer to support the organization’s MEAL and research functions and other duties as assigned. The MEAL Officer will be responsible for supporting baseline surveys, formative and operational researches, community feedback and accountability mechanisms and development of programme reports. S/he will ensure that these tasks are functional and well grounded, strengthening coordination and collaboration with all programme team and partner staff, while ensuring that MEAL is visible within projects.

For the candidate with the required experience and passion for the role, Trócaire offers a competitive package of salary and benefits.

The role is a local position based in Gedo, Somalia. Somali nationals are highly encouraged to apply.

Reporting to MEAL Coordinator this is a fixed term contract for one year and is based in Gedo, Somalia.

Key responsibilities

Under the direction of the MEAL Coordinator, ensure that the projects have solid MEAL plans, Indicator Performance Tracking Tables, and log frames

• Support project leads (Programme Coordinators) in updating the indicator tracking tables and provide necessary MEAL guidance regarding project performance.

• Support online reporting of the health programme on DHIS2 (MoH report), Reporting Hub (cluster report) and other approved reporting systems.

• Operationalise MEAL community accountability mechanisms and forums where community are holding Trocaire to account on programme implementation as guided by the MEAL Coordinator

• Support the development of tools and guidelines for data collection, collation and reporting to facilitate timely and accurate collection of indicator data and tracking of beneficiary reach.

• Support program staff on project related M&E related tools for data collection; Output trackers (OT) and Indicator Performance Tracking Table (IPTT) etc.

• Conduct field visits to monitor program activities / interventions against Quality Benchmarks/ Quality Checklists through qualitative and quantitative methods, and thereafter produce and share reports with MEAL Coordinator and the program team

• Support program staff to strengthen joint planning and monitoring with partners

• Work with the MEAL Coordinator in conducting data quality assessments to ensure that collected data is validated, is accurate and consistent while providing feedback as necessary to program teams

• Provide support for all needs assessments, operational research, and evaluations.

• With direction from the MEAL Coordinator supervise external consultants while they are in the field for data collection

• Assist MEAL Coordinator/ Program Coordinator in preparing and conducting evaluations, project reviews and routine assessments such as Baseline Studies, Post Distribution Monitoring, Client Satisfaction Surveys and Community Based Nutrition Surveillance (CBNS)

• With support from programs teams and the MEAL Coordinator, develop quality case studies that will enhance reporting the external stakeholders.

• Work with MEAL Coordinator to produce MEAL monthly and annual reports

• Support the updating of data on Salesforce

· Under the direction and guidance of a MEAL coordinator to provide support on strengthening organizational MEAL systems through programme identification, design, programme monitoring & reporting, requisite database & data Management, and supporting learning & adaptive programme.

· With support and guidance from MEAL Coordinator set up grants & related projects systems and tools by developing logframes, result frameworks, MEAL plans and indicator protocols for active grants and related projects.

· Support database and data management by ensuring tools are in place for routine and periodic data collection and related data processing; cleaning & analysis.

· Support project leads in updating the indicator tracking tables and provide necessary MEAL guidance regarding project performance.

· Provide data quality controls and audit through monitoring projects delivery against donor commitments and conducting requisite data quality reviews especially under Health & Nutrition programme.

· Conduct field visits to monitor program activities / interventions against Quality Benchmarks/ Quality Checklists through qualitative and quantitative methods, and producing actionable report programme team.

· Support implementation of accountability and community-based monitoring approaches, and forums where community are holding Trocaire to account on programme implementation as guided by the MEAL Coordinator.

· Assist MEAL Coordinator/ Program Coordinator in preparing and conducting evaluations, project reviews and routine assessments such as Baseline Studies, Post Distribution Monitoring, Client Satisfaction Sur-veys, related case studies and Community Based Nutrition Surveillance (CBNS)

· With support from programs teams and the MEAL Coordinator, develop quality case studies that will en-hance reporting the external stakeholders.

· Support reporting including online platforms related reporting for instance the health programme on DHIS2 (MoH report), and Reporting Hub (cluster report), Trocaire Salesforec and other approved reporting systems while working with MEAL Coordinator to produce MEAL monthly and annual reports. Provide Requisite Support and guidance to programme teams, partners and peers.

Safeguarding Programme Participants-Children & Adults

Trócaire is committed to safeguarding people within our programmes from exploitation and abuse and has specific policies on this commitment (including a Global Code of Conduct) which outlines the expected behaviour and the responsibility of all staff, consultants and other organisational representatives. More information on Trócaire’s Safeguarding policies available here.

Diversity and Inclusion

We welcome diverse applicants to join our inclusive workforce.

Trócaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are an organisation that embraces diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds to bring their experiences and perspectives to Trócaire.

Diversity and Inclusion Statement available here.

Requirements

Experience/ Qualifications

· Reputable University degree or higher qualification in Social Sciences, Statistics, Economics, Development Studies, Information/Data Management or another relevant discipline

· At least 3 years of progressive experience in monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning of development programmes

· Experience working in Somalia or comparable fragile, conflict-affected or access-constrained environments,

· Additional skills/experience in one or more of the following technical areas: health services delivery; health systems strengthening; child health/ nutrition; education, WASH, livelihoodsnd humanitarian projects

· Demonstrated experience of developing communication materials

· Experience in data gathering & management using using digital data-collection platforms such as KoboCollect & proficiency in data analytics and visualization

Qualities

Open to Somali Nationals only

Skills

title: Supervisor (Dark Kitchen)
description:
About the Concept & BVC Hospitality

We are looking for an organized, hands-on Supervisor to lead daily operations at our brand-new Supernova-Crème dark kitchen. In this dynamic role, you will take full ownership of running dual-brand shifts across both kitchen lines.

The Supernova-Crème Deliveroo Edition located in Wandsworth is an exciting, fast-paced dark kitchen operation bringing two of our most popular brands directly to customers at home. Supernova is a bold and energetic smashed burger concept, known for its crave-worthy burgers. Crème is our much-loved dessert concept, famous for giant gooey cookies and premium ingredients.

BVC Hospitality operates a portfolio of innovative, globally recognised food concepts such as NAC, Creme, Supernova, 74 Duke and Le Cafe NAC. Across all our brands, our core values drive us to take proactive ownership of our actions, treat everyone with respect, and collaborate as a unified team. Together, we continuously strive for excellence and embrace growth to deliver exceptional experiences and outstanding results.


Position Summary

The Supervisor plays a key role in the daily operation of our delivery kitchen, acting as a crucial link between management and the team. The Supervisor ensures that delivery shifts run efficiently, standards are upheld, administrative duties are completed smoothly, and customers receive high-quality food on time


Key Responsibilities

  • Dual-Brand Shift Leadership: Direct and motivate the kitchen team during shifts across both brands, ensuring seamless ticket flow and rapid turnaround times.

  • Hands-On Kitchen Execution: Jump in to run and support all stations across both menus during service, including grill, fries (smashing, builds, packing), and Crème cookie shaping and baking.

  • Platform & Hub Management: Actively manage Deliveroo Hub—tracking incoming orders, optimizing prep and dispatch times, updating item availability, and resolving live delivery issues.

  • Opening & Closing: Complete comprehensive opening and closing checklists as part of a pair, ensuring equipment shutdown, site security, and thorough kitchen sanitation.

  • Stock & Ordering: Manage inventory levels across dry store, chilled, and packaging supplies; place regular stock orders and receive deliveries to guarantee zero stock-outs during peak services.

  • Quality & Food Safety Control: Monitor food presentation, temperature, and packaging accuracy before bags are handed over to couriers, maintaining strict compliance with Health & Safety and Food Safety standards.

  • Training Support: Assist in onboarding and training Kitchen Team Members across both burger and bakery operations.

  • Additional Duties: Undertake other responsibilities and similar tasks as requested by management to support the smooth operation of the business.


Key Requirements

  • Experience: Previous experience as a Shift Leader, Team Leader, or Supervisor in a fast-paced kitchen, food service, or dark kitchen environment.
  • Organization: Strong multitasking and time-management skills, with experience managing inventory, stock ordering, and digital platforms.
  • Attitude: Proactive, positive, calm under pressure, and dedicated to upholding high operational standards across a paired team.

Company Benefits

  • Generous Discounts: 50% discount across all BVC Hospitality venues and CODE app membership.

  • Enhanced Holiday Package: One extra day for each year of service (up to 5 days).

  • Enhanced Maternity/Paternity Pay.

  • Long service rewards

  • Birthday gift and referral bonuses.

Ready to lead the shift across two iconic London brands? We’d love to hear from you.

Please note that only candidates with the existing legal right to work in the United Kingdom will be considered for this position. Evidence of eligibility will be required during the recruitment process.

title: Independent Living Skills Coach
description:
Pay: $19/hr +mileage reimbursement for eligible work-related travel + Benefits
Teaching skills. Building confidence. Empowering independence.
Make a meaningful impact by helping adults with disabilities and mental health conditions achieve their goals and increase independence. Independent Living Skills Coaches provide individualized teaching and coaching to help people build practical life skills, connect with community resources, and participate in meaningful areas of interest in their communities. This position offers flexibility, a supportive work environment, and the opportunity to contribute to your community. Plus, you'll enjoy great benefits like generous PTO, medical insurance (for full-time employees), and a focus on your well-being. If you're looking for meaningful & rewarding work where you can see the impact of your efforts every day, we'd love to have you on our team! Apply today and join a team dedicated to helping people thrive in their communities.
Note: We are recruiting for a Independent Living Skills Coach who is comfortable traveling to support individuals in their homes and community within Hennepin County and the surrounding area. Please note that this position will require sporadic visits to our home office in Edina, Minnesota. Applicants must be comfortable with the potential for travel to other areas of the Twin Cities as staffing needs require. Mileage is reimbursed.
Why you’ll love Reach:

  • Meaningful one-on-one work.
  • Opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Inclusive, mission-driven culture.
  • Competitive benefits and mileage reimbursement.
  • Work directly with people with a community-based schedule, not behind a desk.

  • Full benefits package (full time)

Summary of Job Description
The key goal of this position is to promote independence in life skills through teaching, coaching, modeling, encouraging, and support on behalf of Reach for Resources, Inc. It is expected that Independent Living Skills Coaches at Reach will work with each person, the person’s family, and the person’s team to develop, put into practice, and periodically evaluate a Community Living Plan for each person. It is also expected that Independent Living Skills Coach at Reach for Resources will represent the agency in a courteous and professional manner in all phases of the position.
See our work in action here: Reach Community Living: Live, Work, Play

  • Are comfortable working independently while staying connected with their team.
  • Believe in empowering people to build their own skills rather than doing things for them.

  • Are interested in a career in human services, social work, psychology, counseling, disability services, case management, or a related field.
  • Take initiative, solve problems independently, and look for opportunities to improve services.

  • Communicate professionally and respectfully with individuals, families, and team members.

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

  • Environment: The majority of working hours are spent doing direct support and field work meetings. This position has limited in-office and remote work duties. Staff provide support to people with disabilities in their homes and throughout the community.

title: Storekeeper – Construction Materials & Equipment
description:

title: Senior SAP Data Engineer
description:

The Sofidel Group Sofidel, headquartered in Porcari (Lucca), is a global leader in tissue paper production. We are not necessarily looking for an FI/CO Functional Consultant, but rather for a Data Engineer who understands Finance data and can effectively translate the needs of FP&A, Controlling, and Accounting into robust, high‑performing, and reusable data solutions.

The role is office‑based in Porcari, Lucca (Italy).

Qualifications & Experience required:

  • Approximately 5+ years of experience in SAP Data & Analytics / Data Engineering
  • Proven hands‑on experience with SAP Datasphere / SAP Data Warehouse Cloud
  • Experience with at least two SAP Datasphere implementations is preferred
  • Strong technical skills in: SAP Datasphere, S/4HANA Data Model, ABAP CDS Views, Data & Semantic Modeling, Replication and Transformation Flows, Remote Tables & Federation, Advanced SQL / SAP HANA SQLScript, ETL/ELT and Data Pipelines, Data Quality & Reconciliation, Performance Tuning, and Python for data processing and automation
  • Good understanding of Extraction, Delta & CDC and SAP Clean Core principles
  • Very good written and spoken English

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with SAP Business Data Cloud, Data Products, SAP BW/BW4HANA modernization, SAP Analytics Cloud and SAC Planning

Personal Skills:

  • Ability to design simple, robust, and scalable solutions
  • Strong focus on performance and data quality
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across IT and Finance teams

What We Offer

  • A full‑time employment
  • The chance to work in an international Group and a concrete opportunity for professional growth

Our Approach To Compensation

We are committed to offering a fair and transparent compensation approach. This role sits within an annual salary range of €40.000 – €50.000, defined based on internal equity and external market benchmarks. The final offer will be tailored, reflecting the selected candidate’s experience, skills, and overall contribution to the role.

title: Senior Business Program Manager
description:
Overview

With a vision to "Build and sell Microsoft artificial intelligence (AI), Cloud applications, services, and devices with partners, empowering people and organizations to achieve more," Global Channel Partner Sales (GCPS) is responsible for driving revenue outcomes with partners through innovative solutions at scale.

This position is within the Global Partner Investments team in GCPS, which is responsible for leading the design, implementation and governance over a multi-billion-dollar portfolio of investments.

The Senior Business Program Manager will be responsible for leading the go-to-market, landing and readiness of our partner-aligned incentives and investments for the AI Business Solutions and Security commercial solution areas. Working hand-in-hand with the incentive design leads, this individual will translate incentive design into clear, engaging narratives and materials, build and lead partner and field channels and communities, and engage across product marketing, sales, segment and field teams to ensure our investments are understood, adopted and utilized by partners. This role will need to collaborate effectively across teams to turn our incentive strategy into partner action and positively influence the short- and long-term strategy of our market-leading partner ecosystem.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Incentive Program GTM Leadership

  • Owns the go-to-market (GTM), launch and landing of partner-facing incentives and investments for the AI Business Solutions and Security solution areas;

  • Develops and executes integrated GTM plans for each incentive launch and change — defining audiences, messages, channels, deliverables, milestones and success measures — across organizational boundaries, proactively identifying and resolving roadblocks to on-time, high-quality landing;

  • Translates incentive design (eligibility, earning mechanics, payouts, claiming and proof-of-execution requirements) into clear, engaging narratives and materials for partners, field sellers, partner development managers and leadership, such as partner guides, FAQs, pitch decks, readiness training, field advisories and executive briefings;

Partner Channel & Community Leadership

  • Builds and leads partner and field channels and communities for AI Business Solutions and Security incentives (e.g., partner community calls, webinars, online communities, partner advisory forums and major events) to drive awareness, adoption and utilization;

  • Serves as the incentives voice to partners and the field for the solution areas, capturing feedback and escalations and closing the loop with design, operations and support teams;

Cross Functional Joint Planning

  • Establishes and maintains key points of contact with solution area product marketing, partner marketing, sales and field readiness organizations, aligning incentive GTM with solution plays, product launches and sales motions, and acting as an advisor to leadership;

  • Partners closely with incentive design leads, program operations, finance and engineering teams to ensure incentive changes are communicated accurately, consistently and on time;

  • Demonstrates influence across multiple divisions, drives alignment and influence towards common goals, and maintains awareness about business transformation and longer-term growth;

Problem Solving and Insights

  • Defines, tracks and reports GTM and adoption effectiveness (e.g., awareness, engagement, enrollment, utilization and claims), synthesizing partner and field feedback into insights and recommendations that shape future incentive design;

  • Acts as subject matter on AI Business Solutions and Security partner incentives and programs for internal and external audiences;

AI-Powered Innovation

  • Champions the use of AI tools to optimize content creation, community engagement and community management processes, scaling reach and reducing time-to-land;

Other:

  • Embodies our culture and values, contributes to a diverse and inclusive team culture;

  • Travels --may be required at a limited level (~5%).



Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 6+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 8+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 12+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.

title: Student Success Specialist
description:
Student Success Specialist

MedSchoolCoach | Full-Time | Remote

About the Role

MedSchoolCoach is seeking a compassionate, organized, and solutions-oriented Student Success Specialist to join our Student Success team. In this role, you will serve as a trusted point of contact for students and families, helping ensure they receive exceptional service, timely support, and a positive experience throughout their journey with MedSchoolCoach.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who brings patience, empathy, and professionalism to every interaction, particularly when navigating sensitive situations or resolving concerns. This individual should be comfortable managing competing priorities, addressing challenging conversations with confidence, and balancing a supportive approach with the ability to set clear expectations and drive resolutions. We are especially interested in candidates with backgrounds in higher education, admissions, student affairs, academic advising, counseling, or other student-facing roles who understand the unique pressures students and families face throughout the academic and medical education journey.

Key Responsibilities

Student & Family Support

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for students and families, providing thoughtful, responsive, and professional support via email and phone.
  • Manage incoming student inquiries, concerns, and complaints, ensuring timely acknowledgment and follow-up, typically within 24–48 hours.
  • Approach sensitive or emotionally charged situations with patience, empathy, and sound judgment, recognizing when conversations require additional time, care, or escalation.
  • Build positive relationships with students and families, establishing trust and confidence in

MedSchoolCoach's services.

  • Conduct proactive check-ins with students, particularly during onboarding and early stages of service, to ensure satisfaction and address potential concerns.

Issue Resolution & Relationship Management

  • Investigate and resolve student concerns related to service delivery, scheduling, communication, and other aspects of the student experience.
  • Serve as a liaison between students, families, advisors, tutors, and internal teams to facilitate effective communication and timely resolutions.
  • Exercise sound judgment when addressing complaints, balancing student satisfaction with company policies and service expectations.
  • Identify situations requiring escalation and collaborate with leadership to determine appropriate next steps.
  • Maintain a calm, professional, and confident approach during difficult conversations while setting clear boundaries and expectations.

Student Success Operations

  • Coordinate student onboarding and transitions between internal teams, advisors, and tutors to ensure a seamless experience.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of student interactions, concerns, follow-up actions, and resolutions.
  • Monitor ongoing student needs and proactively identify opportunities to improve satisfaction and engagement.
  • Assist with student satisfaction surveys, feedback collection, and other initiatives designed to evaluate the student experience.
  • Identify recurring concerns or service gaps and recommend improvements to processes, policies, and communication practices.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and documentation to support consistent service delivery.
  • Collaborate with Student Success leadership and cross-functional teams on additional projects and initiatives as needed.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • Experience in a student-facing, client services, customer support, or relationship management role.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and thoughtfully with diverse audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, and the ability to build rapport with students and families.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate difficult conversations, manage complaints, and resolve conflicts with empathy and confidence.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting established response timelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to exercise independent judgment when evaluating situations and determining appropriate next steps.
  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt communication styles based on individual needs and circumstances.
  • Proficiency with common productivity and communication tools, including Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Willingness to learn about MedSchoolCoach's services, medical education pathways, and the unique needs of our students.

Preferred

  • Experience working in higher education, college admissions, student affairs, academic advising, enrollment services, or counseling.
  • Advanced degree in education, higher education administration, counseling, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting students and families through academically demanding or high- stakes processes.
  • Previous experience in complaint resolution, student advocacy, or service recovery.
  • Familiarity with student support systems, CRM platforms, or case management tools.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

Our ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and understands that exceptional student support requires more than simply answering questions. It requires listening carefully, communicating clearly, following through consistently, and knowing when to offer reassurance versus when to take decisive action. You will thrive in this role if you are naturally patient and approachable, but also confident and comfortable taking ownership of challenging situations. You recognize that students and families may be navigating stressful or uncertain circumstances, and you take pride in helping them feel heard, supported, and confident in the services they receive. Above all, you are a strong writer, a thoughtful problem solver, and someone who can be trusted to manage sensitive student concerns with professionalism, discretion, and care.

Compensation & Benefits

MedSchoolCoach offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

- Up to four weeks of vacation

- Health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance

- 401(k) with company match

- Flexible work schedule

- Remote work environment

Work Location: Remote

description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

14 November 2026-23:59-GMT+01:00 West Africa Standard Time (Ndjamena)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.


ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of extreme weather shocks.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.


WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).




CONTRACTUAL INFORMATION:

Position Title: IT Operations Officer

Contract Type: Consultant, Level II

Division: Information Technology

Duty Station: Adre, Chad

Duration: 11 months


BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:


The role will be responsible for delivering efficient and effective IT systems and platforms that support WFP’s strategy in Sudan Country Office, including, but not limiting to, management of networking infrastructure and connectivity (VSAT, mobile and terrestrial) in the Area Office telecommunications system (HF/VHF radio network), cyber-security, ensure adequate users support, assets management, inter-agency collaboration, etc.


The incumbent will report directly to the Head of Darfur Area Office (AO), while maintaining functional reporting line to the Foundational Team Lead of TEC Sudan Unit for all technology related aspects.


ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES (not all-inclusive):


  • Manage the operation and maintenance of the Local Area Network (LAN) and Wide Area Network (WAN) systems to ensure that Network Operating Systems support data base, documents, resources and other data files.
  • Contribute to the development of plans and budgets and manage the deployment of IT and Telecom systems and platforms aligned with business needs, in accordance with WFP corporate standards.
  • Monitor and maintain IT and Telecom systems and networks, ensuring appropriate data security and access controls considering both local and wide area network issues; and supporting users to get maximum benefits from them.
  • Contribute to technical specifications and tender documents that support the procurement of IT equipment and services at minimum cost, in line with WFP rules and regulations.
  • Collect and analyze data to contribute to the preparation of accurate reports on IT and Telecom activities, investments and costs, identifying ideas to increase cost-efficiencies where possible.
  • Maintain and develop technical expertise and understanding of industry developments.
  • Provide advice to managers and users, understanding and resolving issues, and ensuring IT policies, procedures, systems and tools are correctly applied to support them.
  • Guide and supervise more junior staff, acting as a point of referral and supporting them with more complex analysis and queries.
  • Contribute to the capability building of staff through the review and/or design of appropriate training programs aimed at developing skills/knowledge in IT and Telecoms.
  • Serve as the Emergency Telecommunications Cluster (ETC) Coordinator for the Aare Office with all corresponding responsibilities and accountabilities, with functional reporting to the Emergency Telecommunications Cluster Coordinator in the Country Office.
  • Coordinate with other UN agencies in order to align activities and maximise possibilities of inter-agency collaboration in the field of IT and Telecoms.
  • Interact effectively with internal and external colleagues and user groups to understand their needs and provide appropriate technical support.
  • Follow standard emergency preparedness and contingency planning practices to ensure WFP is able to maintain basic IT services and/or quickly respond and deploy resources to affected areas at the onset of a crisis.
  • Contribute to the preparation of operational plans and deliver resource requirements at the onset of an emergency.
  • Ensure IT Assets Management processes and procedures are in place and followed within established WFP internal rules and regulations.
  • Perform any other related duties as required.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:


Education: Advanced university degree in Computer Science or another relevant field, or First University degree with additional years of related work experience or training/courses.
Experience: At least 5 years of progressively responsible professional experience in planning, design, development, implementation and maintenance of IT systems. Hands on field experience implementing IT and telecoms systems in emergencies.
Knowledge & Skills:

  • Proven hands-on Project Management experience.
  • CCNA or higher certification and Microsoft certification is desirable.
  • Deep understanding of networking protocols (e.g.1 IPSEC, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, QoS)
  • Solid understanding of cyber-security protocols, solutions, threats, etc.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring, network diagnostic and network analytics tools.

Languages: Fluency in English. Knowledge of another UN official languages is an advantage.

WFP LEADERSHIP FRAMEWORK

WFP Leadership Framework guides to the common standards of behavior that guide HOW we work together to accomplish our mission.

Click here to access WFP Leadership Framework

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

WFP is committed to supporting individuals with disabilities by providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact: global.inclusion@wfp.org

NO FEE DISCLAIMER

The United Nations does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. Therefore, you are advised to apply particular care when submitting personal information on the web.

REMINDERS BEFORE YOU SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION

  • All applications must be submitted exclusively through our online recruiting system. We do not consider CVs or applications sent by email, LinkedIn, or any other channel.

  • We strongly recommend that your Workday profile is accurate and complete, and that all sections are filled in, including your employment history, academic qualifications, language skills, and UN grade (if applicable). Once your profile is completed, please apply, and submit your application.

  • If you experience technical issues while submitting your application, you may contact us at global.hrerecruitment@wfp.org. Please note that this email is only for technical issues with an application - unsolicited applications or documents sent to this inbox will not receive a reply.

  • At the application stage, the only required documents are your CV and Cover Letter. Additional documents (passport, certificates, recommendation letters, etc.) may be requested later in the process.

  • Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to proceed to the next stage of the recruitment process.

All employment decisions are made on the basis of organizational needs, job requirements, merit, and individual qualifications. WFP is committed to providing an inclusive work environment free of sexual exploitation and abuse, all forms of discrimination, any kind of harassment, sexual harassment, and abuse of authority. Therefore, all selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference and background checks.


No appointment under any kind of contract will be offered to members of the UN Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (ACABQ), International Civil Service Commission (ICSC), FAO Finance Committee, WFP External Auditor, WFP Audit Committee, Joint Inspection Unit (JIU) and other similar bodies within the United Nations system with oversight responsibilities over WFP, both during their service and within three years of ceasing that service.

title: Plumbing Field Manager
description:
Plumbing Manager

Full-Time | Leadership Position

Are you an experienced plumbing leader who knows how to build a strong team, develop technicians, and drive department performance? Logan Services is looking for a Plumbing Manager to lead our plumbing service and installation teams and help grow a high-performing department. If you're technically knowledgeable, passionate about developing people, and motivated to build a successful business, you could be a great fit at Logan Services.

Why Join Logan Services?

Since 1969, Logan Services has proudly served Ohio families and has expanded throughout Dayton, Columbus, Cincinnati, and Northern Kentucky. We've built our company by putting people first, our customers and our employees. We believe great service starts with great employees. That's why we invest in training, professional development, and opportunities for career growth.

Many people join Logan looking for a job and stay because they find a career.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary – Your leadership experience and contributions are valued.
  • Performance Bonuses & Profit Sharing – Opportunities to earn more based on individual and company performance.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Disability Insurance – Short-term and long-term disability coverage.
  • Life Insurance – Voluntary life insurance plus 100% company-paid group term life and AD&D coverage.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Traditional 401(k) with a 4% company match and Roth contribution option.
  • Professional Development – Opportunities to expand your leadership and technical knowledge.
  • PTO & Paid Sick Time – Time off to support your life outside of work.
  • Career Advancement – Opportunities to grow your career within a stable, expanding company.

The Big Task

As the Plumbing Manager, you'll be responsible for leading the plumbing department, developing technicians, and ensuring our service and installation teams deliver exceptional workmanship and customer experiences. You'll oversee daily operations, drive department profitability, and help technicians grow their skills and careers. You're not just managing a department; you're building the future of plumbing at Logan Services.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the daily operations of the plumbing service and installation teams to meet customer expectations and department goals.
  • Build a high-performing team culture where technicians feel valued, take pride in their workmanship, and deliver exceptional customer service.
  • Recruit, interview, hire, train, and develop plumbing technicians to meet department needs.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to technicians to help resolve challenges and maintain quality workmanship.
  • Oversee technician performance, conduct evaluations, and establish improvement goals in partnership with senior leadership.
  • Partner with Dispatch to ensure technicians are scheduled appropriately based on skill level, efficiency, and training needs.
  • Work with Logistics to maintain appropriate parts inventory, vehicle stocking programs, tool lists, and warehouse inventory.
  • Ensure technicians follow company policies, safety standards, and established workmanship expectations.
  • Work with other department leaders to support company-wide goals and continuously improve operations.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who understands the plumbing trade, knows how to lead people, and has the ability to turn department goals into measurable results.

You'll be a strong fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of plumbing management experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • In-depth knowledge and understanding of residential plumbing systems and the plumbing trade.
  • Strong technical skills, including the ability to interpret plumbing manuals, understand local codes, and troubleshoot technical issues.
  • Experience developing, training, and coaching technicians.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organization, problem-solving, and conflict management skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • A clean, professional appearance and a valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
  • Flexibility to work a non-standard schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Our PARTE Values

Our culture is built around five core values:

P – People First – We treat everyone with respect, compassion, and care.

A – Agile – We embrace change and respond with flexibility, creativity, and purpose.

R – Radical Ownership – We take responsibility for our actions and become part of the solution.

T – Teamwork – We work together, communicate openly, and succeed as one team.

E – Excellence – We continually raise the standard and strive to exceed expectations.

Build a Career, Not Just a Job

At Logan Services, we believe great leaders build great teams. As our Plumbing Manager, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of our plumbing department, develop the next generation of plumbing technicians, and make a lasting impact on our customers and employees.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Logan Services, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

title: Bakery InStore Assistant Department Manager Full Time Day
description:
Come make your difference in communities across Canada, where authenticity, trust and making connections is valued – as we shape the future of Canadian retail, together. Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.

At Atlantic Superstore, we succeed through collaboration and commitment and set a high bar for ourselves and those around us. Whether you are just starting your career, re-entering the workforce, or looking for a new job, this is where you belong.

Why is this role important:

Whether we are shopping for our weekly essentials, a big celebration or checking out the new products and deals our team members are there to give excellent customer service and memorable experiences. Our Assistant Department Managers are dedicated people leaders who navigate us to providing the best in-store experience for shoppers like ourselves in all our stores across Canada. We want to show you how it is done and have you help us improve and build an even better in-store experience. We'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do :

What you bring
