Our commitment to Sustainability and Social Impact is an essential part of the way we do business, and we focus our attention on areas where we can have the greatest impact. Our approach to sustainability and social impact is based on three pillars – Environment, Sourcing and Community – and we are constantly looking for ways to demonstrate leadership in these important areas. Our CORE Values – Care, Ownership, Respect and Excellence – guide all our decision-making and come to life through our Blue Culture. We offer our colleagues progressive careers, comprehensive training, flexibility, and other competitive benefits – these are some of the many reasons why we are one of Canada’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers, Canada’s Greenest Employers & Canada’s Top Employers for Young People.

If you are unsure whether your experience matches every requirement above, we encourage you to apply anyway. We are looking for varied perspectives which include diverse experiences that we can add to our team.

We have a long-standing focus on diversity, equity and inclusion because we know it will make our company a better place to work and shop. We are committed to creating accessible environments for our colleagues, candidates and customers. Requests for accommodation due to a disability (which may be visible or invisible, temporary or permanent) can be made at any stage of application and employment. We encourage candidates to make their accommodation needs known so that we can provide equitable opportunities.

Please Note:
Candidates who are 18 years or older are required to complete a criminal background check. Details will be provided through the application process.

title: Group Coordinator Lead
description:

Design, develop, and deliver engaging classroom and operational training presentations. Maintain training programs for WMS-related processes and warehouse operations. Train on site Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and customer-facing process documentation. Prepare detailed work instructions for operational functions and system processes. Conduct new-hire training, onboarding, and cross-training for associates and temporary staff. Evaluate training effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Partner with operations leadership to ensure employees are trained on safety, quality, and productivity standards. Serve as a subject matter expert on warehouse processes, MHE operations, and WMS functionality. Provide ongoing coaching and support to associates to improve performance and operational compliance. Assist leadership with special projects and additional operational responsibilities as assigned.


Position: 1st Shift Inbound Group Lead
Shift:Mon-Fri 5am-1:30pm
Pay: $22.35 per hour

Be part of the world’s largest logistics company!DHL Supply Chain has been certified as a Great Place to Work® in the US and Canada! Our excellent benefits packages includes:

- PTO program for all associates, including paid holidays and vacation
- 401(k) with generous company match
- Tuition reimbursement program

Grow your skills. Shape your world.


Role Purpose:

Responsible for assigning work schedules, training associates and monitoring associate progress for the work group they are directing. Provides day-to-day direction and guidance to work group. Responsible for daily workloads.

Key Accountabilities:

title: Certified Ski or Snowboard Instructor
description:
Create Your Experience of a Lifetime!

Come work and play in the mountains! Whether it’s your first-time seeing snow or you were born on the slopes, joining our team means discovering (or re-discovering!) a passion for the outdoors while building lifelong connections with teammates and guests from around the world.

With 40+ resorts across 3 continents, you can join our team for a season or stay to build a career. From day one, you'll receive some of the highest compensation rates in the industry, free pass(es) along with free ski and snowboard lessons, 40% retail discounts, the chance to grow through Epic Service - our leading training and development experience, and wellness benefits to fuel your success.

Hiring for our seasonal positions occurs on a rolling basis. Applications will be accepted until December 15th or until the positions are filled (whichever is first).

Employee Benefits

• Ski/Mountain Perks! Free passes for employees, employee discounted lift tickets for friends and family AND free ski lessons
• MORE employee discounts on lodging, food, gear, and mountain shuttles
• 401(k) Retirement Plan
• Employee Assistance Program
• Excellent training and professional development
• Referral Program

To Learn More, please review the Benefits Eligibility Summary

Job Summary:

Share your passion! The Certified Instructor will have deep enthusiasm for the sport, allowing him/her to provide quality ski instruction to groups and individuals, adults and children. With a constant eye towards safety and a teaching-strategy centered around fun, our instructors will build lasting relationships with our guests. From beginner to advanced, our team works to ensure students get the most out of their day, their week or their seasons with us.

Job Specifications:

  • Starting Wage: $21.00/hr - $40.00/hr
    • Pay range reflects minimum base wages; instructors may have opportunities to earn more with additional teaching incentives
  • Employment Type: Winter Seasonal 2026/2027.
  • Shift Type: Full Time hours available. For Full-Time Instructors, a 40-hour workweek is not guaranteed. Scheduled hours will vary depending on business volume.
  • Minimum Age: At least 18 years of age
  • Housing Availability: Yes

Job Responsibilities:

  • Upholding the highest levels of guest safety on varied terrain in the high altitude under varying winter weather conditions.
  • Clearly and accurately instructing assigned levels of skiing to students, both physically and verbally.
  • Ensuring that students are matched to appropriate skier skill level and working with supervisors/managers to make appropriate changes when necessary.
  • Assisting guests with transportation of equipment to and from snow when needed.
  • Clearly communicating instructions for guests to load and unload the chairlift.
  • Supervising children in class at all times, including assisting at lunch and snack times and ensuring return of children to identified guardian.
  • Assisting in operational responsibilities of Ski & Ride programs including but not limited to registration process, directing guests to appropriate equipment fitting source, upkeep of outdoor teaching areas, and cleanliness of facilities.
  • Teaching skiing at all levels of difficulty based upon ability and experience.
  • Understanding and abiding by the rules and procedures set forth in the Resource and Guidelines Manual.
  • Must be able to discuss the lesson content and evaluate the progress of the lesson with the guest.
  • Able to physically, clearly and accurately demonstrate assigned levels of skiing and snowboarding models.
  • Must have high level of guest service skills and experience.
  • Assisting with boot/equipment fitting, sales lobby greeting and other tasks assigned by Manager/Supervisors.
  • Other duties as assigned

Job Requirements:

  • At least 18 years of age
  • High School or equivalent education
  • Ability to attend all required Ski and Ride training sessions
  • PSIA/AASI Level 1, 2 or 3 certification (international equivalent ok)
  • Basic knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, and browser applications, including basic internet navigation
  • Must be fluent in all aspects of the English language (spoken and written)
  • Must have excellent guest service skills
  • Must have excellent communication skills
  • Must work well in a team environment
  • Must successfully pass a Background Check
  • Must be able to work in inclement weather in a high alpine environment
  • Must have sight, speech, and hearing abilities sufficient to learn skills, follow, and provide directions
  • Must be willing to teach both adults and children
  • Must be able to provide 2 letters of reference
  • Must be available to work holidays and weekends
  • Must be willing to adhere to the Vail Resorts policy of wearing an approved snow sports helmet at all times while teaching

Preferred skills:

  • Experience working with guests of all ages
  • Knowledge of local area/resort
  • Previous experience with teaching/coaching/mentoring children
  • Second language - Spanish preferred

What’s in it for you?

  • Free EPIC Pass to all of our resorts
  • Discounted coupons for friends and family
  • Shuttle bus from S. Lake Tahoe to Kirkwood
  • Carpool Incentive program
  • Discount with select industry manufactures
  • Opportunities for ski/ride breaks
  • Opportunities to participate in ski/ride improvement clinics
  • Discounted lodging at our Rock Resort Properties starting at $85/night
  • 50% off Colorado Mountain Express transportation
  • Food and beverage discounts at mountain dining locations
  • Retail discounts at Vail Resorts Retail stores
  • 10-25% off at our Starbucks locations
  • Unique events! Including concerts, employee meals, employee activities, pro competitions!
  • On site medical clinic with benefits for employees
  • Job Share opportunities to work more hours if needed

The expected pay range is $21.00/hr - $40.00/hr. This is the pay range we reasonably expect to pay for this position. Individual compensation decisions are based on a variety of factors.

In completing this application, and when submitting related documentation, applicants may redact information that identifies their age, date of birth, and/or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We follow all federal, state, and local laws including restrictions on child/minor labor. Minors hired into this position will not be asked or permitted to engage in any activities restricted to adult workers.

Vail Resorts is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

Job Summary:
Join a great team! We have openings at The Arrabelle, Vail Resorts’ premier property located at the base of Vail Mountain. Here you will maintain assets inside and outside of guest rooms, owner condos and common areas. Ensure all areas are safe and in working order.

Job Specifications:

  • Starting Wage: $22.00/hr - $27.70/hr
  • Employment Type: Year Round
  • Shift Type: Full Time hours available
  • Minimum Age: At least 18 years of age
  • Housing Availability: No

Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform electrical, mechanical and general construction, repair and maintenance work on existing facilities and equipment. Conduct daily checks of the Building Automation System (JCI) and building mechanicals.
  • Perform routine maintenance on the property’s physical structure, mechanical, electrical and HVAC systems, and other related equipment that contributes to the safe and effective operation of the facility.
  • Perform daily rounds to check boilers, pools, common areas, sprinkler systems, the fire pump room and fire panels.
  • Visually inspect completed work for quality and report deficiencies.
  • Comply with company policy on vehicle operation.
  • Attend to work orders, guest requests, housekeeping requests, front desk requests and room calls.
  • Assist with required inspections and certifications for property equipment as directed.
  • Maintain all facilities and operating systems in safe and efficient working order, including automatic doors, exit doorways and required snow and garbage removal. Work will require lifting 20 pounds or more.
  • Complete assigned tasks in a safe, timely manner.
  • Work with outside contractors to provide necessary improvements or maintenance as directed.
  • Carry ladders up and down stairs with required tools, which may exceed 20 pounds.
  • Work may require lifting arms above the head and shoulders to perform ceiling repairs, including addressing small leaks, electrical shorts and motor replacements.
  • Maintain records of all work activities and supporting materials.
  • Provide written reports to other departments as needed.
  • Safely dispose of all waste materials.
  • Maintain tools, equipment and vehicles, and keep work areas safe, secure and organized.
  • Work with other departments when directed.
  • Keep track of supplies and complete requisitions for needed supplies.
  • Maintain vehicle maintenance records and schedules.
  • Maintain all pools and hot tubs according to applicable safety and health standards.

title: Senior Java Performance Engineer
description:

Performance is your passion. Optimization is your superpower.

Are you a Senior Java Engineer who loves digging deep into complex systems, solving challenging performance issues, and making mission-critical applications run at their best?

We're looking for an experienced Senior Java Performance Engineer to join a global engineering team in the banking and financial services industry. You'll work on platforms supporting portfolio performance reporting, helping financial advisors, operations teams, and clients access accurate information about portfolio returns, asset allocation, and holdings.

This role goes beyond writing code. You'll combine advanced Java development with database optimization, distributed processing, production troubleshooting, and cloud modernization. If execution plans, CPU bottlenecks, and large-scale batch processing sound like challenges you'd enjoy solving, we'd love to hear from you!

🚀 What will you do?

  • Build and modernize Java applications: Develop and maintain Java 21 and Spring Boot batch applications and microservices, including major framework and dependency upgrades.

  • Optimize distributed processing: Operate, troubleshoot, and tune an Apache Storm-based processing cluster, covering worker balancing, restarts, and alert configuration.

  • Master database performance: Analyze and optimize SQL Server and Azure SQL Hyperscale workloads through execution plans, indexing, query tuning, and troubleshooting performance regressions.

  • Drive cloud modernization: Help migrate mainframe batch jobs and DB2 data flows to Azure as part of a broader platform modernization initiative.

  • Keep critical processes running: Monitor nightly batch performance against service-level targets, investigate production incidents, lead root cause analysis, and implement lasting fixes.

  • Strengthen application security: Address open-source dependency vulnerabilities using Nexus IQ or similar Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools, ensuring appropriate risk assessment and sign-off.

  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with data, cloud, QA, application support, and external technology partners to deliver reliable, high-performing solutions.

🧠 What we're looking for

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred.

  • 18+ years of hands-on Java development experience, ideally within banking or financial services.

  • Strong Java 17/21 and Spring Boot expertise, including experience with major framework upgrades — must-have.

  • Proven SQL Server / Azure SQL performance tuning experience, ideally with Azure SQL Hyperscale, including execution plan analysis, query optimization, plan regression troubleshooting, and CPU bottleneck resolution — must-have.

  • Hands-on experience with distributed or stream processing technologies, such as Apache Storm, Kafka Streams, or Apache Flink — must-have.

  • Experience with DB2 and understanding or migrating mainframe batch jobs — an advantage.

  • Familiarity with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Helm, and Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID integration — an advantage.

  • Experience resolving open-source vulnerabilities using Nexus IQ or similar SCA tools — an advantage.

  • Background in wealth management or portfolio performance, including returns calculations, holdings, and valuation data — an advantage.

  • A strong understanding of Agile, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and DevOps practices.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to troubleshooting.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with engineering teams, senior stakeholders, and external vendors.

  • A collaborative mindset and experience working with globally distributed teams in a diverse environment.

👥 Meet your team

You'll join the Portfolio Performance Reporting team within Digital Intelligence & Advisor Platforms.

The team builds and operates platforms responsible for calculating and reporting portfolio returns, asset allocation, and holdings for financial advisors, operations teams, and clients.

You'll work in a collaborative, globally distributed environment alongside specialists in data, cloud, QA, and application support. Quality, reliability, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything the team delivers.

✨ Why join this project?

  • Work on business-critical platforms within the banking and financial services industry.

  • Tackle complex performance challenges across Java, distributed processing, and Azure SQL.

  • Contribute to a major modernization program involving cloud technologies and legacy systems.

  • Collaborate with experienced international engineering teams and external technology partners.

  • Make a tangible impact on the performance, stability, and security of enterprise applications.

Ready to take on complex performance challenges and help modernize critical financial platforms?

Apply now and let's talk!

title: Fan Relations Specialist
description:
Fan Relations Specialist – Dairy Queen

Starting Pay: $16.00 per hour | Full-Time

Location: Dairy Queen Grill & Chill

Love People? Love Making Someone's Day? Join Our Team!

We're looking for an energetic, outgoing, and customer-focused Fan Relations Specialist who takes pride in delivering outstanding hospitality.

At Dairy Queen, we don't just serve food and treats. We create experiences that bring customers back.

This is more than a cashier position. You'll be the face of our restaurant, building relationships with guests, creating memorable experiences, and helping us deliver exceptional customer service every day.

What You'll Do

Guest Experience & Hospitality

  • Warmly greet and acknowledge every customer entering the restaurant.
  • Create a welcoming, friendly, and positive dining experience.
  • Build relationships with regular customers and make them feel appreciated.
  • Check on dine-in guests to ensure they're satisfied with their experience.
  • Handle customer questions, concerns, and complaints professionally.
  • Encourage satisfied customers to share their experiences through Fan Feedback surveys and online reviews.

Service & Operations

  • Take orders accurately and efficiently using the POS system.
  • Verify orders before handing them to customers.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming dining room, front counter, and restroom area.
  • Assist with order preparation, packaging, and service when needed.
  • Communicate with Grill, Chill, and Drive-Thru teams to ensure fast and accurate service.
  • Identify service delays and proactively help resolve customer concerns.
  • Follow food safety, cleanliness, and restaurant operating standards.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of customer service experience in a fast-food, restaurant, retail, or hospitality environment.
  • Friendly, outgoing personality with excellent communication skills.
  • Genuine passion for helping people and providing exceptional service.
  • Ability to multitask and work efficiently during busy periods.
  • Dependable, punctual, and professional.
  • Comfortable using POS systems and learning digital tools.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Willingness to support teammates wherever needed.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • Enjoys interacting with people and starting conversations.
  • Notices when a guest needs assistance without being asked.
  • Takes pride in keeping the restaurant clean and welcoming.
  • Can turn a negative customer experience into a positive one.
  • Understands that speed, accuracy, and friendliness are equally important.
  • Brings positive energy and leads by example.

What Success Looks Like

As a Fan Relations Specialist, your success will be measured by your ability to:

Deliver consistently friendly and welcoming customer service.

Help improve overall guest satisfaction and Fan Feedback.

Build relationships with regular customers and encourage repeat visits.

Maintain excellent front-counter and dining-room cleanliness.

Support fast, accurate, and efficient restaurant operations.

Positively represent Dairy Queen in every guest interaction.

title: Technical Designer

description:
Technical Designer

Reports to: Associate Director of Technical Design

About Ravenswood Studio Inc.

Ravenswood Studio is a nationally recognized custom fabrication company driven by passionate artisans who take pride in every aspect of each and every project we undertake. With our core values of Trust, Ingenuity and Excellence, we build museum and corporate exhibits, specialty millwork, custom themed elements and scenery for theater, opera, and film.

Celebrating 35 years as one of the nation’s most talented builders, we fabricate projects of all scales and complexities. We are creative, detail oriented, deadline sensitive, and budget conscious, making us a perfect match to bring our clients vision into a physical reality. We are as passionate about our projects as our clients are.

Our team of innovators includes Project Managers, Technical Designer, Carpenters, Metalworkers, Scenic Artists, Sculptors, and Electronics Experts who partner and collaborate with Designers, Architects, and Clients. Within our 100,000 sq ft fabrication facility, we use state-of-the-art fabrication technologies, methods and materials to produce award-winning projects that set our clients apart time and time again.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Technical Designers are responsible for creating drawings of our projects for both client review and shop fabrication. With input from project managers, job leads, and fabricators, design detailers aim to find the simplest and most efficient solutions.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create drawings for design specific parts, ordered from suppliers.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, especially 3D, as well as Microsoft and Google Suites
  • Hands on fabrication experience highly recommended
  • Relevant degree / diploma, professional certification, or equivalent work experience of at least 3 years’ drafting in one or more of the following industries: museum exhibit, display, cabinetry / millwork, theater / opera, or themed environments.
  • Ability to prioritize and problem solve with shifting priorities and deadlines.
  • Is proactive, aware, and focused.
  • High attention to detail, seeing tasks through until completed.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Understanding of the materials and methods used in a custom fabrication facility.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD especially 3D, as well as Microsoft and Google Suites
  • Hands on fabrication experience highly recommended
  • Relevant degree/diploma, professional certification, or equivalent work experience of at least 3 years' drafting in the following industries: museum exhibit, display ,cabinetry/ millwork, theater/ opera, or themed environments.
  • Ability to prioritize and problem solve with shifting priorities and deadlines.
  • Is proactive, aware and focused.
  • High attention to detail, seeing tasks through until completed.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Understanding of the materials and method used in a custom fabrication facility.

title: PRODUCTION OPERATIONS ENGINEER INTERN
description:
Ariston Group is a global leader in sustainable climate and water comfort, listed on Euronext Milan. In 2025 the group reported 2.7 billion-euro revenues, with almost 11,000 employees, direct presence in 41 countries in 5 continents, 32 production sites and 31 research and development centers. The group demonstrates its commitment to sustainability through renewable and high-efficiency solutions, including heating heat pumps, water heating heat pumps, hybrids, domestic ventilation, air handling, electric components, and solar thermal systems, while continuously investing in technological innovation, digitalization, and advanced connectivity solutions. The group operates under global strategic brands Ariston, Wolf and Elco, and brands such as Calorex, NTI, Atag, Domotec, Brink, Chromagen, Racold, as well as Thermowatt and Ecoflam in the components and combustion technologies business.

We are looking for a Production / Operations Engineer Intern to join our Production Team and support the monitoring, analysis and continuous improvement of manufacturing performance.

The internship offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a complex manufacturing environment, working directly with the shop floor and on real industrial challenges related to production performance, planning, process stability and operational efficiency.

The candidate could develop a challenging Master's thesis project focused on solving a real production or operational problem, combining academic methodologies with their practical application in a manufacturing environment.

Main responsabilities;

  • Monitor and analyze key production KPIs, supporting the identification of performance gaps and improvement actions.
  • Support daily production and Gemba meetings, providing the information required to monitor performance, production issues and ongoing actions.
  • Support production planning and scheduling activities, monitoring production progress and deviations between plan and actual performance.
  • Analyze production capacity, workloads, productivity and operational constraints to support production decisions.
  • Collaborate with the Time & Methods team to identify improvement opportunities in production line balancing, supporting the analysis of workloads and production efficiency.
  • Support the standardization of production processes through Standard Operating Procedures, One Point Lessons and standard work.
  • Participate in Root Cause Analysis and structured problem-solving activities related to production losses, quality issues and process inefficiencies.
  • Contribute to Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing and WCM initiatives, supporting improvement projects directly on the shop floor.

What we're looking for:

  • Master's degree or final-year student in Management Engineering, Industrial Engineering or related fields.
  • Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes and production management principles.
  • Basic knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, WCM and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Strong interest in production planning, manufacturing performance and shop-floor management.
  • Familiarity with production KPIs and data analysis applied to manufacturing processes.

Knowledge of data analysis/programming tools is considered a plus.

We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all people. We strive to provide a work environment that is accessible, welcoming and inclusive, in full compliance with applicable legal requirements. In line with this commitment, we promote fair, transparent and equitable reward practices. The compensation package will be determined based on the experience, skills and the scope of the role, applying objective and gender‑neutral criteria. We believe that transparency and fairness are essential to building trust, fostering inclusion and ensuring equal opportunities for everyone.

title: Advanced Electrical
description:
Create Your Experience of a Lifetime!

Come work and play in the mountains! Whether it’s your first-time seeing snow or you were born on the slopes, joining our team means discovering (or re-discovering!) a passion for the outdoors while building lifelong connections with teammates and guests from around the world.

With 40+ resorts across 3 continents, you can join our team for a season or stay to build a career. From day one, you'll receive some of the highest compensation rates in the industry, free pass(es) along with free ski and snowboard lessons, 40% retail discounts, the chance to grow through Epic Service - our leading training and development experience, and wellness benefits to fuel your success.

Hiring for our seasonal positions occurs on a rolling basis. Applications will be accepted until December 15th or until the positions are filled (whichever is first).

• MORE employee discounts on lodging, food, gear, and mountain shuttles
• 401(k) Retirement Plan

Job Summary:

This position is a highly skilled person with experience operating and maintaining all types of equipment in their areas of responsibility.  In addition to advanced level knowledge, they use highly specialized skills in a specific area(s) of expertise. Duties are performed in all types of environments, both indoors and outdoors. 

Job Specifications:

  • Starting Wage: $35.07/hr - $46.75/hr
  • Employment Type: Winter Seasonal 2026/2027
  • Shift Type: Full Time hours available
  • Minimum Age: At least 18 years of age
  • Housing Availability: No

Job Responsibilities:

  • Ensure the safe and reliable electronic operation of the lifts and snowmaking equipment. 
  • Emphasis on proficiency, instruction, and leadership in lift maintenance and mountain operations.
  • Assist and ensure that all maintenance procedures are scheduled and performed.
  • Responsible for assuring lifts comply with all Z98 and Canadian electrical codes and regulations.
  • Responsible for high and low-voltage systems on lifts.
  • Responsible for the upkeep and maintenance of lift controller programming.
  • Responsible for following the company’s safety and risk management policies and procedures 
  • Responsible for performing all routine and assigned maintenance procedures.
  • Responsible for recording all information on lift work performed and submitting it to lift Dispatch on time.
  • Fabrication and maintenance of electronic circuits as required.
  • Responsible for the upkeep of system blueprints and schematics.

  • 10+ years of on-the-job electrical experience.
  • High School or Equivalent.
  • Four or more years of electronics/electrical experience and programming.

  • Work comfortably at heights up to 30 meters.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (personalization) m/f/d
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 18000 – 20000 PLN / mies. netto

limango is a European platform focused on curated value shopping for families. As part of the OTTO Group - one of Europe’s leading e-commerce players - we connect families with inspiring brands, great deals, and products they truly love. Our ambition is to strengthen our position as one of Europe’s leading discount e-commerce players for families and beyond.

Today, limango operates across Germany, Poland Austria, and the Netherlands, offering one of the largest selections for the whole family: from fashion and accessories to toys, outdoor, cosmetics, home and travel offers.

Behind the platform is a team that values a good atmosphere, trust, collaboration, flexibility and real impact. We foster a hybrid-first culture in Munich and Wrocław (2 days in the office), while staying open to remote talent who value the same way of working.

JOIN THE LIMANGO IT!

Join the limango IT and Product Development team! In the limango IT and Product development you get the chance to contribute your own ideas and know-how to maintain and develop our highly frequented, self built online shop for our markets in Poland, Germany, Austria and the Netherlands. Together with our experienced and international development teams you will bring our shop sites to the next level.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Machine Learning Shop team, you will own the business-critical logic behind our campaign-based flash sale model. Your work will directly impact how we rank campaigns based on customer interests and category affinities, optimize our product recommender systems, and prevent churn through smart communication models.

You will work within a modern tech stack world in a well-rehearsed, agile environment alongside dedicated Product Owners, Data Engineers, and Web Developers.

YOUR MAIN TASKS AND WHAT WE EXPECT

  • Building and deploying data-driven and machine learning solutions for portal personalization and campaign ranking.

  • Taking care of the whole machine learning process – verifying data quality, choosing optimal algorithms, feature engineering, model validation with correct metrics, and interpretability.

  • Monitoring, maintaining, scaling, and updating existing data / ML pipelines.

  • Building solutions following best software practices – clean code, testing, and automatic deployments.

  • Working closely with data engineers, data scientists, and development teams in building our whole ML / data-driven infrastructure – reliable data pipelines and shared, clean data sources.

  • Explaining and recommending optimal data-driven / ML solutions to both business stakeholders and developer teams.

  • Sharing and improving ML / MLOps knowledge within the organization.

WHAT WE EXPECT

  • 3-5+ years of professional experience building, training, validating, and deploying ML solutions in production environments.

  • Very good knowledge of Python programming, SQL, and Git.

  • Experience in training and validating ML solutions (decision trees, neural nets, regression models).

  • Ability to scale solutions according to infrastructure or business requirements.

  • Good understanding of data lake / lakehouse architecture.

  • Good knowledge of English (C1) (work in an international environment).


Nice to have:

  • Professional experience with recommender systems and NLP.

  • Previous experience in ecommerce data ecosystems.

  • Professional experience with PySpark programming and the Databricks Lakehouse platform ecosystem.

  • Experience in structured streaming and Scala programming.

  • Familiarity with MLOps environments such as mlflow.

WHAT WE OFFER & WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

  • Hybrid or remote work model

Enjoy the flexibility to work either in a hybrid model -with 2 days per week in our Wrocław office (you choose the days) if you’re based locally - or fully remotely from anywhere in Poland.

  • Flexible start to your day

Flexible start times let you plan your working day in a way that fits your schedule.

  • Real benefits you’ll actually use

Enjoy our products your way, for yourself or your loved ones. Plus, a wellbeing platform with access to health programs, webinars and challenges, as well as private medical care (Lux Med) for you and your family and a Multisport card.

  • Office vibes we enjoy

A treadmill under a desk, ping-pong table, popcorn machine, Xbox console or a quick break on a massage mat - small things that make your day better. You’re also welcome to bring your child or pet to the office - we genuinely love having them around 😊

  • Learning & development

Access to language learning (English, German, Polish) via an app, along with a wide range of courses, podcasts and learning tools. You’ll also grow through international projects, collaboration and opportunities for occasional business trips that give you exposure to different teams and perspectives.

  • Eco in action

From Brita water dispensers instead of plastic bottles to eco-friendly document disposal - we focus on everyday habits that make a real difference. We’ve even planted our own Limango tree to support green spaces in Wrocław.

  • Activities and Events

From sports events to team gatherings, company wide events or casual afterwork events in our office - we like to stay active, spend time together and keep things social, in a natural and easy-going way.

We look forward to receiving your application and can't wait to get to know you. Apply now! :)

  • Szkolenia i kursy HUGO BOSS University umożliwiające stały rozwój osobisty oraz profesjonalny.

title: Quality Assurance Supervisor - UniClean
description:
Location Quality Assurance Supervisor

UniClean, a specialized division of UniFirst Corporation, provides cleanroom cleaning and garment services to the pharmaceutical, biotech, semiconductor, electronics, and other controlled environment industries. Our specialized services help customers maintain the strict cleanliness and contamination-control standards required in these critical environments.

As a Quality Assurance Supervisor lead day-to-day quality activities at one of UniClean’s largest processing facilities. Reporting directly to the Director of Quality Assurance & Strategic Projects, this position drives the facility’s quality management system, oversees quality control, and works with Operations to maintain consistent execution of approved processes and customer requirements. The Supervisor ensures that quality decisions are supported by accurate records, effective controls, and clear accountability so the facility can defend its processes and demonstrate product conformity.

Essential Responsibilities

Quality Systems and Compliance

· Maintain the facility’s quality management system in alignment with UniClean procedures, ISO 9001 requirements, and applicable customer and regulatory requirements. Maintain audit readiness through routine floor presence and verification of actual practices.

· Support ISO certification and surveillance audits, including preparation, participation, evidence gathering, responses, and follow-up on findings. Provide facility quality performance and action status for management review.

· Administer controlled procedures, work instructions, forms, and quality records. Verify that current documents are available, records are complete and traceable, and changes receive required review, approval, and training.

· Lead investigations of nonconformances and customer complaints. Manage corrective action requests and corrective and preventive actions through containment, root cause analysis, assigned actions, and documented effectiveness checks.

Quality Control and Product Conformity

· Oversee in-process testing, inspection, sampling, and garment grading against approved methods, specifications, and acceptance criteria. Review results and trends, investigate failures, and verify completion of required follow-up.

· Control nonconforming product through identification, segregation, documented holds, evaluation, and authorized disposition. Verify reinspection or retesting when required and prevent unintended use or shipment.

· Maintain consistent inspection and grading practices. Review defect classifications, garment condition, rejection and loss trends, and disposition records with Operations to improve product quality and grading accuracy.

· Verify that required quality testing equipment is within calibration or verification status and that testing personnel are trained. Escalate conditions that call the reliability of results into question.

Risk Assessment and Process Assurance

· Conduct and maintain process risk assessments, including process failure mode and effects analysis where appropriate. Evaluate changes, recurring defects, and audit findings to identify risks and confirm effective controls.

· Assist the Division Quality team with validation protocols, execution, data review, and report preparation. Review proposed process or equipment changes for quality impact and required documentation before implementation.

Audits and Customer Quality

· Plan and conduct internal audits of facility processes and quality controls. Document objective evidence, communicate findings, track actions to closure, and verify that corrective actions are effective.

· Coordinate and support customer audits and quality visits. Gather records, explain process controls, and prepare accurate responses with the Director of Quality Assurance & Strategic Projects and facility leadership.

· Assist with supplier qualification, supplier audits, and supplier corrective actions as assigned. Evaluate quality concerns involving purchased materials or services and track required follow-up.

· Serve as a facility resource for customer quality questions, complaints, specifications, and quality commitments. Coordinate responses with Quality, Operations, and Service and escalate significant or recurring concerns promptly.

Reporting and Quality Leadership

· Prepare and issue routine customer quality reports, including inspection and grading results, nonconforming product quantities, disposition status, and corrective actions, in accordance with approved reporting requirements.

· Maintain accurate facility quality metrics covering testing, defects, complaints, audit findings, corrective actions, and grading or loss trends. Verify source data, identify adverse trends, and report risks and overdue actions to leadership.

· Coach employees and supervise assigned quality personnel on procedures, inspection methods, documentation, and escalation. Verify training effectiveness and reinforce that records must accurately reflect work performed.

· Work with Operations to resolve quality issues and sustain improvements across shifts. Escalate unresolved risks directly to the Director of Quality Assurance & Strategic Projects and perform other related quality duties as assigned.

Quality Authority and Accountability

Initiate quality holds and request suspension of affected processing or shipment when evidence indicates that product or process requirements may not be met. Notify facility leadership and the Director promptly, document containment, and ensure release or disposition occurs only through authorized personnel under approved procedures. Maintain independent quality judgment and escalate unresolved concerns. Responsibility for process execution remains with the applicable operational owners.

title: Software Development Team Lead
description:
Title: Software Development Team Lead
Reports to: Associate Director, DevOps
Department: DevOps
Location: Kyiv, Ukraine – Remote

About Atlas Technica

Atlas Technica’s mission is to shoulder IT management, user support, and cybersecurity for our clients, who are hedge funds and other investment firms. Founded in 2016, we have grown year over year through our uncompromising focus on service.

We value ownership, execution, growth, intelligence, and camaraderie. We are looking for people who share our Core Values, thrive, and contribute to this environment while putting the customer first. At Atlas Technica, we offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and great perks to our global Team. We strive to maintain a professional yet friendly environment while promoting professional and career development for our Team Members. Join Atlas Technica now!

Position Overview

We are seeking a Software Development Team Lead to lead a multidisciplinary team of full-stack and AI engineers supporting Atlas Technica’s internal software products. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for team development, software architecture, engineering standards, technical delivery, and the responsible adoption of AI across both our products and software development practices.

The Software Development Team Lead will set technical direction, guide architecture and system design, establish engineering standards, and help the team navigate complex technical decisions. This individual will work closely with Product, Project Management, Business Analysis, and other stakeholders to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.

The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering and architecture expertise with people leadership, sound technical judgment, and practical experience delivering production AI solutions. This leader should be equally comfortable coaching engineers, reviewing architecture, solving complex technical problems, and establishing responsible AI practices that improve both product capabilities and engineering effectiveness.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of full-stack and AI engineers, establishing clear expectations and fostering ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence
  • Partner closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements and priorities into effective technical delivery
  • Set technical direction and provide architectural leadership across software products, including system design, data architecture, integrations, scalability, and engineering governance
  • Lead architecture and technical-design reviews, evaluate engineering proposals, guide technical trade-offs, and remove complex technical barriers for the development team
  • Establish and continuously improve architecture standards, development practices, coding standards, technical guidelines, reference architectures, and reusable engineering patterns
  • Mentor engineers on software architecture, technical decision-making, code quality, system design, security, maintainability, and engineering best practices
  • Drive the responsible adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, review, documentation, and CI/CD, while evaluating impact on productivity and quality
  • Provide technical leadership for production AI solutions, including selection of appropriate models, providers, platforms, infrastructure, and integration approaches based on business, security, performance, latency, and cost requirements
  • Define AI evaluation approaches, quality metrics, monitoring, observability, feedback loops, and safeguards that support reliable and measurable production performance
  • Establish appropriate security, privacy, governance, and human-review controls for AI systems, including mitigation of risks such as hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and unpredictable behavior
  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, technical standards, reusable AI patterns, and engineering guidance that support consistent delivery and future team growth
  • Collaborate across technical and business teams to align priorities, data ownership, architectural standards, dependencies, and outcomes while continuously improving development processes and technology capabilities

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on development experience with modern production applications
  • 5+ years of full-stack software engineering experience using technologies such as ASP.NET/C# with React, Angular, or comparable modern frontend frameworks
  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Software Architect, Solution Architect, Principal Engineer, or comparable technical-leadership level
  • 2+ years of experience leading a software engineering team or serving in a comparable people and technical leadership role
  • Demonstrated experience delivering production AI solutions beyond proof-of-concept or prototype environments
  • Experience designing AI agents, tool-calling workflows, multi-step orchestration, or other production agentic systems
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major LLM or AI platform such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or Azure OpenAI
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, asynchronous processing, event-driven architecture, APIs, SQL and NoSQL databases, and enterprise integration patterns
  • Strong backend engineering and architecture experience with the ability to integrate AI capabilities into complex existing systems
  • Demonstrated ability to establish technical standards, evaluate architecture decisions, and guide engineers through complex technical trade-offs
  • Strong people-leadership and coaching skills with the ability to create alignment, provide actionable feedback, develop engineers, and build a collaborative and high-performing team
  • Experience working directly with senior technical stakeholders and communicating complex technical concepts, risks, and recommendations clearly
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Desirable Qualities:

  • Experience designing and delivering systems involving sensitive, confidential, or regulated data
  • Experience implementing human-in-the-loop AI workflows and determining when automation or autonomous behavior is appropriate
  • Experience defining technical or architecture standards across multiple engineering teams or products
  • Strong knowledge of security, privacy, identity, access control, and data-governance considerations within AI-enabled systems
  • Experience architecting enterprise AI solutions involving copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), document intelligence, conversational AI, workflow automation, or multi-agent systems
  • Experience designing AI agents involving tool calling, memory, orchestration, evaluation, and human-review controls
  • Microsoft Azure, AI, software-development, Anthropic, or other relevant technical certifications
  • Experience measuring the impact of AI-assisted software-development practices on engineering productivity, quality, or delivery performance

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Operations Team Manager
description:
Operations Team Manager

Location: Hybrid Peterborough

Department: Insurance Customer Operations

Contract type: Permanent / Full-time

About Us

The fleet accident management specialists. We help the UK’s best-known businesses keep their vehicles moving year-round, with swift incident response, end-to-end claims management, and market-leading vehicle repair.

Our Intervention team speaks to third parties involved in incidents with our customers’ vehicles. Where the third party is not at fault, the team offers them our accident management service at no cost to them: claims handling, a replacement vehicle and repair, with costs recovered from the at-fault insurer.

About the role

You will lead the Intervention team day to day. You will make sure the team contacts third parties quickly, explains our service clearly and honestly, and converts the right cases into managed claims. You will balance conversion with good customer outcomes and full compliance, and you will own the team’s results, quality and development.

Key responsibilities

Leading the team

▪ Manage, coach and motivate the team through regular one-to-ones, call reviews and team huddles.

▪ Set clear individual targets and hold team members to account for performance, quality and conduct.

▪ Recruit, induct and train new team members, working with Learning and Development on training plans.

▪ Handle absence, performance and conduct matters in line with Activate Group people policies.

▪ Build a team culture that lives our values: Make it happen, Strive for better and Win together.

Sales performance

▪ Deliver daily, weekly and monthly targets for contact rate, conversion and claims volume.

▪ Plan resourcing and rotas so the team reaches new third-party leads fast, while the incident is fresh.

▪ Analyse call and lead data to spot where cases are lost, then fix scripts, processes or skills.

▪ Share good practice and the strongest calls across the team.

Customer outcomes and compliance

▪ Make sure team members describe the service accurately, including what “no cost to you” means and when it applies.

▪ Keep the team working within Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) claims management rules, Consumer Duty, data protection and contact rules.

▪ Make sure team members recognise and support vulnerable customers and never apply pressure to sign up.

▪ Run quality assurance on calls and case notes, act on findings and keep evidence ready for audit.

▪ Own complaints and escalations from third parties and resolve them within agreed timescales.

Operations and stakeholders

▪ Produce performance reports for the Head of Insurance Customer Operations and the senior leadership team.

▪ Work with the claims, repair and replacement vehicle teams so each converted case hands over cleanly.

▪ Work with fleet customers’ account managers on lead flow, data quality and service levels.

▪ Propose and lead process improvements and raise system or data changes through the right IT route.

Skills and experience

Essential

▪ At least two years managing a sales, contact centre or telephone-based team against targets.

▪ A record of hitting conversion targets without compromising customer outcomes.

▪ Confidence using performance data to coach people and make decisions.

▪ Clear, persuasive communication, written and spoken.

Desirable

▪ Experience in accident management, credit hire, motor claims or insurance.

▪ Knowledge of Consumer Duty and how to treat vulnerable customers.

▪ Experience with dialler, telephony and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.

▪ A recognised management or coaching qualification.

Benefits

We believe in rewarding our people for the great work they do. When you join Activate Group, you can expect:

• 33 days holiday, including bank holidays

• Personal health cash plan – claim back the cost of everyday healthcare such as dental and optical check-ups

• Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental pay

• Life assurance at three times your basic salary

• Free breakfasts and fresh fruit

• A birthday surprise for everyone


What you can expect from us

At Activate Group, we want everyone to have the tools and support they need to do their best work. We’re an innovative business that continuously reviews and improves our systems, processes and ways of working, making sure they support our teams to do their jobs effectively.

Every role at Activate Group is aligned to our wider business vision and purpose – making someone’s bad day better. You’ll understand how your role contributes to the bigger picture and how your work helps deliver excellent outcomes for customer and partners.

We believe work should be enjoyable. We make time to celebrate success, recognise achievements and bring people together at team events and company-wide celebrations. We’ll also support your ongoing development through regular feedback and career planning.

Whether you’re based in one of our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough or Huddersfield, working at an Activate Accident Repair (AAR) site, or working from home, you’ll be part of a supportive culture where people are encouraged to succeed.


A bit about us

Activate Group is a fast-growing business approaching 1,000 team members nationwide.

We work with some of the UK’s largest fleets and insurance companies, supporting drivers that have been involved in road incidents through our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough and Huddersfield.

We manage every step of the repair journey - repairing vehicles at our own Activate Accident Repair (AAR) body shops, as well as through a UK-wide network of trusted independent repair partners.

We also work with the UK’s largest vehicle manufacturers, supporting their approved repair programmes, and deliver innovative technology solutions to fleets, vehicle repair centres and dealerships.

Our purpose & values

Our purpose underpins everything we do: Make someone’s bad day better

Our values define how we work with our team members, customers and suppliers:

•Make it happen – Be accountable. Take the initiative, work fast, and do a great job.

• Strive for better– Be bold. Challenge the norm - make small improvements often.

• Win together– Be a team player. Win together, learn together, respect each other.

  • Utrzymanie Veeam, kontrola kopii zapasowych i testy odtwarzania usług oraz danych zgodnie z ustalonymi celami RPO i RTO.

  • Diagnozowanie incydentów eskalowanych przez Helpdesk, analiza logów i przyczyn awarii oraz wdrażanie działań zapobiegających ich powrotom.

  • Automatyzacja zadań w PowerShell, aktualizacja i utwardzanie konfiguracji systemów oraz wdrażanie środków bezpieczeństwa wspólnie z zespołem.

  • Planowanie zmian i migracji, przygotowanie testów oraz planów wycofania, a także dokumentowanie rozwiązań i współpraca z dostawcami.

Opis wymagań

  • Co najmniej 3 lata praktyki w administracji środowiskiem produkcyjnym oraz doświadczenie w samodzielnym rozwiązywaniu incydentów i wdrażaniu zmian.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość Windows Server i Active Directory: GPO, DNS, DHCP, uprawnienia, diagnozowanie problemów z uwierzytelnianiem i replikacją.

  • Praktyczne doświadczenie z Microsoft 365, Entra ID i Exchange Online oraz wdrażaniem polityk w Intune i mechanizmów ochrony Microsoft Defender.

  • Umiejętność administrowania środowiskiem VMware vSphere, w tym ESXi, vCenter, maszynami wirtualnymi i mechanizmami HA.

  • Doświadczenie z Veeam i rzeczywistym odtwarzaniem danych lub usług; rozumienie retencji, izolacji kopii oraz różnicy między snapshotem a backupem.

  • Umiejętność pisania i utrzymywania skryptów PowerShell oraz praktyczna znajomość zasad najmniejszych uprawnień, MFA i zarządzania aktualizacjami.

  • Rozumienie zależności systemów od sieci TCP/IP, DNS, routingu i reguł firewall; umiejętność współpracy z administratorami sieci przy diagnostyce.

  • Samodzielność, dokumentowanie pracy i dzielenie się wiedzą; angielski pozwalający korzystać z dokumentacji i prowadzić zgłoszenia do wsparcia producenta.

Dodatkowym atutem będzie:

  • Doświadczenie w pracy ze środowiskami HCI opartymi na VMware vSAN lub innych technologiach, w migracji środowisk oraz w przeprowadzaniu testów odtwarzania po awarii.

  • Administracja systemami Linux, znajomość macierzy NetApp lub infrastruktury serwerowej Cisco UCS.

  • Praktyka w monitoringu i centralnej analizie logów, korzystaniu z Git lub automatyzacji przez API.

  • Udział we wdrażaniu technicznych środków bezpieczeństwa związanych z NIS2 oraz certyfikaty Microsoft, VMware lub Veeam.

W Centrum Usług Informatycznych Politechniki Gdańskiej utrzymujemy i rozwijamy usługi, z których korzystają studenci, naukowcy i administracja uczelni. Szukamy osoby, która potrafi samodzielnie diagnozować złożone problemy, bezpiecznie wdrażać zmiany i usprawniać codzienną pracę przez automatyzację. Dołączysz do zespołu pracującego nad modernizacją infrastruktury, bezpieczeństwem tożsamości i odpornością usług. Szukamy osoby na poziomie Senior lub doświadczonego Mida. Poziom stanowiska i wynagrodzenie dopasujemy do potwierdzonych kompetencji oraz zakresu odpowiedzialności.

Oferujemy

title: Regional Business Support Specialist
description:
Wynagrodzenie
umowa o pracę: 10750 – 14000 PLN / mies. brutto

Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

Your career opportunity

The Regional Business Support Specialist will join the RBS team in Cracow, providing support for the processing of credit transactions and related administrative activities for HSBC businesses across multiple European countries. The role is integral to supporting Relationship Management teams across Europe with credit-related activities.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct periodic credit reviews for an assigned portfolio of large corporate clients, including financial analysis and modelling, and assessment of industry dynamics, competitors, and market and environmental risks.

  • Support Relationship Managers (RMs) in processing credit transactions, including credit administration and related activities.

  • Assist RMs in monitoring financial covenants and compliance with approval conditions.

  • Co-ordinate with Credit Operations on limit set-up, drawdowns, satisfaction of approval conditions, and collateral/security monitoring.

  • Participate in client meetings and conferences as required.

  • Deliver additional role-related tasks as requested by RMs and/or the Line Manager.

  • Liaise with customers and/or loan agents, to obtain information and resolve related queries.

  • Ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Work with teams across HSBC to ensure timely completion of all required activities.

What you need to have to succeed in this role

  • University degree in one of the following fields: Banking, Finance, Accountancy or Economics.

  • Solid experience in financial analysis, financial modelling and credit risk assessment.

  • Experience with financial and risk tools and ad-hoc client queries.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Demonstrated commitment to high-quality delivery, with a professional, appropriately critical mindset and the ability to maintain excellent service standards for internal and external clients.

  • Eye for detail, result-oriented and like to work pro-actively.

  • Strong analytical capability, able to multi-task and manage multiple applications concurrently.

What we offer

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits covering healthcare, family friendly leaves, pension and life assurance, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

  • Additional bonuses for recognition awards

  • Multisport card

  • Private medical care

  • Life insurance

  • One-time reimbursement of home office set-up (up to 800 PLN).

  • Cafeteria platform

  • Employee assistance program

  • Additional contributions to PPK scheme

  • Corporate parties & events

  • CSR initiatives

  • Nursery discounts

  • Financial support with trainings and education

  • Social fund

  • Flexible working hours

  • Free parking

  • Online behavioural test

  • Telephone screen

  • Interview with the hiring manager

title: ERP Platform Expert
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Job Description

About the Role

The Cloud ERP Platform Expert is responsible for the implementation, operation, and continuous evolution of Haleon’s global ERP platform across SAP RISE, SAP BTP, Azure, PaaS, and SaaS ecosystems. The role ensures that the ERP estate is secure, resilient, compliant, and highly available, enabling critical business operations and transformation initiatives.

Working across the full ERP technology stack - Applications, SAP Basis, Databases, Operating Systems, Cloud Infrastructure, and Security - the individual will lead platform governance, operational excellence, modernization, vulnerability management, and lifecycle management while partnering with internal teams and strategic service providers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for end-to-end implementation and operation of Haleon’s ERP platforms across SAP RISE, BTP, Azure, and hybrid landscapes.

  • Execute Haleon’s SAP BTP strategy, governance, and adoption roadmap, including services such as Integration Suite, HANA Cloud, Build, Signavio, Event Mesh, and Cloud ALM.

  • Lead SAP Basis, BTP, database (Oracle/HANA), OS, and infrastructure administration activities for a large-scale global ERP estate.

  • Ensure platform availability, performance, capacity, security, and disaster recovery readiness.

  • Drive platform patching, upgrade, migration, and refresh activities.

  • Lead vulnerability remediation and security hardening across the ERP technical stack.

  • Ensure compliance with SOX, ITGC, audit, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements from ERP platform standpoint.

  • Govern change, release, incident, and problem management processes for ERP landscape.

  • Manage partners and service providers to deliver operational excellence.

  • Act as escalation point for critical production and business-impacting incidents.

Required Experience & Skills

Technical Expertise

  • SAP ECC, S/4HANA (RISE), BW/BW4HANA, APO, PI/PO, Solution Manager, GRC, MDG, ILM, PLM, BFC, FIM, BODS, ATTP, and SAP Java Stack platforms.

  • SAP BTP administration, governance, security, and operations.

  • Azure cloud hosting and hybrid ERP architectures.

  • Oracle and SAP HANA database administration and performance tuning.

  • Integration with enterprise platforms including Celonis, OpenText, Loftware, Salesforce, Ariba, Concur, Fieldglass, and IBP.

Professional Experience

  • 10+ years of Proven experience managing large global ERP estates (100+ instances).

  • Strong background in SAP cloud transformations, ERP migrations, and platform modernization programs.

  • Expertise in ERP security, resilience, compliance, and operational governance.

  • Experience working with globally distributed teams and managed service providers.

  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.

  • Proven ability to manage complex escalations and influence Director, VP, and senior leadership stakeholders.

  • Experience within pharmaceutical or other regulated industries preferred.

Success in This Role

Implement and operate a secure, resilient, compliant, and future-ready ERP platform that accelerates business value, enables cloud transformation, and ensures reliable operations across Haleon’s global ERP landscape.

Job Posting End Date

2026-11-09

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 20000 – 30000 PLN / mies. netto

Synerise is not just another tech company. It is a space where our brilliant team consequently brings technology change to the business world and instead of following known paths, we are creating a new one – a next-generation, fully personalized and AI-driven customer experience.

We successfully deliver an all-in-one tool - Synerise (YouTube link). An ever-evolving behavioral data platform, enhanced by AI to generate outstanding ROI in more than 30 markets for industry leaders in Retail, Banking, eCommerce, Automotive, Insurance, and Telco, processing more than 150 billion transactions annually. However, we don't limit ourselves solely to this solution. We're building BaseModel (website link) - a foundation model for behavioral data embedded within a novel platform for enterprise Data Science teams, that is another step on our path to create innovation in AI and demonstrate its potential for the business world.

‍

Having such great solutions, we are looking for a highly motivated Cloud Security Specialist to join our brave and brilliant Synerise Team. See if you fit our diverse and dynamic environment, where we constantly evolve together with the growth of our clients.


‍

What will you do on a daily basis?


  • Monitor and secure cloud environments, primarily on Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), leveraging their built-in security tools and mechanisms and implement custom tools and controls for self-hosted components based on IaaS.

  • Implement and manage security measures for containerized platforms using Kubernetes and Docker, focusing on microservices-based architectures.

  • Design, implement, and maintain DevSecOps solutions in CI/CD pipelines, integrating tools for: code security analysis; vulnerability management and software composition analysis (SCA); security testing for applications and infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to embed “security by design” principles throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Conduct security audits, including regular penetration tests and vulnerability scans, for both applications and infrastructure.

  • Analyze security incidents, perform root cause investigations, and implement remediation strategies.

  • Develop, implement, and maintain security policies and standards based on best practices (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks).

  • Provide education and training for teams on application and infrastructure security.

‍

What will make us a perfect match?


  • At least 3 years of experience in IT security, with a focus on cloud-native environments.

  • In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes security (e.g., RBAC, network policies, pod security standards) and hands-on experience managing microservices architectures.

  • Proven experience implementing DevSecOps solutions, including: securing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI/CD, ArgoCD); using tools for code security and vulnerability scanning; automating security processes for application risk management.

  • Strong expertise in Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) security features and tools (e.g., Azure Security Center, Google Cloud Security Command Center).

  • Strong understanding of security threats and attack techniques relevant to containerized and cloud-native environments.

  • Proficiency with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) to automate security processes.

  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Elastic Stack, Prometheus, Grafana).

  • Knowledge of security frameworks and best practices (e.g., OWASP SAMM, NIST CSF) and compliance regulations (e.g., GDPR).

  • Preferred certifications: CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), CISSP, Azure/GCP Security Specialty, CEH, or similar.

  • Fluency in Polish (C2) and English (C1).

You will work closely with stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive vendor risk frameworks, aligning security controls with regulatory requirements and emerging threat landscapes.
