title: Trainee Solicitor
description:
Annan House

Staff

COMPANY OVERVIEW

EnQuest is an independent oil and gas company, recognised for its expertise in maximising the value of mature and underinvested hydrocarbon assets. The Group is focused on sustainably extending field life and unlocking value across the asset lifecycle. EnQuest’s operations are centred in the UK and Southeast Asia, with transformational growth across both regions representing a core strategic priority. As a key player supporting a pragmatic and responsible energy transition in the UK, EnQuest is advancing the transformation of the Sullom Voe Terminal on Shetland into a major decarbonisation and renewable energy hub.

Fundamental to EnQuest’s success to date is our greatest asset, our people. Their talent, expertise, knowledge, and commitment have delivered remarkable results, and we continue to look for the same attributes in prospective employees as we pursue plans for further development across our global operations.

At EnQuest, we support a diverse and inclusive workplace and continually look to improve and develop our culture. We are respectful and open with others, valuing the diversity of all our people and listening to the views they bring. Our focus on diversity and inclusion makes our performance stronger and enhances our business.

The successful candidate will become part of a progressive, innovative and ambitious organisation that holds a distinct set of values based on respect for the individual. As well as having the opportunity to pursue your goals and achieve your ambitions, you will be encouraged to contribute fresh ideas and take on new challenges that test your abilities and elevate your performance to new levels.

The legal traineeship programme lasts two years in order to provide the practical experience and professional development required to qualify as a solicitor in Scotland.

THE ROLE

The Trainee Solicitor will form part of EnQuest's Legal & Commercial team, supporting a wide range of legal and commercial activities and ensuring advice and support is delivered to the wider business on time and to a high standard.

This exciting opportunity will provide exposure across a range of legal and commercial work, including support to operations, drafting, reviewing and analysing upstream agreements (such as joint operating agreements and decommissioning security agreements) and supply chain contracts, dispute resolution and HSEA matters.

The role is based in Aberdeen and will involve collaborating with employees and stakeholders primarily across our UK operations, providing an excellent foundation for a long-term career in a legal environment.

The successful candidate will be given the opportunity to contribute to key people initiatives and projects, helping to support business performance while developing the skills, knowledge, and experience required to become a legal professional.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER

  • During the two-year traineeship, we will provide structured on-the-job training and opportunities to develop practical knowledge and broader business understanding across the organisation.
  • Throughout the programme, group learning and personal coaching will be provided to help develop competence, confidence, and personal effectiveness. The programme includes a structured series of modules aligned to the EnQuest Values and incorporates interactive learning events, behavioural development training, and 1:1 coaching.
  • A strong mentoring culture, with an assigned mentor to support personal and professional development together with supervision from the wider Legal & Commercial team to provide learning opportunities throughout the traineeship.
  • Exposure to a broad range of activities and projects that will help build a well-rounded understanding of the legal and commercial work undertaken by a solicitor forming part of an in-house legal and commercial team of an independent energy company.
  • Based in our Aberdeen office, with opportunities to visit operational sites and engage with employees across the business.
  • Competitive benefits package including 33 days holiday, private medical insurance, company pension, and life assurance.
  • Flexible working culture, including hybrid working arrangements, noting that learning from the expertise of colleagues is an important part of a trainee’s development and the best place to learn from colleagues is within the office environment.
  • Support towards providing the professional development and practical experience required to qualify as a solicitor.
  • Potential secondment within a law firm (still based in Aberdeen) for a period of time.

We are looking for high-achieving candidates with a desire to learn. The ideal candidate should enjoy problem solving, detailed analysis, be willing to be trusted with meaningful work and embrace new ideas and take on projects where the approach or solution isn’t known from the outset.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We are looking for talented individuals who are passionate about developing a career as a solicitor in an in-house legal environment.

We are making a significant investment in our future talent and are looking for individuals who demonstrate professional ability, curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a genuine interest in people, organisational culture, and employee development.
  • Enjoy building relationships and working collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Possess strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with confidential information.
  • Demonstrate strong organisational and planning skills.
  • Show initiative and be comfortable taking ownership of tasks and projects.
  • Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Display a growth mindset and a desire for continuous learning and development.
  • Demonstrate agility and adaptability, embracing change and thriving in a fast-paced environment where priorities, challenges, and opportunities can shift quickly.

TRAINEE REQUIREMENTS

  • LLB in Scots Law (or equivalent qualification).
  • Diploma in Legal Practice (or equivalent qualification).
  • An Entrance Certificate from the Law Society of Scotland (or equivalent).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building capabilities.
  • High levels of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Ability to work effectively, both independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility, adaptability, and a positive attitude towards learning and development.
  • A strong commitment to developing a long-term career within a legal environment.

ELIGIBILITY

Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.

OUR APPLICATION PROCESS

Interviews and assessments are designed to measure your skills for success, while also providing you with an understanding of the graduate programme, our company, and the role itself. You will have plenty of opportunity to ask questions throughout the process.

Application Stages

  • Online application via our Careers Portal - Careers (myworkdayjobs.com)
  • Interview with Business and HR Stakeholders (early 2027)
  • Group Assessment Centre (following above interview)

WHY JOIN ENQUEST?

At EnQuest, you'll have the opportunity to build your career in a business that values its people, encourages innovation, and supports professional growth.

Join us and be part of our journey as we support the energy transition and develop the talent that will drive our future success!

CLOSING DATE FOR APPLICATIONS: 31 DECEMBER 2026

  • Pełnienie roli eksperta technologicznego i mentora dla zespołów HD/BI.

title: Senior Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Engineer
description:
Wynagrodzenie

Hello,
We are called People More because we treat our employees with respect, but also because the projects we work on are for people and should be easy and pleasant to use. We are technological, but we look at the bigger picture :)
The company is made up of people with a huge client base in the country and abroad, for whom we build projects from scratch (UX, UI, frontend, backend, mobile) or in part. We work directly for our clients and also support our partners in their own solutions. This ensures a wide range of projects and the ability to change! We work with clients all over the world.
For the project that we are working on with our partner, we are looking for Senior Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Engineer.

Your duties will include:

  • Design and build scalable Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions for business teams operating across different markets.

  • Lead the design of integrations between Dynamics 365, enterprise systems and Azure services.

  • Take a leading role in platform upgrades, migrations and modernisation projects.

  • Mentor engineers, share knowledge and support the adoption of high-quality development practices.

  • Explore and promote the use of AI tools in everyday engineering work.

  • Contribute to architecture reviews, technical discussions and technology community initiatives.

Requirements that must be met:

  • At least 5 years of experience developing Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions.

  • Hands-on experience with Power Platform, Dataverse and Azure services, particularly Azure Functions and Azure Service Bus.

  • Experience designing and delivering end-to-end Dynamics 365 implementations.

  • Strong knowledge of C#, .NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, and SQL.

  • Familiarity with modern DevOps practices and Agile ways of working.

  • Ability to make sound technical decisions and take responsibility for their outcomes.

  • A collaborative approach and a willingness to mentor and support other engineers.

  • Practical experience using AI tools in software engineering workflows.

  • Very good English and Polish

Nice to have:

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications.

  • Experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.

  • Knowledge of Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis or Apache Kafka.

  • Experience working in large enterprise environments.

What we offer:

  • We are open and honest and we solve problems instead of generating them.

  • Maybe it’s obvious, but we really respect our employees and associates. We used to be software developers, too, and we appreciate that job!

  • A small team

  • An international working environment and international projects

  • Private medical care

  • Sports card

  • Training courses

  • Work that is 100% remote (unless you prefer another system)

We have an office in Krakow, but if you like to work remotely, that’s absolutely fine. We are OK with fully remote work. For us, you can be located anywhere. :)

Why it’s a good idea to work with People More?

  • If you are not satisfied with your work or your tasks, we’ll find a way out together!

  • If you get bored, we will offer you a new product and new, fascinating tasks

  • We will work on your brand together: you will get an opportunity to attend conferences, including as a speaker, and we will help you publish in recognized magazines and online

  • We will facilitate your access to challenges that are usually difficult to get

  • At any time, you can talk directly to the board of People More—we talk your language because the company’s founders are software developers and designers!

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A friendly remote initial interview

  • A remote technical talk

  • The decision to work together!

title: Product Manager, API & Maps
description:
Vaisala is a global leader in measurement instruments and intelligence helping industries, nations, people, and the planet to thrive. From predicting hurricanes to optimizing renewable energy production, our technology is used where it matters the most – from data centers, windfarms and laboratories to airports, the Arctic and even the surface of Mars. For a second year running, Vaisala got recognized in TIME Magazine's World's Best Companies in Sustainable Growth 2026 study. Our team of close to 2,500 experts and 62 nationalities around the world is committed to taking every measure for the planet. Driven by our shared purpose, curiosity, and pioneering spirit, we stay ahead and make a difference. At Vaisala, you don't have to fit in to belong.

Our employees demonstrate, uphold, support, and model the Vaisala Values: Customer Focus, Innovation & Renewal, Strong Together and Integrity. Sharing strong and common values is part of our culture and enables us to work towards our shared mission.

Vaisala Xweather helps organizations integrate weather intelligence into their applications and operations. By combining local sensor data with advanced AI predictions, we deliver precise and actionable weather insights. We transform weather challenges into opportunities and build resilience against severe weather and climate change.

As Technical Product Manager for API & Maps, you’ll own the product strategy and roadmap for our Weather API and mapping products, including SDKs and the developer experience. You’ll work with customers, engineering, and commercial teams to identify opportunities, set priorities, and drive adoption and revenue growth. AI is a key strategic focus: you’ll shape how our services are discovered, integrated, and consumed through AI-assisted development, AI applications, and agent workflows.

This is a hybrid-based position out of our Minneapolis, Minnesota office.

What you’ll do:

  • Own strategy and the roadmap. Use customer research, market insight, and business priorities to define product direction, differentiation, and investment decisions.

  • Lead customer discovery. Understand customer workflows and business needs. Confidently discuss capabilities, limitations, and integration approaches with developers and technical stakeholders.

  • Shape the AI strategy for API and Maps. Identify how AI changes customer needs and service consumption. Prioritize opportunities based on customer value, feasibility, reliability, and economics.

  • Drive growth through data. Independently analyze usage and revenue data. Partner with marketing and engineering to improve activation, paid conversion, retention, and expansion.

  • Shape pricing and packaging. Work with commercial teams on positioning, usage-based pricing, and monetization opportunities that support sustainable growth.

  • Turn priorities into delivery. Define problems, requirements, and success measures. Partner with engineering on scope and tradeoffs across new capabilities, performance, reliability, and compatibility.

  • Improve the developer experience. Prioritize onboarding, documentation, examples, and integration improvements that help customers move from evaluation to production.

  • Manage the product lifecycle. Lead launches, API version transitions, deprecations, and sunset decisions, including customer communication and migration plans for the installed base. Evaluate outcomes and adjust priorities based on evidence.

What you’ll bring:

  • 3+ years as a product manager for technical products, where you owned the roadmap and were accountable for its business results.

  • Practical API fluency, including REST, HTTP, JSON, authentication, errors, and rate limits. Ability to test requests, inspect responses, and understand integration workflows and code examples.

  • Ability to independently query and analyze usage and revenue data using SQL or comparable tools, and turn findings into decisions.

  • Understanding of product-led growth, including free tiers, trial-to-paid conversion, usage-based pricing, retention, and expansion.

  • Practical familiarity with AI-assisted development and AI applications that consume APIs or data services, and the ability to translate those changes into product priorities.

  • Strong customer discovery, technical communication, and written requirements skills, with sound judgment, organization, and follow-through.

  • Availability to collaborate with US-based engineering teams and customers during core US business hours.

  • Relevant experience may come from product management or another technical role with substantial product ownership.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience launching AI-powered products or capabilities, including evaluating quality, cost, adoption, and monetization.

  • Mapping or geospatial experience, including layers, tiles, coordinates, raster or vector data, or libraries such as Mapbox, MapLibre, Google Maps, or Leaflet.

  • Experience with developer platforms, SDKs, or technical B2B products, including successful growth experiments or pricing and packaging changes.

  • Ability to adapt JavaScript or Python examples, or experience developing web or mobile applications.

  • Familiarity with weather or environmental data and applications that depend on timely, reliable information.

What success looks like:

  • A clear strategy and focused roadmap, trusted customer relationships, and measurable improvements in integration success, adoption, paid conversion, retention, and revenue growth.

  • AI investments address demonstrated customer needs and produce meaningful product and business value.

ANTICIPATED SALARY RANGE: $110,000 - $125,000 base salary with our annual Xweather STI bonus plan (on top of base compensation). Salary is determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Additionally, we offer our employees a competitive benefits package which is outlined below. Please note that applications sent via email cannot be processed due to privacy reasons.

What we offer:

Our benefits package includes: health, dental, and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, company paid life, long and short term disability, 401(K) plan with company match, a variety of voluntary benefits programs, Employee Assistance Programs, and tuition reimbursement. We also offer holiday pay and a generous paid time off plan.

To be considered for this position you must currently be eligible to work in the U.S. Vaisala participates in the E-Verify employment verification system. Candidates are subject to a complete background check prior to an offer being extended.

EOE Veteran/Disability

Vaisala is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons in all facets of employment. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to any legally protected status.

Reasonable Accommodation Notice

Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. As a government contractor, Vaisala complies with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (the Act), which is a law that prohibits federal contractors and subcontractors from discriminating in employment against individuals with disabilities and requires employers take affirmative action to recruit, hire, promote, and retain these individuals.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application for a recognized disability under applicable law, please contact Human Resources by phone at 303-499-1701 or by email at ushr@vaisala.com. Please note that you can easily submit application by attaching your LinkedIn profile in the recruitment tool (LinkedIn Apply functionality).

title: IT Support Manager - Technical Senior (Paris)
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 22800 – 31200 PLN / mies. netto

The office is located in Paris, France.

Ideal candidate would be the one to relocate to Paris. We could establish hybrid mode during trial period, but long term this job is with relocation to Paris being sponsored by the company.

The Workplace Operations Manager is responsible for the full range of end-user services (workplace, mobility,

collaboration, telephony, user experience), coordinates internal and external teams, manages suppliers, and applies

the standards defined by the Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams.

MAIN ACTIVITIES

User support and service management

  • Manage user support activity (internal and external) and ensure the quality of service delivered.

  • Supervise, coach, and develop the skills of the support teams.

  • Oversee incident, request, and problem management, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met.

  • Contribute to resolving major incidents and coordinate actions with the various IT teams.

  • Foster a service-oriented culture centered on proximity and user satisfaction.

  • Ensure regular communication with users on major incidents, maintenance operations, service changes, and best practices.

  • Serve as the IT Department’s primary point of contact for Digital Workplace services and ensure an excellent relationship with business teams.

Operational maintenance (run)

  • Ensure the availability, performance, and service quality of the entire Digital Workplace ecosystem: Windows and macOS, workstations, Mobility (smartphones, tablets), Microsoft 365, Collaboration tools (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online), Fixed and mobile telephony, Printing and peripherals; User identity management in collaboration with the infrastructure teams

  • Manage operational maintenance activities by coordinating internal teams, partners, and service providers.

  • Track critical incidents, recurring problems, and the associated improvement plans.

  • Ensure proper management of the IT estate (hardware and software), stock, licenses, and equipment lifecycle.

  • Oversee hardware renewals and optimize operating costs.

Technical governance and cross-functional coordination

  • Maintain an overall view of the workplace ecosystem and its dependencies with infrastructure, business applications, and cloud services.

  • Work closely with the Infrastructure, Network, Cybersecurity, Applications, and business teams to ensure service consistency.

  • Roll out and implement the technical standards, recommendations, and security requirements defined by the Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams.

  • Ensure ongoing compliance of workstations and user services (Intune, Microsoft 365, Defender, security policies, encryption, MFA, etc.).

  • Manage the suppliers and partners operating within the Digital Workplace scope and ensure their commitments are met.

Collaboration and telephony

  • Ensure the operational maintenance of Microsoft 365 collaboration services (Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive).

  • Ensure the proper functioning of fixed-line, mobile, and Teams telephony solutions.

  • Support the evolution of collaborative usage and promote adoption of new tools.

  • Oversee the management of Microsoft 365 licenses and collaboration services.

Continuous improvement and service evolution

  • Define and steer the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with the IT strategy.

  • Identify opportunities for process automation, standardization, and simplification.

  • Implement performance indicators (SLAs, KPIs, user satisfaction, service quality, availability).

  • Provide regular reporting to the IT Department.

  • Manage improvement projects covering the workplace, collaboration, mobility, and telephony.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
About Givzey | Version2.ai

Givzey | is a fully remote, AI-native company that created the Autonomous Fundraising category in 2024, when it researched, developed, and deployed the world’s first Autonomous AI to address the labor shortage and capacity gap in nonprofit fundraising. Fundraising teams have a finite capacity to reach donors with one-to-one communication, on average leaving 97% of donors to their organization receiving only marketing communications. A labor shortage compounds the problem: even when organizations want to hire more fundraisers, they often can't find them. The result is a significant capacity gap, where teams can't reach large pools of high-potential donors, resulting in important organizations with world-changing missions being unable to fully execute on their visions.

Version2.ai's Virtual Engagement Officers (VEOs) close the labor shortage gap with each VEO independently managing a portfolio of up to 1,000 donors, delivering personalized outreach through text, email, video, and robotically handwritten notes year-round. VEOs don't just make staff more efficient; they manage donor portfolios independently, freeing human fundraisers to focus their time on the highest-value relationships while also closing transformational revenue for these organizations.

VEOs have already generated over $20M in fundraising revenue to date, including individual gifts as large as $100,000, at an opt-out rate of just 0.07%. Organizations deploying a VEO see 4x annual ROI on average, and the top 20% see 8x or higher. More than 250 VEOs are now deployed across higher education, healthcare, and nonprofit organizations in the U.S. and Canada, including UNICEF USA, Bucknell University, Wake Forest University, and William & Mary.

Adam Martel founded Givzey four years ago and leads the company as CEO. He previously founded, scaled, and sold Gravyty, the first company to develop and sell AI-first solutions to nonprofit organizations.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Applied AI Engineer to lead the technical design and delivery of high-impact AI initiatives across our products.

This is a senior individual contributor and technical leadership role for an experienced software engineer with deep expertise in building production AI systems. You'll lead small teams of engineers responsible for delivering sophisticated AI capabilities, from agentic workflows and retrieval systems to autonomous business processes and intelligent product experiences.

We're looking for someone who brings more than technical expertise. You should be capable of taking ownership of complex initiatives, breaking ambiguous problems into actionable engineering work, making sound architectural decisions, and guiding a team from concept through production delivery.

Equally important, you'll play a significant role in raising the technical maturity of our engineering organization. Through mentorship, code reviews, architectural guidance, and hands-on collaboration, you'll help establish higher standards for software quality, testing, reliability, and maintainability.

We value engineers who combine deep technical ability with practical judgment, strong ownership, and a genuine investment in making the people around them better.

What You'll Work On

  • Agentic AI systems that autonomously execute complex, multi-step business workflows.
  • AI-powered product experiences combining LLMs, retrieval, backend services, and human oversight.
  • Retrieval and knowledge systems that connect AI agents to organization-specific information.
  • Backend services, APIs, and tool integrations enabling AI systems to safely interact with production applications.
  • Evaluation, observability, and testing frameworks that improve the quality, consistency, and reliability of AI behavior.
  • Orchestration systems and infrastructure supporting scalable, production-grade AI applications.
  • Engineering tooling and practices that improve development velocity, software quality, and operational reliability.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead small teams of engineers in the design, development, and delivery of complex, high-impact AI initiatives.
  • Own the technical execution of projects from initial design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation.
  • Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear technical approaches, actionable engineering tasks, and achievable delivery milestones.
  • Drive architectural discussions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and establish sound implementation strategies.
  • Coordinate engineering efforts, identify dependencies and blockers, and maintain accountability for technical execution and delivery commitments.
  • Remain actively involved in implementation, contributing production code and solving challenging technical problems alongside the team.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering leadership, and stakeholders to ensure technical solutions deliver meaningful business outcomes.

Applied AI Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI systems using LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval architectures, and backend services.
  • Develop sophisticated agent workflows involving tool calling, structured outputs, multi-step reasoning, deterministic validation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Build and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, including ingestion pipelines, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and context assembly.
  • Integrate foundation models through platforms such as Amazon Bedrock and AWS AgentCore.
  • Develop evaluation frameworks for AI workflows, including regression testing, golden datasets, trace analysis, and quality measurement.
  • Improve production AI systems for reliability, accuracy, latency, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Design systems that safely handle unpredictable model behavior, edge cases, operational failures, and real-world production constraints.

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

  • Elevate engineering standards through thoughtful code reviews, architectural guidance, hands-on mentorship, and technical leadership.
  • Mentor engineers in software design, debugging, testing strategies, system architecture, and production engineering practices.
  • Establish and reinforce best practices around code quality, automated testing, documentation, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Help engineers develop stronger technical judgment, ownership, independence, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Identify recurring technical weaknesses, unnecessary complexity, and process inefficiencies, and actively work to address them.
  • Promote a culture of thoughtful engineering where solutions are not simply functional, but reliable, understandable, testable, and maintainable.
  • Lead by example through high-quality implementation, effective collaboration, constructive feedback, and strong personal accountability.

Required Qualifications

  • US citizen or authorized to work in the United States.
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience designing and delivering production systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend software engineering.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership for engineering projects or small teams, including architecture, implementation, mentorship, and delivery.
  • Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and shipping production AI applications using LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, or related technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of backend architecture, APIs, distributed systems, databases, and workflow orchestration.
  • Experience designing agentic workflows, tool-calling systems, structured outputs, or retrieval-augmented generation architectures.
  • Strong understanding of production AI challenges, including model reliability, hallucination mitigation, evaluation, observability, latency, and cost management.
  • Demonstrated commitment to software engineering best practices, including automated testing, code review, CI/CD, system design, and maintainability.
  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  • Proven ability to mentor engineers, provide constructive technical feedback, and influence engineering practices.
  • Strong technical judgment, debugging skills, and the ability to navigate complex systems and ambiguous requirements.
  • Ability to balance hands-on engineering contributions with technical leadership responsibilities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across engineering, product, and business teams.
  • Experience operating in fast-moving environments where ownership, adaptability, and execution are essential.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Amazon Bedrock, AWS AgentCore, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, or related AWS services.
  • Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, DSPy, Semantic Kernel, or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience building multi-step autonomous agents that interact with tools, APIs, external systems, or business workflows.
  • Experience developing AI evaluation frameworks, prompt regression testing, trace analysis, or human-in-the-loop review systems.
  • Experience with vector databases and semantic retrieval technologies such as OpenSearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS.
  • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as LangSmith, Arize, Helicone, Weights & Biases, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives within startup or rapidly scaling SaaS organizations.
  • Experience improving engineering practices, introducing development standards, or helping teams increase their technical maturity.
  • Experience balancing technical debt, delivery speed, operational reliability, and long-term architectural decisions.

Who Thrives in This Role

We're looking for an engineer who naturally takes ownership and leads through technical expertise, sound judgment, and example.

Someone who can look at a complicated technical problem, develop a clear approach, bring other engineers along, and drive the work through completion.

Someone who cares deeply about code quality and engineering craftsmanship, but understands the importance of pragmatism and delivering real value.

Someone who enjoys mentoring engineers, challenging assumptions, providing constructive feedback, and helping teammates become more capable and independent.

Someone who understands that technical leadership means being accountable not only for their own contributions, but also for the quality and success of the work they help lead.

Above all, we're looking for someone who makes both our AI systems and our engineering organization stronger.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-impact AI initiatives are delivered successfully through effective technical leadership, clear ownership, and strong collaboration.
  • AI systems are reliable, observable, maintainable, and trusted by customers and internal teams.
  • Engineers working alongside you demonstrate measurable growth in technical ability, independence, and engineering judgment.
  • Code quality, testing practices, architectural consistency, and operational reliability improve across the teams you lead.
  • Complex technical initiatives move from ambiguous requirements to production-ready solutions with greater consistency and predictability.
  • Engineering decisions balance innovation, delivery speed, maintainability, and long-term business value.
  • Your technical leadership enables the broader organization to deliver increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities with confidence.

title: Senior C++ Software Engineer
description:

Build high-performance systems where every microsecond matters.

In high-performance trading, every microsecond counts. Are you a C++ engineer who enjoys solving complex performance challenges and building software where speed, reliability, and precision are critical?

We’re looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer to join an engineering team developing a low-latency trading platform. You’ll work on exchange connectivity and algorithmic trading systems serving clients across major European financial markets.

You’ll contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from analyzing trading requirements and designing new features to automated testing, deployment, and production support.

  • Apply modern software engineering practices across development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

What you’ll bring

  • Solid experience developing and debugging applications in Linux environments.

Nice to have

Experience in any of the following areas will be a strong advantage:

Low-latency engineering

  • Lock-free data structures and concurrency optimization.

  • Kernel-bypass networking technologies, such as DPDK or Solarflare.

  • Cache-aware design and NUMA tuning.

  • Microsecond-sensitive performance optimization.

Performance analysis

  • Advanced profiling with perf, Intel VTune, and flame graphs.

Financial technology

Automation and observability

  • Experience building or integrating MCP servers.

Why join?

  • Take ownership across the full software development lifecycle, including production support.

  • Explore modern AI-assisted development tools and engineering automation.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers in a technically demanding environment.

Ready to make every microsecond count?

If you’re passionate about modern C++, Linux, and high-performance systems, this is an opportunity to apply your engineering expertise to the challenges of low-latency trading.

Apply now and help build the next generation of high-performance trading technology!

title: IT Application Owner Specialist, VP
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: IT Application Owner Specialist, VP

Location: Mumbai, India

Corporate Title: Vice President

Role Description

Deutsche Bank is accelerating the renewal of its digital channels and technology estate through a portfolio of strategic, complex and business-critical initiatives. As a Vice President, the IT Application Owner Specialist will provide senior leadership across application strategy, operational resilience, technology risk and regulatory compliance, working with Business, Technology, Risk and Control stakeholders to translate enterprise priorities into sustainable outcomes. The role requires strong judgement and governance to balance delivery speed, service stability, security, cost and control obligations, while enabling Agile ways of working and continuous improvement without compromising quality.

Role Description - Summary:

The IT Application Owner Specialist provides accountable leadership for a portfolio of applications, setting the technology direction and governance required to maintain stability, security, resilience and regulatory compliance. The role evaluates the current technology landscape, prioritises strategic improvements and makes risk-based decisions that balance business outcomes, control requirements and sustainable delivery.

What we’ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • The IT Application Owner Specialist provides accountable leadership for a portfolio of applications, setting the technology direction and governance required to maintain stability, security, resilience and regulatory compliance. The role evaluates the current technology landscape, prioritises strategic improvements and makes risk-based decisions that balance business outcomes, control requirements and sustainable delivery.
  • Work includes:
  • Determining the appropriate technological solutions to balance delivery and compliance
  • Identifying gaps in the current infrastructure solutions and implementing the associated improvements whilst ensuring compliance with technical roadmaps
  • Improving the safety and security of IT Applications, compliance with internal and external standards and operational readiness
  • Provide accountable leadership for audit and regulatory remediation relating to the application portfolio, ensuring root causes are addressed, evidence is complete, commitments are delivered on time and overdue or high-risk findings are escalated promptly.
  • Own the identification, assessment and treatment of technology and application risks, challenge control effectiveness, sponsor proportionate remediation and ensure material risks, dependencies and risk-acceptance decisions are transparently reported to senior governance forums.
  • Contributing and assisting the implementation of policy and strategy specific to IT management and Information Security
  • Identify and sponsor opportunities to adopt new technologies and engineering practices where they deliver measurable business, resilience or control benefits; ensure proposals are supported by appropriate architecture, security, risk, cost and implementation assessments before adoption.
  • Be accountable for the availability, stability, capacity and performance of applications across production and non-production environments, ensuring measurable service outcomes, effective resilience testing and timely escalation and remediation of material operational risks.
  • Establish and govern the L3 support model with development and infrastructure teams, ensuring clear ownership, effective major-incident response, root-cause remediation, knowledge continuity and measurable improvements in service reliability.
  • Ensure policy-compliance for the application, identify and own projects necessary to ensure policy-compliance (e.g. security monitoring)
  • Manage the technical roadmap of the application (technology roadmap compliance), estimate/budget capacity needed
  • Represent the application portfolio in Domain Expert Meetings and senior governance forums, providing clear recommendations on investment, risk, sequencing and delivery feasibility; challenge project estimates and maintain oversight of Run the Bank and total application costs.
  • Define non-functional requirements and ensure that project teams apply these in projects
  • Set and govern the assurance framework for projects and changes affecting the application portfolio, ensuring that test strategies, architecture and risk assessments, implementation plans and operational-readiness evidence meet agreed standards; challenge material gaps and hold delivery owners accountable for remediation before approval.
  • Ensure availability of all necessary application/service knowledge and documentation

Your skills and experience

  • Extensive relevant experience 12 – 15 years, including a sustained track record of accountable leadership for complex, business-critical application portfolios within a large, regulated organisation.
  • Proven leadership across technology risk, IT Run the Bank and production support, with accountability for service performance, operational resilience, control effectiveness and prioritization across competing business demands.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply recognized risk and control frameworks, including COBIT and the ISO 27000 series, to application governance, control design, assurance and senior risk decision-making.
  • Proven experience leading technology risk, audit and regulatory remediation, including root-cause analysis, delivery of sustainable corrective actions, evidence-based closure and escalation of material issues.
  • Technical background required, experience in Java Enterprise environment with knowledge of web- and application- servers is a plus
  • Hands-on ITIL experience is a plus
  • Proven ability to lead and influence geographically distributed, cross-functional teams, including setting direction, clarifying accountability, resolving delivery conflicts and sustaining performance across organizational boundaries.
  • Familiar with Agile Team management tools (JIRA, Confluence)
  • Strong business and financial management capability in a technology environment, including investment prioritization, budgeting, cost transparency, capacity planning and delivery estimates and commercial assumptions.
  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex technology and risk topics into clear recommendations, constructively challenge senior stakeholders and build alignment across Business, Technology, Risk and Control functions.
  • Proven portfolio planning and execution capability, including prioritizing competing commitments, managing interdependencies and capacity, establishing credible delivery plans and intervening decisively when milestones, controls or outcomes are at risk.
  • Demonstrated executive judgement and adaptability in complex, fast-changing environments, with the ability to reprioritize across material risks and business commitments, make timely decisions with incomplete information and communicate trade-offs and consequences clearly.
  • Strong analytical and crisis-leadership capability, with a record of structuring ambiguous problems, mobilizing the right experts, making timely risk-based decisions and ensuring that root causes and systemic improvements are addressed.
  • Proven skills in all business management activities
  • Proven ability to sponsor the responsible adoption of AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making and workflows at scale, while applying critical judgement and ensuring appropriate governance, data protection, human oversight and accountability for AI-enabled outcomes.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

About us and our teams

Please visit our company website for further information:

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Title: CDL Instructor

Department: Community Education & Cultural Heritage

Location: Juneau


Exemption Status: Non-Exempt

Pay Grade(s): 11-12 ($36.98 - $40.67+ DOE)

Purpose:

The Commercial Driver's License (CDL) Instructor provides classroom and behind-the-wheel training to individuals seeking to obtain a Commercial Driver's License or enhance their commercial driving skills. The position delivers safe, effective, and hands-on instruction in accordance with Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) requirements, applicable state regulations, and established training standards.

The CDL Instructor prepares students for commercial driving examinations, evaluates student progress, maintains accurate training records, and promotes safe driving practices. This position supports workforce development by helping participants gain the knowledge, skills, and qualifications necessary to pursue employment in the commercial transportation industry.

Essential Functions. An individual in this role must be able to perform the following functions with or without reasonable accommodation:

· Provide classroom instruction covering commercial driving regulations, vehicle operations, safety procedures, defensive driving, and other topics required for CDL training.

· Conduct behind-the-wheel instruction, including vehicle inspections, basic vehicle control, backing, maneuvering, and on-road driving.

· Prepare students for applicable CDL knowledge and skills examinations, including pre-trip inspections, basic control skills, and road testing.

· Deliver training consistent with FMCSA Entry-Level Driver Training (ELDT) requirements, Alaska Division of Motor Vehicles regulations, and established curriculum standards.

· Evaluate student performance, identify areas requiring improvement, and provide constructive feedback and additional instruction as needed.

· Maintain accurate student attendance, training hours, performance evaluations, and other required documentation.

· Ensure training vehicles and equipment are inspected before use and maintained in safe operating condition.

· Identify and report vehicle maintenance concerns, safety hazards, accidents, and equipment deficiencies.

· Reinforce safe driving practices, proper vehicle handling, and compliance with applicable traffic laws and commercial transportation regulations.

· Adapt instructional methods to accommodate different learning styles, experience levels, and training needs.

· Assist students in understanding CDL licensing requirements, testing procedures, endorsements, and employment-related qualifications.

· Coordinate training schedules, vehicle availability, and student participation with program staff and management.

· Maintain current knowledge of commercial driving regulations, training requirements, and industry safety practices.

· Participate in required professional development, safety training, and instructor certification activities.

· Promote a positive, respectful, and supportive learning environment for Tribal citizens and other program participants.

· Maintain confidentiality of student information and comply with applicable organizational policies and procedures.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

Great cloud platforms do more than provide infrastructure — they empower engineering teams to innovate securely, operate reliably, and deliver faster.

You’ll take ownership of platform engineering, cloud security, networking, and Infrastructure as Code, helping establish consistent engineering standards across the platform. If you’re passionate about secure cloud architecture, platform automation, and building infrastructure that helps engineering teams do their best work, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help build the next generation of secure, scalable cloud platforms.

High Voltage (HV) Engineer (Authorised Person – Electrical)

Based: On site Rolls-Royce in Derby | UK‑wide site coverage

Hours: 40hrs Monday -Friday

Flexibility required for outages, shutdowns, and critical works

JLL Work Dynamics
JLL Work Dynamics partners with leading organisations across industry sectors, creating environments that achieve a more humancentric, resilient, and responsible approach to shaping a better world of work. With more than 45,000 specialists globally, the team enables clients to enhance the performance of their real estate portfolios and people to realize their ambitions for a more sustainable built environment.

The role

At JLL, our Engineering teams support some of the most complex and safety‑critical environments in the UK. We are now seeking an experienced HV Engineer to play a key role in delivering safe, compliant, and resilient electrical operations across the Rolls‑Royce UK estate.

This is not a standard electrical engineering role.
It is a formally authorised, safety‑critical position with responsibility for controlling and authorising work on high‑risk electrical systems.

The Role

As an HV Engineer, you will act as the Electrical Authorised Person (HV/LV) for designated Rolls‑Royce sites, based on Derby and supporting locations across the UK.

You will hold authority for the safe isolation, switching, and authorisation of High Voltage and complex Low Voltage systems, ensuring all works are delivered in full compliance with the Safe System of Work, Electrical Safety Rules, and statutory requirements.

Alongside this authority role, you will remain technically engaged—supporting projects, maintenance, fault diagnosis, inspections, and asset reliability across a highly critical environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the Electrical Authorised Person (HV/LV) within your defined area of appointment
  • Control and authorise work on HV, LV, and complex LV electrical systems
  • Prepare, review, and check HV switching programmes and safety documentation
  • Undertake isolations, proving dead, restoration of supplies, and transfer of control
  • Issue, control, suspend, and cancel permits to work and safety documents
  • Verify the competence of the Person in Charge (PiC) and monitor works on site, stopping work immediately if safety is compromised
  • Provide training and mentorship to new and existing competent persons
  • Review and approve RAMS for high‑risk electrical activities
  • Act as Duty Authorised Person when appointed, maintaining system oversight, and manage access to high-risk infrastructure
  • Provide technical leadership during outages, shutdowns, critical works, and project works
  • Diagnose complex faults and support planned and reactive maintenance activities
  • Ensure inspections, testing, and remedial actions meet statutory and client standards
  • Maintain accurate records, schematics, and asset documentation
  • Promote a strong safety culture, including stop‑work authority where required

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • Electrical trade qualification or engineering qualification (UK‑recognised or equivalent)
  • Proven experience working with High Voltage and complex LV electrical systems
  • Currently appointed as an Electrical Authorised Person (HV/LV) or demonstrably capable of assessment
  • Strong knowledge of Safe Systems of Work, Permit to Work, and isolation procedures
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations
  • C&G Level 2 & 3 Electrical Installation or equivalent
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Willingness to travel UK‑wide and work flexibly for critical operations

Desirable

  • Test and inspection certification
  • Experience supporting HVAC electrical interfaces
  • Familiarity with critical or regulated environments
  • First aid qualification including resuscitation

Why Join JLL?

  • Work in a senior, safety‑critical engineering role with real authority
  • Support one of the UK’s most prestigious and complex client estates
  • Clear pathways for progression within Authorised Person, Senior HV, and AE‑track roles
  • Strong professional governance, training, and support
  • A culture that values safety leadership, technical excellence, and accountability

At JLL, we embrace more innovative ways of working and prioritise opportunities to strengthen and advance your career. We support each other's wellbeing and champion inclusivity and belonging across teams. What sets JLL apart is our culture of collaboration, both locally and across the globe. Join us in taking the more inspiring, innovative, and optimistic path on our journey toward success as an High Voltage Engineer in Derby.

title: Industrial Electrical Project Manager Greenville
description:
Position Overview

IEG is seeking an experienced Industrial Electrical Project Manager with a strong electrical construction background. This position is ideal for an accomplished Industrial Journeyman Electrician, Lead Technician, Foreman, Superintendent, or General Foreman who has successfully led crews and projects in industrial environments and is ready to take the next step in their career.

We are not seeking a traditional office-only Project Manager. We are looking for a hands-on electrical leader who understands how industrial projects are built, can lead field teams, and has the technical expertise to oversee projects from planning through completion.

The ideal candidate has at least three years of experience leading crews of ten or more electricians and possesses the leadership, organizational, and technical skills necessary to manage multiple projects while supporting field operations.

What You'll Do

  • Manage industrial electrical projects from kickoff through completion.
  • Coordinate labor, materials, equipment, and scheduling.
  • Lead field teams and support Foremen and Lead Electricians.
  • Oversee project execution while maintaining quality, safety, and productivity standards.
  • Review drawings, specifications, submittals, and construction documents.
  • Ensure compliance with NEC requirements, customer specifications, and company standards.
  • Monitor project budgets, manpower utilization, and production goals.
  • Coordinate with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.
  • Identify and resolve field challenges before they impact project schedules.
  • Maintain project documentation and reporting using company software systems.
  • Assist with estimating, project planning, and change order management.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • Minimum three years of experience leading crews of ten or more electricians in an industrial environment.
  • Background as an:
    • Industrial Journeyman Electrician
    • Lead Technician
    • Foreman
    • General Foreman
    • Superintendent
    • Similar industrial electrical leadership role
  • Experience running projects ranging from small service work to large industrial installations.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Technical Knowledge

Candidates should possess strong working knowledge of:

  • National Electrical Code (NEC)
  • Industrial power distribution
  • Motor controls
  • Transformers
  • Switchboards and switchgear
  • Lighting systems
  • Feeder sizing and load calculations
  • Grounding and bonding
  • PPE requirements and electrical safety practices
  • Tool, equipment, and manpower planning
  • Industrial electrical construction methods

Required Skills

  • Installation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of industrial electrical systems.
  • Threading, bending, and installing EMT and rigid conduit from ½" through 4".
  • Reading and interpreting blueprints, one-lines, schematics, plans, and specifications.
  • Electrical calculations and layout work.
  • Strong computer proficiency including:
    • Microsoft Office
    • Outlook
    • ERP systems
    • Project documentation software
  • Crew leadership, coaching, and development.
  • Training and mentoring apprentice and junior electricians.

Ideal Candidate Traits

The successful candidate will be:

  • Highly technical
  • Safety-focused
  • Strong communicator
  • Organized and detail-oriented
  • Adaptable in multiple industrial environments
  • Effective at multitasking and prioritization
  • Capable of leading teams and developing personnel
  • Customer-focused and solution-oriented

Compensation & Benefits

Pay: $30.00 to $35.00 per hour, based on experience

Expected Hours: 40 to 60 hours per week

Benefits

  • 401(k)
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off

Schedule

  • Monday through Friday
  • Overtime available
  • On-call as needed

Why Join IEG?

At IEG, we value leaders who have built their careers in the field and understand what it takes to successfully execute industrial electrical projects. If you're an experienced industrial electrician ready to move beyond running crews and into a larger role managing projects, budgets, schedules, and client relationships, we want to hear from you.

Apply today at www.iegusa.com.

title: Senior Therapeutic Area Specialist, Cardiovascular Community - Atlanta N, GA
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.




Job Posting Title: Therapeutic Area Specialist, Cardiovascular Community - Atlanta N, GA

Therapeutic Area (TA): Cardiovascular

Primary Location: Field – United States

Primary Job Posting Location: Atlanta N, GA


At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. The BMS Mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer.


Join us, build your professional career within one of the most innovative bio-pharma companies, and make a difference.


Position Summary

The TAS is a critical role in our unique customer model to execute the BMS aspiration to be the BioPharma that delivers the most impactful engagement with Health Care Providers (HCPs), driving adoption of new and existing medicines for appropriate patients.


The primary role of the TAS is to drive demand for BMS medicines within their portfolio for the appropriate patients. To meet the HCPs expectations, the TAS engages them with a differentiated Customer Experience (Cx) through deeper scientific dialogue on and consistent with label, leveraging new ways of working and CE^3.


The role builds and maintains strong professional credibility with regional thought leaders (RTLs) and community-based physicians/HCPs in private practice, medical groups practices, office staff, and other stakeholders in the patient care continuum as their primary point of contact.


The TAS liaises with other BMS functions as needed to deliver an overall higher Customer Experience (Cx) – by meeting HCP needs in a timely and scientific manner. This role will prioritize the safe and appropriate use of BMS products while also focusing on overall business results and performance objectives while exemplifying BMS values.


The TAS role is field-based. A TAS is anticipated to spend much of their time spent field with external customers.


Key Responsibilities


Portfolio Promotion

  • Promotes approved indications of BMS products within a defined territory or region to meet or exceed assigned sales targets in a compliant manner.
  • Creates demand for BMS medicines by articulating in a balanced manner the clinical and scientific rationale for use of products in appropriate patients.
  • Engages with and continuously maintains/grows a high level of scientific expertise in all assigned products and therapeutic areas.
  • Prepares and successfully implements comprehensive territory and account plans.
  • Proactively uses available tools such as SOPHIA to derive insights and to dynamically inform call plans.
  • Provides feedback on experience using these tools to leadership to enable continuous improvement.

Fair & Balanced Scientific Dialogue

  • Demonstrates scientific expertise and passion in using approved scientific resources and publications to present information to HCPs and ensures medical accuracy.
  • Conducts in-office presentations (e.g., lunch and learns) and discusses product-related scientific information with HCPs that is consistent with label.
  • Organizes external speaker programs, selecting speakers from list approved by Speakers Bureau and facilitating scheduling and logistics.
  • Maintains a high level of working expertise on emerging data for approved indications.
  • Engages real-time medical support through Medical on Call to reactively answer unsolicited questions and complex technical inquiries.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Proactively collaborates with other field teams to ensure the best Customer Experience (Cx) for HCPs.
  • Gathers and shares relevant insights and information internally with the appropriate stakeholders to enable BMS to better serve its customers.

Complies with all laws, regulations, and policies that govern the conduct of BMS.


Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Advanced scientific degree and/or preferred 5+ years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience as healthcare sales / MSL / HCP / nurse.
  • Ability to communicate scientific or clinical data accurately and convincingly to help physicians best serve their patients.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining strong credibility with key customers, office staff, and others in the customer influence network via a customer-centric mindset and desire to create positive and differentiated Customer Experience (Cx).
  • Experience in cardiovascular preferred.
  • Demonstrated strong capability in account management skill sets, superior selling competencies, and proven sales performance track record of meeting or exceeding goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively cross-functionally with a positive team mindset and can-do attitude.
  • Strong selling and promotional skills proven through a track record of performance.

Key competencies desired


Customer/commercial mindset

  • Demonstrated ability to drive business results.
  • Experience identifying, engaging, and cultivating credibility with customers across the patient care journey.
  • Demonstrated account management skills and problem-solving mentality. Understands the patient journey and can customize engagement and deliver tailored messages.
  • Demonstrated resourcefulness and ability to connect with customers.

Patient centricity

  • Understands the patient journey and experience.
  • Has a patient-focused mindset.

Scientific Agility

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate scientific and clinical data in an easy-to-understand manner to help HCPs best serve their patients.
  • Has a strong learning mindset and passion for science. Prioritizes staying current with the latest data.

Analytical Capability:

  • Ability to analyze data, such as prescribing patterns, market trends, and HCP preferences. Data-driven insights help TAS strategize and target their efforts effectively.
  • Ability to segment HCPs based on their preferences and other relevant factors. This helps them tailor their communication and product presentations to suit individual HCP needs.
  • Understanding how to interpret and analyze data related to BMS products, customer preferences, clinical data.
  • Ability to use CE^3 to generate insights and do dynamic call planning.

Digital Agility:

  • Understanding, adapting, and effectively using technology in various aspects of healthcare business and interacting with HCPs.
  • Utilizing various digital communication channels such as emails, instant messaging apps, and video conferencing to stay in touch with healthcare professionals, colleagues, and clients. This enables TAS to respond promptly to inquiries, share updates, and maintain effective communication.
  • Competency using CE^3 and other software or CRM tools to collect, enter, and manage quality data in a timely and compliant manner, track interactions, and plan future engagements with healthcare professionals.
  • Ability to use the Medical on Call technology effectively.
  • Keeping up to date with technological advancements and changes.

description:
Kodano Optyk to sieć salonów optycznych, która powstała, by ułatwiać klientom wybór najlepszych i najwygodniejszych okularów korekcyjnych i słonecznych w bardzo atrakcyjnych cenach.

Kodano Optyk należy do grupy Kodano S.A. operatora największego w Polsce i Europie Centralnej sklepu internetowego z soczewkami kontaktowymi i płynami do ich pielęgnacji. Jeśli szukasz nowych wyzwań i rozwoju zawodowego oraz chcesz mieć realny wpływ na swoją karierę, dołącz do naszej firmy i zacznij pracę w bardzo dynamicznej branży.

  • komunikacyjność - zależy nam na prokliencka postawie i otwartości na ludzi

To oferujemy

  • wynagrodzenie podstawowe oraz atrakcyjną prowizję, zależną od Twoich predyspozycji sprzedażowych

  • szkolenia dopasowane do Twoich aktualnych umiejętności (bardzo częste - minimum raz w miesiącu, które prowadzone są przez naszych Trenerów)

  • atrakcyjne rabaty na okulary dla Pracowników

Dlaczego warto z nami pracować?

  • Będziesz miał wpływ na swój realny rozwój w innowacyjnej firmie, która jest nową marką w branży optycznej. Praca w naszej firmie, ze względu na niszową branżę to także wyzwania dające poczucie satysfakcji zawodowej, ale też osobistej.

Wierzymy, że to właśnie ludzie są naszym najcenniejszym kapitałem, dlatego stawiamy sobie ambitne cele, które mają za zadanie wspierać rozwój zawodowy i osobisty każdego pracownika.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 1100 – 1350 PLN / dzień netto

Senior DevOps Engineer - Azure & Terraform

Automate infrastructure. Engineer reliability. Deliver at scale.

Location: Wrocław, Poland
Work model: Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office
Seniority: Senior
Experience: 10+ years
THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to strengthen infrastructure automation, deployment processes, and platform reliability across cloud and on-premises environments.

In this role, you’ll work with Microsoft Azure, Terraform, containerization technologies, and CI/CD pipelines to build and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable infrastructure. You’ll also coordinate complex releases across multiple teams, troubleshoot challenging technical issues, and help improve observability and operational resilience.

This opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong ownership, a proactive mindset, and the ability to navigate complex infrastructure environments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design, automate, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

  • Support services running across Microsoft Azure and on-premises environments.

  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline infrastructure provisioning and application deployments.

  • Work with Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Helm.

  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, and Linux-related issues.

  • Coordinate releases across multiple teams, ensuring smooth deployments and operational readiness.

  • Improve monitoring, observability, incident response, and platform reliability.

  • Support secure engineering practices, including secrets management and infrastructure security.

  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to improve automation and deployment standards.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of professional experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or a related field.

  • Advanced hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure.

  • Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and Helm.

  • Strong Linux administration, scripting, networking, and troubleshooting skills.

  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

  • Proven experience designing CI/CD pipelines and automating deployments.

  • Understanding of monitoring, incident response, secrets management, and secure engineering practices.

  • Experience coordinating complex releases involving multiple teams.

  • Strong ownership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

NICE TO HAVE

  • GitLab CI/CD

  • Ansible

  • Splunk

  • Azure Monitor

  • Grafana

  • Java

WORKING ARRANGEMENT

This role requires working on-site at the Wrocław office five days per week. Candidates must be comfortable with a fully office-based working arrangement.

READY TO ENGINEER WHAT’S NEXT?

If infrastructure automation, cloud engineering, and building reliable platforms are your strengths, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply now and bring your DevOps expertise to a challenging enterprise environment.

title: Product Owner - Aplikacje Lokalne (FMCG)
description:

Craftware to ponad 500-osobowa firma technologiczna, która wspiera duże organizacje w rozwiązywaniu złożonych problemów biznesowych za pomocą nowoczesnych rozwiązań IT - od systemów sprzedażowych i automatyzacji, po platformy danych i AI.   • Udokumentowane doświadczenie w zarządzaniu dostawcami zewnętrznymi utrzymującymi aplikacje: SLA, eskalacje, jakość usługi, relacja handlowa - warunek twardy

title: Business Advancement Administrator
description:
About Our Job


What We Offer

The City and County of Denver offers a competitive salary commensurate with education and experience. The hiring range for this position is $68,773 - $80,000.00/year, based on experience and education. We also offer generous benefits for full-time employees which includes but is not limited to:

  • A guaranteed life-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service
  • 457B Retirement Plan
  • 140 hours of PTO earned within first year + 13 paid holidays, 1 personal holiday, 1 Wellness Day and 1 volunteer day per year
  • Competitive medical, dental and vision plans effective within 1 month of start date

Location

The City and County of Denver utilizes a hybrid model workplace that balances the responsibilities of public service with the benefits of a flexible work environment. Employees work where needed, at a city site and/or in the field three days a week and telecommute remotely at a designated workplace within the State of Colorado the remaining days.


On designated onsite days, you will work at the Wellington E. Webb Municipal Office Building, located at 201 W. Colfax Avenue, Denver, CO 80202. You may also be required to attend local events based on operational needs.

Who We Are

Denver Economic Development and Opportunity (DEDO) serves to support Denver’s businesses, employers, and workforce, creating shared prosperity and sustained economic growth. DEDO has sharpened its focus and enhanced alignment across divisions, ensuring its work is centered on the premise that quality jobs are the most powerful tool to create better outcomes for Denverites.

DEDO accomplishes this by making Denver a place that is easy to do business with, fostering job creation, and building an economy that works for everyone. DEDO helps residents gain the skills, training, and credentials needed to secure quality jobs while also supporting, growing, and recruiting local employers.

DEDO’s work aligns with city priorities including the Vibrant Denver and Family-Friendly initiatives:


  • Growing, strengthening, and supporting Denver’s small businesses
  • Revitalizing and investing in Denver’s downtown economy
  • Ensuring Denver residents have access to high-quality jobs as well as training and development opportunities
  • Making it easier to do business with and in the City and County of Denver
  • Supporting economic growth while implementing anti-displacement strategies
  • Fostering and supporting a dynamic innovation and entrepreneurial sector
  • Recruiting employers from outside markets

Denver Business Development is focused on growing, strengthening, and supporting Denver’s businesses. This division prioritizes small businesses through 1:1 technical assistance, financing, grants, strategic planning, certification, and connections to additional resources. It also works to attract, retain, and grow businesses in the City and County of Denver. Denver Business Development supports entrepreneurs and startups helping diversify Denver’s economy and build the jobs of the future. It sells Denver on the global stage as a destination for businesses to launch or expand operations, and takes benefit from the city’s highly-educated and talented workforce. The division also serves Denver’s minority and women-owned businesses through small business certification, ensuring opportunity for priority businesses.

What You'll Do

Denver Business Development is seeking a Business Advancement Administrator to help businesses navigate City processes and requirements, identify and address barriers to doing business, and collaborate with City agencies to streamline processes and improve the overall business experience. This position will also engage with business organizations and stakeholders to understand challenges, provide guidance, and support a more accessible, efficient, and business-friendly environment.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Business Engagement

  • Provide guidance and technical assistance to businesses navigating City processes, regulations, and requirements
  • Coordinate with businesses and City staff to resolve challenges, clarify requirements, and facilitate progress on business-related projects
  • Build and maintain relationships with trade organizations, business improvement districts, and other business stakeholders to increase awareness of Business Advancement Division services
  • Maintain tracking systems and performance measures to evaluate and communicate the impact of Business Advancement Division initiatives

Process Improvement

  • Evaluate City processes, ordinances, and policies to identify barriers to doing business and recommend opportunities for improvement
  • Collaborate with partner agencies to develop and implement process improvements and strengthen coordination across City departments
  • Prepare presentations and recommendations for DEDO executive leadership regarding challenges facing businesses and strategies to improve processes and the overall business experience

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain collaborative relationships with City agencies, community organizations, vendors, business partners, and internal stakeholders to advance division goals and support executive priorities

What You’ll Bring

Our ideal candidate has some or all the following experience, skills, and characteristics:

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex policies, regulations, and processes and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Experience developing solutions to streamline operations, reduce administrative barriers, and improve efficiency
  • Ability to collaborate across departments and agencies and navigate complex organizational environments
  • Strong relationship-building, stakeholder engagement, and consensus-building skills.
  • Ability to influence decision-making and effectively communicate recommendations to leadership
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Customer-focused approach with an understanding of how government processes impact the business community
  • Commitment to improving government efficiency, accessibility, and responsiveness through innovation and collaboration

Required Minimum Qualifications

  • Education requirement: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Public Administration Public Planning or related field.
  • Experience Requirement: Three (3) years’ experience performing full performance professional level duties within a specialized, functional area. (This does not include clerical experience.)
  • Education/Experience Equivalency: One (1) year of the appropriate type and level of experience may be substituted for each required year of post-high school education.
  • Additional appropriate education may be substituted for the minimum experience requirements.

Preferred Application Documents

  • Resume
  • Cover Letter

Application Deadline

This posting is expected to stay open until November 8, 2026. Please submit your application as soon as possible no later than November 8, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. MST.
