title: Modern Engineering Apprenticeship, Prestwick, 2027 intake
description:
Job Description Summary

Our apprentices follow a three-year training programme, with day release college attendance. This is a full-time role, Monday-Friday.

Job Description

About GE Aerospace

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

Engineering is at the center of what we do, and we are looking for talented, innovative engineers who can help us design and develop products for today, tomorrow, and in the future. If you are a dreamer, doer, and inventor who wants your voice to be heard and see your ideas take flight, this is the opportunity for you.

Role description

The Engineering Apprentice will function under the overall guidance of the Apprentice Coordinator but also on a day-to-day basis be managed by the Team Leader / Supervisor in charge of the department where the Apprentices’ current training is taking place. For the duration of the Apprenticeship at GE Caledonian, you will gain practical experience and develop theoretical knowledge whilst obtaining formal qualifications, which are recognised and fully transferrable within the Aerospace industry.

Due to the broad range of engineering disciplines within GE Aerospace, engineering apprenticeships can encompass aircraft engine overhaul mechanics, CNC/ manual machinists, mechanical & electrical maintenance, mechanical inspectors and welders. The hiring manager will discuss this further with the relevant candidates during the recruitment process.

You will perform multiple aspects of maintenance and repair to the highest quality. Excellent communication skills are required, along with the ability to accurately follow work process instructions. You will have a keen sense of achievement and take pride in the work you undertake and produce. The ability to work efficiently within a team is essential.

You will:

  • Adhere to GE Aerospace health & safety policy and safe working practices.
  • Be highly self-motivated, be able to work in a small team and independently.
  • Have good problem-solving abilities, able to think on your feet.
  • Have basic PC knowledge of networking and communication.
  • Be working to targets and deadlines.
  • Be undertaking your qualification on jet engines.
  • Be working with your team in the development and implementation of continuous improvement projects.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Performing Engineering Operations (PEO) at SCQF Level 5 Completed by July 2027

OR
Foundation Apprenticeship in Engineering Completed by July 2027.

  • Team player, cooperative, interested in further personal and career development
  • High degree of flexibility, highly motivated with the ability to work under pressure

GE Aerospace partner with Ayrshire College for training delivery, therefore we would recommend be living in an area commutable to the college.

Desired Characteristics

  • Able to roll up your sleeves and get involved in projects
  • Organised & able to work towards deadlines
  • Inspired and curious to learn
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Able to take ownership for projects
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Able to work as part of a team

Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process, you will be required to submit an initial CV application. After this, the stages could include testing and assessment centre. Our recruitment team will be in touch with you at every stage to keep you updated and understand what is next in the process. Please ensure you review your emails (and junk folder) regularly as we will be communicating to you in this way and would not want you to miss vital messages.

If you require any adjustments to the process to enable you to be at your best, please email the team via Apprenticeship.Queries@geaerospace.com.


Please only submit one application. If you submit multiple applications, we will progress the most suitable one. If in future you are deemed to be suitable for other opportunities, we will automatically consider you for these too.

Please note our applications will close on Sunday 15th November but may close earlier dependent on application volumes. We would encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Total Reward

At GE Aerospace we understand the importance of Total Reward. Our flexible benefits plan, called FlexChoice, gives you freedom, choice, and flexibility in the way you receive your benefits, as well as giving you the opportunity to make savings where possible.


As a new joiner to GE Aerospace, we are pleased to be able to offer you the following as default in your benefit fund, which you then can tailor to meet your individual needs.

  • Non-contributory Pension
  • Life Assurance
  • Group income protection
  • Private medical cover
  • Holiday Hourly equivalent of 26 days, with flexible option to buy or sell

ABOUT THE INNOCENCE PROJECT

The Innocence Project works to free the innocent, prevent wrongful convictions, and create fair, compassionate, and equitable systems of justice for everyone. Our work is guided by science and grounded in anti-racism. Since our inception, the Innocence Project has used DNA and other scientific advancements to prove wrongful conviction. To date, we have helped to free or exonerate more than 250 people who, collectively, spent more than 3,600 years behind bars. Our efforts have led to the passage of more than 200 transformative state laws and federal reforms. Today, the Innocence Project continues to fight for freedom, drive structural change, and advance the innocence movement. To learn more, please visit .

ABOUT THE POSITION

The Post-Conviction Litigation (“PCL”) Department Summer 2027 Law Student Interns will work to support the litigation and direct client representation provided by the staff of the PCL Department which, collectively, represents nearly 200 people wrongfully convicted of crimes around the country.

PCL Summer Law Student Interns will gain hands-on experience working directly with clients and communities impacted by wrongful convictions. Interns will work with their supervising attorneys on active post-conviction cases to help prepare written motions, develop litigation strategy, communicate with courts, prosecutors, and other criminal legal system stakeholders, and prepare for evidentiary hearings.

This position will be an in-person 10-week paid internship working 40 hours per week. The internship will commence on June 2, 2027 and will end on August 7, 2027.

All Innocence Project employees must embrace, respect and value the rich diversity of perspectives and experience of a diverse and heterogeneous staff. We recognize and appreciate that our work is better for having varied participants and thought partners.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

The ideal candidate for this internship is passionate about racial justice, is eager to learn directly about post-conviction litigation, is a clear communicator, and is an excellent legal researcher and writer.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Job duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Supporting post-conviction litigation docket through legal research, memo writing, and creating discovery and/or trial transcript digests;
  • Assisting in writing claims or entire motions for post-conviction DNA testing and/or post-conviction relief;
  • Developing investigation plans;
  • Communicating with clients and their families.

About Galois

We are a community of researchers, engineers, and operations people dedicated to creating trustworthiness in critical systems in every functional area of the organization. Our unique organizational structure enables us to adapt to the needs of the innovative projects we deliver.

What We Do: We believe trustworthy systems are built on a formal mathematical foundation. Our researchers apply formal analysis techniques to the design and verification of critical software systems, allowing us to model, analyze, and mathematically prove that a system behaves exactly as intended under all circumstances. With clients including NASA, DARPA, AWS, and the DoW, we leverage our cutting-edge research to deliver high assurance solutions and tools that enhance security, reliability, and operational efficiency across sectors including aerospace & defense, healthcare, semiconductors, and fintech.

Research Engineers at Galois design and develop advanced technologies for safety- and security-critical systems, networks, and applications. Engineers work in small team settings and must successfully interact with clients, partners, and other employees in a highly cooperative, collaborative, and intellectually challenging environment.

Life at Galois: People are the foundation of Galois’s success. As an employee-owned company, we care not only about the technologies we develop, but also the path we take to create them. Galois operates under a highly collaborative organizational model that encourages leadership and teamwork and respects the individuals.

For more on our culture and organizational structure, visit Life at Galois.

About This Role

Galois is hiring a Software Engineer/Researcher to join our team! This role will primarily focus on advancing the state of the art in programming language theory research and implementation. Researchers in this role will use their expertise in Formal Methods and Programming Languages to conduct rigorous formal verification of software and systems, ensuring they meet the highest security standards.

Responsibilities

As a Research Engineer, you will have the following responsibilities:

  • Requirements gathering: engaging the client in a series of discussions, where each iteration refines the needs of the client, and leads to the suggestion of means to meet those needs.
  • Architecture and design: constructing high-level architectural descriptions of software systems, and constructing deeper program designs by fleshing out architecture prototypes. Architectures must be designed with assurance in mind, determining where and how formal methods are to be applied.
  • Implementation: extending design prototypes through to a finished product, with care taken to ensure robustness and ease of use.
  • Formal verification: use mechanical reasoning tools such as theorem provers and model checkers to demonstrate or analyze desired security and correctness properties of systems.
  • Testing and validation: constructing and regularly conducting system, unit, and regression tests, and conducting semi-formal validation and verification.
  • Technology research and development: conducting speculative research and development of cutting-edge technology, and incorporating that technology in product prototypes.
  • Technical infrastructure development: developing (designing, implementing, and maintaining) tools to be used within Galois, and developing library code to be shared among projects.

Key Qualifications

  • Education:
    • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent is required.
    • An MS or PhD in CS or a related field is desirable but optional.
  • Required Technical Expertise:
    • A programming languages background and experience with formal methods.
    • Must have hands-on experience developing software and applying formal verification techniques.
    • Familiarity with diverse formal methods, such as model checking, theorem proving, program analysis, and formal semantics of programming languages, and demonstrated expertise in at least one such area.
    • Experience in all aspects of software engineering practices.
    • Fluent in using semi-formal methods such as Haskell or other functional programming languages, including executable formal specifications.
  • Required General Skills:
    • Must work well with customers, including building rapport, identifying needs, and communicating with strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
    • Must be highly motivated and able to self-manage deadlines and quality goals.
  • Preference will be given to candidates with one or more of the following technical expertise:
    • Experience applying formal methods to artificial intelligence and machine learning systems, including techniques for verifying, analyzing, or improving the safety, security, and reliability of AI-enabled systems.
    • Direct experience in developing high-assurance systems and/or security products.
    • Experience with Model Based Systems Engineering tools, with expertise in SysML and AADL.
    • Knowledge of hardware engineering languages and platforms such as VHDL, Chisel, Bluespec, SystemVerilog, and Verilog.

Security and Citizenship Requirement

U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance​.

Location

We enjoy a hybrid work environment, and candidates may be based out of the greater Boston, MA area or any of our offices in Arlington, VA, Dayton, OH, Minneapolis, MN, or Portland, OR.

Benefits

We offer a robust benefits package to provide for your and your family’s well-being, including:

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • 401(k) retirement plan with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Fully paid medical insurance plans and dental and vision reimbursement plan
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with generous employer contributions
  • Mental health and wellbeing support through our employee assistance program
  • 5 weeks of paid time off and 9 days of paid company holidays each year
  • 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave (available for birth, adoption, and fostering)
  • 1 week of fully paid “Blue Sky” innovation time each year to pursue your interests

For more information on our benefits, visit Careers at Galois.

Compensation

Compensation is based on the value of your results, not your value as an employee or person. The compensation process, individual salaries, and criteria for salary changes are transparent to the entire company.

For more information about our forward-looking and transparent approach to pay, visit Compensation.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Galois is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, ethnicity, national origin, ancestry, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or parental status, pregnancy or childbirth, disability, age, religion, creed, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We encourage and respect different viewpoints and experiences as being essential to the process of innovation. We strive to acquire, grow, and maintain a diverse and inclusive workplace that applies principles and standards equitably while supporting the needs and accommodations of the individual employee.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and federal and state laws, it is the policy of Galois, Inc. to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing the employment application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact peopleoperations@galois.com.

title: Architekt/tka Danych
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 22000 – 26000 PLN / mies. netto

O projekcie

SPIID (Systemy Przetwarzania i Integracji Danych) to firma IT z Rybnika, specjalizująca się w budowie hurtowni danych i systemów raportowych dla branż medycznej, produkcyjnej i ubezpieczeniowej. Tworzymy rozwiązania, które pomagają firmom zapanować nad rozproszonymi danymi i dzięki temu podejmować trafniejsze decyzje biznesowe. Nasze działania zostały docenione tytułem Diamenty Forbesa 2026. Poszukujemy doświadczonego Architekta / Architektki Danych do współpracy w formule B2B przy realizacji projektu budowy hurtowni danych - łączącej wiedzę technologiczną z realnym wpływem na biznes klienta.

Zakres współpracy

W ramach kontraktu B2B realizacja usług obejmuje:

  • Projektowanie architektury danych dla obszaru hurtowni danych, BI i integracji danych, na podstawie wymagań biznesowych zebranych od interesariuszy (warsztaty, wywiady, sesje architektoniczne),

  • Definiowanie i utrzymywanie standardów: modelowania danych, integracji, nazewnictwa, przepływów danych i dokumentacji architektonicznej,

  • Modelowanie procesów biznesowych AS-IS / TO-BE oraz przekładanie ich na docelową architekturę rozwiązań danych,

  • Projektowanie rozwiązań dla hurtowni danych, data martów oraz warstw semantycznych,

  • Projektowanie modeli i struktur danych oraz nadzór nad ich spójnością w całej organizacji,

  • Projektowanie i nadzór nad procesami ETL/ELT oraz integracją danych z systemami wewnętrznymi i zewnętrznymi,

  • Przygotowywanie i nadzór nad dokumentacją architektoniczną (mapy źródeł, słowniki biznesowe i techniczne, diagramy) w narzędziu Enterprise Architect,

  • Zapewnienie jakości, spójności i kompletności danych wykorzystywanych w raportowaniu i analityce,

  • Współtworzenie zasad Data Governance (klasyfikacja danych, właścicielstwo, kontrola jakości),

  • Ścisłą koordynację z zespołem deweloperskim oraz doradztwo technologiczne w trakcie realizacji projektów,

  • Udział w testach akceptacyjnych (UAT) i odbiorach realizacji projektów z perspektywy zgodności z założoną architekturą.

Oczekiwane kompetencje

Niezbędne:

  • Wyższe wykształcenie na kierunku technicznym związanym z rolą architekta / tki,

  • Co najmniej 5 lat doświadczenia zawodowego, w tym udokumentowane doświadczenie w roli architekta/tki danych / architekta/tki rozwiązań (nie tylko analityka),

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu architektury danych, hurtowni danych (DWH) i rozwiązań BI od podstaw lub w ramach dużej przebudowy,

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z dużymi zbiorami danych,

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość procesów ETL/ELT i wzorców integracji danych,

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość tematyki baz danych, języka SQL oraz relacyjnych baz danych,

  • Znajomość tematyki klastrów obliczeń rozproszonych,

  • Udokumentowane doświadczenie w projektowaniu i dokumentowaniu architektur usługowych systemów wielowarstwowych,

  • Umiejętność prowadzenia warsztatów architektonicznych oraz definiowania standardów i pryncypiów projektowych,

  • Znajomość notacji UML i BPMN, doświadczenie w tworzeniu specyfikacji na poziomie architektonicznym, znajomość narzędzia Enterprise Architect,

  • Umiejętność pracy na styku biznes – IT – analityka oraz koordynowania prac wielozespołowych,

  • Doświadczenie w bezpośredniej współpracy z biznesem/klientem na poziomie decyzyjnym.

Mile widziane:

  • Doświadczenie w definiowaniu zasad Data Governance,

  • Znajomość narzędzi: JIRA, SharePoint, Confluence,

  • Podstawowa znajomość Git / Bitbucket (lub GitLab, GitHub),

  • Znajomość języka Python,

  • Doświadczenie w pracy w metodyce Agile/Scrum,

  • Zaawansowana znajomość Enterprise Architect,

  • Doświadczenie projektowe w przetwarzaniu i analizie dużych zbiorów danych (big data, chmura),

  • Znajomość procesów biznesowych z obszaru ochrony zdrowia, w tym zagadnień związanych z procesem rozliczania świadczeń z płatnikiem publicznym (NFZ).

Forma współpracy: kontrakt B2B (umowa o świadczenie usług);

Tryb realizacji: zdalnie lub z biura w Rybniku (ul. Dąbrowskiego 9) – wybór formy współpracy po stronie Wykonawcy;

Organizacja pracy: samodzielne planowanie sposobu i metod realizacji zadań w oparciu o ustalony zakres usług i terminy projektowe, bez sztywno narzuconych godzin pracy;

Rozliczenie: rozliczenie miesięczne na podstawie faktury VAT, zależne od zakresu zrealizowanych i odebranych usług;

Zakres współpracy z Zamawiającym: z uwagi na charakter projektu (dostęp do danych wrażliwych/poufnych klienta) współpraca realizowana wyłącznie na rzecz Zamawiającego przez czas trwania kontraktu.

Jak wygląda proces nawiązania współpracy:

  • Przesłanie oferty współpracy (CV / portfolio zrealizowanych projektów);

  • Spotkanie wstępne z przedstawicielem odpowiadającym za nawiązywanie współprac z Usługodawcami (ok. 30 min) - omówienie zakresu projektu i warunków kontraktu B2B;

  • Spotkanie weryfikacyjne z przedstawicielem projektu - ocena doświadczenia w projektowaniu architektury danych i podejmowaniu decyzji architektonicznych i podejścia do realizacji zadań analitycznych, ew. zadanie / case study .

  • Ustalenie warunków współpracy i podpisanie umowy B2B.

title: Senior Project Coordinator
description:
Total Comp: $60,000 - $80,000 Yearly (base + bonus)
Location: Overland Park, KS
Company: DataMap
Client Work:

About DataMap

DataMap.ai is an AI-first technology consulting and solutions company focused on enterprise systems and automation. We build applications, implement ERP platforms, and provide managed services and production support at scale. Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth companies such as Google. They rely on us to modernize operations and automate workflows in ways that produce measurable business value.

DataMap is growing fast. We value innovation and collaboration, we work with urgency, and we reward speed, precision, and accountability. Teams here have the authority to solve complex enterprise problems and deliver results.

Why Join DataMap

At DataMap, projects run the way we expect every project to run in five years, with AI copilots drafting plans, surfacing risks, and writing first-draft status reports. At this level you help improve the coordination workflows the delivery team uses, and you review AI drafts before they go to the project managers you support.

You'll work across everything DataMap runs, including our most visible engagements, from customer, partner, and partnership-growth work to internal and operations projects. The next step up is Project Manager, where you manage that work.

Role Overview

As a Senior Project Coordinator, you'll coordinate multiple concurrent projects for DataMap's project managers, run the workstreams they delegate, keep PMO mechanics running, and mentor Project Coordinators. Project management at DataMap owns the management of all of our work, which covers everything: customer work, partner work, partnership growth, internal projects, and operations projects. The work ranges from implementations of partner platforms for enterprise clients and development of the products and customer portals we build and sell (Positron, RoboApprover, Itemova EDI SaaS) to the partnership-growth, internal, and operations projects that make DataMap run and grow.

You coordinate independently on assigned workstreams, keep schedules, risks, actions, and stakeholders straight across every project you support, and bring decisions and open issues to the project manager. This is a senior support role: project managers manage the client relationship and are accountable for business outcomes. Business development and commercial conversations stay with the project managers you support.

You will use AI tools every day and help improve the workflows built on them, including the meeting-capture flows, status cadences, and prompt libraries the delivery team uses.

Your Growth Path

Project management at DataMap has a defined five-level ladder that runs from delivery support to leading the practice: Project Coordinator, Senior Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, and Director of Project Management. We post every level and promote from within, and moving up depends on performance and on the needs of the business. Beyond the Director level, the path continues into executive leadership, such as DataMap's Vice President, Operations & Delivery.

This is the senior support seat: you coordinate independently across multiple projects of every type, run the workstreams project managers delegate, and mentor Project Coordinators. Strong Senior Project Coordinators can grow into Project Manager, where the job moves from supporting the work to managing it, with accountability for the outcomes and client relationships that come with it. Project Managers go after business development on the projects they are on: they identify leads for new software and service sales, draft the orders, and get customer signatures. They lead their project teams: they proactively engage team members, ask what they're working on, suggest course corrections, and drive business outcomes. Along the way you work on Fortune 500 client engagements and see up close how the project managers you support grow their accounts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate schedules, dependencies, resources, vendors, and third-party contractors across multiple concurrent projects in customer, partner, partnership-growth, internal, and operations work.
  • Run the workstreams your project managers delegate end to end: plan them, track them, see them through to completion, and bring the project manager every decision that's theirs to make.
  • Keep RAID logs, integrated trackers, decision logs, and documentation current across the projects you support, so each project record stays the single source of truth.
  • Produce client-ready status reports, budget tracking, and dashboards, with AI writing the first draft and your review finishing it.
  • Run governance mechanics for the project managers you support (the status cadence, risk tracking, and decision workflows), and coordinate communication among project teams, functional consultants, and client and partner stakeholders.
  • Use AI-driven risk detection to spot schedule slips and dependency conflicts early, and escalate them to the project manager who owns the work.
  • Capture new requests that come up in client conversations in the project record, and route each one to the project manager with the context they need.
  • Support user acceptance testing, workshops, and cutover activities across the projects you support.
  • Improve the team's AI coordination workflows: meeting-capture flows, automated status cadences, prompt libraries, and workflow templates.
  • Mentor and guide Project Coordinators, and train them on DataMap's standard practices and tools.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in project coordination or IT project delivery.
  • Regular use of AI assistants (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to track, report, and follow through on your work. Bring examples.
  • The ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team: you keep multiple projects straight, keep the project managers you support informed, and raise risks before they become surprises.
  • Strong command of schedules, dependencies, and multi-stakeholder communication.
  • Knowledge of business process analysis, user acceptance testing, and effective meeting management.
  • You're detail-oriented, adaptable, curious, and positive, and you do your best work in a fast-moving consulting environment.

Preferred Experience

  • CAPM or Google Project Management Professional Certificate (PMP a plus).
  • Demonstrated coordination experience on ERP or cloud software implementations (e.g., Coupa, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365).
  • Proficiency with Jira and Smartsheet, including their AI features; Lucidchart a plus.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery: sprints, backlogs, and releases.
  • Experience building prompt libraries or AI workflow templates for a team.

Benefits & Perks

  • Total compensation of base salary plus bonus.
  • Unlimited vacation and a flexible work environment.
  • Free catered lunch on Fridays at headquarters.
  • On-site gym at headquarters.
  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Health insurance with generous employer contribution.
  • Dental, life, and disability insurance.
  • Hands-on mentorship and career development opportunities.

Why Apply?

  • Build your career in enterprise technology consulting.
  • Coordinate projects that run on AI copilots and major financial and supply chain systems, and help deliver AI programs for enterprise clients.
  • Work at a company that values innovation, collaboration, and professional growth.

If you're eager to learn and grow, apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

  • Wdrożenia NAC, segmentacja sieci i podnoszenie bezpieczeństwa dostępu; udział w projektach związanych z NIS2.

title: Senior Client Experience Manager
description:
About us

Share Local Media, or SLM, is a rapidly growing startup reimagining the world of offline marketing for tech and e-commerce companies. We started as e-commerce marketers ourselves, and launched SLM with a goal of transforming offline marketing channels, starting with direct mail and now OOH, by turning them into high performing, scalable channels for a digitally native client set. To do so, we’ve taken an inputs based-approach to the space, and re-engineered the channels from the ground up to make it easier to test, faster to execute, more measurable, and ultimately, more effective for e-commerce and tech clients of all types.

So what does SLM actually do? We’re a full-service direct mail & OOH agency, media program operator, and technology platform, serving some of your favorite e-commerce and tech brands (think Casper, Away, Grubhub, etc.). We live and breathe direct response marketing, and strive to delight clients with high performing campaigns built around fast, data-driven client service, and premium, unique branding.

What are we like at SLM? We’re passionate, humble, and kind. We value data-driven thinking, speed, persistence, creativity, and teamwork. We love helping clients grow and scale through a tactile medium that has long term brand value. And finally, we get excited about transforming old-school channels into something new through data, product, technology, and a service-driven mentality.

Share our excitement? Great - We’d love to hear from you!

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Client Experience Manager. In this role you would partner with clients and internal stakeholders to drive retention, expansion, and product adoption—using data to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and inform strategic decisions. You would be responsible for building engagement and retention strategies for our existing client base. You would work with clients as well as our sales/marketing teams to drive adoption and outcomes leading to growth across our portfolio of clients. As a Senior Client Experience Manager you will work to understand customers through ongoing analysis of data and feedback, then turning that into retention strategies. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong competencies across analytical, communication, strategic, and operational skillsets. You will be responsible for supporting the business in areas of future growth, autonomously owning projects in service of revenue and operational growth. You will work with all Share Local Media teams and be an integral part of our mission to make marketing easier for tech and e-commerce brands everywhere.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Design and automate a recurring feedback schedule at critical client lifecycle stages to gather data on improving overall client experience
  • Translate client feedback into actionable insights and collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product & Account Management to inform roadmap priorities
  • Develop client engagement strategies to help our account management teams build stronger relationships with clients through tiered engagement playbooks, in-person events, and executive level engagement
  • Develop and host client events, conferences, and webinars focusing on industry expertise, best practices, and knowledge sharing
  • Regularly report on the effectiveness of these strategic programs to senior management, providing insights and recommendations for ongoing improvements
  • Manage multiple concurrent work streams, stakeholders, and timelines to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery
  • Contribute to the development of scalable implementation of processes and best practices across the team

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in marketing, account management, strategy, or consulting, preferably in SaaS, AdTech, MarTech, or startup environments
  • Experience working within multi-channel marketing ecosystems (SMS, RCS, email, push, CDPs, ESPs, marketing automation platforms)
  • Demonstrated ownership of ambiguous projects and self-defining objectives and priorities
  • Experience building standard operating procedures that have been successfully adopted by larger teams
  • Proven ability to work effectively cross-functionally, building relationships and ensuring cohesive strategies towards common business goals
  • Strong, hands-on project management and event management experience


What we offer

  • Base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $128,000 and is based upon experience and other factors.
  • Full-time role, hybrid NYC based
  • Career ownership and growth opportunities
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Robust benefits package
  • A fun culture including: catered meals, team events, and happy hours
  • The opportunity to work with a group of passionate, humble, and kind team members

If you’re looking to be part of something new that is transforming an industry, this is the role for you. You will be empowered to think like an entrepreneur by coming up with new ideas, testing and implementing them, and then scaling them quickly across clients/teams.

title: Director Downtown Environment
description:
About Us

Cities are built by people. The creators of industry, makers of place. Visionaries—for what’s next. At the Downtown Denver Partnership, we are building with vision.

We believe the horizon of a great city is always growing, always improving. We believe our city is only as strong as the center. And we know that a thriving, strategic evolution only happens when every voice steps up to the mic. When access allows for unbridled opportunity.

Whether we are talking about mobility and transportation or economic development, our organization focuses on fostering an impactful culture and business community that will support each and every citizen, giving us all a seat at the table.

Building our center city, making our place.

About the Position

Downtown Denver deserves to be the cleanest, most beautiful, and most welcoming downtown in America, and the Director of Beautification & Public Realm Care is the person who makes that true every single day.

Working across the Downtown Denver Partnership and the Downtown Denver Business Improvement District (DDBID), this leader directs the public realm operations, service provider contracts and field teams that define the everyday downtown experience for workers, residents, businesses, and visitors.

This role pairs operational excellence with a planner’s understanding of how cities work. The Director manages significant budgets and contracts, builds trusted relationships with the City and County of Denver, property owners, businesses, and community partners, and translates organizational strategy into measurable results in a highly visible environment. The Director serves as a key member of the Downtown Environment leadership team and a respected voice for downtown operations and public realm asset management. This position prioritizes beautification and the public realm.

Utilizing the Downtown Area Plan as a guide, this position is fundamental to the successful delivery of provision of a vibrant and beautiful Place.

Responsibilities

Strategic Implementation

  • With an eye for design, detail, and ambitious standards, this position will apply landscape architecture and urban planning expertise to public realm, streetscape, mobility and placemaking priorities, helping shape how downtown spaces are managed, maintained, and improved over time.
  • Execute the operations strategy, annual workplan and performance goals for Downtown Environment operations in alignment with the Partnership’s strategic work plan and the DDBID operating plan.
  • Define, track and report key performance indicators that demonstrate measurable outcomes for downtown cleanliness, activation, and overall public realm quality.
  • Anticipate emerging downtown conditions and needs, and recommend service, staffing, and investment adjustments accordingly.
  • Build out of a robust Asset Management process to ensure the longevity of the downtown public realm.

Program and Project Oversight

  • Oversee daily operations of downtown public realm programs, including cleaning and maintenance, landscaping and beautification, seasonal lighting, and other district services.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and field priorities, from planning through delivery, ensuring work is completed on time, on budget and to a high standard.
  • Monitor field conditions proactively and coordinate rapid responses to maintenance, infrastructure across the district.
  • Coordinate with Partnership colleagues in planning, events, marketing, communications, and advocacy to align operations with broader downtown initiatives.

Budget, Contract and Compliance Management

  • Develop, manage, and monitor the operating budget for Downtown Environment operations, including monthly variance analysis, forecasting, and fiscal accountability.
  • Lead procurement and manage service provider and vendor contracts, including scopes of work, performance standards, invoicing, renewals, and corrective action.
  • Hold contractors, vendors, and internal teams accountable to KPIs and service levels through regular field inspections, performance reviews, and clear reporting.
  • Seek cost efficiencies and alternative service delivery models that strengthen the long-term value of district investments.
  • Administer and ensure compliance with intergovernmental agreements, licenses, permits and other obligations with the City and County of Denver and other public partners.
  • Assess risk, insurance and liability considerations related to operations and contracted services.

Stakeholder and Relationship Management

  • Serve as a primary liaison with City and County of Denver agencies, including public works, transportation and infrastructure, parks, public safety and permitting, to coordinate services and resolve issues in the downtown core.
  • Build and sustain strong relationships with property owners, businesses, residents, nonprofits, and community partners, and DDBID Enterprise clients, responding to operational concerns and demonstrating the value of district services.
  • Influence partners and decision makers across public and private sectors, often without direct authority, to advance shared downtown outcomes.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop operations staff, fostering a collaborative, accountable and service-oriented team culture. Hand-in-hand relationship with Safety Director and team.
  • Collaboration and coordination with DDP’s Planning and Community Impact and Strategic Programs and Activations Teams, is critical part of the work of the Downtown Denver Partnership.
  • Set clear expectations, conduct performance evaluations, and support professional growth for direct reports.
  • Ensure staff and contracted teams are trained, equipped, and supported to work safely and effectively in the field.

Alignment and Board Engagement

  • Partner with Alignment leadership to inform strategy, budgets, and priorities, and provide timely updates on operational performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Prepare and present reports, analysis and recommendations to the Board, committees, and other governing bodies.
  • Support Board and committee processes related to the DDBID, including the operating plan, budget, and annual reporting requirements.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in landscape architecture, urban planning, public administration, nonprofit management, business administration, construction management, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
  • 7–12+ years of progressive experience, including leadership experience, in urban planning, downtown or district management, public realm operations, municipal or nonprofit management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with budget responsibility and with managing and overseeing service contracts and vendors, including performance monitoring and accountability.
  • Experience in local government, and/or with nonprofit organizations, and familiarity with business improvement districts, public-private partnerships or similar entities, preferred.
  • Strong external-facing relationship management skills, with experience working with government agencies, nonprofits, and community stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and to build consensus among diverse stakeholders.
  • Strategic planning and execution experience, with the ability to translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
  • Proven staff management experience, including coaching, developing, and evaluating teams.
  • Strong project and asset management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment with significant public visibility.
  • Excellent public presentation, written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to boards, public officials, and community groups.
  • Economic and community development mindset, with a commitment to downtown Denver and the people who live, work, and visit here.
  • Ability to work in the field in all weather conditions and to occasionally work early mornings, evenings and weekends to support events and urgent operational needs.

What We Offer

  • Expected salary range $115,000 - $135,000
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays
  • Employer paid Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Transportation Benefits
  • Personal and Professional Development

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Function: Cybersecurity – OT/ICS Offensive Security

Location: Bengaluru or Mumbai | Hybrid, with travel to customer and industrial sites

Experience: 6–10 years

OT/ICS Penetration Tester & Red Team Specialist

Role Overview
Seeking an experienced OT/ICS Penetration Tester to conduct security assessments, penetration testing, attack-path analysis, and adversary simulation across industrial and critical infrastructure environments. The role focuses on identifying vulnerabilities and attack paths across OT networks, SCADA/ICS systems, PLCs, HMIs, industrial DMZs, remote access infrastructure, and IT/OT environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform OT/ICS security assessments across Purdue Levels 0-3.
  • Assess SCADA, PLCs, HMIs, historians, engineering workstations, and OT network architecture.
  • Evaluate IT/OT attack paths, segmentation, firewalls, remote access, and industrial DMZs.
  • Conduct controlled red team and adversary simulation exercises.
  • Assess privilege escalation, lateral movement, identity exposure, and credential security.
  • Map findings to MITRE ATT&CK for ICS and Enterprise frameworks.
  • Support purple team exercises and validate security controls.
  • Develop test plans, risk assessments, rules of engagement, and rollback procedures.
  • Coordinate testing with OT, engineering, safety, SOC, and stakeholder teams.
  • Deliver technical and executive reports with remediation recommendations.

Required Skills

  • OT Security / ICS Security
  • Penetration Testing / Red Teaming
  • SCADA, PLC, HMI, DCS
  • Industrial Networks & Protocols
  • Active Directory, Windows, Linux
  • MITRE ATT&CK for ICS
  • Purdue Model
  • IEC 62443 / NIST 800-82
  • Attack Path Analysis
  • Vulnerability Assessment & Adversary Simulation

title: Director of Employer & Payor Relations
description:
Director of Employer & Payor Relations

Locations: Tyler, Longview & Galveston, Texas
Travel: Approximately 25–35% regional travel
Compensation: Base salary + quarterly performance incentives
Position Type: Full-Time

Relationships Matter. Advocacy Makes a Difference.

At Hospitality Health ER (HHER), we believe exceptional healthcare extends beyond the walls of our emergency rooms. It includes the relationships we build, the trust we earn, and the way we advocate for patients, employers, and the communities we serve.

We're seeking a dynamic, relationship-driven Director of Employer & Payor Relations to help bridge the gap between emergency healthcare, employer-sponsored benefits, and insurance networks.

This is not a traditional marketing position.

It's an opportunity for a strategic relationship builder who understands the complexities of healthcare reimbursement, thrives in challenging conversations, and knows how to transform obstacles into opportunities.

The right person will combine executive-level communication skills, healthcare financial literacy, and a genuine passion for helping people navigate an increasingly complicated healthcare system.

The Opportunity

As Director of Employer & Payor Relations, you will serve as a trusted resource and strategic partner to corporate HR leaders, benefits administrators, insurance brokers, third-party administrators (TPAs), and regional employers.

You'll work closely with leadership to strengthen existing relationships, resolve complex billing concerns, communicate the value of our emergency care model, and advance meaningful conversations about insurance network accessibility.

Beyond resolving immediate concerns, you'll help build a collaborative network of employers, benefits professionals, and community stakeholders who recognize the value of accessible, efficient emergency healthcare.

Your mission: Build trust. Create solutions. Strengthen partnerships. Expand access.

What You'll Do

Champion Employer & Benefits Relationships

  • Serve as a primary relationship contact for employer groups, HR executives, benefits directors, brokers, and TPAs across HHER's markets.
  • Build trusted partnerships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful problem-solving.
  • Navigate sensitive employer concerns involving emergency care billing, insurance coverage, and employee experiences with professionalism and discretion.
  • Coordinate timely resolutions with internal stakeholders while maintaining transparency and accountability.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships and restore confidence when challenges arise.

Advance Payor Relations & Network Accessibility

  • Develop relationships with self-funded employers, benefits consultants, brokers, and plan administrators to advocate for improved access to HHER's emergency services.
  • Educate employer groups on network participation, emergency care coverage, and potential opportunities for direct-to-employer partnerships.
  • Support employer-led requests for network expansion and facilitate conversations with insurance carriers and TPAs.
  • Collaborate with leadership on strategic initiatives designed to expand in-network accessibility and reduce unnecessary barriers for patients.
  • Help cultivate a coalition of employers and benefits stakeholders committed to improving healthcare access in their communities.

Navigate Complex Healthcare Billing Challenges

  • Partner with revenue cycle and billing leadership to investigate escalated employer and patient concerns.
  • Help stakeholders understand explanations of benefits (EOBs), claim adjudication, reimbursement processes, and coverage considerations.
  • Coordinate appropriate internal reviews and facilitate timely, accurate communication regarding billing disputes.
  • Apply working knowledge of healthcare reimbursement practices, ERISA, the No Surprises Act, and applicable insurance regulations.
  • Maintain confidentiality and ensure all communications and resolutions align with established policies and regulatory requirements.

Translate Data Into Meaningful Business Value

  • Analyze employer utilization trends, emergency care encounters, claims information, and relevant financial metrics.
  • Develop compelling presentations demonstrating HHER's value to employer-sponsored health plans.
  • Collaborate with leadership to evaluate opportunities for cost efficiencies, improved care navigation, and reduced avoidable healthcare expenditures.
  • Communicate complex healthcare and financial information in a clear, accessible, and persuasive manner.
  • Use data-driven insights to strengthen employer relationships and support strategic network discussions.

Drive Strategic Growth & Accountability

  • Establish and maintain meaningful engagement with employers, brokers, and benefits professionals throughout the Tyler, Longview, and Galveston markets.
  • Develop a consistent communication and relationship management strategy across all HHER locations.
  • Monitor employer satisfaction, escalated issue resolution, partnership development, and network advocacy initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate relationship documentation, activity reporting, and progress toward established performance objectives.
  • Partner with executive leadership to identify emerging opportunities, address barriers, and advance long-term organizational goals.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, payor relations, employer benefits, TPA account management, insurance brokerage, healthcare contracting, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated success managing professional relationships with employers, executives, benefits administrators, or healthcare stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of employer-sponsored health plans, insurance reimbursement, claims processes, or healthcare financial operations.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to navigate complex and sensitive situations with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment.
  • Strong analytical skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Excel and business presentations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while collaborating across departments.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout HHER's Texas markets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with self-funded employer health plans, TPAs, or employee benefits brokerage firms.
  • Familiarity with emergency department billing, out-of-network reimbursement, and healthcare claims adjudication.
  • Working knowledge of ERISA, the No Surprises Act, independent dispute resolution (IDR), and applicable Texas insurance regulations.
  • Experience supporting healthcare network development, employer contracting, or direct-to-employer arrangements.
  • Established professional relationships within the East Texas or Gulf Coast employer and benefits communities.
  • Experience presenting healthcare financial data or strategic recommendations to executive audiences.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn't measured simply by the number of meetings held or relationships established. It's measured by the trust you build, the problems you solve, and the progress you create.

You'll make a meaningful impact by:

  • Strengthening employer relationships through timely, thoughtful resolution of complex concerns.
  • Improving communication and collaboration between employers, benefits professionals, and HHER's revenue cycle teams.
  • Expanding engagement with regional HR leaders, benefits brokers, and TPAs.
  • Advancing qualified opportunities for employer-supported network participation and direct-to-employer agreements.
  • Delivering measurable progress toward strategic relationship and business development objectives.

Quarterly performance incentives will be tied to established goals involving relationship management, issue resolution, strategic engagement, and partnership development.

The Person We're Looking For

You're equal parts relationship builder, strategic thinker, and problem-solver.

You know how to listen when someone is frustrated, ask the right questions, and bring the right people together to find a solution.

You're comfortable discussing complex healthcare financial matters with an experienced benefits executive, but you never lose sight of the individual patient behind the claim.

You understand that credibility is earned through follow-through, transparency, and consistency.

Most importantly, you recognize that the strongest partnerships aren't built by avoiding difficult conversations. They're built by navigating those conversations with confidence, compassion, and integrity.

If you're ready to make a meaningful impact at the intersection of healthcare, employer benefits, and community relationships, we'd love to meet you.

Join Hospitality Health ER.

Build relationships. Advocate for access. Make healthcare work better.

This position offers flexibility with remote and hybrid work options. If you are passionate about integration technologies and eager to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your tasks

  • Migrating existing integrations from BizTalk to Azure Integration Services

  • Collaborating with business owners and architects to define integration requirements

  • Ensuring best practices in integration development and deployment

  • Troubleshooting and resolving integration issues

  • Participating in the design and architecture of integration solutions

  • Documenting integration processes and solutions

  • Mentoring junior team members on integration best practices

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in integration development

  • Deep expertise in Azure Integration and Azure Integration Services

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot integration issues

  • Experience working in a collaborative team environment

  • Advanced level of English

Nice-to-have requirements

  • Experience with other Azure services related to integration

  • Knowledge of API management and microservices architecture

  • Familiarity with Microsoft BizTalk or other integration platforms

title: Sports Director
description:
OUR CULTURE:

Our mission and core values are brought to life through our culture. At the YMCA of South Hampton Roads, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day.


We are welcoming: we are open to all and create spaces where people can belong and become.

We are genuine: we value people and embrace individuality.

We are hopeful: we believe in the potential of people to grow, lead and become catalysts for change.

We are nurturing: we support individuals throughout their journey to reach their full potential.

We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger, beginning with our people.

Our culture is not a People & Culture initiative; it is how we lead, serve, develop talent, make decisions and deliver on the YMCA's mission.


POSITION SUMMARY:

Under the direction of the Executive Director, the Sports Director is responsible for the day-to-day operations of Youth and Adult sports programming at multiple YMCAs within the YMCA of South Hampton Roads. This position provides Cause-Driven leadership in staff supervision, volunteer management, fiscal management, program administration, facility & equipment stewardship, community relations, and personal-professional

development. This role helps support the Association Sport’s Cabinet by assisting in a leadership role. The Division Sports Director is the acting Sports Director at a location of the

YMCA of South Hampton Roads. Priorities include:

  • To develop and grow their home YMCA as the premiere Sports service provider in the Hampton Roads community through strong innovative direct leadership
  • Indirect leadership of multiple Family Center Sports Leaders
  • Achieve budget expectations annually
  • Staff and Volunteer development The Division Sports Director will be based out of one of the following centers within their division:
  • Blocker Norfolk Family YMCA
  • Currituck Family YMCA
  • Greenbrier Family YMCA


The Sports Director must understand and be willing to learn the necessary skills required for the successful completion of duties including:

Budget and Financial Performance

  • Develops, manages, and monitors center sport’s operating budgets to meet or exceed targets. Initiates and manages adjustments to the budget to assure a balanced operation and submits reports on current operations.
  • Makes necessary purchases, inventories, and deliveries of all program related supplies in accordance with Association standards

Program Development and Membership Engagement

  • Provides safe, organized, and quality sports programs that serve the community needs
  • Plans, develops, and implements sports programming in accordance with the association sport’s calendar
  • Implements Association membership strategies that support recruitment of new members and retention of existing members. Creates a member-focused culture and models relationship-building skills in all interactions. Uses YMCA “listen first” skills to understand and respond to the needs, wants and interests of members. Fosters a climate of innovation and resolves problems to ensure member satisfaction, plan and execute community-programming opportunities in the extended Norfolk and Portsmouth community
  • Develops long-range plans for the expansion of programs and services, in harmony with overall YMCA objectives. Monitors the achievements of these objectives and exercises appropriate action to assure the achievements of the objectives are of the highest quality programs and services
  • Develops, produces, and distributes program information necessary to promote assigned programs, in accordance with branch marketing plans
  • Ensures safety, cleanliness and function of all related facilities and equipment

Team Performance Towards Organizational Goals

  • Provides strong leadership and support for attaining Association’s goals and objectives of the strategic plan
  • Hires, trains, evaluates, and supervises sports team members
  • Recruits and trains program volunteers
  • Provides leadership and support for branch management team, annual support campaign, and volunteer committees/boards as assigned
  • Performs the duties of direct reports as needed

Fundraising

  • Participates in a successful annual support campaign, with staff giving and membership involvement

Professional Development

  • Completes New Staff Orientation, blood borne pathogens, child abuse prevention and trainings as required
  • Attends mandatory staff meetings and assists with the leadership of the Sport’s Cabinet
  • Incorporates character development within the activities of the Y
  • Represents and promotes the Y in the local community by developing positive working and collaborative relationships with other organizations, businesses, and governmental entities

Facility Management

  • Ensures upkeep of related facilities and equipment
  • Effectively coordinates facility usage for assigned programs and activities

title: Mid / Senior SQL Developer
description:
Wynagrodzenie

Oferujemy

title: E-learning Content Specialist – Elucidat
description:
Wynagrodzenie

Hello,
We are called People More because we treat our employees with respect, but also because the projects we work on are for people and should be easy and pleasant to use. We are technological, but we look at the bigger picture :)
The company is made up of people with a huge client base in the country and abroad, for whom we build projects from scratch (UX, UI, frontend, backend, mobile) or in part. We work directly for our clients and also support our partners in their own solutions. This ensures a wide range of projects and the ability to change! We work with clients all over the world.
For the project that we are working on with our partner, we are looking for E-learning Content Specialist – Elucidat.

Your duties will include:

  • Develop online courses in Elucidat using structured, detailed storyboards provided by the team.

  • Translate storyboard instructions into course pages, following the specified content structure and sequence.

  • Build learning content using Elucidat’s authoring tools and features, according to the supplied requirements.

  • Ensure the course accurately reflects the content and instructions included in the storyboard.

  • Identify any missing information or unclear instructions and clarify them with the project stakeholder.

  • Manage assigned course development tasks independently within the agreed project timeframe.

Requirements that must be met:

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Elucidat and confidence in using it independently.

  • Proven experience developing e-learning content and delivering completed online courses.

  • Ability to interpret detailed storyboards and translate them into fully developed learning materials.

  • Good understanding of how to structure and present content in an online learning environment.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow content and production guidelines accurately.

  • Good organisational skills and the ability to deliver assigned work within agreed deadlines.

  • Availability for a short-term contract

  • Very good English and Polish

What we offer:

  • We are open and honest and we solve problems instead of generating them.

  • Maybe it’s obvious, but we really respect our employees and associates. We used to be software developers, too, and we appreciate that job!

  • A small team

  • An international working environment and international projects

  • Private medical care

  • Sports card

  • Training courses

  • Work that is 100% remote (unless you prefer another system)

We have an office in Krakow, but if you like to work remotely, that’s absolutely fine. We are OK with fully remote work. For us, you can be located anywhere. :)

Why it’s a good idea to work with People More?

  • If you are not satisfied with your work or your tasks, we’ll find a way out together!

  • If you get bored, we will offer you a new product and new, fascinating tasks

  • We will work on your brand together: you will get an opportunity to attend conferences, including as a speaker, and we will help you publish in recognized magazines and online

  • We will facilitate your access to challenges that are usually difficult to get

  • At any time, you can talk directly to the board of People More—we talk your language because the company’s founders are software developers and designers!

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A friendly remote initial interview

  • A remote technical talk

  • The decision to work together!

title: Senior Azure Advanced Cloud Engineer
description:
Overview

Our customers depend on Azure to run critical parts of their businesses, and the Engineering Operations (EngOps) team is committed to delivering the quality, reliability, and support experiences that turn customers of Microsoft Cloud into fans.
The Advanced Cloud Engineering & Supportability (ACES) Strategic team is a global EngOps organization focused on Microsoft’s strategic Azure customers. We are customer-obsessed engineers who lead mission-critical engagements across incident management, problem management, service improvement, and customer advocacy. We also turn lessons from individual customer engagements into scalable improvements across Azure.

As a Senior Advanced Cloud Engineer, you will serve as the primary engineering contact accountable for your customer’s Azure support experience. You will lead the resolution of critical and complex technical issues, support customer’s key Azure initiatives, and represent the customer’s voice within Microsoft. You will partner closely with Customer Success Account Managers, Cloud Solution Architects, Technical Support Engineers, Product Groups, and other engineering teams.
If you are passionate about solving complex technical problems, improving customer experience, and driving innovation at scale, we would like to hear from you.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Technically Oriented
• Track customer incidents, engage with strategic customers and partners to understand issues, contribute to troubleshooting through diagnostics, communicate progress and next steps to customers with a focus on reducing time taken to mitigate critical incidents.
• Use engineering and support tools, customer telemetry and/or direct customer input to detect and flag trends/patterns of issues in the products or products misuse across customers. Develop and share insights and best practices with customers.
• Recommend and help develop training/readiness modules (e.g., mentoring, leading triages, content creation, brown bag sessions, blogs, quality assurance checks). Acts as a mentor, shares knowledge, and contributes to the content and readiness strategy for the team.

Customer Solution Lifecycle Management
• Serve as a connecting point between the product team and customers throughout the engagement lifecycle, engage with customers to understand their business and availability needs, develop and offer proactive guidance on designing configurations and deploying solutions on Azure.
• Handle complex escalations on customer issues from the customer or support or field teams, conduct impact analysis, help customers with answers to their technical questions, and serve as an escalation resource in areas of subject matter expertise.
• Conduct in-depth root cause analysis of issues and translates findings into opportunities for improvement and track and drive them as repair items.

Relationship/Experience Management
• Act as voice of customers and synthesize product feedback from strategic customers to provide input on business plans developed by the product groups. Identify customer usage patterns and drive resolutions on reoccurring issues with product groups. Close the feedback loop with the customers on product features.
• Partner with other teams (e.g., program managers, software engineers, product, customer service support teams), prioritize, unblock, and resolve critical customer issues.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver solutions to strategic customers and develop mechanisms that improve customer health and reduce the turnover time.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Data Analytics/Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), or related field AND 4+ years experience in technology industry, cloud, technical support, and/or customer experience engineering
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
    • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of demonstrated experience supporting and troubleshooting enterprise level, mission-critical applications and infrastructure resolving complex issues/situations and driving technical resolution across cross-functional organizations.
  • Hands-on expertise in two or more Azure or equivalent technology areas, such as Compute, Storage, Networking, Kubernetes, SQL Database, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, App Service, Azure Functions, Redis Cache, and other Azure services.
  • 2+ years of customer-facing experience, with demonstrated ability to prioritize, advocate for, and communicate customer needs to stakeholders.
  • 2+ years of Experience with being on-call and driving mitigation for mission critical incidents.
  • Strong communication and customer-engagement skills, including the ability to build trust, communicate complex technical issues to varied audiences, and lead recurring customer business reviews.

title: Data Platform Engineer with Apache Druid
description:
Wynagrodzenie
B2B: 1500 – 1650 PLN / mies. netto

Data Platform Engineer (Senior / Principal)

Build the data platform that turns massive datasets into meaningful insights.

Work model: 100% Remote
Project duration: December 2026
Seniority: Senior / Principal

THE OPPORTUNITY

Data at scale requires more than infrastructure — it requires thoughtful engineering, high-performance pipelines, and reliable architecture.

We’re looking for Senior and Principal Data Platform Engineers to help build and evolve a large-scale data platform for an international technology company operating in the customer engagement, automation, and data-driven marketing space.

You’ll work on the foundations that make data accessible, enriched, secure, and ready for analytics — from Apache Druid ingestion pipelines and Kafka-based streaming to database optimization and access control.

If you enjoy solving complex data engineering challenges and building systems designed to perform at scale, this project offers an opportunity to make a meaningful technical impact.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop and maintain Apache Druid ingestion pipelines and custom extensions, including integrations with external lookup backends.

  • Build and support Kafka-based data pipelines, with potential involvement in Flink-based stream processing.

  • Design and implement pre-aggregation and data enrichment processes.

  • Optimize MySQL queries and database performance in high-scale environments.

  • Develop metadata enrichment mechanisms across multiple data stores.

  • Integrate and maintain Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) solutions across platform components.

  • Work with AWS services, including S3, Aurora, and IAM.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams working on broader data platform and lakehouse initiatives.

  • Contribute to the scalability, performance, and security of a modern analytical data ecosystem.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong hands-on experience with Apache Druid, particularly ingestion pipelines and extension development.

  • Experience building and maintaining Kafka-based data pipelines.

  • Knowledge of Flink or similar stream-processing technologies.

  • Strong understanding of MySQL query optimization and database performance tuning at scale.

  • Experience implementing metadata enrichment across data platforms.

  • Practical experience integrating and maintaining RBAC solutions across multiple data stores.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, particularly S3, Aurora, and IAM.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate on complex engineering challenges.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with ClickHouse.

  • Familiarity with Apache Iceberg and lakehouse architectures.

  • Knowledge of query federation technologies such as Trino and Amazon Athena.

  • Experience with large-scale analytical platforms and modern data ecosystem integrations.

WHY THIS PROJECT?

  • Remote-first collaboration — work from wherever you do your best engineering.

  • Real data platform challenges — work with ingestion, streaming, enrichment, performance, and access control at scale.

  • Modern data technologies — contribute to an ecosystem built around Apache Druid, Kafka, AWS, and related technologies.

  • Technical impact — help evolve platform capabilities that support data-driven products and analytics.

READY TO ENGINEER WHAT’S NEXT?

If building scalable data platforms, optimizing complex pipelines, and solving challenging engineering problems is what drives you, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply now and bring your data engineering expertise to the next stage of platform evolution.

title: Program Director
description:
Clinical Program Director

Department: Clinical

Reports To: Vice President of Operations, Executive Director of Quality Assurance

Direct Reports: Clinical Staff

FLSA Status: Exempt

POSITION SUMMARY

The Clinical Program Director provides oversight and leadership for daily clinical programming operations, ensuring high-quality, compliant, and well-coordinated patient care. This role is responsible for facilitating interdisciplinary collaboration, maintaining documentation and utilization review standards, supporting clinical staff development, and serving as a key liaison between clinical teams and leadership. The Clinical Program Director will also assume operational leadership responsibilities for the program, to be further defined by the Vice President.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Daily

  • Facilitate the Interdisciplinary Meeting at 9:00 AM, Monday through Friday.
  • Verify that the time of admission matches the patient's signature on the Consent for Treatment and Conditions of Admission form (Intake tab).
  • Assign any patients admitted overnight prior to the Interdisciplinary Meeting by completing the Assignment of Care Team and UR Level of Care forms (Initial Clinical tab).
  • Ensure new admission assignments are discussed during the Interdisciplinary Meeting rather than via email.
  • Update the Provider/Step-Down List.
  • Relay upcoming UR reviews and the therapists responsible for updating documentation for the current week in the Clinical Teams channel, Monday through Friday.
  • Ensure all Group Notes are opened and completed by facilitators daily.
  • Ensure all clients are accounted for during split groups.
  • Audit Group Notes daily and send email notifications for any group notes left incomplete for the past 48 hours.
  • Stay current on activity in relevant Teams channels and respond as needed.
  • Stay current on email correspondence and respond as needed.

Weekly

  • Participate in weekly Group Supervision, conducted by the Clinical Director (CD).
  • Meet with the Clinical Director prior to Supervision to discuss quality assurance (QA) deficiencies.

Monthly

  • Complete the monthly Performance Improvement (PI) Programming Report.
  • Provide Case Managers with the link to Patient Satisfaction Surveys.
  • Ensure Therapist Peer-to-Peer Review forms are completed for each therapist and filed in the binder at the facility.

Bi-Annual

  • Coordinate and participate in the Bi-Annual Flyland Clinical Department Meeting

As Needed

  • Support recruitment and training, including orientation and onboarding of clinical staff.
  • Complete UR Peer Reviews for insurance authorization denials, when permitted by a Licensed Clinician.
  • Collaborate with the Programmer and Clinical Director on coaching and staff development plans.
  • Serve as on-call resource for psychiatric emergencies.

OPERATIONAL DUTIES

This role will absorb operational leadership duties in addition to the clinical programming responsibilities above. title: Electronics Engineer
description:
3Brain is a Swiss deep tech company working on cell-electronic interfaces that link biological networks to computers via custom-made semiconductor microchips. Our mission is to empower life scientists to probe intelligent networks, accelerate biomedical discoveries for the benefit of patients, and create a future more exciting than the present. Our interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers are constantly pushing the boundaries of engineering for life’s complexities. We are ambitious, fast-growing and love to explore. The company’s cutting-edge products are used in laboratories and pharma companies worldwide. 3Brain is headquartered in Switzerland nearby Zurich, has a Data Science and Discovery Unit in Genova, Italy, and an operational unit in the US.

Tasks

For the next expansion step, 3Brain is looking for a full-time Hardware electronics engineer to reinforce our R&D team. You will help develop embedded systems for high-speed data acquisition devices, including tasks such as system engineering, schematics design and layout, testing and verification. You will also contribute to the current device’s life-cycle management, including activities such as automation, production testing and optimization.

In particular, your tasks involve:

  • Designing high-speed embedded systems and architectures for products based on high-resolution microelectrode arrays
  • Designing low-level current/voltage instrumentation tools to operate Micro-electrode Arrays (MEA)
  • Design and implement hardware systems and sub-systems (PCBs), including high-speed ADCs, microcontrollers and FPGA-SoMs, power supplies, etc.
  • Bringing-up, testing, measuring, characterization and validation of electronic systems
  • Design and development of production test tools
  • Make, assemble, debug and test demonstrators and prototype devices
  • Documentation (engineering, production, QA, etc.)

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Independence and ability to communicate and work effectively with other team members in a multicultural and international environment
  • BSc/MSc in Electrical Engineering
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in HW Design
  • Design of analog electronics and high-speed digital systems (Simulation, Schematics, HDI Layout)
  • Detailed understanding of PCB-manufacturing
  • Good understanding of EMC compliance and mechanical integration
  • Practical and industrial hands-on experience (e.g. prototype soldering, setting up test-benches, transfer and scale-up to mass production, etc.)
  • Prototyping and testing (i.e. for bring-up, debugging and production)
  • Background in basic signal processing (i.e. sampling, filtering, aliasing, etc.)
  • Fluency in English

Additional Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Python
  • Microprocessor programming

Benefits

  • A dynamic and stimulating work environment driven by a desire to build transformational technologies to help others.
  • A young, fast-growing company with plenty of opportunities for personal growth and development.
  • Great challenges and adventures in both technical and economical fields.
  • Working place: Pfäffikon SZ, Switzerland. It is a lakeside village just outside of Zurich, the country’s main cultural, financial and business center.

description:

The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Non-Technical Project/Program Management


General Profile

Recognized as an expert within the company. Anticipates internal and or external business challenges and/or regulatory issues; recommends process, product or service improvements. Solves unique and complex problems that have a broad impact on the business. Contributes to the development of functional strategy. Leads project teams to achieve milestones and objectives. Progression to this level is typically restricted on the basis of business requirements.


Key Responsibilities

This role will include dedicated onsite support at a Malaysian Contract Manufacturer to manage day-to-day execution of the Applied NEXX ramp and establishment of future business ongoing stability. The individual will act as the primary onsite execution leader, working closely with the contract manufacturer’s operations and the Applied NEXX team to drive material readiness, production flow, schedule adherence, issue resolution, and escalation discipline required to support the planned increase in output.

  • Manage daily onsite execution, including floor-level production readiness, material status, manufacturing constraints, and open action items for active and planned tool builds.
  • Lead daily production-floor scrums with the supplier and Applied stakeholders to identify problems, assign owners, drive real-time shortage resolution, and remove barriers to committed ship dates.
  • Establish and maintain a single source of truth for tool-by-tool readiness, including CTB status, long-lead material placement, PO acknowledgement, supplier commitments, configuration alignment, ECO disposition, and schedule risks.
  • Drive proactive escalation of material, quality, engineering, planning, purchasing, and manufacturing issues before they impact customer-committed dates or ramp milestones.
  • Partner with Applied NEXX manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, planning, and quality counterparts to ensure execution plans support the ramp from the current production rate toward the required multi-tool-per-quarter output.
  • Monitor the contract manufacturer’s capacity, staffing, second-shift readiness, training plans, layout constraints, and production-line maturity to support near-term and long-term capacity requirements.
  • Promote disciplined project management, clear ownership, stable communication cadence, and an open, proactive execution culture.
  • Interact with management to ensure that resources and attention needed to meet Nexx need by dates are allocated.
  • Interact with Applied Singapore and Applied Malaysia leadership teams to seek support as needed.
  • Defines clear project and program objectives, milestones, ownership, and resource plans for the contract manufacturers onsite execution model, ensuring the team remains focused on ramp readiness and committed delivery outcomes.
  • Ensures assigned programs are completed against agreed requirements, with attention to schedule adherence, product/process specifications, cost, resource utilization, and timely closure of execution risks.
  • Maintains disciplined documentation, status reporting, and cross-functional communication so that Applied NEXX, the contract manufacturer, and supporting functional teams are aligned on decisions, risks, actions, and escalation paths.

Other Requirements: This position also may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.
